chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 166: Wolf Cavalry, Charge!
paragraphs: However.
After observing the situation, these Lord Monsters.
Whether it was because they were wary of the firepower on Han Xing’s territory or for some other reason.
Ultimately, they did not enter the battlefield themselves.
Everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
But at that moment, although those Lord Creatures did not step in, seeing that Han Xing’s territory couldn’t be breached after prolonged attacks.
They began to emit strange sounds.
"Wuu—"
It was like a baby’s cry, yet also reminiscent of the sounds made by whales underwater.
As their sounds resonated among the tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
In the next moment, massive, blood-thirsty monsters appeared one by one.
These monsters, at the very least, had the strength of Elite Monsters, and there was no shortage of Leader Monsters among them.
In large numbers, each Lord-level Creature was surrounded by an army of over ten thousand Leader Monsters and Elite Monsters!
However, they just briefly showed their faces, then hid back into the horde of monsters.
Neither Shen Yun nor anyone else, including Han Xing, noticed these Leaders and Elites.
But they did realize that the attack from the Blood Tide Monsters had become even more ferocious.
Countless monsters charged one after another without pause!
As soon as one wave died, another would immediately take its place, without any interval.
The intensity was far greater than ever before.
"Damn, have these monsters gone mad? They’re so reckless!" Cheng Jianyong asked, puzzled.
Everyone frowned in agreement.
If the attack rhythm of these monsters had previously been a gentle breeze, it was now a raging storm!
The pressure on the Defense Towers skyrocketed!
Han Xing did not answer.
The Thunderbolt Tower and Flamethrower Catapult erupted once more!
Rumble!
This time the monster horde was even denser.
A quarter of the attack buildings wiped out over a hundred thousand monsters!
This round gained nearly 150,000 battle merits, an immense amount!
At that moment, everyone was suddenly horrified to see.
When those ordinary monsters were blasted to pieces, their bodies falling from the sky.
Massive, twisted figures emerged from within the horde.
Now, tens of thousands of Leader and Elite Monsters revealed their presence!
Everyone’s expressions changed dramatically.
"It’s Leader Monsters and Elite Monsters, so many of them!" Cheng Jianyong urgently warned!
Shen Yun took a glance at the situation, instantly realizing what was happening, his face turning frantic.
"Damn it! I didn’t expect the Tier Two Blood Tide Monsters to be so cunning!"
"They actually had these Leaders and Elites hidden among the ordinary monsters, waiting for the right moment to approach us!"
"The Catapults and Thunderbolt Towers can’t take them out in one blow, this is really troublesome!"
After hearing this, everyone realized the situation.
At this moment, with the inability of the Thunderbolt Tower and Catapult to instantly eliminate these monsters, there were only two response strategies.
The first was for Han Xing to mobilize more attack buildings to deal with these Lord Creatures.
But doing so would allow the Blood Tide Monsters to seize the opportunity to forcibly land on Han Xing’s territory.
At that point, not only would the attack rhythm of the Defense Towers be disrupted, but even their territory would face an onslaught!
The second option was for Han Xing to simply ignore these Lord Creatures and allow them to reach the territory.
They would then confront them directly in battle.
Undoubtedly, the second method would lower the risk to the territory.
However, the risk would then transfer to the five of them.
Everyone looked at Han Xing with grave expressions.
At this time.
The raid army, composed of Leader Monsters and Elite Monsters, seized the chance and closed in to within five hundred meters of Han Xing’s territory!
They were about to collectively land on Han Xing’s Sky Island.
As the monsters drew closer, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun shouted in unison: "Brother Xing! Should we go down?"
They were already prepared to charge into battle.
Including Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
However, Han Xing stopped them.
"Hold on."
The four were stunned.
Those Leaders and Elites were almost on the territory.
What was there to not be urgent about?
However, Han Xing did not speak, instead, he looked down at the empty ground,
Boom! Boom boom!
The Thunderbolt Tower continued to unleash its terrifying Energy.
More and more monsters endured each wave of attacks, closing in on Han Xing’s territory!
In the blink of an eye.
Thousands of Leader and Elite Monsters appeared from all directions.
"Brother Xing!" Cheng Jianyong was already losing his patience.
Han Xing calmly stated: "Don’t be nervous."
"The Leaders and Elite Monsters are just thicker-skinned than those ordinary monster hordes."
"The firepower on our territory is more than sufficient; even if they can hide among the horde, they’ve still sustained considerable damage from the previous attacks."
"So, each of these creatures is definitely carrying varying degrees of injuries."
"We don’t even need to personally intervene with these heavily injured creatures."
Cheng Jianyong was dumbfounded once more.
Not needing their intervention meant that Han Xing still had a trump card?
Han Xing did not offer an explanation but instead looked down at the territory.
Exactly as Han Xing had mentioned.
These Elite Monsters staggered, carrying injuries of varying severity.
Under that intense bombardment, even Leaders and Elite Monsters suffered severe wounds.
However, despite paying a heavy price, these Blood Tide Monsters finally managed to land on Han Xing’s territory.
They were impatient to tear those humans apart!
Thousands of bloody figures pounced toward Han Xing and the others.
Everyone’s faces were tense.
At this moment, Han Xing looked toward the open area of the territory.
There, stood a Green army and a Yellow army.
It was the force composed of Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs, long prepared and waiting.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 166: Wolf Cavalry, Charge! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The next moment.
Han Xing directly spoke: "Wolf Cavalry, it’s time for you to take the battlefield!"
As soon as the words fell, tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry simultaneously raised their proud heads, looking at Han Xing on the city wall, who is their lord.
"Swear to fight to the death for the lord!"
"It is our honor to fight for the lord!"
Creatures summoned from the Otherworld have absolute loyalty to their lord.
Upon death, their consciousness returns to this world, so they regard dying in battle as an honor.
Han Xing nodded.
"I will not command you in this battle; you will rely entirely on your own combat experience."
"You need to kill as many enemies as possible while striving to keep casualties low."
"Let me see if the Wolf Cavalry tribe is as brave and skilled as legends say!"
Undoubtedly, Han Xing’s request is quite challenging.
However, there is not a trace of fear in the eyes of the Wolf Cavalry, instead, their battle spirit is soaring!
They all raised their Great Swords, "The Wolf Cavalry tribe, invincible in all directions!"
"Let the lord see our strength!"
"Wolf Cavalry, all out!"
The next moment.
The Wolf Cavalry stood up, shouting in unison!
"Charge! For the lord, charge forward fearlessly!"
With a thunderous boom, the scene of tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry charging was truly heart-stirring.
Though they had no mounts, they still displayed an incredible momentum.
Beside them, over a hundred Minotaurs were equally unwilling to fall behind.
They placed the Totems on their shoulders down and slammed them into the ground!
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
The Totems hit the ground in unison, like heavy drums beating on everyone’s hearts.
Over a hundred Minotaurs advanced in unison.
Accompanied by their steps, it felt like they were not just a group of creatures, but a marching legion of war machines!
Watching the surging war intent in the eyes of the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
Han Xing also smiled.
The next moment.
He took out a golden horn from his backpack.
"Woooo——"
After the long sound of the horn.
Tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry and over a hundred Minotaurs seemingly felt a call coming from deep within their souls!
They felt a surging war intent erupting from within their bodies!
"Roar!"
"Moo!"
At this moment, the army formed by the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry finally clashed with the invading Blood Tide Monsters.
A Leader-level monster covered in scales and with giant pincers rushed fiercely.
It seemed to want to disrupt the formation of the Wolf Cavalry.
And just then, an elite Minotaur leapt high and shouted furiously.
"Die!"
It raised its giant Totem in its hand and smashed it toward that Leader-level Blood Tide monster.
Seeing the Minotaur Vanguard’s attack coming, a contemptuous look appeared in the deep eyes of the Leader Monster.
An Elite Level creature dares to strike at me?
It instantly raised crab-like blood-red pincers, intending to seize the Minotaur Vanguard’s Totem!
Bang!
The stout Totem touched the Leader Monster.
The Leader Monster only felt an unimaginable force coming upon it.
Crack!
With a crisp breaking sound, the pincers it raised were directly broken!
At this moment, the mutated Leader-level monster’s eyes showed a terrified expression.
In the first clash, it was completely outmatched by this Elite Level Minotaur!
This is because the current stage Blood Tide monster Leader is only level 20 and has not yet evolved into a Three-star monster.
While the Minotaur Vanguard is a level 25 Three-Star Elite Creature.
Speaking of Attributes, the Minotaur Vanguard outmatches it by a large margin!
Furthermore, with Han Xing’s Vim Divine Power Horn and the Dark Night Goddess Statue’s Attack Power boost.
The Minotaur Vanguard’s current actual combat power is not weaker than a Three-star Leader Monster.
Dealing with them is as simple as bullying children!
The next moment!
The Leader-level monster was smashed and flew over ten meters away.
Even before it could react.
A muscle giant over three meters tall leapt high.
War Trample!
The massive Totem covered its entire vision, smashing directly towards its head.
Boom!
Pfft!
Blood splattered, and the ground cracked!
The Leader-level monster was instantly smashed into a pulp!
In the first wave of combat, the Minotaur Vanguard achieved a resounding victory.
This scene.
Brought about different reactions in both armies.
The momentum of the Evil God mutations seemed to extinguish in an instant.
Meanwhile, Han Xing’s army, at this moment, was brimming with morale!
They watched the Minotaur Vanguard display its might, and a surging War Intent welled up within them.
"Fight!"
"Kill!"
The Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs charged forward directly!
The formation of Blood Tide Monsters was directly scattered.
Especially the over one hundred Minotaurs.
They leapt into the monster army, like war machines.
Wielding massive totems that weighed thousands of pounds with ease, they swept through the enemy ranks.
Anywhere there was a Minotaur presence, it was a complete onslaught.
Ordinary-level Minotaurs crushed Elite Monsters!
Minotaur Vanguards crushed Leader Monsters!
At this moment, the Minotaur race demonstrated astonishing combat power.
The spectators on the city walls were already dumbfounded.
Shen Yun couldn’t help but swallow: "These Minotaurs are born brutes, aren’t they..."
"The vigor in their fighting is terrifying.
Cheng Jianyong also said somewhat cautiously, "I feel that if I were to duel, I could maybe handle ten or twenty of them, but any more and it’d be too much."
Everyone agreed with this statement.
Cheng Jianyong, despite being a luxury-equipped melee Profession.
If he didn’t have teammates to help, he might be overrun and beaten to death by these Minotaurs.
On the other side, the Wolf Cavalry also displayed impressive coordination.
In terms of individual combat power, perhaps they were no match for the Minotaur unit.
But they knew how to use their numerical advantage to encircle and eliminate these monsters.
Using ten Wolf Cavalry as a squad, and a hundred as a unit.
Morphing into sharp blades that pierced the Blood Tide army.
The formation of Blood Tide Monsters was directly scattered.
Elite Monsters and Leader Monsters were isolated, creating small battlegrounds.
Unable to break through, they were ultimately slaughtered by the blades of the Wolf Cavalry!
Seeing this, Han Xing also completely relaxed.
In the first frontal encounter, both units demonstrated powerful combat capabilities and gained the upper hand.
With this, even if the Thunderbolt Towers and Catapults let some monsters slip through, there would be no need to worry.
"Very good, the combat power of the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry is impressive."
"After this monster outbreak ends, I’ll directly summon an army of hundreds of thousands!"
Han Xing thought hopefully.
Then, the defensive capability of his territory will truly be impenetrable.
In the air.
A dozen or so Lord-level monsters, seeing their elite troops defeated, grew increasingly anxious.
Since the encirclement formed.
Less than ten minutes had passed.
And over two million Blood Tide Monsters have already been taken down by the territory’s attack devices!
Among them were at least tens of thousands of Elites and several hundred Leaders!
If this continues, they will be utterly passive.
At this moment, they all looked toward the depths of the monster tide.
Seemingly waiting for a command from a certain presence.
At the same time.
Within the territory of the ’Huayi Alliance’ team.
Zhou Huang was similarly ambushed by a Lord-level creature.
But at the crucial moment.
Zhou Huang unleashed incredible combat power.
As the number one in the region, how could he not have some tricks up his sleeve?
In the next moment, Zhou Huang drew out a golden greatsword full of cracks, terrifying golden light spilled from within.
"Dragon Slayer!"
With one swing.
It was as if a torrent of water surged forth.
You could even faintly hear the sound of a dragon’s roar.
The Lord-level creature felt a lethal threat within and was directly forced back by the strike.
In the next moment, the Lord-level creature transformed into a blood mist and fled.
However, before everyone could breathe a sigh of relief.
They suddenly saw, in the distant sky, an army of over ten million Blood Tide Monsters appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 167: Dominator
paragraphs: Zhou Huang wielded his sword, just forcing back that lord-level creature.
However, before the survivors of the Huayi Alliance could catch their breath.
They suddenly saw, in the distant sky, an army composed of tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
The terrifying size of this army left the 500,000 humans of the ’Huayi Alliance’ Sky Island in disbelief.
Throughout all the human survivors, they faced a scale of monsters second only to Han Xing.
If it were an ordinary team, encountering such a scale of monsters, they would have given up resisting long ago.
But fortunately, Zhou Huang’s temperament was very resilient.
Though his expression was grim, he immediately issued various directives, leading the command.
Zhou Huang’s strength didn’t lie in his combat abilities but in his unparalleled coordination skills.
Because of his identity on Blue Star, he was extremely skilled at directing large-scale wars.
During the first merge, Zhou Huang clearly stated he wanted to unify the entire region, which means the only team name would be Huayi Alliance.
Naturally, this aroused dissatisfaction among other teams, prompting them to organize an ambush targeting Zhou Huang.
Back then, Zhou Huang, with just over 5,000 people, defeated eight teams and over 40,000 survivors, leaving them in disarray.
His terrifying war intent, endless contingency plans, and meticulous coordination abilities left his opponents trembling in fear.
After that battle, all the teams in Area One submitted to Zhou Huang.
Thus, he managed to establish the most recognized and largest team in such a short time.
Now, facing millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
Zhou Huang steadily and methodically continued to issue commands.
But even though Zhou Huang extracted every ounce of power he could muster to the limit.
Facing enemies that outnumbered them a hundredfold, it was getting increasingly difficult to hold on.
The battle ring formed by the survivors was being gradually compressed, retreating towards the living area.
They knew they couldn’t retreat any further.
Beyond lay the living quarters, home to hundreds of thousands of civilians.
Among them were also their relatives and friends.
In this critical moment.
Zhou Huang seemed to have made a certain decision.
He raised his golden greatsword high.
The blinding Holy Light covered millions of meters around!
At the same time, the cracked golden longsword grew even more fractured, on the verge of shattering.
This golden light caused no physical damage, but it stretched deep into the Blood Tide.
Even the lord-level creatures looked blankly at this golden light.
However, amidst them.
A creature over ten thousand meters in size, with strength far surpassing the lords, sensed danger within this golden light.
After some hesitation, this creature issued a certain command.
The next moment, the army of tens of millions of Blood Tide monsters retreated like a tide.
On the territory.
The 100,000 survivors and over 400,000 dependent relatives felt immense relief.
Then, with overwhelming admiration, they looked at Zhou Huang.
They knew that it was Zhou Huang who unleashed that golden light.
Once again, he rescued everyone from peril!
After the crisis was averted, Zhou Huang’s facial expression remained unchanged, but he couldn’t help but break into a cold sweat.
He murmured softly, "Luckily, the First Knight King’s sword still had one last strike."
"But unfortunately, the power of rules on it is exhausted; after this, this sword really becomes a piece of useless iron..."
A look of regret appeared on Zhou Huang’s face.
Just then, he suddenly took off a bead hanging from his neck.
It was entirely covered in a blood-red hue,
Zhou Huang’s face turned grave, "It seems the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser’s Dragon Pearl truly gave me enlightenment."
"Inside the Blood Tide, an entity with terrifying intellect has already emerged."
"This message must be spread quickly."
Zhou Huang hurriedly opened the public channel to make an announcement!
"All fellow humans, this is Zhou Huang!"
"I’ve received information that a creature above the lord in the Blood Tide monsters has emerged, possessing terrifying intellect."
"This level of creature is unimaginably fearful, we call it, Dominator!"
"Dominator-level creatures possess unimaginable mighty power, and have intelligence beyond ordinary beings."
"Currently, they have concentrated their forces and are attacking our human elite teams!"
"Huayi Alliance, Kunlun, Kyushu, and other teams are all under massive monster siege..."
"Any survivors who still have the ability, please hurry to these locations to rescue these teams!"
"This is of utmost importance!"
"If the elite group of the Human Race is wiped out, then the advance of the Blood Tide monsters will be unstoppable."
"The extinction of the Human Race is at hand!"
After speaking.
Zhou Huang sent over thirty coordinates consecutively.
These coordinates were spread afar, including the location of Han Xing’s Xingyu City.
Nobody knows how Zhou Huang obtained these coordinates.
However, everyone detected the gravity of Zhou Huang’s words.
The coordinated attack by Dominator-level monsters was targeting these human elite teams.
If they succeed, the human elite would be wiped out!
Once these elites perish, it will be the others’ turn next.
The chat channel was in a heated discussion.
"Damn, these monsters are so cunning!"
"After laying low for a few days, they actually targeted those elite teams!"
"So despicable!"
The billions of survivors also felt a shiver down their spines.
Dominator level creatures are even more powerful than Lords!
And currently, out of billions of people in the human race, less than a ten-thousandth can single-handedly combat a Lord!
Let alone, the even more terrifying Dominators!
At this moment, other survivors encountering small-scale monster tides were asking one after another.
"Have you seen the coordinates Director Zhou sent out? Are there any brothers near there? Hurry and go support."
"We ’Eight Squirrels’ are here, but we’re also being besieged by blood tide monsters, completely unable to split ourselves!"
"We ’Spectrum’ are the same, too many monsters to handle!"
The blood tide monsters have been holding back for a few days.
The amassed numbers have reached a terrifying level.
Yet despite this, they can’t cover all of the human survivors.
And to deal with those human elite, the majority of blood tide Lord-level creatures concentrated on the thirty coordinates Zhou Huang sent out.
At this moment, the monsters other ordinary survivors encountered weren’t as terrifying as imagined.
Now, some teams had already finished their battles early.
At this time, a survivor named Wind Celestial Emperor spoke on the chat channel.
"Autocratic for Ten Thousand Years’ battle will soon end; we’re heading to the target location for support, brothers nearby, hold on!"
"Heart Joy Club is about to take down these monsters, where are the brothers of Zone 5? Join me in rescuing the Cyan Robed Goddess of the Immortal Mansion!"
"War God Hall is in crisis, where are brothers of Zone 7? Come quickly!"
In the team channel, some teams kept sending out calls.
They had already ended their battles.
During this time, it wasn’t just the blood tide monsters getting stronger.
The vast number of blood tide monsters, while bringing crisis, also provided all survivors with massive amounts of experience and battle merits.
These battle merits could be exchanged at the Battle Merit Store for Bronze and Silver Treasure Chests.
Survivors with abundant battle merits even exchanged one or two Golden Treasure Chests!
Previously, most survivors were a mix of blue and purple equipment.
Having one or two pieces of Purple Equipment was already considered a top-notch player.
But with the push from the Battle Merit Store, a large number of Silver Treasure Chests appeared.
The rarely-seen Purple Armor also gradually became more common.
Now, quite a few survivors were equipped with a full set of Purple Armor.
Compared to before the blood tide outbreak, everyone’s attributes had significantly improved.
And those big teams that were previously advantageous gained even more battle merits.
Under this system, their development rate saw a qualitative surge!
Now, many large teams had ended their battles.
And they were heading promptly towards the thirty coordinates sent by Zhou Huang for reinforcements.
Under immense pressure, at this moment, billions of humans displayed astonishing unity!
This is something that could never have happened on Blue Star.
But now, because there’s a common enemy.
If it’s not defeated, it would be the moment of human extinction!
Facing the crisis of extinction, humanity abandoned racial and national concepts and began to spontaneously unite together.
At this time, on a large Sky Island, there were as many as tens of thousands of people.
Among them, over twenty thousand were professionals above level 15.
The sky was filled with blood tide monsters surrounding them.
On the castle at the center of the territory, a breathtakingly beautiful woman in cyan stood atop, directing the battle.
She was none other than the goddess-level figure with the highest popularity from the previous five districts, Luo Chan.
This Sky Island was an Immortal Mansion she founded with her own hands, the team’s base.
Luo Chan glanced lightly, her delicate eyebrows unruffled, deftly directing.
In the sky, flamethrower catapults bombarded in waves, cutting off the air supremacy of the blood tide monsters.
On the territory, more than twenty thousand professionals coordinated seamlessly to keep the invading blood tide creatures firmly at the boundary.
However, no matter how much they resisted.
Unfortunately, the number of monsters was too great.
Even though they had more than fifty flamethrower catapults.
Compared to the millions of blood tide monsters, it was still too few.
At this moment, Luo Chan furrowed her brows, bit her lower lip lightly, and watched helplessly as the monster tide surged like a tsunami nearby.
The battle line formed by the survivors was being compressed step by step, about to retreat to the living area of the territory.
There, hundreds of thousands of ordinary people had no combat power.
At this time, the melee professionals blocking the blood tide monsters shouted loudly: "Hold on! Hold on!"
"Brothers, hang in there, Director Zhou has already sent out our location, soon, someone will come to save us!"
"We have to hold on!"
Luo Chan also heard about upcoming reinforcements through the chat channel.
At this moment, she bit her lip lightly, and the previously desperate pupils once again filled with intense war intent!

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 168: No Eggs Remain Unbroken Beneath a Collapsed Nest
paragraphs: Luo Chan said with determination in her voice, "Brothers and sisters of the Immortal Mansion."
"Reinforcements are on the way, we must hold on."
"Remember, behind you are your family, friends, and loved ones."
"They have just arrived in this world and have no ability to fight. If we let them face these monsters, they will become nothing but sacrifices."
"Now, all their hopes are pinned on us. If even we retreat, who will come to save them?"
"No matter what, we must hold out until the end."
"And I, Luo Chan, will fight alongside all of you until the very last moment!"
Everyone listened and their fighting spirit reignited.
"Goddess Luo Chan, we will advance and retreat with you!"
"That’s right, as long as we live, the tower stands. I will live and die with the Immortal Mansion!"
Supported by hope, many Survivors were also stirred to battle intent.
"There’s an Elite Monster over there, Hunter, quickly throw a spike trap!"
"Where’s the Illusionist? Cast a Mind Induction on that Leader Monster and lure it into the Attack Range!"
"Those with more than 5 layers of Blood Curse, retreat to the back of the battle line and wait for Holy Profession Purification!"
The army of more than twenty thousand Survivors was also being commanded in an orderly manner.
Although it was tough, they managed to barely hold on.
On the other side, the leaders of Kunlun, Boundless, and the Divine Hall, Chen Dali, were also resisting with difficulty.
Everyone gritted their teeth.
Because of Zhou Huang’s words, hope was reignited within them.
At this moment, as long as it wasn’t the last moment.
They would never give up!
Compared to the struggles of these people,
the number of monsters Han Xing faced, although the greatest among all of Blue Star’s humanity,
he still found it relatively easy.
So far, the five of them hadn’t even made a move.
All the invading monsters were completely wiped out by those Lord’s Buildings and the wolf cavalry army below.
At this moment, Han Xing, relying solely on the Defense Tower, had already killed more than four million monsters.
And he had already harvested five million Battle Merits!
Although still in a State of war, Han Xing was now so excited he nearly trembled all over!
What is the concept of five million Battle Merits?
This means he can exchange all five Bright Moon Treasure Chests in the Battle Merit Store!
To know, within the Bright Moon Treasure Chests, there’s a high probability of getting Orange Equipment!
Even if his luck was a bit off and he didn’t get Orange Equipment, the other items in the chest were equally amazing.
Han Xing thought excitedly, "Blood Tide Monsters, keep besieging me, don’t stop!"
"Better yet, let me directly save up to one hundred million Battle Merits to exchange for that Sun Treasure Chest!"
He was already anticipating the moment he accumulated one hundred million Battle Merits in his heart!
By then, he might possess the first Divine Artifact Level Equipment among all humanity!
Moreover, that time wouldn’t be too far off.
At this thought, Han Xing couldn’t feel more excited!
It seemed as if the Blood Tide Monsters heard Han Xing’s plea, they cooperated well.
No matter how many were blasted to death, they kept charging forward fearlessly.
It seemed they wouldn’t stop until they had taken down Han Xing’s territory!
At this moment, still over a hundred kilometers away from Han Xing’s Xingyu City.
More and more Survivors, having resolved the monsters near the Sky Islands, were heading there to support.
System prompts showed they had reached a new area and automatically joined the nearby regional channel.
However.
When these Survivors on the dozens of Sky Islands saw the vast sea of blood from afar, they couldn’t help but turn pale.
At that moment, they all stopped in their tracks.
A Survivor said in the chat channel with a trembling voice, "I... damn!"
"This... this... this is fucking unbelievable, right?"
"So many monsters attacking a Sky Island, even if there were ten thousand Celestial Soldiers and Generals attacking the Monkey King, it wouldn’t be like this!"
Other Survivors echoed in agreement, "It’s terrifying, there must be at least tens of millions of monsters here, right?"
"Inside, how many Leaders and Elite Monsters must be hiding!"
After this reminder, everyone recalled something, and their faces turned pale.
To know, the more monsters there were, the more Elite Monsters and Leaders would be among them. This was a pattern Survivors discovered in recent days.
Sometimes, you might even see one or two Lord-level Creatures within a Blood Tide!
However, what they did not know was, within, the hidden Lord-level Creatures, not just a couple, but an astonishing dozen!
Among them, there was also an even more terrifying Dominator Level creature!
At this point, even the Survivors who were preparing for rescue felt some fear.
Swallowing hard, everyone said, "It’s exaggerated, which team would survive this?"
"With our numbers, even if we all went together, it wouldn’t be enough to fill the gaps between the monster’s teeth, right?"
This reminder startled everyone.
They knew that given the weight of these Sky Islands, rushing for rescue
was akin to throwing a few stones into the sea, causing no waves.
Moreover, there was a high probability of being engulfed by the monsters within.
Compared to their initial enthusiasm, now, there was a flicker of retreat in the Survivors’ hearts.
After a moment of silence.
At this moment, a survivor named Donglian Fire said, "Everyone, our Fire Demon Corps is retreating first. There are too many monsters, and we just can’t help."
"We don’t want to lose our lives here."
After speaking, Donglian Fire controlled his vast territory on the Sky Island and turned away.
The local channel suddenly fell silent.
The number of these tens of millions of monsters felt like a cold bucket of water poured over their enthusiasm.
What Donglian Fire said was indeed reasonable.
It’s not that they didn’t want to help, but they simply didn’t have the ability.
Upon thinking that, more and more Sky Islands sighed in their hearts and also chose to leave.
Seeing the number of Sky Islands nearby decreasing,
At this time, a survivor named Chujiang Tiankuo shouted loudly in the local channel, "Why are you running? All of you damn well come back!"
"You can run for a moment, but can you run for a lifetime?"
His tone contained some anger.
However, those survivors ignored him and quickly controlled their territories to leave.
Chujiang Tiankuo stood there frozen, yet he still wanted one last struggle.
"Damn it, everyone, don’t leave!"
"Stay here a bit longer. If more people come, there’d be hope to rescue those inside."
In the chat channel, the survivors who left said:
"Director Chu, it’s not that we’re indifferent, it’s just there’s no chance of rescue, we’d just be sending ourselves to death!"
"You saw it too, with a horde of this size, even calling Zhou Huang wouldn’t help."
"I suggest you leave quickly too, or it’ll be big trouble if you get targeted by those monsters!"
After they spoke.
They didn’t look back, turning and quickly leaving.
At this point, there were only a dozen or so Sky Islands left in the vicinity.
The survivors on them looked at each other in dismay.
On an enormous Sky Island with a territory exceeding 200,000 square meters,
a man around the age of twenty-seven or eight stood on his territory, his face flushed with anger.
He was the director of Cloud Water Pavilion, Chujiang Tiankuo.
"Damn, damn it!"
"A bunch of cowards, running without even fighting!" Chujiang Tiankuo cursed in anger.
Though he cursed, Chujiang Tiankuo knew it wasn’t really their fault.
These monsters’ numbers were simply too despairing.
At this time, one of his team members cautiously asked, "Director, those guys are almost all gone. What should we do now?"
"Shouldn’t we also run?"
"After all, they have a point. It’s not that we’re indifferent, there’s just no hope for rescue."
After hearing this, the anger on Chujiang Tiankuo’s face gradually faded, turning into a solemn expression.
Now, with fewer and fewer Sky Islands remaining, it meant more people were leaving.
He seemed to be considering whether to continue persisting, waiting for more people to rescue the survivors inside.
It’s just that the number of monsters was too overwhelming.
Even if he had the will, he didn’t have the ability.
After a moment, he seemed to have made a difficult decision.
With a tremble in his voice, Chujiang Tiankuo said, "Damn, these monsters are really exaggerated."
Everyone thought Chujiang Tiankuo had finally changed his mind and was ready to leave.
Yet they heard him gritting his teeth, saying,
"Today, I refuse to believe it. I’m not leaving!"
At this moment, those survivors asked in confusion, "Director?"
Chujiang Tiankuo took a deep breath.
"Everyone, go to the chat channel and call for people, then upload the video from here."
"Tell them there’re damn tens of millions of Blood Tide monsters here!"
"If they don’t come, then let everyone inside die and let these monsters swallow them all up!"
"A bunch of idiots, thinking that running now will save them? I want to see which team has the guts to survive under such a terrifying horde!"
The team members, upon hearing this, instantly became solemn.
But they knew their director was this kind of person.
Once he made up his mind, it was hard to persuade him otherwise.
Just as he said before.
You can run for a moment, but can you run for a lifetime?
After the people inside die, who would be next?
The overturned nest leaves no unbroken eggs.
The team members exchanged glances, then nodded.
Then, they uploaded the shocking footage they had captured and called for help.
Seeing the Blood Tide monsters number beyond the tens of millions, even those large group leaders were dumbfounded.
"Oh my, what exactly are these tens of millions of monsters?"
"Does anyone know which team’s guys are being besieged in there? Is it the ’Huayi Alliance’?"
However, the Huayi Alliance people immediately came out to clarify it wasn’t them.
Everyone was puzzled.
At this moment, another survivor spoke up.
"Everyone, don’t worry about who’s inside, so many monsters, they must be exterminated!"
"As Director Chu said, even if we escape now, what about later?"
"If those inside can’t hold on, it’ll be our turn next!"

Swallowing hard, everyone said, "It’s exaggerated, which team would survive this?"
"With our numbers, even if we all went together, it wouldn’t be enough to fill the gaps between the monster’s teeth, right?"
This reminder startled everyone.
They knew that given the weight of these Sky Islands, rushing for rescue
was akin to throwing a few stones into the sea, causing no waves.
Moreover, there was a high probability of being engulfed by the monsters within.
Compared to their initial enthusiasm, now, there was a flicker of retreat in the Survivors’ hearts.
After a moment of silence.
At this moment, a survivor named Donglian Fire said, "Everyone, our Fire Demon Corps is retreating first.
There are too many monsters, and we just can’t help."
"We don’t want to lose our lives here."
After speaking, Donglian Fire controlled his vast territory on the Sky Island and turned away.
The local channel suddenly fell silent.
The number of these tens of millions of monsters felt like a cold bucket of water poured over their enthusiasm.
What Donglian Fire said was indeed reasonable.
It’s not that they didn’t want to help, but they simply didn’t have the ability.
Upon thinking that, more and more Sky Islands sighed in their hearts and also chose to leave.
Seeing the number of Sky Islands nearby decreasing,
At this time, a survivor named Chujiang Tiankuo shouted loudly in the local channel, "Why are you running?
All of you damn well come back!"
"You can run for a moment, but can you run for a lifetime?"
His tone contained some anger.
However, those survivors ignored him and quickly controlled their territories to leave.
Chujiang Tiankuo stood there frozen, yet he still wanted one last struggle.
"Damn it, everyone, don’t leave!"
"Stay here a bit longer.
If more people come, there’d be hope to rescue those inside."
In the chat channel, the survivors who left said:
"Director Chu, it’s not that we’re indifferent, it’s just there’s no chance of rescue, we’d just be sending ourselves to death!"
"You saw it too, with a horde of this size, even calling Zhou Huang wouldn’t help."
"I suggest you leave quickly too, or it’ll be big trouble if you get targeted by those monsters!"
After they spoke.
They didn’t look back, turning and quickly leaving.
At this point, there were only a dozen or so Sky Islands left in the vicinity.
The survivors on them looked at each other in dismay.
On an enormous Sky Island with a territory exceeding 200,000 square meters,
a man around the age of twenty-seven or eight stood on his territory, his face flushed with anger.
He was the director of Cloud Water Pavilion, Chujiang Tiankuo.
"Damn, damn it!"
"A bunch of cowards, running without even fighting!" Chujiang Tiankuo cursed in anger.
Though he cursed, Chujiang Tiankuo knew it wasn’t really their fault.
These monsters’ numbers were simply too despairing.
At this time, one of his team members cautiously asked, "Director, those guys are almost all gone.
What should we do now?"
"Shouldn’t we also run?"
"After all, they have a point.
It’s not that we’re indifferent, there’s just no hope for rescue."
After hearing this, the anger on Chujiang Tiankuo’s face gradually faded, turning into a solemn expression.
Now, with fewer and fewer Sky Islands remaining, it meant more people were leaving.
He seemed to be considering whether to continue persisting, waiting for more people to rescue the survivors inside.
It’s just that the number of monsters was too overwhelming.
Even if he had the will, he didn’t have the ability.
After a moment, he seemed to have made a difficult decision.
With a tremble in his voice, Chujiang Tiankuo said, "Damn, these monsters are really exaggerated."
Everyone thought Chujiang Tiankuo had finally changed his mind and was ready to leave.
Yet they heard him gritting his teeth, saying,
"Today, I refuse to believe it.
I’m not leaving!"
At this moment, those survivors asked in confusion, "Director?"
Chujiang Tiankuo took a deep breath.
"Everyone, go to the chat channel and call for people, then upload the video from here."
"Tell them there’re damn tens of millions of Blood Tide monsters here!"
"If they don’t come, then let everyone inside die and let these monsters swallow them all up!"
"A bunch of idiots, thinking that running now will save them?
I want to see which team has the guts to survive under such a terrifying horde!"
The team members, upon hearing this, instantly became solemn.
But they knew their director was this kind of person.
Once he made up his mind, it was hard to persuade him otherwise.
Just as he said before.
You can run for a moment, but can you run for a lifetime?
After the people inside die, who would be next?
The overturned nest leaves no unbroken eggs.
The team members exchanged glances, then nodded.
Then, they uploaded the shocking footage they had captured and called for help.
Seeing the Blood Tide monsters number beyond the tens of millions, even those large group leaders were dumbfounded.
"Oh my, what exactly are these tens of millions of monsters?"
"Does anyone know which team’s guys are being besieged in there?
Is it the ’Huayi Alliance’?"
However, the Huayi Alliance people immediately came out to clarify it wasn’t them.
Everyone was puzzled.
At this moment, another survivor spoke up.
"Everyone, don’t worry about who’s inside, so many monsters, they must be exterminated!"
"As Director Chu said, even if we escape now, what about later?"
"If those inside can’t hold on, it’ll be our turn next!"

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 169: Eight Million Battle Merit!
paragraphs: "When the people inside can’t hold out anymore, it’s our turn!"
After saying this, the person received a chorus of agreement.
Other survivors chimed in.
"That’s right. By then, who among you is confident you can survive the siege of these tens of millions of monsters?"
With this reminder, the survivors realized the severity of the situation.
"I’m heading over immediately; Director Chu is waiting for us!"
"We’ll be there too."
Meanwhile.
Han Xing and the others, who were in battle, suddenly saw numerous messages from survivors flooding the regional chat channel.
"Brothers here, we’ve heard you are targeted; hold on, reinforcements are on the way!"
"Bathing City is arriving soon!"
"Beidou is coming soon, wait for us!"
"Hold on!"
Seeing the messages on the local channel, Han Xing and the others were momentarily stunned.
They were unaware of Zhou Huang’s warning message on the chat channel.
And Zhou Huang was calling for all survivors to rescue the elite of the Human Race under siege.
Han Xing and the others quickly checked the chat logs and understood the situation.
Everyone was momentarily stunned.
Instead of being pleased about the incoming reinforcements, they were somewhat surprised.
After a moment, Cheng Jianyong asked blankly, "Brother Xing, if other survivors come to help, will it impact us?"
Han Xing nodded helplessly, "Probably will."
"It’s very likely that if the monsters see they can’t take us down, and the reinforcements have arrived, they’ll choose to retreat."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned and hurriedly asked, "Oh no, if these Blood Tide Monsters retreat, won’t you miss out on earning battle merit, Brother Xing?"
During this time, other survivors were busy fighting and had no time to check the battle merit leaderboard.
But Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, not engaged in battle, kept an eye on the leaderboard rankings.
Currently, the leader on the battle merit leaderboard was Han Xing’s virtual name, Star River.
With 7.42 million battle merits, he was at the top.
The second place had just surpassed 300,000 battle merits.
Such a huge gap drew everyone’s attention.
They inwardly hoped.
If these Blood Tide Monsters continue to attack, could Han Xing directly accumulate one hundred million battle merits?
And then they’d witness what the legendary Sun Treasure Chest looks like.
However, if other survivors rushed in for rescue,
The Blood Tide Monsters, seeing they couldn’t capture Han Xing, might just retreat.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked again, "Uh, should we tell them we don’t need their rescue?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, nodded, "I’ll do it."
He opened the regional chat channel and spoke.
"Brothers nearby, hello, I’m Star River, the one being besieged by these Blood Tide Monsters."
The main person was speaking.
Among the thousands of Sky Islands arriving, some survivors looked bewildered, while others appeared shocked.
"He just said he is Star River, who is Star River?"
No one spoke.
For many, the name Star River was either familiar or unfamiliar.
Someone then said, "Bro, just look at the current battle merit leaderboard to know who Star River is."
That person quickly opened the battle merit leaderboard.
When they saw 7.34 million,
No, now it’s 7.52 million, a seven-figure battle merit, everyone was dumbfounded.
"Over seven million battle merits, what kind of fierce person is this?"
"Terrifying!"
For a moment, everyone was stunned by the astronomical figure of battle merits.
Besides, this fierce person with millions of battle merits is named Star River!
But considering the number of monsters besieging them, everyone felt relieved.
At this moment, on a large Sky Island over 400,000 square meters stood a man around 30 years old.
He was Alpha, the leader of the Digital Celestial Team.
He said in the local chat channel, "So it’s the Star God, I’ve long heard of your name."
"I was wondering where such a strong person came from, able to withstand the siege of tens of millions of monsters and hold out for so long."
Alpha continued, "It seems, Star God doesn’t need our assistance and can easily handle it?"
Seeing Alpha’s name, Han Xing seemed to recall something.
Before the global human merger, the Digital Celestial Team was one of the top teams in the second district.
On the Cloud Secret Realm Points leaderboard, Alpha had once been in the top ten.
Pausing for a moment, Han Xing replied, "I wouldn’t say it’s easy, but I can manage to hold on for a while."
Listening to Han Xing’s response.
Everyone looked at each other.
Including Chujiang Tiankuo of the Cloud Water Pavilion, who was left speechless.
He had thought the people inside were on the verge of extinction, close to destruction.
He was almost ready to dive in with urgency.
But it turned out, they were still leisurely chatting with everyone.
Meanwhile, more and more people were learning about Han Xing’s exploits.
Regarding this legendary figure.
Everyone gained some understanding of his strength.
Though they couldn’t see what was happening inside,
Regardless of what method Star River used, being able to withstand the impact of tens of millions of Blood Tides proved his immense power.
Even stronger than the currently recognized number one team, the Huayi Alliance.
And this was why Han Xing dared to openly reveal his identity.
Even if others knew his identity, and knew of the massive resources he accumulated through various trades,
They might even harbor some immoral intentions because of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 169: Eight Million Battle Merit! (Part 2)
paragraphs: But if they want to target us, they should weigh their options first.
Which is stronger compared to these tens of millions of monsters!
At this moment, Han Xing said, "Everyone does not need to worry about us here."
"Although the number of monsters is large, we can still barely maintain."
"Moreover, I am worried that your gathering will attract the attention of the Blood Tide Monsters and suffer their attacks."
"If anyone still has strength at this time, you can go and help other human compatriots."
Han Xing’s words, on the one hand, covered up his own strength a bit.
On the other hand, it told these survivors not to risk coming to rescue him.
Upon hearing this, some of the survivors quietly breathed a sigh of relief in their hearts.
To be honest, if possible, they also don’t want to deal with such a terrifying monster tide.
At this time, Han Xing spoke again.
"However, Brother Xing has remembered everyone’s kindness."
"After this battle is over, I will give everyone a small gift."
The eyes of the crowd lit up.
During this period.
Even survivors not familiar with Han Xing quickly gathered information about him.
And they also learned that Han Xing has what can be called a vast amount of resources.
The small gift he mentioned must be valuable.
At this moment, Alpha spoke first: "In that case, our Digital Celestial Team will leave first. Brother Star River, if you need assistance, just shout in the chat channel, and we’ll come immediately."
Seeing this, other teams also said one after another: "Brother Star River, we Beidou will do the same."
"And us, the Bathing City!"
Han Xing replied: "Alright, I will remember this."
Moments later, one Sky Island after another gradually left the place, forming groups of two or three, and went to other areas to assist.
As these survivors gradually retreated.
They watched the endless sea of blood-red monsters from afar and involuntarily breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing was right.
Under the siege of so many monsters.
The alliance formed by these survivors is still too weak, simply not enough to cope with this level of Blood Tide.
If they attract the attention of those Blood Tide creatures at this time, and a wave rushes over,
these teams are likely to be annihilated in an instant.
Although these people retreated.
The story of Han Xing and others standing against tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters quickly spread among the survivors.
After today,
everyone will remember a man named Star River.
By miraculous means, he withstood the assault of tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters!
At this time.
The Thunderbolt Tower in the territory was still wantonly unleashing firepower.
During this period, three or four Lord-level creatures even rushed at their territory.
But they were intercepted by Han Xing and the others with immense combat strength.
Moreover, at the cost of over five hundred Wolf Cavalry deaths, they also forcefully killed two Lord-level creatures.
The other two Lords, heavily injured, fled back into the Blood Tide monster group in panic.
After this, the Blood Tide Monsters could no longer organize any decent offensive.
Besides, as waves of monsters were blasted to pieces.
His battle merit was also steadily increasing.
In just over ten minutes, his Combat Merit Points officially surpassed eight million!
At this moment, the excitement in Han Xing’s eyes was almost uncontrollable!
Eight million battle merits!
Even if they were all exchanged for Golden Treasure Chests, he could exchange for 800!
Although there is still some distance from the target of 100 million battle merits,
at least Han Xing saw hope.
At this point, the monster horde had been smashed by Han Xing by nearly one-fifth.
The density of the monster group visibly thinned considerably.
Seeing that the long attack was ineffectual.
The remaining Lord-level creatures became even more anxious.
They simultaneously looked towards the depths of the Blood Tide,
a creature covered in blood blisters, body appearing to be stitched from various animal tissues, and its body length exceeding a kilometer, suddenly emerged.
In the next moment, this figure shook and suddenly made a strange noise.
This sound was like some kind of animal call.
At the instant they heard this sound, everyone simultaneously felt a sense of oppression in their chest.
At the same time, they also saw, hidden deep in the Blood Tide.
That a gigantic monster of such a size seemed to cover the heavens and the earth.
The moment everyone merely looked at that monster, they instantly felt their consciousness polluted.
Various bizarre images kept appearing.
A sea of blood world, endless corpses floating and sinking on the water surface, surging up and down...
It was as if they had fallen into some strong Illusion Technique.
At this moment, Han Xing quickly reminded: "Don’t look at that monster!"
Upon this reminder, everyone became aware and quickly averted their gazes.
Shen Yun was the first to react, quickly casting a Purification Technique on everyone.
With his current Spiritual Power, the effect of the Purification Technique was incredibly strong.
Unless it’s a status like a Blood Curse that cannot be removed, it can be nearly instantly dispelled.
Everyone also felt a burst of clarity in their minds.
After the hallucination disappeared, their vision returned to normal.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, pale-faced and still shaken, said, "Damn, what the hell was that? I just took one look and almost fell for it!"
Everyone felt a lingering fear.
The methods of this monster are too bizarre.
Han Xing furrowed his brow, analyzing, "This monster is probably the Dominator-level creature Zhou Huang mentioned in the chat channel."
"Dominator?"
Hearing this word, a hint of shock also appeared in Shen Yun’s eyes.
Before this, they thought Lord-level was already the most terrifying monster below Legend.
Unexpectedly, above Lord, there is an even more terrifying Dominator!
Before everyone could come back to senses from their shock.
A sudden disturbance arose from the depths of the Blood Tide monsters.
They spread in waves like the tide.
Han Xing’s expression tightened, and he quickly warned, "Be careful, that Dominator creature might be making a move!"
Upon hearing these words, everyone’s expressions became serious as they raised their weapons, ready for action!
However, the anticipated scene of a Dominator-level creature’s assault did not occur.
All they saw was.
As the Dominator-level creature made a cry, a blood-colored bubble drifted over from the Blood Tide.
This bubble seemed slow, but in reality, it was extremely fast.
In an instant, it crossed over ten thousand meters and approached Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Moreover, it seemed immune to all attacks.
Whether it was the rampant electricity from the Thunderbolt Tower or the bombardments from the Catapult, they had no effect on it.
"Something strange, fall back!" Han Xing immediately ordered.
Everyone instinctively ran towards the Lord’s Mansion.
And just then, the blood-colored bubble had reached the edge of the territory.
However, the anticipated attack effect did not occur.
At the moment it approached Han Xing’s territory, the blood-colored bubble rapidly expanded.
The next moment, it directly encapsulated the entire Sky Island of Han Xing.
Everyone stared blankly at the sky.
They now seemed like little fish trapped in a bubble, bewilderedly watching the outside world.
"What the hell is this?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Han Xing didn’t speak, but instead controlled various Defense Towers to attack, trying to break this layer of bubble.
However, everyone was shocked to find out that these Defense Towers had no effect on this bubble at all.
Not only did Magic Damage structures like the Thunderbolt Tower have no effect.
Even physical damage towers like Siege Crossbow Arrow and Flamethrower Catapult couldn’t budge this blood-colored bubble in the slightest!
Cheng Jianyong also tried using his skill, Sky Sword.
But still, it had no effect.
"Wow, Dominator-level creatures are this terrifying?"
"A single skill incapacitated all the Defense Towers in the territory!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
At the same time.
As the attacks from the Thunderbolt Tower and Catapult lost effect.
The group of monsters seemed invigorated, immediately charging towards Han Xing’s Sky Island.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly gestured for everyone to stop.
"No need to run, I guess this blood-colored bubble is preventing our attacks from reaching the outside world."
"But correspondingly, those Blood Tide monsters are also probably unable to get in."
Everyone stopped in their tracks upon hearing this and then anxiously watched in all directions.
The next moment, the sky was filled with Blood Tide monsters pouncing forward.
But just as Han Xing predicted, these monsters, upon contact with the thin layer of bubble, could advance no further as if hitting a wall.
Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
However, the crisis wasn’t over.
At this time, the territory’s Sky Island was completely covered from inside to outside.
Those monsters clawed ferociously outside the bubble.
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"We won’t be trapped inside this bubble forever, will we?"
Han Xing shook his head: "It’s unlikely. Skills like these that disregard all attacks, akin to the Power of Rules, can’t last long."
"I estimate, at most, it’s only a matter of tens of seconds."
Sure enough.
On the fifteenth second since they were enclosed by the blood-colored bubble.
The bubble surface had already appeared with spider web-like cracks.
And they were rapidly spreading.
By the twentieth second.
The blood-colored bubble shattered with a sound.

Upon hearing these words, everyone’s expressions became serious as they raised their weapons, ready for action!
However, the anticipated scene of a Dominator-level creature’s assault did not occur.
All they saw was.
As the Dominator-level creature made a cry, a blood-colored bubble drifted over from the Blood Tide.
This bubble seemed slow, but in reality, it was extremely fast.
In an instant, it crossed over ten thousand meters and approached Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Moreover, it seemed immune to all attacks.
Whether it was the rampant electricity from the Thunderbolt Tower or the bombardments from the Catapult, they had no effect on it.
"Something strange, fall back!" Han Xing immediately ordered.
Everyone instinctively ran towards the Lord’s Mansion.
And just then, the blood-colored bubble had reached the edge of the territory.
However, the anticipated attack effect did not occur.
At the moment it approached Han Xing’s territory, the blood-colored bubble rapidly expanded.
The next moment, it directly encapsulated the entire Sky Island of Han Xing.
Everyone stared blankly at the sky.
They now seemed like little fish trapped in a bubble, bewilderedly watching the outside world.
"What the hell is this?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Han Xing didn’t speak, but instead controlled various Defense Towers to attack, trying to break this layer of bubble.
However, everyone was shocked to find out that these Defense Towers had no effect on this bubble at all.
Not only did Magic Damage structures like the Thunderbolt Tower have no effect.
Even physical damage towers like Siege Crossbow Arrow and Flamethrower Catapult couldn’t budge this blood-colored bubble in the slightest!
Cheng Jianyong also tried using his skill, Sky Sword.
But still, it had no effect.
"Wow, Dominator-level creatures are this terrifying?"
"A single skill incapacitated all the Defense Towers in the territory!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
At the same time.
As the attacks from the Thunderbolt Tower and Catapult lost effect.
The group of monsters seemed invigorated, immediately charging towards Han Xing’s Sky Island.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly gestured for everyone to stop.
"No need to run, I guess this blood-colored bubble is preventing our attacks from reaching the outside world."
"But correspondingly, those Blood Tide monsters are also probably unable to get in."
Everyone stopped in their tracks upon hearing this and then anxiously watched in all directions.
The next moment, the sky was filled with Blood Tide monsters pouncing forward.
But just as Han Xing predicted, these monsters, upon contact with the thin layer of bubble, could advance no further as if hitting a wall.
Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
However, the crisis wasn’t over.
At this time, the territory’s Sky Island was completely covered from inside to outside.
Those monsters clawed ferociously outside the bubble.
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, "Brother Xing, what do we do now?"
"We won’t be trapped inside this bubble forever, will we?"
Han Xing shook his head: "It’s unlikely.
Skills like these that disregard all attacks, akin to the Power of Rules, can’t last long."
"I estimate, at most, it’s only a matter of tens of seconds."
Sure enough.
On the fifteenth second since they were enclosed by the blood-colored bubble.
The bubble surface had already appeared with spider web-like cracks.
And they were rapidly spreading.
By the twentieth second.
The blood-colored bubble shattered with a sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 170: I’m Going All Out
paragraphs: Only twenty seconds passed before the scarlet bubble shattered directly.
Even faster than Han Xing anticipated!
However, before everyone could breathe a sigh of relief.
The blood tide monsters, long waiting in ambush, surged in like an overwhelming flood.
At this moment, they were less than a hundred meters from Han Xing’s territory.
At this distance, given the speed of these blood tide monsters, they could charge in less than a second!
Under normal circumstances.
Other survivors might have panicked and activated all the defense towers in their territory to repel these monsters.
However, by doing so, they would fall right into the trap set by that Dominator-level creature.
When all the defense towers enter reloading time.
Taking advantage of this empty Sky Island, endless blood tide monsters would flood the territory!
However, Han Xing did not panic.
He maintained his rhythm.
Activating a quarter of the defense towers to attack.
Rumble!
Thunder roared, and artillery fire thundered.
The flamethrower catapult’s shells exploded at close range, turning an unknown number of monsters into minced meat in this wave of attacks!
However, at this moment, more monsters rushed onto the territory.
With the combat strength of the wolf cavalry and minotaurs, they couldn’t possibly hold back so many monsters!
Watching the monstrous tide surging below, everyone couldn’t help but clench their fists.
At this moment, Han Xing, with a calm expression, suddenly said.
"Alright, now it’s our time to shine."
Upon hearing this, a spark of light seemed to ignite in the eyes of the four people.
They had no fear in their eyes, and even a hint of excitement could be seen!
Previously, they only watched the defense towers on the territory showcase their might, having nothing much to do.
Even when Lord and Elite Monsters attacked in groups, they were blocked by the wolf cavalry army below.
Now, it was finally their turn to take the stage!
Their hearts surged with war intent!
The five of them simultaneously drank a bottle of blood curse antidote.
The next moment, five silhouettes shot down from the city walls like arrows off a string and charged toward the oncoming blood tide army.
At this moment, the army composed of wolf cavalry and minotaurs was struggling under the overwhelming number of attacking monsters.
No matter how brave and skilled they were, fearless of death.
They were still being suppressed by the enemies who vastly outnumbered them.
In fact, there were already significant casualties among the wolf cavalry.
And at this moment.
Han Xing and others descended.
The massive clouds of thunder, the fierce arrow rain, and the terrifying explosions of blast flame arrows.
Directly annihilated hordes of blood tide monsters.
The courageously resisting wolf cavalry army immediately felt the pressure ease.
They simultaneously looked back at the five individuals, impressed by their formidable combat strength!
"Lord is mighty!"
The wolf cavalry tribe worships the strong, and Han Xing’s displayed battle power completely won them over.
However, the first wave of everyone’s outbreak was merely an appetizer.
The next moment, they saw their Lord leaping high.
His entire being like a racing arrow, instantly charging a hundred meters ahead.
Han Xing directly activated his new skill after the Second Transformation of the Wild Ranger, Instant Shadow Flash!
All monsters along the path, upon contact with Han Xing’s silhouette, were blown away like a storm.
And at this moment, Han Xing, who had charged into the center of the monster crowd.
Suddenly activated the Legendary Effect on the Ice Burial Weapon, Extreme Cold Domain.
Like a lotus blooming on a high mountain, the chilling air swept across.
Hundreds of meters of nearby blood tide monsters were frozen into ice, falling from the sky.
Large batches of monsters perished.
At this moment, Han Xing transformed once again into the Emperor who dominated death and ice.
After one skill, ten thousand corpses lay at his feet.
This scene gave a strong visual shock.
Just this wave alone caused at least ten thousand monsters to meet their end!
The next moment, a white light rose from Han Xing’s body.
The death of tens of thousands of monsters brought him vast amounts of experience.
Plus, the additional experience boost from the Dawn Goddess Statue.
Han Xing directly leveled up to level 26.
The wolf cavalry was visibly excited.
After Han Xing cleared the field.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also began to erupt!
They also displayed fearsome lethality not inferior to the Thunderbolt Tower, and were even more flexible.
Wave after wave of monsters fell.
Every moment, substantial battle merit and experience value were recorded.
White light successively rose from everyone’s bodies.
And, as they killed more monsters.
The blood tide monster group barely approaching the territory’s Sky Island was once again pushed back repeatedly.
The surrounding range of thousands of meters of blood tide monsters was almost cleared.
In the sky, that enormous creature over a thousand meters long suddenly shivered.
This Dominator-level creature seemed to have severely underestimated the battle power of the human race on this Sky Island!
It never expected that, besides the numerous defense towers on the Sky Island.
The strength of the human race itself was equally terrifying.
Just these five people could even handle a monster tide numbering less than a hundred thousand!
The Dominator creature appeared increasingly anxious.
Because under the current circumstances, if it didn’t continue sending in Lord-level creatures, it wouldn’t be able to take down this group of humans.
At this moment, the Dominator-level creature seemed to be hesitating.
Should it go all out and send every Lord-level creature to assault the human territory.
Doing so has a chance of success.
However, it’s uncertain if these survivors have other tricks up their sleeve.
After all, these humans have surprised it more than once already.
Moreover, the Lord Creatures in hand are not many.
In the previous wave of assault, two were killed by them.
The next moment, it seemed to make a decision.
That is, retreat!
"Goo——"
A low rumbling sound emerged.
The remaining Blood Tide Monsters received the command and simultaneously halted their assault.
Swish~
The swarm of Blood Tide Monsters receded.
Suddenly, a ray of sunlight pierced through the dark sky.
At this moment, Shen Yun and others bravely fighting on the territory raised their heads to the sky.
"Huh? These monsters are fleeing?"
The crowd also stared at the figures of the retreating monsters.
Shortly after, Han Xing responded: "It seems so, considering they’ve already lost tens of millions of forces to me."
"Even if the Blood Tide Monsters spawn quickly, it can’t keep up with such attrition."
"Moreover, the Dominator-level monster seems unwilling to invest all forces against us here."
Upon hearing this, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Just as they were about to clean up the battlefield, Han Xing suddenly had a thought.
He hurriedly said, "Everyone, continue fighting!"
"We can’t let these monsters get away!
Upon hearing this, everyone looked at Han Xing.
After barely repelling these monsters, why suddenly say not to let them escape?
Han Xing explained, "That Dominator-level creature is highly intelligent; if it doesn’t want to spend all forces on us, it means it has another plan!"
"This creature, finding us difficult to handle, surely aims to target other survivors!"
Upon hearing this, everyone immediately understood the meaning behind Han Xing’s words and their expressions became sharp.
The Blood Tide Monsters are numerous beyond count, even though Han Xing eliminated tens of millions, there are nearly thirty to forty million left.
Though unable to defeat Han Xing, it doesn’t mean other survivors can withstand their assault!
Such a terrifying quantity would leave almost no Sky Island standing!
Cheng Jianyong incredulously said, "Damn it, these monsters are too cunning. Could that Dominator truly be so intelligent?"
Han Xing didn’t speak; the answer was obvious.
Shen Yun also wore a solemn expression and asked, "Brother Xing, how do we catch up?"
"Those Blood Tide Monsters are much faster than us; the Sky Island simply can’t keep up!"
The Blood Tide Army, besides its unparalleled number, also has formidable mobility.
Calculated at speed per hour, monster army’s movement speed is over 1500 kilometers per hour.
Even Xingyu City’s current fastest movement speed can barely reach 900 kilometers.
Other survivors’ Sky Islands are even slower.
Hence, when facing the Blood Tide Army’s siege, few survivors manage to escape.
However, Han Xing suddenly had a thought.
Because two days ago, he exchanged for a territory core acceleration device in the trading channel.
Its effect is to input Spirit Cores to double the movement speed of the territory!
Originally, he intended to use it for escaping when outmatched.
But now, could it perhaps aid them in pursuing the Blood Tide Monsters?
The next moment.
An amused smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Damn, I didn’t expect it to be of use so soon."
Cheng Jianyong asked questioningly, "Brother Xing, what is it?"
Han Xing didn’t answer but addressed all residents in the City Lord’s Mansion: "Everyone, hold on tightly, preferably tie yourself to a pillar with a rope!"
"Next, I’m going all out!"
Inside Xingyu City.
Lanlan and others listened to Han Xing’s statement, somewhat puzzled.
However, the next moment, they understood what Han Xing meant.
Boom!
Twenty thousand Spirit Cores were thrown in!
The territory core acceleration device started operating at full speed.
Instantly, the Sky Island’s movement speed surged several times!
Only three seconds passed.
Han Xing’s massive Sky Island’s movement speed broke from 0 to 500 kilometers per hour.
Another three seconds passed.
Directly reached 2500 kilometers per hour!
The massive momentum nearly floated them into the air.
If this world had air resistance!
Otherwise, such instant acceleration would have thrown them off.
"Wow! So fast, Brother Xing!" Cheng Jianyong clung tightly to a Catapult on the city wall, exclaiming in disbelief.
Everyone also grabbed onto things to steady themselves.
Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng were terrified, their faces devoid of color.
In an instinctive move, both grabbed onto Han Xing’s arm, one on each side.
Initially, Han Xing felt fine.
With his attribute intensity, this speed was easy to adapt to.
But once held by the two women, Han Xing couldn’t resist leaning back due to inertia.
Then, the three rolled together to the bottom of the city wall.
