chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 171: Miracle Reborn!
paragraphs: The three of them rolled down together to the bottom of the castle wall.
During the roll, Han Xing felt two soft bodies.
Occasionally, he heard a couple of tantalizing moans by his ear.
A moment later, the three bodies stopped rolling and lay on the ground.
The scene at this moment looked somewhat...
Zhang Lianmeng remained in a supine position, pressing on Han Xing’s head.
Su Xiaoyang pressed against Han Xing’s stomach, and none of the three moved, as if trapped in a curious atmosphere.
Then, the two women suddenly seemed to realize something, their faces flushing red with embarrassment.
They scrambled to stand up from the ground, then lowered their heads with shy expressions.
"Ahem..." Han Xing, lying on the ground, coughed dryly twice.
The two women came to their senses and extended their hands, intending to pull Han Xing up from the ground.
However, they saw that Han Xing had already stood up, dusting off the dirt from his body, indicating he was fine.
To be honest, with their weight, even ten of them pressing on Han Xing wouldn’t have any effect on him.
Moreover, this was just a small episode; Han Xing didn’t mind.
A moment later, everyone adapted to the rhythm of this speed and gradually steadied themselves.
However, in the occasional glances shared between Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, one could still see the shyness in each other’s eyes.
At this moment, Xingyu City was advancing rapidly, chasing in the direction the monster herd flew.
In the area closest to Han Xing, there was also a Sky Island heavily targeted by the Blood Tide Monsters.
It was one of the thirty coordinates issued by Zhou Huang.
Now, the survivors on that Sky Island were under siege by millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
A graceful figure stood on top of the territory castle, commanding.
This was the Sky Island where the Immortal Mansion team resided.
The Cyan Robed Goddess, Luo Chan, was leading tens of thousands of professionals on her territory in a courageous defense.
However.
Even if their cooperation was good and their division of labor clear.
They couldn’t avoid the attacks from those Blood Tide Monsters.
Especially those in close combat professions.
Once or twice was alright.
But when survivors were attacked more than five times, the layers of the Blood Curse would stack up madly.
The time left for them was less than half an hour.
At this moment, these survivors had no choice but to retreat to the second line, awaiting the healing from the Holy Profession Purification Technique.
Consuming in this way.
Although the number of the monster herd was decreasing, their effective combat power was also continuously reducing.
Luo Chan was so anxious that her brows were almost knitted together, her beautiful features showing worry.
And just at that moment, she suddenly heard an encouraging piece of news.
Led by the Heart Joy Club, several dozen teams were rushing over together.
In the local channel, those survivors shouted inside.
"Brothers of the Immortal Mansion, hold on, Heart Joy Club is about to arrive!"
"City Light is on the way, Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, I’m coming!"
"And us, Fenghe Association, Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, hang in there!"
There was a look of gratitude in Luo Chan’s eyes.
"Everyone... thank you..."
Upon hearing the news of reinforcements.
Below, the survivors of the Immortal Mansion also rekindled amazing fighting spirit in their eyes.
However, before Luo Chan could express her gratitude in the local channel.
In this area, all the survivors within a hundred kilometers simultaneously looked up, gazing toward the horizon!
A far more terrifying and massive blood-red tide was approaching at a horrifying speed.
Its number was more than ten times that of Luo Chan’s side!
At this moment, the dozens of Sky Islands that were rushing over nearby all stopped simultaneously.
Anyone who saw such a spectacular scene would be overwhelmingly shocked.
The local chat channel suddenly fell into dead silence.
At this moment, there were even over ten Sky Islands that turned around without a word and left!
The survivors on the Immortal Mansion hurriedly said, "Brothers, why are you all leaving, come back quickly!"
"Friends from Fenghe Association, don’t go!"
Even though the survivors from the Immortal Mansion pleaded frantically, they simply turned a deaf ear.
You’ve got to be kidding!
They wouldn’t mind helping decorate an already beautiful occasion or even helping during difficult times.
If doing so could win the favor of the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, they would be willing to take some risks too.
But now, staying would obviously mean certain death.
Even those survivors who were lured by Luo Chan’s beauty to come to the rescue started feeling a strong urge to retreat in their hearts.
More and more Sky Islands left.
On the scene, only a few scattered Sky Islands remained in place.
These remaining Sky Islands were all rather sizable.
Among them was the Heart Joy Club, initially the second-largest team in the five major areas.
As a staunch ally of the Immortal Mansion, the leader of Heart Joy Club, Song Caidongzi, was reportedly constantly pursuing the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan.
However, at this moment, even Song Caidongzi’s eyes could not escape showing a conflicted look.
Leaving was not an option, but not leaving was just as difficult.
Everyone knew that Song Caidongzi admired Luo Chan.
But in such a critical moment, if Song Caidongzi left, his supposed pursuit would become a joke.
If word got out, it would severely damage the reputation of the Heart Joy Club.
But staying would be even more foolish.
Not only would they fail to save Luo Chan, but they might also lose the entire Heart Joy Club, comprising tens of thousands.
It’s completely equivalent to seeking death.
Watching more and more Sky Islands leave.
Luo Chan lowered her eyes, with a faint mist in her pupils.
She softly asked on the local channel, "Young Master Song, are you really leaving?"
Her voice carried a hint of desperation and plea.
In the face of death, even though Luo Chan had a strong mind, able to face life and death calmly.
However, since the establishment of the Immortal Mansion, it was no longer her personal Immortal Mansion.
Above, there were more than 30,000 Survivors and their relatives.
That was tens of thousands of lives.
As their leader, Luo Chan promised to lead them to survival.
If the Heart Joy Club also abandons them at this time.
Then it would mean that they have been sentenced to death, completely losing hope.
Song Caidongzi, upon hearing the pitiful plea from the Cyan Robed Goddess, felt a pang of reluctance in his heart.
But after being persuaded by the team members, Song Caidongzi weighed the situation in his mind.
A moment later, he made a difficult decision.
"Cyan Robed Goddess... It’s not that we won’t save you, but we are truly powerless."
"You see, more and more people are leaving."
"Even if those in the Heart Joy Club wish to help, facing such a monster, they are powerless."
"It would only increase casualties for nothing."
Song Caidongzi’s tone also carried helplessness.
After hearing this, deep despair appeared on Luo Chan’s exceptionally beautiful face.
Just one glance would evoke a look of pitiful sadness.
But Luo Chan also knew, under this circumstance, even if the Heart Joy Club came to help, it would be akin to sending the death.
A moment later, the despair in Luo Chan’s eyes faded, replaced with a certain determination.
She said on the local network, "Friends of the Heart Joy Club, Luo Chan understands your position, please leave quickly."
"Your willingness to come means more to Luo Chan than words can express. No need to increase casualties, weakening the Power of the Human Race."
Song Caidongzi sighed upon hearing this.
Then he turned around, controlling the Sky Island to move away from there.
At this moment, she bit down and said, "Brothers and sisters of the Immortal Mansion, even without external assistance, even if death is destined today."
"Luo Chan will still fight with you to the last moment!"
Under the shroud of despair.
The Survivors of the Immortal Mansion remained silent.
They glanced back; there were tens of thousands of bewildered eyes watching them.
There lay their family, friends, and dearest ones.
A moment later.
Someone softly shouted one phrase.
"Kill!"
The remaining Survivors of the Immortal Mansion seemed also inspired by this decisive word.
Determination appeared in their eyes.
Because even their staunch ally, the Heart Joy Club, had turned to leave under the pressure of the Blood Tide.
Now, they could only rely on themselves!
Even in the face of death, they would fight to the last moment!
However.
With the strength of the Immortal Mansion, it was barely maintaining against a few million Blood Tide Monsters before.
Now the number has increased tenfold.
Among them, countless Leaders and Elites were hidden, and even Lord Monsters.
At this moment, unless a miracle occurs.
Otherwise, they would have no chance of turning the tables.
At this time.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters had completely enveloped the Sky Island of the Immortal Mansion!
In the distance, those from the Heart Joy Club saw the scene of the Immortal Mansion’s Sky Island being engulfed, and couldn’t help but sigh.
"Alas... So many monsters, it’s impossible to stop them."
"Yes, it’s a pity for the Cyan Robed Goddess."
Upon finishing, they also prepared to quickly manipulate the Sky Island to leave.
Fearful that after destroying the Immortal Mansion, that wave of Blood Tide Monsters might come for them.
At this point, the Blood Tide Monsters seemed to want a quick battle.
The Dominator Level Creature hidden among the monsters ordered, directly sending eight Lord Level Creatures to assault the territory of the Immortal Mansion.
Luo Chan gritted her teeth, exerting all her strength to resist to the end.
However, when she saw the eight monstrous Lord Monsters rushing towards her.
At that moment, she deeply understood what despair meant.
Eight Lord Level Monsters.
Even if just one appeared, it could bring severe damage to the Immortal Mansion.
Regardless of how the Survivors of the Immortal Mansion resisted, in the face of absolute power, there was not a sliver of chance.
"Heaven... could you really not give us a glimmer of hope?"
The Survivors of the Immortal Mansion cried out in anguish.
Yet at this moment.
Twenty beams of blue light soared into the sky, shooting in from afar.
Like thunderbolts shattering the dark night sky!
Forcefully breaking through the blood clouds that covered the sky!
The Survivors of the Immortal Mansion looked up in confusion, still unaware of what had happened.
The next moment.
They saw hundreds of burning Flame Shells, carrying an aura of Destruction, whistling towards them!
Rumble!
The skies, which had only been torn open with cracks before, were now completely blown apart!
The hopeless scene woven by tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters was torn to shreds by Flame and Thunder!

sentences.text: The three of them rolled down together to the bottom of the castle wall.
During the roll, Han Xing felt two soft bodies.
Occasionally, he heard a couple of tantalizing moans by his ear.
A moment later, the three bodies stopped rolling and lay on the ground.
The scene at this moment looked somewhat...
Zhang Lianmeng remained in a supine position, pressing on Han Xing’s head.
Su Xiaoyang pressed against Han Xing’s stomach, and none of the three moved, as if trapped in a curious atmosphere.
Then, the two women suddenly seemed to realize something, their faces flushing red with embarrassment.
They scrambled to stand up from the ground, then lowered their heads with shy expressions.
"Ahem..." Han Xing, lying on the ground, coughed dryly twice.
The two women came to their senses and extended their hands, intending to pull Han Xing up from the ground.
However, they saw that Han Xing had already stood up, dusting off the dirt from his body, indicating he was fine.
To be honest, with their weight, even ten of them pressing on Han Xing wouldn’t have any effect on him.
Moreover, this was just a small episode; Han Xing didn’t mind.
A moment later, everyone adapted to the rhythm of this speed and gradually steadied themselves.
However, in the occasional glances shared between Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, one could still see the shyness in each other’s eyes.
At this moment, Xingyu City was advancing rapidly, chasing in the direction the monster herd flew.
In the area closest to Han Xing, there was also a Sky Island heavily targeted by the Blood Tide Monsters.
It was one of the thirty coordinates issued by Zhou Huang.
Now, the survivors on that Sky Island were under siege by millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
A graceful figure stood on top of the territory castle, commanding.
This was the Sky Island where the Immortal Mansion team resided.
The Cyan Robed Goddess, Luo Chan, was leading tens of thousands of professionals on her territory in a courageous defense.
However.
Even if their cooperation was good and their division of labor clear.
They couldn’t avoid the attacks from those Blood Tide Monsters.
Especially those in close combat professions.
Once or twice was alright.
But when survivors were attacked more than five times, the layers of the Blood Curse would stack up madly.
The time left for them was less than half an hour.
At this moment, these survivors had no choice but to retreat to the second line, awaiting the healing from the Holy Profession Purification Technique.
Consuming in this way.
Although the number of the monster herd was decreasing, their effective combat power was also continuously reducing.
Luo Chan was so anxious that her brows were almost knitted together, her beautiful features showing worry.
And just at that moment, she suddenly heard an encouraging piece of news.
Led by the Heart Joy Club, several dozen teams were rushing over together.
In the local channel, those survivors shouted inside.
"Brothers of the Immortal Mansion, hold on, Heart Joy Club is about to arrive!"
"City Light is on the way, Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, I’m coming!"
"And us, Fenghe Association, Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, hang in there!"
There was a look of gratitude in Luo Chan’s eyes.
"Everyone... thank you..."
Upon hearing the news of reinforcements.
Below, the survivors of the Immortal Mansion also rekindled amazing fighting spirit in their eyes.
However, before Luo Chan could express her gratitude in the local channel.
In this area, all the survivors within a hundred kilometers simultaneously looked up, gazing toward the horizon!
A far more terrifying and massive blood-red tide was approaching at a horrifying speed.
Its number was more than ten times that of Luo Chan’s side!
At this moment, the dozens of Sky Islands that were rushing over nearby all stopped simultaneously.
Anyone who saw such a spectacular scene would be overwhelmingly shocked.
The local chat channel suddenly fell into dead silence.
At this moment, there were even over ten Sky Islands that turned around without a word and left!
The survivors on the Immortal Mansion hurriedly said, "Brothers, why are you all leaving, come back quickly!"
"Friends from Fenghe Association, don’t go!"
Even though the survivors from the Immortal Mansion pleaded frantically, they simply turned a deaf ear.
You’ve got to be kidding!
They wouldn’t mind helping decorate an already beautiful occasion or even helping during difficult times.
If doing so could win the favor of the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan, they would be willing to take some risks too.
But now, staying would obviously mean certain death.
Even those survivors who were lured by Luo Chan’s beauty to come to the rescue started feeling a strong urge to retreat in their hearts.
More and more Sky Islands left.
On the scene, only a few scattered Sky Islands remained in place.
These remaining Sky Islands were all rather sizable.
Among them was the Heart Joy Club, initially the second-largest team in the five major areas.
As a staunch ally of the Immortal Mansion, the leader of Heart Joy Club, Song Caidongzi, was reportedly constantly pursuing the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan.
However, at this moment, even Song Caidongzi’s eyes could not escape showing a conflicted look.
Leaving was not an option, but not leaving was just as difficult.
Everyone knew that Song Caidongzi admired Luo Chan.
But in such a critical moment, if Song Caidongzi left, his supposed pursuit would become a joke.
If word got out, it would severely damage the reputation of the Heart Joy Club.
But staying would be even more foolish.
Not only would they fail to save Luo Chan, but they might also lose the entire Heart Joy Club, comprising tens of thousands.
It’s completely equivalent to seeking death.
Watching more and more Sky Islands leave.
Luo Chan lowered her eyes, with a faint mist in her pupils.
She softly asked on the local channel, "Young Master Song, are you really leaving?"
Her voice carried a hint of desperation and plea.
In the face of death, even though Luo Chan had a strong mind, able to face life and death calmly.
However, since the establishment of the Immortal Mansion, it was no longer her personal Immortal Mansion.
Above, there were more than 30,000 Survivors and their relatives.
That was tens of thousands of lives.
As their leader, Luo Chan promised to lead them to survival.
If the Heart Joy Club also abandons them at this time.
Then it would mean that they have been sentenced to death, completely losing hope.
Song Caidongzi, upon hearing the pitiful plea from the Cyan Robed Goddess, felt a pang of reluctance in his heart.
But after being persuaded by the team members, Song Caidongzi weighed the situation in his mind.
A moment later, he made a difficult decision.
"Cyan Robed Goddess...
It’s not that we won’t save you, but we are truly powerless."
"You see, more and more people are leaving."
"Even if those in the Heart Joy Club wish to help, facing such a monster, they are powerless."
"It would only increase casualties for nothing."
Song Caidongzi’s tone also carried helplessness.
After hearing this, deep despair appeared on Luo Chan’s exceptionally beautiful face.
Just one glance would evoke a look of pitiful sadness.
But Luo Chan also knew, under this circumstance, even if the Heart Joy Club came to help, it would be akin to sending the death.
A moment later, the despair in Luo Chan’s eyes faded, replaced with a certain determination.
She said on the local network, "Friends of the Heart Joy Club, Luo Chan understands your position, please leave quickly."
"Your willingness to come means more to Luo Chan than words can express.
No need to increase casualties, weakening the Power of the Human Race."
Song Caidongzi sighed upon hearing this.
Then he turned around, controlling the Sky Island to move away from there.
At this moment, she bit down and said, "Brothers and sisters of the Immortal Mansion, even without external assistance, even if death is destined today."
"Luo Chan will still fight with you to the last moment!"
Under the shroud of despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 172: Shattering Despair!
paragraphs: On the territory of the Immortal Mansion.
Tens of thousands of survivors, along with hundreds of thousands of relatives, all appeared confused.
"The monster horde is under attack, am I seeing things?"
"Could it be, is a miracle really happening?"
At this time, another male survivor shouted loudly!
"It’s not a miracle, it’s the Flamethrower Catapult! So many catapults!"
"Someone’s come to save us!"
After hearing this, the confusion in everyone’s eyes turned into wild joy!
They all looked over.
Seeing not far away that Sky Island, like a war fortress, wantonly unleashing firepower, their eyes widened abruptly.
"Such strong firepower! Someone really came to save us, hold on, brothers!"
"Who are the people on that Sky Island?"
"Is it Zhou Huang?"
At this stage, aside from the ’Huayi Alliance’, they didn’t think any other force would dare risk millions of monsters to rescue them.
Because they had long heard that the Huayi Alliance already had over a hundred thousand survivors above level 15, and more than a hundred Flamethrower Catapults.
If it’s Zhou Huang, maybe they can really be saved from the mouth of the monster tide!
However, when the first wave of Defense Tower bombardment ended and the smoke cleared.
They saw.
There was no mighty army of survivors on that Sky Island,
only a few unfamiliar silhouettes standing on the city walls.
Disappointment simultaneously appeared in everyone’s eyes.
"Just... just five people?"
"God, am I seeing right, do they really dare to come save us with so few people?"
Although the scene just now was indeed shocking enough.
However, the number of people on this Sky Island is still too few.
If they can’t form a strong defensive line like the survivors, they will be engulfed almost immediately when surrounded by monsters.
At this point, those survivors also realized this and their faces changed color instantly!
"Quick, warn those brothers on the Sky Island, let them run away quickly!
"Don’t let these monsters target you, or it’ll be over!"
Although, in their hearts, they were very grateful to those on the Sky Island for daring to take such a great risk to aid them.
But the number of survivors on that Sky Island is still somewhat too small,
At this time, Luo Chan almost immediately reacted.
When she saw Han Xing’s Sky Island still on the outskirts of the monster tide, she quickly said: "Friends outside, thank you for extending a helping hand, Luo Chan is immensely grateful!"
"But please leave as soon as possible."
"Otherwise, once surrounded by the monster tide, you will also lose your chance to escape!"
However, that Sky Island did not listen to her words at all.
Instead, like madmen, they plunged headlong into the monster tide.
The people of the Immortal Mansion were dumbfounded.
"Damn! What do these people want to do?"
"Damn it, don’t come die with us!"
Below, the survivors shouted in despair.
However, at the next moment when the massive Sky Island was engulfed by the Blood Tide.
The anticipated scene of monsters charging onto the Sky Island and tearing them to pieces did not appear.
Instead, more than twenty lightning beams, each ten thousand meters long, suddenly blasted out!
Crackle.
The dazzling electric light, terrifyingly destructive.
Where the blue beams passed.
Tens of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters were directly blasted to death!
This scene once again left the tens of thousands of people in the Immortal Mansion stunned.
However, before they could react.
They saw that Sky Island proceed without a moment’s pause, crushing the monster horde with unstoppable momentum.
And rapidly approaching the area where the Immortal Mansion was located.
The target, surprisingly, was those Lord-level creatures preparing to besiege the Immortal Mansion!
When nearly reaching the Sky Island Territory where the Immortal Mansion was located.
Han Xing stood on the territory’s city wall and suddenly shouted, "Everyone, hit the deck!"
Although the people of the Immortal Mansion were confused, they still instinctively chose to obey.
The next moment.
Dozens of blue pillars of light, shocking to behold, swept over their heads.
In an instant, three to four Lord-level creatures, unable to dodge, were covered by the light beams from the Thunderbolt Towers.
Crackle... crackle...
Terrifying electrical energy rampaged through their bodies, not enough to instantly kill them.
However, they still fell into a brief paralysis state.
The eight Lords were simultaneously shocked.
At this moment, they even felt a crisis of death!
Before these Lords could react.
In the next moment.
Over a hundred ice spears shot out swiftly!
The paralyzed Lord Monsters became sitting ducks in mid-air!
Thud thud thud!
Fragments of ice and blood splattered.
These terrifying creatures, each over a hundred meters large, were turned into sieves by this concentrated attack.
In an instant, four Lord-level creatures died on the spot!
The system notification appeared.
[Kill mutant: Eye of the Evil God (Three-star Lord Level), gain Battle Merit *5000, gain Sacred Artifact Fragment *1.]
[Kill mutant: Evil God’s Tongue (Three-star Lord Level), gain Battle Merit *5000, gain Sacred Artifact Fragment *1]
Luo Chan, who originally thought today would be the day she died, was not only shocked but also confused beyond words.
What is that? Defense Towers?
But such power, it’s terrifying...
And those ice spears, they have such formidable destructive power!
Who on earth is the master of this Sky Island?
At this moment, even the usually composed and calm Goddess Luo Chan, when facing death, couldn’t help but tremble slightly.
Her eyes filled with intense curiosity, fixed on those five figures on the city wall.
In the air, with four Lords killed, the remaining few Blood Tide Lords showed expressions both angry and fearful.
They were just about to recklessly fight Han Xing!

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 172: Shattering Despair! (Part 2)
paragraphs: However, at this moment, they once again received instructions from that being.
"Gah—"
The Dominator level creature issued a command.
Full retreat!
Whoosh!
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters, including those previously attacking, retreated like a tide again.
"Damn, trying to run again?"
Han Xing wanted to seize the victory and pursue them.
But he noticed another blood-colored bubble flying over from the monster tide.
This bubble seemed to have an auto-tracking feature, unavoidable.
The next moment.
Xingyu City was once again enveloped by that blood-colored bubble, unable to advance an inch.
"Grass, here it comes again!"
Han Xing was helpless too, and stopped in place.
Waiting for the duration of the blood-colored bubble to end.
Twenty seconds of time.
The duration of this thing is neither long nor short.
But it’s just annoying.
At this moment, the survivors of Immortal Mansion experienced a rollercoaster of life and death within a few minutes.
After the crisis was resolved, many sat paralyzed on the ground.
When they saw the scene of the blood clouds rapidly retreating, they couldn’t help but feel a lingering fear.
At that moment, after the panic subsided, everyone turned their curious eyes.
In front of them stood a Sky Island shrouded in blood-colored bubble,
On top stood five young humans, both male and female.
It was they who descended like divine weapons, forcefully breaking the inevitable death situation!
At this time, everyone had some questions in their hearts.
Who exactly are these five people?
Even Zhou Huang, the legendary figure of the first great group, couldn’t achieve this, could he?
At this time, a cyan figure gracefully stepped out from the crowd.
Luo Chan had a special aura about her, exuding an ethereal and elegant demeanor, making it hard for one to look away at first glance.
No wonder Luo Chan was recognized as the goddess-level figure in the fifth major district.
Han Xing also noticed that stunning figure.

Luo Chan walked gracefully, her face showing gratitude, and solemnly said, "Thank you all for your righteous assistance. Luo Chan and the hundreds of thousands of brothers and sisters of Immortal Mansion will forever remember your kindness!"
After speaking, she elegantly bowed deeply to Han Xing and the others.
Seeing their leader bow.
All Immortal Mansion members also saluted Han Xing and the others.
Han Xing lightly nodded, implying he accepted their thanks.
Luo Chan saw this and slightly lowered her phoenix eyes.
Although there was still some distance, given their professionals’ vision level, they could easily see each other’s faces.
At this moment, she also noticed the figure carrying a longbow among the five.
It seemed that he was the one issuing the commands.
In other words, he was the owner of this massive floating island.
Luo Chan stared intently at Han Xing, as if trying to imprint his image in her memory.
Both sides fell into a momentary silence.
A moment later, Luo Chan’s lips curved into a slight smile.
With a gentle smile, unparalleled elegance.
She spoke, "Honored benefactors, would you be willing to visit our Immortal Mansion territory for a chat?"
"The entire Immortal Mansion, with tens of thousands of people, wishes to formally express our gratitude to you all."
After Luo Chan spoke, the survivors of Immortal Mansion looked expectantly at Han Xing.
Luo Chan was not wrong; they did wish to get acquainted with such high-level powerhouses.
At that moment, the blood-colored bubble surrounding Han Xingkong Island had already shattered.
At this moment, Han Xing’s gaze wasn’t on Luo Chan.
But rather focused on the horizon, where the Blood Tide army had already retreated.
It was clear that Luo Chan sincerely wanted to thank him.
However, Han Xing had no intention of interacting with these people right now.
He only wanted to quickly eliminate that group of Blood Tide creatures and accumulate one billion points!
Han Xing directly refused, "No need to be polite, your danger also bears some of my responsibility."
"This rescue was just a casual effort."
After speaking, not waiting for Luo Chan to reply, Han Xing continued, "I have other matters, so let’s part ways here!"
After speaking, Han Xing suddenly accelerated his Sky Island.
His gaze locked onto the distant Blood Tide, as if watching his prey!
Amidst the perplexed gazes of tens of thousands of survivors in Immortal Mansion territory.
A massive floating island suddenly swept over their heads, chasing after the tail of the Blood Tide creatures.
The survivors of Immortal Mansion were stunned.
"Bro... brothers, did I see it wrong? It looks like they’re chasing after that group of Blood Tide creatures?"
The other survivors were shocked beyond words.
"It seems so..."
"Now that I think about it, they also came over like that just now."
"Could it be that these creatures were running here to deal with us because they were fleeing from them?"
This speculation left everyone dumbfounded.
This is likely the truth.
Because just now, that mysterious man also said a sentence, that their danger had a part of his responsibility.
The survivors of Immortal Mansion swallowed, then said with some helplessness.
"Should we call it worthy of being our savior? This is too fierce!"
"Indeed, to make millions of Blood Tide monsters drop their armor and run like chased dogs, I guess there’s only this one man in all humanity."
"Does anyone know what the brothers on that floating island are called? I really want to know such an unparalleled hero!"
This person spoke the minds of everyone.
Including the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan standing nearby, curiosity appeared in her eyes.
She vaguely saw the appearance of those five.
And knew, that the man with the longbow was the owner of that territory.
But unfortunately, the other party seemed in a hurry to deal with those Blood Tide creatures, not intending to interact with them much.
At this time, a survivor in Immortal Mansion made a guess.
"I guess the owner of that Sky Island might be called Star River.
"Star River?"
Upon hearing this name, Luo Chan’s heart trembled.
It’s him...
The last time, a transaction involving a purple backpack also alerted many group leaders.
As the leader of Immortal Mansion, Luo Chan naturally had heard of Han Xing’s name.
At this moment, some surviving members of Immortal Mansion were puzzled, "Star River? Never heard of him. Is he some famous figure?"
Another survivor stepped out and said.
"I don’t know if Star River is famous, but after today, I estimate that billions of survivors worldwide will remember his name!"
"That exaggerated? Why?"
The crowd asked in confusion.
"Check today’s Battle Merit leaderboard, and you’ll know why."
Battle Merit leaderboard?
Upon hearing this.
The survivors of Immortal Mansion seemed to think of something, a hint of curiosity and anticipation in their eyes.
Luo Chan listened, and immediately opened the Battle Merit leaderboard.
When she saw.
The name Star River occupying the top spot with eight-digit Battle Merits.
Her astonished small mouth slightly opened.
"My God... over ten million Battle Merits!!!"
"Hiss..."
Instantly, everyone in Immortal Mansion gasped collectively.
At present, the majority of survivors had only a few hundred, or at most a few thousand Battle Merits.
Even some large group leaders only had tens of thousands of Battle Merits.
At this time, Han Xing’s figure of over ten million Battle Merits was simply astronomical!
Unknowingly shocking tens of thousands around the world.
Luo Chan also developed a strong curiosity about this man with whom she had only a brief encounter.
Currently, Han Xing was unaware of the discussions about him.
He was recklessly consuming Spirit Cores, madly accelerating his core territory!
His goal was the overwhelming Blood Tide army.
After fleeing Han Xing’s pursuit, they quickly moved to another area, targeting a survivor Sky Island.
Their chosen target was also a group Sky Island, named Trilobite.
Like the people in Immortal Mansion.
When they saw the immense horde of millions of monsters sweeping in, they felt a sense of despair.
Some even wrote their last wills on the spot.
However, this sense of despair didn’t last long.
The next moment, they saw a Sky Island speeding from a distance.
Emitting dozens of beams of lightning capable of destroying everything!

sentences.text: However, at this moment, they once again received instructions from that being.
"Gah—"
The Dominator level creature issued a command.
Full retreat!
Whoosh!
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters, including those previously attacking, retreated like a tide again.
"Damn, trying to run again?"
Han Xing wanted to seize the victory and pursue them.
But he noticed another blood-colored bubble flying over from the monster tide.
This bubble seemed to have an auto-tracking feature, unavoidable.
The next moment.
Xingyu City was once again enveloped by that blood-colored bubble, unable to advance an inch.
"Grass, here it comes again!"
Han Xing was helpless too, and stopped in place.
Waiting for the duration of the blood-colored bubble to end.
Twenty seconds of time.
The duration of this thing is neither long nor short.
But it’s just annoying.
At this moment, the survivors of Immortal Mansion experienced a rollercoaster of life and death within a few minutes.
After the crisis was resolved, many sat paralyzed on the ground.
When they saw the scene of the blood clouds rapidly retreating, they couldn’t help but feel a lingering fear.
At that moment, after the panic subsided, everyone turned their curious eyes.
In front of them stood a Sky Island shrouded in blood-colored bubble,
On top stood five young humans, both male and female.
It was they who descended like divine weapons, forcefully breaking the inevitable death situation!
At this time, everyone had some questions in their hearts.
Who exactly are these five people?
Even Zhou Huang, the legendary figure of the first great group, couldn’t achieve this, could he?
At this time, a cyan figure gracefully stepped out from the crowd.
Luo Chan had a special aura about her, exuding an ethereal and elegant demeanor, making it hard for one to look away at first glance.
No wonder Luo Chan was recognized as the goddess-level figure in the fifth major district.
Han Xing also noticed that stunning figure.
Luo Chan walked gracefully, her face showing gratitude, and solemnly said, "Thank you all for your righteous assistance.
Luo Chan and the hundreds of thousands of brothers and sisters of Immortal Mansion will forever remember your kindness!"
After speaking, she elegantly bowed deeply to Han Xing and the others.
Seeing their leader bow.
All Immortal Mansion members also saluted Han Xing and the others.
Han Xing lightly nodded, implying he accepted their thanks.
Luo Chan saw this and slightly lowered her phoenix eyes.
Although there was still some distance, given their professionals’ vision level, they could easily see each other’s faces.
At this moment, she also noticed the figure carrying a longbow among the five.
It seemed that he was the one issuing the commands.
In other words, he was the owner of this massive floating island.
Luo Chan stared intently at Han Xing, as if trying to imprint his image in her memory.
Both sides fell into a momentary silence.
A moment later, Luo Chan’s lips curved into a slight smile.
With a gentle smile, unparalleled elegance.
She spoke, "Honored benefactors, would you be willing to visit our Immortal Mansion territory for a chat?"
"The entire Immortal Mansion, with tens of thousands of people, wishes to formally express our gratitude to you all."
After Luo Chan spoke, the survivors of Immortal Mansion looked expectantly at Han Xing.
Luo Chan was not wrong; they did wish to get acquainted with such high-level powerhouses.
At that moment, the blood-colored bubble surrounding Han Xingkong Island had already shattered.
At this moment, Han Xing’s gaze wasn’t on Luo Chan.
But rather focused on the horizon, where the Blood Tide army had already retreated.
It was clear that Luo Chan sincerely wanted to thank him.
However, Han Xing had no intention of interacting with these people right now.
He only wanted to quickly eliminate that group of Blood Tide creatures and accumulate one billion points!
Han Xing directly refused, "No need to be polite, your danger also bears some of my responsibility."
"This rescue was just a casual effort."
After speaking, not waiting for Luo Chan to reply, Han Xing continued, "I have other matters, so let’s part ways here!"
After speaking, Han Xing suddenly accelerated his Sky Island.
His gaze locked onto the distant Blood Tide, as if watching his prey!
Amidst the perplexed gazes of tens of thousands of survivors in Immortal Mansion territory.
A massive floating island suddenly swept over their heads, chasing after the tail of the Blood Tide creatures.
The survivors of Immortal Mansion were stunned.
"Bro... brothers, did I see it wrong?
It looks like they’re chasing after that group of Blood Tide creatures?"
The other survivors were shocked beyond words.
"It seems so..."
"Now that I think about it, they also came over like that just now."
"Could it be that these creatures were running here to deal with us because they were fleeing from them?"
This speculation left everyone dumbfounded.
This is likely the truth.
Because just now, that mysterious man also said a sentence, that their danger had a part of his responsibility.
The survivors of Immortal Mansion swallowed, then said with some helplessness.
"Should we call it worthy of being our savior?
This is too fierce!"
"Indeed, to make millions of Blood Tide monsters drop their armor and run like chased dogs, I guess there’s only this one man in all humanity."
"Does anyone know what the brothers on that floating island are called?
I really want to know such an unparalleled hero!"
This person spoke the minds of everyone.
Including the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan standing nearby, curiosity appeared in her eyes.
She vaguely saw the appearance of those five.
And knew, that the man with the longbow was the owner of that territory.

At this time, a survivor in Immortal Mansion made a guess.
"I guess the owner of that Sky Island might be called Star River.

It’s him...
The last time, a transaction involving a purple backpack also alerted many group leaders.

Never heard of him.
Is he some famous figure?"

"That exaggerated?
Why?"

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 173: The Man Who Hunts Calamities
paragraphs: When the Blood Tide Monsters were about to overwhelm this Survivor Sky Island, Han Xing made a powerful entrance!
Tens of thousands of monsters perished instantly in this wave of attack.
Not even a bone remained!
Then, Han Xing controlled the Sky Island, recklessly charging into the monster tide, launching a wild bombardment.
This scene gave a strong sense of unreality.
Even the survivors of the Trilobite were stupefied for a long time, unable to recover.
They believe that even after many years, they will never forget this shocking moment!
At this time.
The Dominator Level creature hidden within the Blood Tide.
When it saw Han Xing chasing again, it couldn’t help but show a look of impatience.
The pesky bug, actually so persistently annoying!
However, even if its desire to kill Han Xing was strong, it was helpless.
Unless it personally took action, there was no way to take down this Sky Island.
But even as a Dominator Level creature, it didn’t dare claim it could withstand a wave of attacks from the thousands of Defense Towers on that Sky Island without dying.
In frustration, it was forced to retreat again.
At this moment, Han Xing was once again shrouded in a blood-colored bubble.
In front, the survivors on the Trilobite Sky Island were almost dumbstruck.
What kind of fierce person is this?
As soon as they came, those millions of monsters were bombarded like encountering a nemesis!
Moreover, those monsters, upon seeing them, didn’t even resist, just ran away!
Without paying attention to the shock in the survivors’ eyes.
As soon as the duration of the blood-colored bubble ended.
Without a moment of hesitation, Han Xing invested a large number of Spirit Cores again, rushing out like a speeding rocket.
Vaguely, they seemed to hear someone shouting, don’t run, my Battle Merit, with baffling words like these.
After Han Xing’s Sky Island departed.
One of the survivors swallowed and asked the person next to him, "Did you record it just now?"
Others nodded, their eyes filled with disbelief.
"Recorded... recorded it."
"Great! Hurry and upload this video, let others see that an unrivaled fierce person has appeared among our human survivors!"
"Oh right, by the way, give our Trilobite a bit of an advertisement."
Upon hearing this, that survivor immediately nodded.
When this video was uploaded, a heated discussion broke out in the chat channel.
Moreover, the Trilobite people were vigorously promoting it in there.
Saying they saw with their own eyes, there were only five people on that Sky Island.
But their displayed combat power far exceeded everyone’s imagination.
Initially, those survivors who heard about it were very skeptical and certain that it was impossible.
After all, five survivors, chasing down millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
It sounded way too fantastical.
However, as more and more videos were uploaded from various angles.
The disdain in many people’s eyes turned into shock!
On this day, in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Countless survivors witnessed that astonishing scene.
In front, millions of Blood Tide Monsters fleeing at high speed.
Chased closely by a Sky Island.
With singular power, pursuing these millions of monsters!
They have completely believed this seemingly absurd event.
At this moment, the chat channel exploded!
"Brothers, have you ever seen a fierce person? This is a true fierce person!"
"What does it mean to single-handedly chase down millions of troops?"
"Whose subordinate is this? I would call him the greatest fierce person of Blue Star!"
Other survivors developed a strong curiosity about the person above,
"Does anyone know who the fierce person above is?"
"No need to guess, just check the Battle Merit List and you’ll know."
At the same time, many people eagerly opened the Battle Merit List.
Now on the Battle Merit List, the only existence whose merit has surpassed eight digits!
Also knew that the fierce person on that Sky Island is called Star River.
Moreover, as Han Xing continued to pursue those Blood Tide Monsters, his Battle Merit kept increasing at a terrifying speed!
On this day, Star River earned another title.
The Fierce Person Chasing Calamity!
On Han Xing’s side, in relentless pursuit of the Blood Tide Monsters.
Along the way, countless survivors were rescued.
Among them were many large teams.
These people, at the first moment of being liberated, also united more survivors to rescue nearby humans.
Step by step advantage accumulated, and then it snowballed larger and larger.
The human situation was already developing in a positive direction.
More and more survivors were free to act, and actively engaged in rescuing other besieged Sky Islands.
With the united efforts of all humans.
After a full day of fighting.
The Blood Tide Crisis, which had been brewing for five days, was finally gradually broken!
From the failure of millions of monsters to besiege Han Xing, to Han Xing’s victorious pursuit, and hunting down Blood Tide Creatures. Nearly ten hours passed.
From morning until sunset.
Han Xing was almost nonstop in activating the Territory Core Accelerator, keeping his Sky Island ahead of the monster army’s speed.
Of course, the consumption was also extremely terrifying.
The territory core consumes 20,000 Spirit Cores every minute, which translates to 1.2 million per hour.
Until now, Han Xingguang has used the cores for acceleration, consuming over ten million Spirit Cores!
However, his gains are equally astonishing.
Just in Battle Merit alone, Han Xing has already achieved over 30 million!
A whole day’s relentless pursuit, Han Xing has shown the monsters what it means to fight to the end.
He chased them like a mad dog, tirelessly on the heels of the Blood Tide Monsters.
Time and again, they were caught up to, time and again, they were consumed.
The number of monsters has been reduced by nearly half!
Among them, many Lord-level monsters were killed by Han Xing’s firepower bombardment.
Now, he has 8 Sacred Artifact Fragments in his backpack.
Though there’s still a distance to exchange for that Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact, it gives Han Xing hope.
At this moment, the Dominator-level monster seems to have activated some skills, and the speed of the tens of millions of Blood Tide army surges again.
Han Xing hurriedly urged the Sky Island Territory to keep up.
Throughout the day, they battled across tens of thousands of kilometers.
Now, even Han Xing doesn’t know where they have arrived.
As it was getting late.
The blood-colored moon climbed back above everyone’s head.
However, after continuing to pursue the monsters for a distance longer.
Han Xing suddenly saw a glaring blood-red appear in front.
It seems that there are more Blood Tide Monsters ahead.
When they got closer, they found the scale of the blood-red scene was beyond their imagination.
There, it was like a world condensed from blood-colored mist!
Just a glance made everyone’s scalp tingle almost simultaneously.
"Damn it!"
At this moment, Han Xing made no hesitation.
Directly controlled the Sky Island to flee backward at extreme speed!
During the escape, the five of them kept their nerves tense, for fear something might catch up from behind.
They fled for nearly an hour, across over three thousand kilometers.
Only then did Han Xing stop the Sky Island.
Despite this, when thinking of that scene, everyone turned pale and felt lingering fears.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong swallowed a mouthful of saliva and asked with difficulty, "Just now... what was that?"
"Don’t tell me, that huge mass was all Blood Tide Monsters?"
Everyone’s eyes were filled with disbelief.
While chasing that massive Blood Tide Monster group, Han Xing saw them suddenly burrow into an even larger blood mist.
If all in there are monsters, just in numbers, it might be many times the size of the monster group that besieged Han Xing and his party!
Han Xing also felt some lingering fear and said, "I vaguely saw something floating in the blood mist,"
"Perhaps that’s where the altar mentioned by the system lies."
After hearing this, everyone’s faces showed a look of realization.
If that’s the location of the altar, it makes sense.
After all, everyone knows that Blood Tide Monsters come to the Land of the Abandoned Gods through the altar.
No wonder the scale of monsters there is so terrifying!
When the Sky Island finally stopped.
After experiencing a day of speed and passion, everyone collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Once they snapped back from witnessing the shocking scene of the Blood Altar.
Cheng Jianyong took deep breaths as he sighed.
"Damn, today was truly exhilarating, annihilating tens of millions of monsters, how much Battle Merit is that, just thinking of it makes me tremble all over!"
Shen Yun at the side also nodded in deep agreement.
"Brother Xing has truly made a name for himself this time, all day long it’s Star River’s name on screen, even Zhou Huang is rarely mentioned now."
Not just Cheng Jianyong and the others.
In the territory, Lanlan and others looked at Han Xing with deep admiration in their eyes!
Compared to the video clips circulating everywhere now, their personal experience left a deeper impression.
They also clearly know that Han Xing’s territory strength far exceeds others’ imagination!
At the very least, the Thunderbolt Tower, such High-Level construction, hasn’t shown up anywhere in the entire trading channel.
Han Xing’s face also showed a gratified smile.
A whole day of high-intensity fighting kept his nerves constantly tense.
But likewise, the gains were also astonishing.
Especially when Han Xing looked at his Battle Merit count, he couldn’t help but laugh happily!
Battle Merit: 34.32 million!
Over 30 million!
Such a terrifying amount of Battle Merit, if all exchanged for Golden Treasure Chests, it’s nearly over 3,000 pieces of Golden Equipment!
It could even arm a regiment of a thousand people!
Of course, Han Xing certainly wouldn’t use it all to exchange for Golden Treasure Chests.
Because this wouldn’t maximize the benefits of those Battle Merits.
After all, the Battle Merit Store has plenty of good things.
Apart from Golden Treasure Chests, there are also Puppets of various grades.
And 5 limited, more precious Bright Moon Treasure Chests that haven’t been exchanged!
Han Xing rubbed his hands in excitement.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked from the side, "Brother Xing, are you going to exchange for the Bright Moon Treasure Chest now?"
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze towards him.
The Bright Moon Treasure Chest, which offers a high probability of yielding Orange-Level Equipment.
Until now, none of them have seen one, let alone opened one.
They couldn’t help but be curious.
Han Xing was very much looking forward to it as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 174: Counting the Spoils, Opening the Bright Moon Treasure Chest!
paragraphs: After considering for a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s wait to exchange for the Bright Moon Treasure Chest, I’ll redeem the Lord Puppet first."
Everyone’s eyes lit up upon hearing this.
The Lord Puppet is also a rare and valuable item.
The power of lord-level creatures was something they had already experienced.
Especially puppets, due to their unique body structure, are immune to the Blood Curse, making them the best troops to face this Blood Tide outbreak.
Combined with the powerful combat force of the lord-level puppet, it could withstand tides of tens of thousands of monsters all by itself.
Then, with a wave of his hand, Han Xing directly clicked to exchange.
The system prompt appeared.
"Do you wish to consume Battle Merits: 300000, to exchange for Moon Armor Puppet*1."
"Yes."
The next moment.
In front of everyone, a fifty-meter-tall silver-white armored giant appeared out of thin air!
This giant was clad in silver-white chain armor, covered with scale-like patterns.
The thickness of its armor, even at a glance, hinted at its terrifying defense.
Moreover, the moment this giant appeared.
The five of them, including Han Xing, felt as though they were enveloped by a peculiar force, with a significant increase in their defense.
It was the lord-level puppet’s skill, Puppet King Domain: Increases the defense of all allied creatures by 20%!
"Wow... this effect is really good!" Shen Yun exclaimed.
His entire body was wrapped in heavy golden armor, and his defense was already extremely high.
Now, with the addition of Puppet King Domain, his defense reached an exaggerated level.
Compared to others, this lord-level puppet skill was more beneficial for Shen Yun.
But the one who gained the most was, of course, Han Xing!
The domain could increase the defense of all allies.
This also included the wolf cavalry army and the minotaur army below!
For over ten thousand wolf cavalry to all receive a 20% defense boost, what concept is that?
Especially with the presence of the Dark Night Goddess Statue and the Vim Divine Power Horn.
Under the triple enhancement,
The wolf cavalry’s frontal combat capability got a significant boost.
One could say, now any random wolf cavalry could easily beat an elite monster of the same level!
Just the presence of this domain skill alone, even if the Moon Armor Puppet had no combat power, it was already incredibly powerful!
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of the Moon Armor Puppet appeared.
[Moon Armor Puppet (Three-Star Lord Creature)]: Specially enhanced puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Level]: Level 25.
[Attributes]: Power 764, Agility 653, Spirit 633, Constitution 754.
[Skills]: Steel Bones, Flame Spray, Blood Cutting, Heavy Hammer Strike, Metal Burst, Puppet Master Domain (Exclusive Domain Skill).
Han Xing previously had a Golden Armor Puppet of a similar type, which was a leader creature.
But as Han Xing’s level kept increasing, that Golden Armor Puppet’s level could no longer keep up, so it hadn’t been deployed again.
Undeniably, the combat power of these puppet creatures was very formidable.
Han Xing pondered, "The lord-level Moon Armor Puppet is limited to one exchange, but there is no limit for the leader-level Golden Armor Puppet."
"However, a Golden Armor Puppet also requires 50,000 points to exchange."
"In the case of excessive battle merits, exchanging a batch of Golden Armor Puppets to form a puppet legion is also a good choice."
"But for now, it’s better to save battle merits and exchange for that Sun Treasure Chest worth 100 million battle merits."
Everyone also looked up, shocked at the fifty-meter Chain Armor Giant, feeling waves of security.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "As expected of a lord-level creature, just this one domain skill is comparable to the improvement from a piece of top-grade equipment.
"Moreover, it’s an all-unit enhancement, making the gains even more incredible!"
Shen Yun nodded and said, "That’s right, I think every human team, as long as they have enough points, should exchange for a lord-level puppet first."
"This thing, the improvement is massive!"
Shen Yun’s statement was right; the lord-level puppet was the biggest help to the team.
But 300,000 battle merits are no small number.
For other survivors, it would take at least one or two months of life-and-death battles to accumulate this number.
Even the leaders of large groups would need at least one or two weeks’ time.
But for Han Xing, accumulating these 300,000 battle merits was too easy and simple.
Just a few waves of bombardment from the territory defense towers would suffice to gather this number.
After exchanging the lord puppet,
Han Xing still had 34 million battle merits left.
Just enough to spend what he had to spare.
Now, he was about to exchange for another valuable item from the Battle Merit Store.
Han Xing excitedly rubbed his hands and said, "Finally, I’m about to open my first Bright Moon Treasure Chest in life!"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and the others all set aside their tasks and looked at Han Xing expectantly.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly exchanged for the first Bright Moon Treasure Chest.
"Do you wish to consume battle merits*1,000,000, to exchange for a Bright Moon Treasure Chest*1?"
"Yes."
"Exchange successful, remaining exchange attempts: 4."
The prompt ended.
Clink!
In front of everyone, a chest appeared, intricately carved like crystal, its surface emitting a pure white radiance.
The mere appearance of this treasure chest makes one feel its preciousness.
Inside, there must be even more rare treasures hidden!
Han Xing was just about to ask Su Xiaoyang for help in opening the chest.
But then he saw the prompt on the chest.
[Can only be opened by the chest redeemer.]
Han Xing was a bit surprised, seemingly not expecting that the Bright Moon Treasure Chest had such a restriction.
He felt a bit uncertain about his own luck.
But since there was such a restriction, he had no other choice.
Han Xing approached the artistic treasure chest and directly clicked to open it.
The next moment.
The dazzling orange radiance illuminated the entire territory.
It was the light emitted from the orange armor.
When the light dissipated.
A pile of materials of varying colors and strange shapes appeared under the crystal treasure chest.
There were a few pieces that looked like liquid yet also like metallic black stones.
There were also a few burning strange items, resembling flames and some kind of plant seeds.
"The shapes of the materials from the Bright Moon Treasure Chest are quite distinctive..."
Han Xing’s mouth twitched.
On top of this pile of materials, he also saw a pair of ancient boots.
The boots looked very ordinary, with a black exterior, and it was unclear what material they were made from.
However, everyone had witnessed that intense radiance.
Surely, these boots must not be simple.
Han Xing quickly gathered all the materials, and the system prompt appeared.
[Successfully opened Bright Moon Treasure Chest, acquired Permanent Gold Ingot*74, Rhythm Black Iron*11, Ancient Fire*3... acquired Phantom Spirit Boots (orange)*1.]
"There really is orange equipment!"
Han Xing was thrilled beyond measure.
Just as he had expected.
"Now, let’s see if this orange equipment is of Legendary Quality or Epic Quality!"
With an excited heart, Han Xing clicked to view the attributes of the boots.
[Phantom Spirit Boots (orange) lv25, Quality: Legendary, Defense: 72~87, Agility+55, Power+40, Constitution+30.]
[Attached Effect]: Phantom Spirit (When attacked, has a 50% chance to convert 100 Spirit into Agility attribute)
[Attached Effect]: Shadowless (Increases movement speed by 25%)
[Attached Effect]: Thousand Miles a Day (Legendary Effect, entering battle state increases agility by 1 point for every meter moved, up to a limit of 100, effects last until battle state ends.)
Seeing the above attributes, even with Han Xing’s composure, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
Although only of Legendary Quality, its attributes are vastly stronger than the golden boots he currently has equipped.
Furthermore, all three effects are very powerful.
Especially the Legendary Effect, its actual impact is even stronger than described.
Entering battle state increases agility without cooldown.
The only limitation is needing to move 100 meters to stack to the full state.
And given Han Xing’s current movement speed.
meters only takes two seconds to cover.
This effect essentially adds 100 agility long-term.
Combined with Han Xing’s current base attributes, it’s already surpassing the S+ growth Coal Ball!
Seeing Han Xing’s shocked expression, they guessed that the attributes of this equipment must be very powerful.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, what’s the attribute of these boots? Show us!"
Han Xing satisfied their curiosity by posting the attributes of the Phantom Spirit Boots.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
"Wow, such high agility!"
Shen Yun also agreed, "Indeed, and should we say, as expected of orange equipment?"
"One item increasing attributes roughly 30% more than golden equipment—if you wear a whole set, wouldn’t you be invincible?"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Undoubtedly, the enhancement from a piece of orange equipment is huge.
Even if it’s only of Legendary Quality, it’s still much stronger than golden equipment of the same level.
If they could obtain two more pieces, the Survivor’s strength would experience a terrifying qualitative change.
At this time, they all looked towards Han Xing.
Because they knew Han Xing currently had over thirty million battle merits.
He could exchange for four more treasure chests of this level!
Han Xing also smiled slightly, internally excited for the upcoming treasure chest rewards.
But before that, Han Xing needed to check what the other two new materials obtained just now were used for.
Firstly, the material resembling both liquid and stone.
[Rhythm Black Iron]: A certain unknown ancient material, containing powerful energy inside, can be used to craft certain powerful weapons, once favored by master artisans of the Dwarf Race.
Note: Collect a certain amount of Rhythm Black Iron to seek the Dwarf Race’s chief artisan to exchange for ancient weapon blueprints.
"Huh?"
Seeing the description above, Han Xing was greatly surprised.
Rhythm Black Iron, seemingly quite extraordinary.
It’s actually one of the raw materials for crafting ancient weapons!

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 175: Flying Unit, Big-beaked Bird
paragraphs: Rhythmic Iron, unexpectedly, is one of the main materials for crafting ancient weapons.
So far, Han Xing has only encountered one ancient weapon, which is the Gold Melting Cannon.
Although it’s only a level 10 equipment, Han Xing once relied on it to crush countless level 15 and 20 monsters along the way.
Moreover, it was with the help of the Gold Melting Cannon that he secured first place on the Secret Realm leaderboard.
Just these two points are enough to prove that any ancient weapon is incredibly powerful.
"Collect a certain amount of Rhythmic Iron, and you can go find the dwarves to exchange for ancient weapon blueprints?"
Han Xing’s eyes showed an expectant expression.
Speaking of which, he already has two items that are related to the Dwarf Race.
The first one is the Spiritual Puppet Blueprint.
Due to the lack of its crucial Spiritual Core Device, Han Xing’s dream of building a puppet army fell through.
The second is Rhythmic Iron.
If he can really exchange for a few ancient weapon blueprints and combine them with Han Xing’s talent ability, he might be able to mass-produce!
"It seems, if there’s a chance, I must find the location of the Dwarf Race."
Han Xing made up his mind.
Of course, the premise is that the entire Human Race can survive this Blood Tide crisis.
Then, Han Xing began to check another item.
[Ancient Fire]: Contains an ancient aura, once ignited, this fire can help find the location of the Path of the Giant Dragon.
"Fire? Ancient aura?"
Han Xing looked puzzled.
This thing seems to be used as a kind of guiding item.
But, what is the Path of the Giant Dragon?
A higher-level dungeon, or some special area?
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing didn’t come up with any relevant information.
Although he doesn’t know its specific use, the items from the Bright Moon Treasure Chest are certainly not bad.
Thinking of this, Han Xing put it back into his backpack.
Now, he is going to exchange for four more Bright Moon Treasure Chests!
Han Xing waved his hand, directly consuming four million points!
Clang! Clang!
Four artistically inspired Crystal Treasure Chests appeared!
Without hesitation, Han Xing opened all four at once.
Orange light flashed in bursts.
The entire Xingyu City seemed to be running a series of slideshows, confusing the relatives in the Lord’s Mansion.
Han Xing also collected all the materials in the chests.
The system notification appeared.
[Successfully opened Bright Moon Treasure Chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*78, obtained Rhythmic Iron*14, obtained Witch Race Emblem*3, obtained Silent Stab (Orange)*1]
[Successfully opened Bright Moon Treasure Chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*64, obtained Rhythmic Iron*15, obtained Ancient Fire*4, obtained Yellow Sand Shield Blueprint (Golden)*1]
[Obtained Heart of Origin (Orange)*1...]
[Obtained Big-beaked Bird Nest Blueprint*1...]
"Wow!"
Even with Han Xing’s composure, he couldn’t help but shout out loud.
Among the four Bright Moon Treasure Chests, a total of two pieces of Orange Equipment, one Golden Shield blueprint, and a unit camp construction blueprint were obtained!
Among them, aside from the [Silent Stab], which is an orange dagger.
The other three items are all useful to Han Xing and greatly benefit him!
The first is the Yellow Sand Shield, a level 25 Golden Equipment blueprint!
It’s known that shields are the second hardest equipment to appear in Sky Island Paradise, besides accessories.
Even Shen Yun is currently using the level 10 Golden Shield, Shield of Immortality.
However, compared to the Shield of Immortality, the Yellow Sand Shield’s defensive power alone exceeds by more than double.
Moreover, this is just a blueprint!
It’s known that golden equipment made by Han Xing’s hand has a high probability of being of Legendary Quality.
It will also carry a powerful Legend effect!
Such rare golden equipment, once appearing on the trading channel, will undoubtedly cause a frenzy.
Especially after this Blood Tide event, teams have become more aware of the importance of Shield Knights.
The defensive line formed by Shield Knights can greatly reduce the casualty rate once it blocks Blood Tide Monsters!
Now, major teams are recruiting Shield Knights everywhere in the chat channels with generous offerings.
Even Paladins aren’t spared if they can’t find Shield Knights.
Especially those well-equipped Shield Knights are warmly welcomed by major teams at this time!
Han Xing also clapped both hands and directly clicked to learn the blueprint.
[Successfully learned the Yellow Sand Shield (Golden) Blueprint...]
Then, Han Xing checked the materials needed to make the Yellow Sand Shield.
[Materials needed]: Permanent Gold Ingot*100, Purple Gold Stone*50, Mithril*1200, Dusk Sand*20...
The first three materials are common, but the last, Dusk Sand, is a bit troublesome.
However, this is not difficult for Han Xing.
He directly searched for the keyword in the trading channel, where hundreds of consignment messages quickly appeared.
Han Xing saw that the price of Dusk Sand wasn’t high, roughly 10,000 Spirit Core for one unit.
Han Xing also waved his hand and purchased 100 units of Dusk Sand.
With materials ready, he clicked to craft.
[Consume materials to craft Yellow Sand Shield (Golden)*1?]
"Yes."
The next moment, a 300-second progress bar appeared on the crafting interface.
During the waiting time, Han Xing checked another piece of equipment.
Heart of Origin.
The name sounds strange, but it’s a special equipment, similar to badges and other accessories.
Each survivor can only equip one.
The attributes of this equipment appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Heart of Origin (Orange) lv25, Quality: Epic, Defense 39~45, Power+37, Agility+42, Spirit+45, Constitution+53.]

Shen Yun asked puzzledly, "Brother Xing, is this equipment an accessory type?"
Han Xing nodded.
Shen Yun suddenly had a look of realization.
Speaking of which, up until now, none of them had obtained a high-grade accessory equipment.
Except for Han Xing, who received a Hunter’s Medal as a system reward for killing the first Lord monster.
Moreover, the Hunter’s Medal is a growth-type equipment and requires killing Lord-level creatures to level up.
Now, its upgrade progress has reached 9/10.
Han Xing noticed that using territorial buildings to kill Lord-level creatures could also increase the upgrade progress of the Hunter’s Medal.
At this moment, Han Xing mused, "In terms of attributes alone, the Hunter’s Medal might not compare to the Heart of Origin, but its attributes are more suitable for me."
"Additionally, the Hunter’s Medal is about to advance, and by then, there should be other changes."
"So, this Heart of Origin should still go to someone who needs it."
Undoubtedly, the most suitable person for this piece of equipment on the field was Shen Yun.
When Shen Yun noticed Han Xing’s gaze, he immediately understood his intention.
However, Shen Yun declined, "Brother Xing, you don’t need to give this equipment to me, it should go to Sister Lian Meng."
Beside them, Zhang Lianmeng was a bit taken aback.
She was a Mage, why would she need such a high constitution piece of equipment?
Zhang Lianmeng hurriedly waved her hand.
However, at this moment, Shen Yun explained, "Brother Xing, Sister Lian Meng, please listen to me."
"So far, our levels are beyond those Blood Tide monsters, so in battle, we can basically crush them with our attributes."
"Besides, with Brother Xing’s help, my current set of equipment is already quite luxurious, even without the Heart of Origin, those monsters can hardly touch me."
"Instead, it’s Sister Lian Meng who, as a Mage, has the weakest Defense among our five."
"If any unexpected situation occurs later, like our formation being disrupted, Sister Lian Meng can still have some means of self-protection with this equipment."
Hearing this, everyone was taken aback.
Then, they pondered thoughtfully in their minds.
It must be said that Shen Yun’s analysis was indeed very reasonable.
The Mage profession is naturally fragile, even with a full set of Golden Equipment, it’s not much better off.
But equipping the Heart of Origin is a different story.
Its high Armor and Constitution, along with those two effects, can both be life-saving.
Its actual effect is almost equivalent to the enhancement brought by a shield.
Even equipping it as a Mage profession can greatly increase Defense.
And for Zhang Lianmeng, it complements her weaknesses.
Han Xing nodded, then directly handed this green aura-emitting, jade-like equipment to Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng did not refuse, knowing that Han Xing did not want anything to happen to her.
This charming woman looked at Han Xing with deeply infatuated eyes.
At this moment, a bright golden light flashed.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully crafted, obtained Shield of Yellow Sand (Gold) *1]
Seeing the golden light, Cheng Jianyong asked suspiciously.
"Eh? What’s this commotion, did Brother Xing just craft Golden Armor?"
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right."
Then he also checked the attributes of the just-crafted equipment.
[Shield of Yellow Sand (Gold) lv25, Grade: Legendary, Defense 107~115, Spirit +50, Constitution +55.]
[Attached Effect]:
Intermediate Force Discharge: When receiving physical attacks, reduces damage by 100 Power from the opponent.
Intermediate Magic Resistance: When attacked by magic, reduces damage effect by 20%.
Yellow Sand Barrier: Legendary Effect, when activated, can apply a layer of Yellow Sand Shield on oneself and all teammates, lasting for 60 seconds.
During the Yellow Sand Shield’s duration, all physical damage is reduced by 60%, and all magic damage is reduced by 30%.
Cooldown time: 60 minutes.
After reading the Shield of Yellow Sand’s attributes, Han Xing was once again delighted.
Shield-type equipment effects are very pure, all about damage reduction.
Compared to the Level 10 Shield of Immortality, the defense of the Shield of Yellow Sand is more than doubled.
Especially with that Legendary Effect, Yellow Sand Barrier, which is terrifically strong!
In Han Xing’s hand suddenly appeared a rectangular, earthy yellow shield.
The Shield of Yellow Sand appeared very simple, resembling a smooth stone slab.
There were no complex patterns on it, just a flat, earthy yellow surface.
As if this really were a shield crafted from yellow sand.
Han Xing directly tossed it to Shen Yun.
Shen Yun was initially a bit confused, but upon seeing the Shield of Yellow Sand’s attributes, his pupils instantly dilated as he exclaimed.
"Holy crap! A Legendary Shield!"
Upon hearing Shen Yun’s exclamation, Cheng Jianyong instantly dashed over.
"What legendary shield? Let me see!" Cheng Jianyong asked eagerly.
Shen Yun obliged, posting the Shield of Yellow Sand’s attributes up.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
"Wow! Such high Defense, it’s almost equal to two of my pieces of equipment!"
"And it has a Legendary Effect, a 60% reduction in physical damage, holy crap!"
Instantly, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes turned red with envy.
However, it’s no wonder he was so surprised.
After all, that one Legendary Effect of the Shield of Yellow Sand is indeed a bit overpowered.
A 60% reduction in physical damage, combined with the team’s high-quality equipment.
It can be said, during the Shield of Yellow Sand’s effect duration, they are basically immune to the damage from those ordinary monsters.
"Damn! Why do you get to use all the good stuff?"
"Lucky that the Heart of Origin wasn’t given to you." Cheng Jianyong said angrily.
Shen Yun ignored him, just happily glanced at the earthy yellow shield in his hands, stroking over it.
Now, even without the Heart of Origin,
this Shield of Yellow Sand has elevated Shen Yun’s Defense to a whole new level!
Especially with the Puppet Realm’s enhancement, it can further augment it, reaching a quite terrifying level!
Currently, even facing a Three-star Lord monster, he’d feel no fear.
Watching the two bicker in their usual way, Han Xing’s lips curled into a slight smile.
Now, out of the five Bright Moon Treasure Chests, four of the rewards have already been checked.
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel amazed.
Is this what’s truly worthy of being the Bright Moon Treasure Chest?
Randomly obtaining any equipment or item from it greatly aids him.
That five million Battle Merit was truly worth spending!
Now, the reward from the last treasure chest remains unchecked.
It is a blueprint.
In Han Xing’s eyes, the importance of this blueprint is even more valuable than a piece of Orange Equipment!
[Big-beaked Bird Nest Construction Plan]: A special territorial building, capable of constructing a Big-beaked Bird’s Nest lands. The Lord can exchange Spirit Cores to incubate Big-beaked Eggs.
Big-beaked Bird, just by the name, you know it’s a winged creature.
In other words, they have the ability to fly.
"Big-beaked Bird, flying creature!"
Han Xing was immensely thrilled: "Great! That way, I can have my first batch of flying units!"
He eagerly checked the materials needed to construct the bird’s nest.
[Big-beaked Bird Nest Construction Materials Required]: Big-beaked Bird Race Totem *1, Wood *1,000,000, Grass *500,000, Refined Iron *200,000, Dark Fire Stone *10,000, Mithril *5,000.
Han Xing murmured, "This thing requires different materials from the Wolf Cavalry Camp."
The key material among them is the Big-beaked Bird Race Totem!
