chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 176: The Solution to the Blood Tide
paragraphs: Building the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest requires the key material, the Big-beaked Bird Totem.
Han Xing, with a probing mindset, glanced at the trading channel.
After a moment, he shook his head with some regret.
"As expected, such crucial items aren’t easy to obtain."
However, Han Xing felt satisfied.
The rewards from the five Bright Moon Treasure Chests had already been fully checked, and they provided him with great help.
Yet at this moment, Han Xing still had 29 million Battle Merit in hand!
With so much Battle Merit, he wasn’t sure how to spend it all at once.
After everyone had left, Han Xing stood alone on the walls of Xingyu City, gazing into the night sky ahead.
At night, the high sky was cold and biting.
As his exhilarated mind gradually cleared, a trace of worry appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Up ahead was where he saw the Blood Altar today.
Han Xing murmured, "That Zhou Huang wasn’t wrong, the speed at which those altars spawn monsters far exceeds our imagination!"
"I thought that after taking down tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters today, the Blood Tide’s scale would weaken a bit."
"In reality, I was thinking too much."
"The number of monsters killed today barely matches the scale of one altar, yet in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, who knows how many such altars exist."
"If we don’t destroy the altars, we’ll never be able to defeat the Blood Tide."
Thoughts flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
"It seems like the altars are key to solving the Blood Tide."
"Similarly, those Blood Tide creatures understand this principle, which is why they haven’t deployed their full force and have left more troops to protect the altars."
To solve the Blood Tide, we must destroy the altars and stop more monsters from arriving in the real world.
But destroying the altars means confronting millions, or even billions, of monster threats, forcing a brutal assault.
Clearly, this is nearly an impossible task.
It’s beyond the capability of all humanity, including Han Xing.
Unless we can gather all human elites together.
Then unite most of the Survivor Sky Islands to form a massive force.
With sheer numbers, we might be able to directly battle the Blood Tide, push through all the way, and destroy the altars one by one.
A spark of inspiration flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
He speculated.
This might be a solution left by the system for humanity to resolve the Blood Tide.
Which is why it directly merged all of humanity globally, removing the server barrier.
Of course, this solution is based on not having anomalies like Han Xing.
Today’s battle, Han Xing has already proved with his actions.
Even an overwhelming wave of Blood Tide Monsters couldn’t shake his Xingyu City.
And they could even be pursued and killed by him along the way.
Although, upon seeing the vast number of monsters around the altar, even he felt a sense of pressure.
But this does not mean Han Xing has no means.
All fear stems from a lack of firepower.
Han Xing suddenly looked up and said in a deep voice.
"As long as... I can double or triple the number of Thunderbolt Towers and Catapults, I should be able to bravely push through the monster tide and reach the vicinity of the Blood Altar!"
"But to be safe, we need to triple or quadruple the Thunderbolt Towers and Catapults."
"However, this means consuming a terrifying amount of resources as well."
Thinking of this, Han Xing clenched his fist.
"Resources, I need more resources!"
Then, Han Xing opened his warehouse again to check his material reserves.
These days, Han Xing has been on the crafting interface 24/7, only pausing to craft some urgently needed items.
The rest of the time was spent entirely making Blood Curse Antidotes.
After six days.
The number of Blood Curse Antidotes in Han Xing’s possession had reached over 125,000 bottles.
It seems like a lot, but compared to the world’s human population, it is still too little—not even a drop in the ocean.
But there’s no choice; making Blood Curse Antidotes takes 5 seconds per bottle, resulting in a limited daily output.
"125,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote should be about ready for a market rollout."
Thinking of this, Han Xing also entered the public channel.
After today’s chaos, intense discussions erupted in the chat channel.
Survivors there were saying:
"Brothers, the Blood Tide Monsters are getting stronger by the day, and their numbers are increasing. This is forcing us to unite!"
"Exactly, not even medium-sized groups can withstand such disasters anymore!"
"Not just small groups, but even large groups face the same trouble. Apart from the Huayi Alliance and Kunlun, no one else dare claim they can resist the next wave of Blood Tide Monster invasion."
At this, everyone was left stunned.
"No way, it’s that extreme? Even the Divine Hall and Kyushu can’t handle it?"
"No, their strength is still a bit less compared to those two behemoths."
"I heard that in District 5, the Immortal Mansion almost got wiped out today. It was at the critical moment that the Star God arrived to save them."
At this point, other survivors listened and also spoke up.
"Our Stark Class was saved by the Star God today as well—we’re so thankful."
"So was our Red Rose."
"Speaking of which, the Star God saved at least millions of lives today. I really don’t know how to thank him."
"Yeah, the pity is that the Star God refuses to accept stranger messages, so you can’t even private chat with him."
Someone else asked, "By the way, does anyone know how the Star God developed? The firepower on his territory is just too terrifying."
"I don’t want to know how the Star God developed; I just want to know if he’s still recruiting! I’d even be willing to sign a ten-year Lord Contract!"
"You’d sign for ten years? I’d sign for twenty!"
"I’d sign for a lifetime, as long as the Star God is willing to take me in!"
"Everyone upstairs, don’t even think about it. The Star God even refuses stranger messages, which means he doesn’t want to recruit anyone at all."
"Really? That’s such a shame..."
All day today, the chat channel has been revolving around the name "Star River," with ongoing discussions.
Even in Area 1 with Zhou Huang, and Area 2 with Boundless, their fame is overshadowed by him.
Now, you could say Han Xing has achieved true fame.
After a round of heated discussion.
The topic shifted to how to deal with the current Blood Tide disaster.
"Sigh... From now on, the situation for humans is becoming more difficult."
"Who says it’s not? If we don’t solve the source, these monsters will keep being born endlessly, and humanity can’t afford it."
"In the past couple of days, more and more of our team have reached five layers or more of the Blood Curse."
"If this continues, even if the Blood Tide monsters don’t swallow us, we won’t have much fighting power left."
The Blood Curse is something that everyone has a headache about.
The whole world is now searching for a way to lift this curse.
Han Xing also knows the global human situation, so these days, he has been continuously producing this antidote.
Now, the stock of the antidote in his hands has finally reached 120,000 bottles.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing directly opened the chat channel and spoke there.
"Fellow human beings, hello, I am Star River."
This was his first time speaking in the public chat channel.
As soon as this message appeared, the whole chat channel suddenly fell into a momentary freeze.
Almost everyone rubbed their eyes, wanting to confirm if they were seeing correctly.
Upon confirming that the ID of the speaker was completely consistent with the one currently on the battle merit leaderboard.
Then, came the crazy spam messages.
"Star God! You’re finally here!"
"Do you remember me? I’m Wang Diao Mao, you saved my life today!"
"Star God, look at me, I’m your loyal little fan."
"I’m the Star God’s dog!"
The spam messages kept appearing.
At this time, Han Xing said again: "Please be quiet, everyone, I have something important to announce."
Upon hearing this, the spam messages began to gradually stop.
Now, the name Star River is indeed spreading by word of mouth, and everyone knows he saved many people today.
Even some survivors who hadn’t noticed the message and were still spamming were soon stopped by their friends.
Upon seeing the spam finally quiet down.
Han Xing slowly said, "I think everyone is now worried about the Blood Curse; there is currently no effective way to remove this troublesome curse."
"I won’t beat around the bush. I’ll get straight to the point: I have a batch of antidotes that can lift the Blood Curse."
The chat channel was silent for a moment.
The next moment, it caused a fierce uproar again!
And this time, it surpassed any previous instance.
The survivors, as if hearing something unbelievable, spammed crazily asking.
"Star God! Is it true that you have antidotes to lift the Blood Curse?"
"How many antidotes do you have?"
"Star God, please save me, I’m almost driven mad by the Blood Curse!"
"Star God..."
The spam messages were so fast that Han Xing could hardly see what people were saying.
At the same time.
Survivors all over the world received the news.
In the chat channel, methods to solve the Blood Curse appeared!
This message was as shocking to everyone as today’s Blood Tide outbreak!
At this current stage, what draws the most attention is naturally information about the Blood Tide monsters, especially methods for lifting the Blood Curse.
After these days of fighting, countless survivors were struck by the Blood Curse.
Their curse levels varied, but even with just 1 layer, they had to endure the torment of this curse constantly.
Those suffering from the Blood Curse are eager to lift this curse at all times.
But they’ve been searching for so many days without a single clue.
Moreover, many people exploited their mentality, scamming in the chat channel, and quite a few people have fallen for it.
Now, someone claimed to have a batch of antidotes that can lift the Blood Curse.
And this person is the most legendary figure right now, Star River.
At this moment, the chat channel has entered its busiest time in history!

"Speaking of which, the Star God saved at least millions of lives today.
I really don’t know how to thank him."
"Yeah, the pity is that the Star God refuses to accept stranger messages, so you can’t even private chat with him."
Someone else asked, "By the way, does anyone know how the Star God developed?
The firepower on his territory is just too terrifying."
"I don’t want to know how the Star God developed; I just want to know if he’s still recruiting!
I’d even be willing to sign a ten-year Lord Contract!"
"You’d sign for ten years?
I’d sign for twenty!"
"I’d sign for a lifetime, as long as the Star God is willing to take me in!"
"Everyone upstairs, don’t even think about it.
The Star God even refuses stranger messages, which means he doesn’t want to recruit anyone at all."
"Really?
That’s such a shame..."
All day today, the chat channel has been revolving around the name "Star River," with ongoing discussions.
Even in Area 1 with Zhou Huang, and Area 2 with Boundless, their fame is overshadowed by him.
Now, you could say Han Xing has achieved true fame.
After a round of heated discussion.
The topic shifted to how to deal with the current Blood Tide disaster.
"Sigh...
From now on, the situation for humans is becoming more difficult."
"Who says it’s not?
If we don’t solve the source, these monsters will keep being born endlessly, and humanity can’t afford it."
"In the past couple of days, more and more of our team have reached five layers or more of the Blood Curse."
"If this continues, even if the Blood Tide monsters don’t swallow us, we won’t have much fighting power left."
The Blood Curse is something that everyone has a headache about.
The whole world is now searching for a way to lift this curse.
Han Xing also knows the global human situation, so these days, he has been continuously producing this antidote.
Now, the stock of the antidote in his hands has finally reached 120,000 bottles.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing directly opened the chat channel and spoke there.
"Fellow human beings, hello, I am Star River."
This was his first time speaking in the public chat channel.
As soon as this message appeared, the whole chat channel suddenly fell into a momentary freeze.
Almost everyone rubbed their eyes, wanting to confirm if they were seeing correctly.
Upon confirming that the ID of the speaker was completely consistent with the one currently on the battle merit leaderboard.
Then, came the crazy spam messages.
"Star God!
You’re finally here!"
"Do you remember me?
I’m Wang Diao Mao, you saved my life today!"
"Star God, look at me, I’m your loyal little fan."
"I’m the Star God’s dog!"
The spam messages kept appearing.
At this time, Han Xing said again: "Please be quiet, everyone, I have something important to announce."
Upon hearing this, the spam messages began to gradually stop.
Now, the name Star River is indeed spreading by word of mouth, and everyone knows he saved many people today.
Even some survivors who hadn’t noticed the message and were still spamming were soon stopped by their friends.
Upon seeing the spam finally quiet down.
Han Xing slowly said, "I think everyone is now worried about the Blood Curse; there is currently no effective way to remove this troublesome curse."
"I won’t beat around the bush.
I’ll get straight to the point: I have a batch of antidotes that can lift the Blood Curse."
The chat channel was silent for a moment.
The next moment, it caused a fierce uproar again!
And this time, it surpassed any previous instance.
The survivors, as if hearing something unbelievable, spammed crazily asking.
"Star God!
Is it true that you have antidotes to lift the Blood Curse?"
"How many antidotes do you have?"
"Star God, please save me, I’m almost driven mad by the Blood Curse!"
"Star God..."
The spam messages were so fast that Han Xing could hardly see what people were saying.
At the same time.
Survivors all over the world received the news.
In the chat channel, methods to solve the Blood Curse appeared!
This message was as shocking to everyone as today’s Blood Tide outbreak!
At this current stage, what draws the most attention is naturally information about the Blood Tide monsters, especially methods for lifting the Blood Curse.
After these days of fighting, countless survivors were struck by the Blood Curse.
Their curse levels varied, but even with just 1 layer, they had to endure the torment of this curse constantly.
Those suffering from the Blood Curse are eager to lift this curse at all times.
But they’ve been searching for so many days without a single clue.
Moreover, many people exploited their mentality, scamming in the chat channel, and quite a few people have fallen for it.
Now, someone claimed to have a batch of antidotes that can lift the Blood Curse.
And this person is the most legendary figure right now, Star River.
At this moment, the chat channel has entered its busiest time in history!

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 177: Selling the First Batch of Blood Curse Antidotes
paragraphs: The chat channel was an unprecedented spectacle!
It was even livelier than the first time the sections merged.
The survivors were frantically spamming the screen, constantly asking various questions.
But very evidently, no one saw their statements.
As soon as a question was posted, it was immediately drowned out by a flood of information.
And this situation was only getting worse.
Even Han Xing’s statement was instantly submerged in the sea of information.
After all, it was a trading channel with billions of people.
This situation was expected.
However, it also caused some trouble for Han Xing.
And then, at that moment.
A Survivor with a golden ID appeared.
Zhou Huang spoke in the chat channel.
"Everyone, quiet down, let’s hear what Star River has to say."
As those words fell, the entire chat channel fell silent.
The survivors who were about to speak were met with a system prompt.
"All members are now muted by admin, you cannot speak for the next three minutes."
Everyone was stunned, and Han Xing was also forbidden from speaking.
Previously, although he knew that Zhou Huang might have some unique attributes.
He didn’t expect that Zhou Huang had such permission to mute the entire chat channel!
In his heart, Han Xing felt a surge of curiosity toward Zhou Huang.
At this point, a system prompt appeared before Han Xing.
"You have been granted special permissions and can now speak in the public chat channel."
"Oh? Special permissions?"
Han Xing’s eyes showed an odd look, knowing it was Zhou Huang who enabled it for him.
However, now wasn’t the time to delve deeper into these matters.
Han Xing opened the chat channel but heard Zhou Huang speak inside.
"Sorry everyone, it’s an emergency, so we can only use this coercive measure."
"I know you all have many questions about Star River and the method to lift the Blood Curse Antidote."
"But with so many people, one person speaking at a time, no one can make themselves clear, and Star River cannot respond."
"Therefore, I think each group should appoint a representative to speak; what do you all think?"
The chat channel fell silent as if everyone wanted to complain in their hearts.
Damn it, you won’t let us talk and still ask what we think?
Of course, Zhou Huang had no intention of asking the survivors’ opinions; he simply said.
"In that case, it’s settled."
Meanwhile, the large group leaders, such as Boundless, Big Hammer, Dragon Abyss, Luo Chan, etc.
All over a hundred of them received the same prompt.
They were granted special permissions and could now speak in the chat channel.
At this time, Zhou Huang said first, "The representatives have been selected."
"Then, I will ask the first most concerning question on behalf of everyone, shall I?"
As he finished speaking, Big Hammer, Dragon Abyss, and others all responded.
"Sure."
"Director Zhou, go ahead."
Zhou Huang nodded and directly asked.
"May I ask, Star River, is it true that you have a batch of antidotes to lift the curse, as you mentioned before?"
Upon seeing this, Han Xing also said directly, "Whether it’s true or not, see for yourself.
Then, he posted the item attributes of the Blood Curse Antidote.
When everyone saw the description, ’completely removes Blood Curse and grants immunity for an hour.’
At that moment, billions of survivors worldwide collectively gasped.
There really is such a medicine!
Especially those survivors already at five levels deep in the Blood Curse, with extensive signs of decay, their eyes suddenly shone with intense hope.
It should be known that the Blood Curse continues to erode the survivor’s body before an outbreak.
During this time, they felt torturous agony beyond words.
Every time the pain became unbearable, they would think of their families.
Only then could they find some motivation to continue living.
However, a few survivors couldn’t bear such suffering and chose to end their lives.
They thought they would have to endure this pain for a long, long time...
But now, the famed Star River presented an antidote that could completely dispel the curse!
Desperate pupils of these survivors simultaneously filled with fierce longing.
If not for being muted, the chat channel might have descended into madness.
At this moment, Big Hammer hurriedly asked.
"Star... Star River, do you have a large stock of these antidotes?"
His tone was slightly trembling.
As the leader of the 3rd area’s Divine Hall, Big Hammer had over one hundred thousand survivors under him.
Similarly, many of his people were also affected by the Blood Curse.
And it was exactly the question that everyone needed an answer to.
Including Boundless and Luo Chan, who were listening intently.
However, Han Xing sighed and said, "I know that the number of Blood Curse patients around the world is immense right now."
"But actually, the reserves of antidote I have on hand are not that many, barely a hundred thousand bottles."
Hearing this number.
The eyes of billions of Survivors around the world showed signs of disappointment.
A hundred thousand Blood Curse Antidotes is, indeed, very little for the global population.
It would take thousands of people just to get one bottle.
And now, there are millions, if not a billion, afflicted by the Blood Curse!
But they also understand that such a precious potion is bound to be limited in quantity.
After all, Han Xing is only one person.
At this moment, Dragon Abyss suddenly asked, "So may I ask, Star God, how do you plan to price this batch of potions?"
Everyone perked up their ears, as this was one of the issues they were most concerned about.
After all, with only a limited supply of a hundred thousand bottles, let alone meeting the needs of the world.
Even the few delegations present might not get much.
And of course, scarcity increases value.
Such life-saving potions are now as critical as water resources when this game first began.
No matter how high a price Han Xing sets, someone is sure to buy.
Especially those major group leaders, who have amassed a terrifying amount of resources.
However, this would mean that ordinary people wouldn’t have access to the Blood Curse Antidote...
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then slowly said, "To be honest, I understand everyone’s difficulties. With so many Blood Curse sufferers worldwide, my potion supply isn’t nearly enough."
"But I can’t give them to you for free either."
"After all, producing this batch of antidotes cost me a lot of resources and effort."
The major group leaders remained silent.
At this moment, the Cyan Robed Goddess Luo Chan softly said, "Star God, we understand.
"That you’re willing to offer so many potions is already a great help, and we’re deeply grateful."
"If this were in modern times, you’d be the real savior, a great hero."
"Asking you to give them for free would weigh heavily on our conscience."
After Luo Chan spoke, many others nodded in agreement.
Then, several major group leaders chimed in.
"Exactly, Star God offering this batch of potions is already incredibly generous!"
"Star God, name your price, we won’t let you be at a loss."
Everyone awaited eagerly, anticipating the final price set by Han Xing.
A moment later, Han Xing slowly said, "Given the limited supply of antidotes I have, I’ll set the price at 10,000 Spirit Cores per bottle for now."
Upon hearing this price, everyone was initially stunned, then somewhat incredulous.
Luo Chan tentatively asked, "Star... Star God, did you perhaps say the wrong price?"
At this moment, the entire world of billions of Survivors was intently watching the chat channel in shock.
However, Han Xing furrowed his brows and slowly replied, "Too high? 10,000 Spirit Cores is my limit; any lower, and I’d be at a loss."
Upon hearing this, Luo Chan explained, "It’s not that I think your price is too high, but rather that it’s exceedingly low."
Other leaders also chimed in, "Yes, Star God, 10,000 Spirit Cores is too cheap."
"Star God, you’re being charitable!"
For the vast majority of current Survivors, 10,000 Spirit Cores is a significant sum, yet attainable.
Especially for those major group leaders, many of whom have millions in Spirit Core resources at their disposal.
So not only do they not think Han Xing’s pricing is high, but indeed, it’s surprisingly affordable.
Particularly those with ulterior motives.
They originally planned to leverage their resources to buy in bulk the moment Han Xing began selling potions.
Then they would hoard them for inflated market prices.
But under this pricing, even ordinary Survivors could participate in the bidding.
Yet the number of antidotes is limited.
By that time, even major groups might not secure many bottles.
At this moment, Han Xing spoke again, "Don’t get excited yet."
"Though I set the price at 10,000 Spirit Cores, there is an additional condition."
"It’s that only Survivors carrying three or more layers of the Blood Curse can trade with me."
Hearing this condition.
The group leaders froze for a moment.
In contrast, the eyes of ordinary Survivors sparkled with joy!
Nobody was a fool, they immediately understood Han Xing’s intentions.
He introduced this condition for two reasons.
One, to prevent groups from bulk purchasing his Blood Curse Antidotes and then reselling them at exorbitant prices.
Two, to ensure that the Blood Curse Antidotes reach those who need them most.
At this moment, even the Survivors who were previously indifferent to Han Xing felt a surge of gratitude.
Then, the Divine Hall’s leader Chen Da Chui was the first to speak.
"Star God, such righteousness!"
Other leaders also chimed in.
"Indeed, Star God is truly the savior of humanity!"
At the Immortal Mansion’s team base, Luo Chan gently tugged at her sleeve, her chest heaving.
Her gaze was intense as she looked into the distance.
Beside her, a girl with bright eyes and delicate features looked curiously at Luo Chan.
A moment later, the girl couldn’t help but ask, "Sister Luo Chan, what’s wrong with you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 178: Trading Frenzy!
paragraphs: "Luo Chan, what’s wrong?" the girl next to her asked.
Luo Chan replied softly, "Nothing, I was just surprised to meet such a charismatic man for the first time."
"The Star God, truly deserving of the title ’Savior of the Human Race’!"
The little girl next to them heard this, her eyes rolled twice, then she chuckled.
"Luo Chan, you wouldn’t happen to have feelings for the Star God, would you?"
Upon hearing this, Luo Chan, who always maintained a dignified posture, blushed instantly.
"Yue’Er! What are you saying?"
"Isn’t it normal to admire someone as righteous and noble as the Star God?"
"Stop guessing foolishly!"
However, the little girl named Yue’Er, after hearing this, had an expression of ’I understand’ on her face.
Luo Chan saw that her explanation didn’t work and became anxious.
At this moment, Han Xing listened to the praises of the crowd, unmoved.
Then, he spoke again in the chat channel.
"Alright, I’ve said most of what I needed to say."
"Now, those who meet my conditions can come to the trading channel for exchange."
Upon hearing this, everyone was taken aback.
Then, hundreds of millions of survivors flocked to the trading channel.
Han Xing also directly opened the consignment window on his side.
The first batch, he listed 100,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote.
Then, he began to set the trading conditions.
Besides having 10,000 Spirit Cores and being survivors affected by the third level or higher of the Blood Curse, only those can trade.
Han Xing added one more condition.
Only one bottle per person.
The consignment feature of the system is convenient; as long as you set the trading conditions, it will impose the corresponding restrictions.
Only those who meet the above conditions can trade.
"This way, it’s almost like blocking all the loopholes," Han Xing thought to himself.
After thinking for a moment and confirming that there wasn’t any flaw that merchants could exploit, Han Xing directly clicked to list them.
However, despite setting three types of conditions,
the moment the Blood Curse Antidote was listed, it immediately triggered a scramble among millions of people.
After all, there were simply too many people affected by the Blood Curse.
The survivors shouted in the chat channel.
"The Star God has put the Blood Curse Antidote up for sale! Hurry!"
"Limited to 100,000 bottles, damn! Hurry, slow hands will miss out!"
"Brothers, let me snag a bottle, I’ve been affected by the fourth layer of the Blood Curse and it’s driving me insane!"
"What’s the fourth layer? I’m enduring the sixth layer just the same!"
"That’s right, it’s fair that each person is limited to one bottle, whoever gets it, owns it!"
The chat bar in the trading channel was also filled with frantic scrolling.
System notifications kept appearing.
[Trade successful, you gained Spirit Core*10000, you lost Blood Curse Antidote*1]
[Trade successful, you gained...]
"I got one! Hahaha!"
"I snagged one too, so happy!"
"Mom and Dad, your son is saved, I won’t turn into some monster! Boo hoo..."
"Daughter, Dad got a bottle, you’re saved!"
Those who snagged one were venting their emotions freely in the chat bar.
These days, the Blood Curse had almost driven them insane.
And those who managed to get the first batch of antidotes had already consumed them at the first opportunity.
Less than three seconds later,
they felt their festering skin returning to normal, the curse within them melting away like spring snow under the blazing sun.
At this moment, many survivors covered their faces and sobbed with relief.
"Boo hoo... Finally, free from this damn curse."
"So glad, no more suffering."
They returned to the chat channel, continually thanking Han Xing.
"Star God, thank you so much.
"Star God, I will forever remember your kindness!"
After all 100,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote were sold out,
those who didn’t manage to snag one were filled with regret in the chat channel.
Some of the more extreme ones even considered ending their lives right there.
However, at this moment, Han Xing comforted them, "There’s no need to worry."
"These 100,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote are just the first batch; I will continue to produce more."
"In the meantime, I hope you all can hold on."
Han Xing’s comforting words had a good effect.
Human nature is fragile, yet resilient.
They are willing to endure pain, as long as there is hope.
Upon hearing Han Xing say that he would continue to list Blood Curse Antidote, these people immediately reignited their will to survive.
After the first wave of transactions ended,
Han Xing looked at the ten billion materials newly added to his inventory, a hint of joy appeared on his lips.
Although his pricing was relatively low,
the volume of antidotes made up for it.
The production of Blood Curse Antidote was fairly simple.
Subtracting the costs, Han Xing made nearly nine times the profit.
If not for the 5-second production time limit,
Han Xing could accumulate an enormous amount daily just by mass-producing these antidotes.
He now desperately needed whatever device could shorten production time!
No matter how precious, he was determined to acquire it.
And this is why Han Xing sold this batch of Blood Antidotes at a lower price.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly lifted his head and murmured, "It’s almost time."
"Now, I’ve attracted enough attention."
"An estimated eighty percent of Blue Star is following the trading channel."

Only one bottle per person.
The consignment feature of the system is convenient; as long as you set the trading conditions, it will impose the corresponding restrictions.
Only those who meet the above conditions can trade.
"This way, it’s almost like blocking all the loopholes," Han Xing thought to himself.
After thinking for a moment and confirming that there wasn’t any flaw that merchants could exploit, Han Xing directly clicked to list them.
However, despite setting three types of conditions,
the moment the Blood Curse Antidote was listed, it immediately triggered a scramble among millions of people.
After all, there were simply too many people affected by the Blood Curse.
The survivors shouted in the chat channel.
"The Star God has put the Blood Curse Antidote up for sale!
Hurry!"
"Limited to 100,000 bottles, damn!
Hurry, slow hands will miss out!"
"Brothers, let me snag a bottle, I’ve been affected by the fourth layer of the Blood Curse and it’s driving me insane!"
"What’s the fourth layer?
I’m enduring the sixth layer just the same!"
"That’s right, it’s fair that each person is limited to one bottle, whoever gets it, owns it!"
The chat bar in the trading channel was also filled with frantic scrolling.
System notifications kept appearing.
[Trade successful, you gained Spirit Core*10000, you lost Blood Curse Antidote*1]
[Trade successful, you gained...]
"I got one!
Hahaha!"
"I snagged one too, so happy!"
"Mom and Dad, your son is saved, I won’t turn into some monster!
Boo hoo..."
"Daughter, Dad got a bottle, you’re saved!"
Those who snagged one were venting their emotions freely in the chat bar.
These days, the Blood Curse had almost driven them insane.
And those who managed to get the first batch of antidotes had already consumed them at the first opportunity.
Less than three seconds later,
they felt their festering skin returning to normal, the curse within them melting away like spring snow under the blazing sun.
At this moment, many survivors covered their faces and sobbed with relief.
"Boo hoo...
Finally, free from this damn curse."
"So glad, no more suffering."
They returned to the chat channel, continually thanking Han Xing.
"Star God, thank you so much.
"Star God, I will forever remember your kindness!"
After all 100,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote were sold out,
those who didn’t manage to snag one were filled with regret in the chat channel.
Some of the more extreme ones even considered ending their lives right there.
However, at this moment, Han Xing comforted them, "There’s no need to worry."
"These 100,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote are just the first batch; I will continue to produce more."
"In the meantime, I hope you all can hold on."
Han Xing’s comforting words had a good effect.
Human nature is fragile, yet resilient.
They are willing to endure pain, as long as there is hope.
Upon hearing Han Xing say that he would continue to list Blood Curse Antidote, these people immediately reignited their will to survive.
After the first wave of transactions ended,
Han Xing looked at the ten billion materials newly added to his inventory, a hint of joy appeared on his lips.
Although his pricing was relatively low,
the volume of antidotes made up for it.
The production of Blood Curse Antidote was fairly simple.
Subtracting the costs, Han Xing made nearly nine times the profit.
If not for the 5-second production time limit,
Han Xing could accumulate an enormous amount daily just by mass-producing these antidotes.
He now desperately needed whatever device could shorten production time!
No matter how precious, he was determined to acquire it.
And this is why Han Xing sold this batch of Blood Antidotes at a lower price.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly lifted his head and murmured, "It’s almost time."
"Now, I’ve attracted enough attention."
"An estimated eighty percent of Blue Star is following the trading channel."

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 178: Trading Frenzy! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "And with so many people’s attention, the probability of items that can shorten production time appearing will also increase."
"Next, all I need is to bring out some precious items that will make them excited enough to trade."
At this moment, Han Xing pondered, "So now, what do I have that could be so enticing they can’t refuse?"
Han Xing rummaged through his warehouse, and most of the items, when taken out individually, weren’t very high in price.
For example, the Permanent Gold Ingot.
One block of Permanent Gold Ingot is roughly equal to the value of ten thousand Spirit Cores.
An item of lv20 Golden Equipment is worth three million Spirit Cores.
But if you say you’ll trade 300 blocks of Permanent Gold Ingot for Golden Equipment, it’s likely not going to happen.
After all, rarity commands a premium.
No one would trade a finished piece of Golden Armor for raw materials.
Because even if you have these raw materials to craft equipment, success is not guaranteed.
If you fail, it could be a total loss!
However, Han Xing didn’t have this worry.
At this moment, he flipped through his blueprint section.
There were five Golden Equipment blueprints and one Orange Equipment blueprint.
Without a doubt, the most precious two blueprints.
Are the Orange Weapon, Ice Burial.
And the Golden Shield, Shield of Yellow Sand.
The former, although just a Bow and Arrow, and Hunter is considered a niche profession.
But worldwide, there are undoubtedly many Survivors who choose the Hunter profession.
As for the second item, the Shield of Yellow Sand, although it’s a golden item.
But Holy Profession is now the most popular profession, and those big group leaders are trying everything to buy Shield with strong attributes.
So, the value of the Shield of Yellow Sand is already comparable to the Longbow ’Ice Burial.’
If possible, Han Xing would even consider mass-producing more top-grade equipment to sell.
But apart from the backpack, those equipment all require some specific materials.
For example, crafting ’Ice Burial’ requires the material Ice Heart.
The Shield of Yellow Sand requires Dusk Sand.
These two materials aren’t widely available on the market.
Han Xing glanced at his reserve of materials.
In the midst of a pile of valuable materials, he saw two hearts emitting chill, and a small pile of Dusk Sand.
"Currently, I have enough materials to craft two ’Ice Burial’ Longbows and three Shield of Yellow Sand."
"These few pieces of top-grade equipment should be able to exchange for quite a few good things."
With that thought, Han Xing immediately decided to start crafting.
He paused the production of Blood Curse Antidote and began crafting the Orange Weapon, Ice Burial.
A towering orange pillar of light rose in Xingyu City.
In front of him appeared two progress bars of 500 seconds each, which is nearly 17 minutes.
Han Xing patiently waited.
When the progress bars reached completion.
Two crystal-like Great Bows appeared before him.
[Ice Burial (Orange) lv20, Quality - Epic, Attack Power 574~632, agility +100, Power +50, Hit Rate +20%. Attached Effect: Ice Source Energy, Shattered Ice, Extreme Cold Domain, Ice Burial.]
[Ice Burial (Orange) lv20, Quality - Legend, Attack Power 514~572, agility +80, Power +40, Hit Rate +10%. Attached Effect: Ice Source Energy, Shattered Ice, Extreme Cold Domain.]
Two Ice Burial Longbows, one of Legendary Quality, one Epic.
At this moment Han Xing pondered, "For this kind of Orange Weapon, appearing too much in the trading channel all at once is rather startling."
"At the current stage, I can list the Legendary Quality Ice Burial Longbow for consignment first."
"As for the other Epic Quality Ice Burial, it can be directly given to Xiaoyang."
Han Xing made his decision.
Then, he began to check another key material, Dusk Sand.
The remaining Dusk Sand was enough to craft three Shield of Yellow Sand.
Han Xing also continued crafting.
Golden Light flashed one after another.
A dozen or so minutes later.
Before Han Xing, there were three earthy-yellow Shields with nearly identical attributes.
Plus, their quality had all reached Legendary Level.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, he began listing these pieces of equipment one by one.
The consignment channel once again featured Star River’s name.
[Consigned Item Information]: Ice Burial Longbow (Orange)
[Seller’s Requested Items]: Same level Orange Equipment, or territory building blueprints.
[Consignor]: Star River.
Seller’s Remarks: Orange Longbow with three attached effects, impressive damage output, requires various camp blueprints, Survivors with speed-up production items, please private message first.
[Consigned Item Information]: Shield of Yellow Sand (Golden)
[Seller’s Requested Items]: Various Defense Tower building blueprints, various camp blueprints, various statue blueprints.
[Consignor]: Star River.
Seller’s Remarks: Top-grade Golden Shield with three attached effects, incredible Defense, requires various Totem, statue blueprints, Defense Tower blueprints, speed-up production items.
At this moment, Han Xing, having just sold a wave of Blood Curse Antidotes, was undoubtedly the focus of everyone’s attention.
His every move could draw the eyes of thousands.
What those Survivors didn’t expect was that just after Han Xing sold off the antidotes,
he had put a batch of top-grade equipment up for sale again.
And these items, just looking at the attributes, are enough to make people drool.
"Brothers, the Star God has put more good stuff up!"
"More good stuff? Could it be Blood Curse Antidote?"
"No, it’s Orange Weapons and Golden Shields."
"Oh, I thought it was another batch of antidotes... wait, what did you say? Orange Weapons!?"
At the current stage, most Survivors hadn’t even touched a piece of Golden Equipment.
Even those top team members only had one or two Golden items.
So, when they heard Han Xing was selling Orange Equipment, their shock couldn’t be overstated.
Including those who were the top powerhouses of previous regions, they had only gotten an Orange Weapon Blueprint in the last ranking rewards.
But clearly, even until now, few had managed to craft Orange Weapons.
Firstly, the low success rate of the Orange Weapon blueprints restricted most powerhouses.
Additionally, the materials required for Orange Weapon crafts are extremely precious.
Even the previous number one powerhouse of merged regions, many still only used Golden Weapons as a stopgap.
On Han Xing’s side, he quickly received a lot of private messages.
"Hello Star God, I am Ao Guanhai, leader of Beigang Village’s guild. I have a Wall of Hurricane blueprint in my possession and would like to trade it for your Shield of Yellow Sand."
"I am Asura, the president of the Hell Association. Can I trade a Golden Weapon Blueprint for your Shield of Yellow Sand?"
These people introduce themselves right away.
Just as Han Xing expected.
The ones private messaging him are key figures from various teams, and they all have something special in their hands,
Among them, Han Xing indeed saw some things that caught his eye.
Such as Wall of Hurricane, Poison Arrow Tower, Corrosion Tower, and other territory structures.
He even saw a key item he urgently needed, the Big-beaked Bird Totem!
Indeed, there’s no shortage of capable people in this world, everyone has their own chances.
But, Han Xing discovered.
Compared to the Orange Weapon Ice Burial, the Shield of Yellow Sand was evidently more popular.
The items those big group leaders offered were also for trading the Shield of Yellow Sand.
From these private messages, Han Xing selected the three most intriguing items for him.
They were the Poison Arrow Tower, Corrosion Tower, and Big-beaked Bird Totem.
And then, the trades were made.
The system notification appeared.
[Trade successful, you have obtained Poison Arrow Tower blueprint*1, you have lost Shield of Yellow Sand (Golden)*1.]
[Trade successful, you have obtained Corrosion Tower... ]
All three Shields of Yellow Sand were traded, and Han Xing got what he wanted.
The first two Defense Towers are in the same category as the Ice Arrow Tower, both in terms of Attack Power and range.
Just, the Poison Arrow Tower has an added poison effect, causing targets to be in a poisoned state for 10 seconds.
The Corrosion Tower can weaken the enemy’s Defense Value.
Ice Arrow, Poison Arrow, Corrosion.
The three Defense Towers have different roles, and if used together, can create unexpected effects.
Plus, a more aggressive Thunderbolt Tower.
Now, in Han Xing’s territory, the types of Defense Towers are certainly growing.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 179: Win-Win!
paragraphs: After the trade ended, Han Xing’s face also showed a satisfied expression.
At this moment, a small totem appeared in his hand.
It was engraved with a bird that resembled a Blue Star Pelican but with a sharper beak and larger wings.
"The Big-beaked Bird Totem is now in hand, and with this, I can start crafting my first batch of flying units."
Han Xing said with a smile: "Today has truly been a smooth-sailing day."
However, although the trade went smoothly.
The item he currently needs the most, a time acceleration tool, still hasn’t appeared.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but mutter: "Is it really this hard to get?"
"I’ve gone through over ten thousand private messages, and not a single one mentioned it?"
Han Xing knew for sure there were items like those out there.
After all, in Xingyu City’s Refining Workshop, there’s relevant technology for this.
Right now, the consignment channel only has an Orange Longbow left, attracting numerous Survivor discussions.
On Han Xing’s side, he continued to receive private messages non-stop.
Most of them were inquiries, such as when the next batch of Blood Curse Antidote will be listed, or if they can purchase a batch in advance.
There were also some asking if Han Xing was hiring.
Actually, only a few came to Han Xing for trade.
Due to the fear of missing some key information.
He painstakingly went over each message.
After spending more than an hour browsing through tens of thousands of private messages.
Han Xing let out a regretful sigh.
"It seems speeding up the making of the Blood Curse Antidote is impossible."
Han Xing was also prepared to cancel the consignment and close stranger private messages.
After all, with thousands of private messages coming in every moment, it was quite overwhelming.
However, before closing the private messages.
Han Xing still held onto a sliver of hope and cleared through his messages one more time.
After checking through over three thousand private messages.
A message from a Survivor named Paratrooper Commander caught Han Xing’s attention.
Paratrooper Commander: "Hello Star God, are you looking for a time acceleration tool?"
Seeing this message, Han Xing quickly replied: "That’s right, do you have one?"
Paratrooper Commander paused for a moment before sending another message.
"Yes, Star God, but I’m not sure if it’s what you’re looking for."
Paratrooper Commander’s tone sounded a bit apprehensive.
Han Xing detected the unease in his tone and frowned, "Show it to me first."
"Alright... okay."
Paratrooper Commander hastily sent over the item information.
[Cursed Artisan’s Hammer]: Special Item
[Item Attributes]: Survivors holding this item have their crafting time for any item reduced by 4 seconds, but suffer a curse effect, reducing equipment crafting success rate by 25%.
Upon seeing the item’s attributes, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
This thing is actually a cursed item.
Just having it on you decreases your equipment crafting success rate by 25%.
And in Sky Island Paradise, calculating based on the dismal success rates of those blueprints, it’s basically like being completely wiped out...
No wonder this Paratrooper Commander would bring it out for trade.
This item is a misfortune no matter whose hands it’s in.
The curse effect alone is hard to bear.
But for Han Xing, this curse effect is non-existent!
Because his SSS-level Talent never fails in crafting any equipment!
For him, there’s no concept of success rate whatsoever!
At this moment, Han Xing felt his breathing get a bit rapid.
"Based on a 5-second crafting time per bottle of Blood Curse Antidote, reducing the crafting time by 4 seconds means each bottle only takes 1 second to make!"
"Previously, even with crafting running 24 hours straight, I could only produce over seventeen thousand bottles a day, the production efficiency was just too low!"
"But now, with this cursed item, it’s equivalent to producing over eighty thousand bottles a day, the effect has increased fivefold!"
"Oh shit!"
At this moment, Han Xing made up his mind to obtain this cursed item no matter what!
Meanwhile, the Survivor named Paratrooper Commander was also feeling anxious.
He knew this item wasn’t anything good.
Ever since it landed in his possession, he had never used it once.
It was left in the warehouse for fear of bad luck.
Several times, when he failed to craft equipment, he suspected it was the effect of this item.
Paratrooper Commander had long wanted to get rid of this hammer.
This time, upon hearing from team members in the team channel discussing the Star God selling Orange Weapons in the trading channel.
Moreover, it’s still a longbow!
By coincidence, he’s also of the Hunter Profession, which sparked his interest even more.
Then he saw Han Xing’s notes.
In that moment, Paratrooper Commander’s heart almost skipped a beat.
Though he knew the hammer was no good.
But what if the Star God needed it?
And so, with a try-and-see attitude, Paratrooper Commander sent the message to Han Xing.
He hadn’t held much hope.
After all, who would be foolish enough to trade valuable Orange Weapons for a cursed item?
Yet at that instant, Han Xing sent a message.
Star River: "Let’s trade."
The three words were concise and clear, and the Paratrooper Commander wiped his eyes.
When he confirmed he hadn’t seen wrong, he was full of disbelief.
At this moment, it seemed that the other side had been waiting for a bit too long.
Han Xing continued sending a message: "What’s wrong? Don’t want to exchange?"
The Paratrooper Commander snapped back to his senses and quickly sent a message: "Exchange! Swap right away!"
In the next instant, fearing that Han Xing might regret it, the Paratrooper Commander clicked on the trade for Han Xing.
On the trade window, both of them placed their items.
A longbow emitting a chilling cold and a rusty hammer.
Then, with trembling hands, the Paratrooper Commander clicked on trade.
When the transaction success message came.
Both of them simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
The Paratrooper Commander sent a message to Han Xing: "Thank you, thank you, Star River God!"
After completing the trade, Han Xing also showed a relaxed smile.
He casually said: "No need to be polite, each gets what they need."
Then, Han Xing directly closed the stranger’s private chat function.
At this moment, the Paratrooper Commander, after acquiring the Ice Burial Longbow, eagerly showed it off in his team chat channel.
"Brothers, look at what this is?"
When his team saw the attributes of that Orange Weapon, they simultaneously gasped.
"Wow, Ice Burial!"
"Isn’t this the Orange Weapon being listed by the Star God right now?
Listening to the surprised voices of his team members, the Paratrooper Commander was full of pride.
"Paratrooper, did you exchange for the weapon from Star God?"
Everyone couldn’t help but ask.
After receiving the Paratrooper Commander’s affirmative answer, the team members were filled with admiration and envy.
"Wow, what kind of luck is this?"
At this time, a survivor named Sun Erhu said: "Is Han Xing stupid to trade such a precious weapon for a cursed item?"
After saying that, the other team members quickly stopped him: "Shh! Erhu, don’t speak carelessly, be careful that someone spreads it out, and then we won’t be able to protect you!"
The survivor named Sun Erhu froze for a moment, seemingly thinking of something, and quickly shut his mouth.
After today’s large-scale Blood Tide eruption, plus the Blood Curse Antidote trade incident tonight.
Han Xing’s prestige had already been elevated to an extremely high level.
Now, countless people see Han Xing as their savior.
Just like the team members said, if someone spreads Sun Erhu’s mockery of Han Xing, surely many people would cause him trouble.
In the next moment, Sun Erhu returned to his territory with a pale face, unsure of what he was thinking.
At the same time, the Paratrooper Commander also received all kinds of envious glances and praise.
But he didn’t know that the information about his acquisition of the Ice Burial Longbow had been revealed by someone with intentions.
And their team was also being targeted by some people.
Of course.
These were not things Han Xing needed to worry about.
At this moment, he looked at the rusty hammer in his hand, with a scrutinizing gaze.
Strange patterns covered the body of the hammer.
Just holding it in hand, he could feel an ominous cold aura.
This hammer was like the high-level assembly line in the Refining Workshop, capable of accelerating.
But the only difference was that it could directly shorten time by seconds.
For example.
The original production of a purple backpack needed two minutes.
After the high-level assembly line shortens the time by 50%, it became 1 minute.
Then, with the Hammer of Curse’s -4 seconds effect, it became 56 seconds.
It didn’t seem to reduce much, but that was for items with relatively long production times.
While for Blood Curse Antidotes, their production time was already short.
Now, Han Xing’s production efficiency was directly multiplied!
Previously, it took him six days to accumulate more than a hundred thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote.
But now, it only took one day to produce over eighty thousand bottles of Curse Antidote!
Even if all were sold at the price of ten thousand Spirit Cores per bottle, Han Xing’s day’s revenue from Spirit Cores would exceed eight billion!
This formidable resource collection speed made Han Xing feel somewhat afraid.
"Great, in this way, just need a few more days to stabilize, then can raise more Defense Towers."
"Then the next step is to achieve a counterattack and actively go after those altars!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing was also highly motivated.
Then, with a wave of his hand, he directly clicked to produce 500,000 bottles on site!
Watching the warehouse, with the Blood Curse Antidote growing every second, Han Xing couldn’t help but show excitement.
At this time, he suddenly thought of something.
Han Xing searched through that numerous private message information using names.
Then he found the presidents of the teams who came to rescue him during the day.
Although they didn’t provide much help to Han Xing.
But in that situation, knowing they couldn’t resist that scale of the monster tide.
And with the risk of being engulfed, they still chose rescue.
Just this intention was enough for Han Xing to affirm their contribution.

Han Xing said with a smile: "Today has truly been a smooth-sailing day."
However, although the trade went smoothly.
The item he currently needs the most, a time acceleration tool, still hasn’t appeared.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but mutter: "Is it really this hard to get?"
"I’ve gone through over ten thousand private messages, and not a single one mentioned it?"
Han Xing knew for sure there were items like those out there.
After all, in Xingyu City’s Refining Workshop, there’s relevant technology for this.
Right now, the consignment channel only has an Orange Longbow left, attracting numerous Survivor discussions.
On Han Xing’s side, he continued to receive private messages non-stop.
Most of them were inquiries, such as when the next batch of Blood Curse Antidote will be listed, or if they can purchase a batch in advance.
There were also some asking if Han Xing was hiring.
Actually, only a few came to Han Xing for trade.
Due to the fear of missing some key information.
He painstakingly went over each message.
After spending more than an hour browsing through tens of thousands of private messages.
Han Xing let out a regretful sigh.
"It seems speeding up the making of the Blood Curse Antidote is impossible."
Han Xing was also prepared to cancel the consignment and close stranger private messages.
After all, with thousands of private messages coming in every moment, it was quite overwhelming.
However, before closing the private messages.
Han Xing still held onto a sliver of hope and cleared through his messages one more time.
After checking through over three thousand private messages.
A message from a Survivor named Paratrooper Commander caught Han Xing’s attention.
Paratrooper Commander: "Hello Star God, are you looking for a time acceleration tool?"
Seeing this message, Han Xing quickly replied: "That’s right, do you have one?"
Paratrooper Commander paused for a moment before sending another message.
"Yes, Star God, but I’m not sure if it’s what you’re looking for."
Paratrooper Commander’s tone sounded a bit apprehensive.
Han Xing detected the unease in his tone and frowned, "Show it to me first."
"Alright... okay."
Paratrooper Commander hastily sent over the item information.
[Cursed Artisan’s Hammer]: Special Item
[Item Attributes]: Survivors holding this item have their crafting time for any item reduced by 4 seconds, but suffer a curse effect, reducing equipment crafting success rate by 25%.
Upon seeing the item’s attributes, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
This thing is actually a cursed item.
Just having it on you decreases your equipment crafting success rate by 25%.
And in Sky Island Paradise, calculating based on the dismal success rates of those blueprints, it’s basically like being completely wiped out...
No wonder this Paratrooper Commander would bring it out for trade.
This item is a misfortune no matter whose hands it’s in.
The curse effect alone is hard to bear.
But for Han Xing, this curse effect is non-existent!
Because his SSS-level Talent never fails in crafting any equipment!
For him, there’s no concept of success rate whatsoever!
At this moment, Han Xing felt his breathing get a bit rapid.
"Based on a 5-second crafting time per bottle of Blood Curse Antidote, reducing the crafting time by 4 seconds means each bottle only takes 1 second to make!"
"Previously, even with crafting running 24 hours straight, I could only produce over seventeen thousand bottles a day, the production efficiency was just too low!"
"But now, with this cursed item, it’s equivalent to producing over eighty thousand bottles a day, the effect has increased fivefold!"
"Oh shit!"
At this moment, Han Xing made up his mind to obtain this cursed item no matter what!
Meanwhile, the Survivor named Paratrooper Commander was also feeling anxious.
He knew this item wasn’t anything good.
Ever since it landed in his possession, he had never used it once.
It was left in the warehouse for fear of bad luck.
Several times, when he failed to craft equipment, he suspected it was the effect of this item.
Paratrooper Commander had long wanted to get rid of this hammer.
This time, upon hearing from team members in the team channel discussing the Star God selling Orange Weapons in the trading channel.
Moreover, it’s still a longbow!
By coincidence, he’s also of the Hunter Profession, which sparked his interest even more.
Then he saw Han Xing’s notes.
In that moment, Paratrooper Commander’s heart almost skipped a beat.
Though he knew the hammer was no good.
But what if the Star God needed it?
And so, with a try-and-see attitude, Paratrooper Commander sent the message to Han Xing.
He hadn’t held much hope.
After all, who would be foolish enough to trade valuable Orange Weapons for a cursed item?
Yet at that instant, Han Xing sent a message.
Star River: "Let’s trade."
The three words were concise and clear, and the Paratrooper Commander wiped his eyes.
When he confirmed he hadn’t seen wrong, he was full of disbelief.
At this moment, it seemed that the other side had been waiting for a bit too long.
Han Xing continued sending a message: "What’s wrong?
Don’t want to exchange?"
The Paratrooper Commander snapped back to his senses and quickly sent a message: "Exchange!
Swap right away!"
In the next instant, fearing that Han Xing might regret it, the Paratrooper Commander clicked on the trade for Han Xing.
On the trade window, both of them placed their items.
A longbow emitting a chilling cold and a rusty hammer.
Then, with trembling hands, the Paratrooper Commander clicked on trade.
When the transaction success message came.
Both of them simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
The Paratrooper Commander sent a message to Han Xing: "Thank you, thank you, Star River God!"
After completing the trade, Han Xing also showed a relaxed smile.
He casually said: "No need to be polite, each gets what they need."
Then, Han Xing directly closed the stranger’s private chat function.
At this moment, the Paratrooper Commander, after acquiring the Ice Burial Longbow, eagerly showed it off in his team chat channel.
"Brothers, look at what this is?"
When his team saw the attributes of that Orange Weapon, they simultaneously gasped.
"Wow, Ice Burial!"
"Isn’t this the Orange Weapon being listed by the Star God right now?
Listening to the surprised voices of his team members, the Paratrooper Commander was full of pride.
"Paratrooper, did you exchange for the weapon from Star God?"
Everyone couldn’t help but ask.
After receiving the Paratrooper Commander’s affirmative answer, the team members were filled with admiration and envy.
"Wow, what kind of luck is this?"
At this time, a survivor named Sun Erhu said: "Is Han Xing stupid to trade such a precious weapon for a cursed item?"
After saying that, the other team members quickly stopped him: "Shh!
Erhu, don’t speak carelessly, be careful that someone spreads it out, and then we won’t be able to protect you!"
The survivor named Sun Erhu froze for a moment, seemingly thinking of something, and quickly shut his mouth.
After today’s large-scale Blood Tide eruption, plus the Blood Curse Antidote trade incident tonight.
Han Xing’s prestige had already been elevated to an extremely high level.
Now, countless people see Han Xing as their savior.
Just like the team members said, if someone spreads Sun Erhu’s mockery of Han Xing, surely many people would cause him trouble.
In the next moment, Sun Erhu returned to his territory with a pale face, unsure of what he was thinking.
At the same time, the Paratrooper Commander also received all kinds of envious glances and praise.
But he didn’t know that the information about his acquisition of the Ice Burial Longbow had been revealed by someone with intentions.
And their team was also being targeted by some people.
Of course.
These were not things Han Xing needed to worry about.
At this moment, he looked at the rusty hammer in his hand, with a scrutinizing gaze.
Strange patterns covered the body of the hammer.
Just holding it in hand, he could feel an ominous cold aura.
This hammer was like the high-level assembly line in the Refining Workshop, capable of accelerating.
But the only difference was that it could directly shorten time by seconds.
For example.
The original production of a purple backpack needed two minutes.
After the high-level assembly line shortens the time by 50%, it became 1 minute.
Then, with the Hammer of Curse’s -4 seconds effect, it became 56 seconds.
It didn’t seem to reduce much, but that was for items with relatively long production times.
While for Blood Curse Antidotes, their production time was already short.
Now, Han Xing’s production efficiency was directly multiplied!
Previously, it took him six days to accumulate more than a hundred thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote.
But now, it only took one day to produce over eighty thousand bottles of Curse Antidote!
Even if all were sold at the price of ten thousand Spirit Cores per bottle, Han Xing’s day’s revenue from Spirit Cores would exceed eight billion!
This formidable resource collection speed made Han Xing feel somewhat afraid.
"Great, in this way, just need a few more days to stabilize, then can raise more Defense Towers."
"Then the next step is to achieve a counterattack and actively go after those altars!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing was also highly motivated.
Then, with a wave of his hand, he directly clicked to produce 500,000 bottles on site!
Watching the warehouse, with the Blood Curse Antidote growing every second, Han Xing couldn’t help but show excitement.
At this time, he suddenly thought of something.
Han Xing searched through that numerous private message information using names.
Then he found the presidents of the teams who came to rescue him during the day.
Although they didn’t provide much help to Han Xing.
But in that situation, knowing they couldn’t resist that scale of the monster tide.
And with the risk of being engulfed, they still chose rescue.
Just this intention was enough for Han Xing to affirm their contribution.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 180: A Small Gift
paragraphs: Han Xing was the first to find the leader of the Cloud Water Pavilion, Chujiang Tiankuo.
At this moment, Chujiang Tiankuo was momentarily stunned upon seeing the trade request initiated by Han Xing.
A moment later, he clicked accept blankly.
Then, he saw a full five hundred bottles of Blood Curse Antidote on the trade bar.
At that moment, Chujiang Tiankuo instinctively exclaimed.
"Damn... no, Star God!"
"So many bottles of antidote, are you... are you sure there’s no mistake?"
Han Xing smiled, "Of course there’s no mistake, I promised you I’d send a little gift."
Chujiang Tiankuo listened, shaking his head helplessly, "Star God, this is no small gift, this stuff is too precious."
As the leader of a large team, Chujiang Tiankuo was very aware of the importance and value of the Blood Curse Antidote.
Although Han Xing had just put up over a hundred thousand bottles for sale,
but with so many people vying for it, it was hard to grab.
Including Chujiang Tiankuo’s own team members, only a few managed to snatch up antidotes.
Now, his team still had hundreds of brothers suffering from the Blood Curse’s torment.
But now, Han Xing directly brought him 500 bottles, equivalent to resolving his urgent need.
This not only completely lifted the curse on his members but also left a surplus.
It’s worth mentioning, ever since Han Xing finished his consignment,
the price of a single bottle of Blood Curse Antidote in the trade channel has soared through the roof!
Even priced at 100,000, countless people are scrambling to buy it.
At this moment, many survivors realized that Han Xing’s price of ten thousand Spirit Cores was truly charity!
Chujiang Tiankuo also felt a surge of gratitude toward Han Xing.
After completing the trade, Han Xing distributed one hundred bottles each to the other leaders.
Amidst the continuous thanks from those leaders, Han Xing closed the private chat.
By this time, it was already late night.
Han Xing planned to finish one last task before resting.
Which was to construct the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest.
As the newly acquired flying unit camp, Han Xing was eager to see the effect of the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest being built.
Now, Han Xing’s Sky Island’s area has exceeded over eighty million square meters, which was quite vast.
On it, there was ample space to construct more buildings.
After searching around, Han Xing found a deep mine at the foot of a mountain, emitting a faint red glow inside.
This mine contained abundant Dark Fire Stone resources.
Han Xing whispered, "I remember, one of the required materials for the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest includes Dark Fire Stone."
"I wonder if building it directly in the Dark Fire Stone mine would have the same effect?"
With this thought, Han Xing entered the enormous mine.
After passing through a corridor, he arrived at a spacious area.
His view widened dramatically.
This was the interior of the mine.
Han Xing found this place suitable and directly clicked build.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume materials: Big-beaked Bird Race Totem*1, Wood*1,000,000, Dry Grass*500,000, Refined Iron*20,000, Mithril*5,000, to build Big-beaked Bird’s Nest*1?]
Han Xing noticed that the required materials indeed excluded the Dark Fire Stone option.
It seemed his decision to build the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest in the mine was correct.
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
"Construction underway, Lord’s Mansion acceleration function activated, remaining time: 16 hours 32 minutes..."
A large amount of material in the warehouse vanished.
In the next moment, the mine began automatically constructing the framework of a bird’s nest, shrouded in smoke.
Han Xing was satisfied and clapped his hands.
Then he directly returned to his Lord’s Mansion to rest.
The next day...
As soon as Han Xing got up, he saw his warehouse had an additional thirty thousand plus bottles of Blood Curse Antidote.
This represented materials worth at least several billion.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a pleased smile.
"The speed at which I’m earning money is truly terrifying!"
Meanwhile.
Today, large-scale Blood Tides continued to appear worldwide.
But compared to yesterday, survivors globally were more prepared, as more and more people united.
Small teams merged into large teams.
Large teams merged into super teams.
With the concentration of manpower, handling large-scale monster tides became less daunting.
Therefore, the cries for help today were significantly fewer.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, along with others, appeared early in the conference hall of the Lord’s Mansion.
The four, ready to go, looked at Han Xing with anticipation in their eyes.
Han Xing nodded directly and said, "Today, we will mainly focus on earning Battle Merit and leveling up."
"While ensuring safety, try to kill those monsters by ourselves as much as possible."
The four nodded, their eyes also filled with intense War Intent.
For the rest of the day, the four were closely monitoring the chat channels and local networks.
Upon hearing information about the presence of Blood Tide monsters, they rushed over immediately and fiercely took them down.
If it was a smaller-scale tide, with a number less than fifty thousand...
Han Xing would lead the team of four to fight directly.
Throughout the entire day, Xingyu City was in a state of relentless raids, and the battles were unceasing.
At the same time, their experience was rapidly increasing.
The white light representing level-up continuously flashed over the five people and one wolf.
By sunset, Han Xing’s level had already reached level 27, and the levels of the others were between 25 and 26.
Comparatively, the majority of current survivors were around level 20, preparing to complete advancement tasks.
Han Xing and the others had already far outpaced them.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but say joyfully, "Teaming up is great, our leveling speed is really fast!"
Shen Yun nodded, "The pity is, a team can share experience with at most five people, otherwise, we could carry some of our relatives from our territory."
The group paused for a moment, realizing this.
At the current stage, the second group of survivors arriving at Sky Island Paradise still didn’t have much combat power.
Now, Blood Tide monsters are everywhere outside.
To have them at this level deal with level ten to twenty Blood Tide monsters would be nothing short of suicidal.
Therefore, up until now, Han Xing hadn’t intended to involve them in battles.
At least, not until after the Blood Tide ends.
Han Xing suddenly said, "If they want to level up, there’s one way."
The group immediately looked at Han Xing.
"What method, Brother Xing?" Shen Yun asked.
"That would be for the five of us to split up, each leading a team of four."
"When encountering monsters, we would still deal with them head-on.
"Then, ensuring safety, have your relatives touch the monster so they can gain experience too."
Upon hearing this method, the four’s eyes lit up simultaneously.
Because, according to Han Xing’s proposal, it was feasible.
Moreover, it was a way to quickly help them catch up with the main force.
At this moment, Han Xing reminded again, "Don’t get too happy too early; those Blood Tide monsters are far beyond their levels."
"Even with us as escorts, we can’t fully take care of all the battle scenarios."
"If even one monster gets overlooked, it could be catastrophic for them."
"So, you need to explain these circumstances to them; whether they’re willing to take the risk should be their own decision."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, hearing this, furrowed their brows.
Moments later, the two nodded and said, "I understand, Brother Xing, I’ll explain this to them."
Finished, they headed back into Xingyu City respectively.
Han Xing also had a lot to do on his end.
First, he needed to sell the newly produced 80,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote in the warehouse, to exchange for resources.
Since Han Xing sold the first batch of 100,000 bottles of antidote last night, many teams’ core combat strength had recovered.
Today, each major team found combat slightly more manageable.
At this time, they were already hoping Han Xing would sell more Blood Curse Antidote.
And Han Xing did not disappoint them.
Because, once again, he put up a full 80,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote on the trading channel for sale.
However, the price compared to yesterday was much higher.
Now, Han Xing’s pricing was 20,000 Spirit Cores per bottle, and it was still limited to one bottle per person.
This time, he didn’t notify beforehand on the trading channel.
But at the moment the Blood Curse Antidote went on sale...
It caused a huge sensation.
"Damn! Brothers, the second batch of Blood Curse Antidote is out, quickly go grab from the trading channel!"
"Star God is really a Star God! So quickly putting another batch up, didn’t keep us waiting long!"
Instantly, millions of survivors got the news and flooded the trading channel.
And when they saw today’s Blood Curse Antidote price was different, part of them hesitated.
"Hmm? Why is the antidote so much more expensive today?"
"Yeah, it costs 20,000 a bottle!"
The tone of this group of survivors seemed somewhat dissatisfied.
However, someone immediately retorted, "What did you expect?"
"Yesterday Star God already said that selling Blood Curse Antidote at 10,000 Spirit Cores barely broke even, did you think others were really doing this out of charity?"
"That’s right, after yesterday’s trading, I saw the price of one bottle of antidote soar to even 100,000, or even 150,000, but there were still lots of people scrambling to buy!"
"20,000 a bottle is likely Star God looking out for ordinary folks like us!"
"Stop chatting, there are only 80,000 bottles this time, if you’re any slower, it’ll be gone!"
With this reminder, those chatting survivors suddenly realized something, and their expressions changed.
The next moment when they opened the consignment channel, they saw the bold words ’Sold Out’.
"Damn, already gone?"
"That was way too fast, I barely chatted and it’s gone..."
While they were talking, really just less than ten seconds passed.
Han Xing’s 80,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidote were completely snatched up!
All of a sudden, those survivors who didn’t snag any felt deeply regretful.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 181: Thriving Growth and Vigorous Development
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Xing was also wearing a look of delight as he gazed at his warehouse.
This round of trade had earned him another 1.6 billion in material resources.
This speed of resource acquisition was truly unbelievable if spoken of.
With resources in hand, Han Xing began to extensively build various defense towers to enhance his combat strength.
The first batch prioritized the ones with the highest damage and power — the Thunderbolt Towers.
Now, the area surrounding Xingyu City was almost entirely encircled.
At this time, Han Xing pondered in a low voice: "The firepower intensity around Xingyu City is already saturated; perhaps it’s time to choose other locations to build defense towers."
Then, he scanned across the territory.
Finally deciding.
To build the new batch of defense towers on the hillside.
After selecting the location, Han Xing began construction directly.
"Would you like to consume materials... to build Thunderbolt Tower*1?"
"Would you like to consume materials... to build Corrosion Tower*1?"
"Would you like to..."
Han Xing clicked continuously.
"Under construction..."
System prompts continuously appeared.
Bang! Bang bang!
Han Xing successively constructed over 30 Thunderbolt Towers, consuming a large amount of resources.
Then, next to the Thunderbolt Towers, he built hundreds of Ice Arrow Towers, Corrosion Towers, and Poison Arrow Towers.
Looking at the materials in the warehouse approaching depletion once again.
Han Xing smiled wryly.
"Damn it, I’m really being wasteful here."
"Earning billions in a day, spending billions, completely lacking the mindset of a hoarder."
Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh about his money slipping away like water.
However, the consumption of these resources was entirely worthwhile.
In the words of a certain Master Ma.
Your money hasn’t disappeared; it merely changed states to accompany you.
And his resources were transformed into more defense towers to protect the territory.
Just at this time, a system prompt appeared.
"The building in your territory, Big-beaked Bird’s Nest, has been successfully constructed."
Hearing this prompt, joy sparkled in Han Xing’s eyes.
"The nest is set up!"
He immediately made his way into the Dark Fire Stone Mine.
Finding that the scene inside had entirely transformed.
Where once an empty mine stood, there was now a huge bird’s nest framework made of refined iron and wood.
Atop the framework lay a thick layer of dry grass.
The Dark Fire Stone emanated a scalding aura nearby, enveloping the entire mine in warmth.
At this moment, Han Xing stepped lightly on the soft dry grass, thinking.
"Wow, it’s quite cozy here; it’s making me want to lie down and nap."
It’s undeniably said that the environment of this bird’s nest was excellent.
Like a natural incubation chamber.
Perfect for nurturing life.
In front of Han Xing, the relevant information about the bird’s nest appeared.
[Big-beaked Bird’s Nest]: By consuming Spirit Cores, you can exchange for Big-beaked Bird Eggs for incubation.
By enhancing the technology level, you can increase the simultaneous incubation number of Big-beaked Bird Eggs and accelerate the incubation and growth speed of Big-beaked Birds.
[Technology 1]: Basic Bird’s Nest Level 1 (Currently can simultaneously incubate 1000 Big-beaked Bird Eggs, requiring 36 hours for incubation.)
[Technology 2]: Accelerated Growth Level 1 (By feeding Spirit Cores, enhance the Big-beaked Bird Level; each level increase adds +1 to the Big-beaked Bird Level Limit.)
"Hmm? This thing is a bit different from the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs."
"It’s incubated in batches!"
Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
He tried clicking the + sign behind the Basic Bird’s Nest Technology, and a system prompt appeared.
"Would you like to consume materials: Refined Iron*10000, Wood*50000, Dark Fire Stone*5000, Mithril*250 to upgrade ’Basic Bird’s Nest Level 1’?"
"Yes.
"Upgrade successful; the nest can now simultaneously incubate 1100 Big-beaked Bird Eggs, reducing incubation time to 35 hours and 50 minutes..."
Joy lit Han Xing’s eyes, "Interesting. Upgrading 1 level increases the capacity by 100 eggs and shortens the incubation time by 10 minutes, right?"
Then, Han Xing continued to click to upgrade.
He clicked 48 times in succession, maxing it out.
Now, this technology had become.
[Giant Bird’s Nest Level: max]: Currently can simultaneously incubate 6000 Big-beaked Bird Eggs, requiring 27 hours and 40 minutes for incubation...
"6000 eggs! That means by tomorrow, my territory can have the first squadron of Big-beaked Birds!"
Excitement welled in Han Xing’s heart, and with a flourish, he directly spent 3 million Spirit Cores to exchange for 6000 Big-beaked Bird Eggs.
The next moment, numerous huge white eggs appeared within the Giant Bird’s Nest.
giant eggs scattered throughout the various corners of the nest.
In the warm environment, these eggs will soon hatch.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Very soon, he will have his first aerial units!
Then, he glanced at the Minotaur Camp and Wolf Cavalry Camp below.
Through uninterrupted summoning over the past two days.
Every single day, Han Xing had to expend almost a massive amount of Spirit Cores to summon Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry.
But correspondingly, the results were very evident.
The Wolf Cavalry could appear every 5 seconds, while a Minotaur needed 10 seconds per summon.
Now, the number of Wolf Cavalry had surpassed 30,000, and Minotaurs had exceeded over 10,000.
Among them were many Leaders and Elite-level Minotaurs.
Currently, the entire territory was thriving with development.
Every day, new defense towers were completed.
Every day, more Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry appeared.
Moreover, not only was the territory’s strength growing.
The strength of Han Xing and others was also rapidly enhancing.
Everything was moving in a positive direction.
After finishing all this, Han Xing concluded his busy day.
