chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 181: Thriving and Rapid Development (Part 2)
paragraphs: Returned to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
The next day.
Before Han Xing got out of bed, he saw a large group of people standing at the gate of the Lord’s Mansion.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, each with their relatives behind them.
Seeing the fear mixed with a trace of determination in their eyes, Han Xing understood what they meant.
So, Han Xing directly asked, "Have you all made up your mind?"
Yesterday, he had Shen Yun and others ask their relatives if they would be willing to fight alongside them and earn some experience to level up.
Thus, Han Xing’s question meant telling them.
Once they decided to participate in the battle, they had to accept the potential risks and even death.
The relatives exchanged a glance after hearing this.
Though there was still some fear in their eyes, they had thought it over for a whole night.
So, looking at Han Xing, everyone nodded with determination.
Without saying more, Han Xing was about to reorganize the teams.
To his surprise, among the crowd, Lanlan and her group of friends were also there.
They were fully armed, looking at Han Xing with anticipation.
At this point, Han Xing asked, "Are you sure you want to join the battle too?"
Lanlan and the others nodded one after another and said, "Mm-hmm! We also want to get stronger and help Lord!"
Compared to the second batch of survivors who arrived in this world, Lanlan and the others had some survival experience.
Their levels were around seventeen or eighteen,
Thinking of this, Han Xing said no more.
Then.
A team was formed by Han Xing and others, with one person leading four relatives to form a squad.
Xingyu City continued to advance rapidly in the sky.
In the battles that followed, the five maintained a tacit cooperation, killing wave after wave of monsters.
The relatives obediently stood aside, occasionally throwing a skill or two to earn some experience.
Although they gained very little experience and only dared to deal with one or two severely injured monsters now and then.
But, it’s important to know that they were all at level 0, and most hadn’t even killed a single monster.
As time passed, the Blood Tide monsters mostly reached level 20, on the verge of becoming three-star monsters.
So, it equated to them battling monsters nearly 20 levels higher.
Any random monster experience was enough for them to level up several times!
All morning, white light flashed continuously across the survivors in the territory, and their levels steadily increased.
They experienced the thrill of leveling up for the first time; each increased attribute made them feel a surge in strength!
The feeling of the body becoming stronger and more energetic.
The older relatives were thoroughly intoxicated, as if they had returned to their youth!
No, even more robust than in their younger days.
At this moment, the relatives looked at Han Xing and the others with surprise and gratitude.
It was these individuals who helped them, the survivors without strength to bind a chicken, quickly enhance their strength.
The relatives fought more vigorously.
They almost always seized the opportunity to deliver the final blow to the severely injured monsters.
A whole day passed, and everyone gained a lot.
But the one who gained the most was Han Xing.
Along the way, when other survivors encountered large monstrous hordes, they’d flee as if avoiding a deadly plague.
But Han Xing saw them as treasures, instantly directing Sky Island to crash into the monster tide fiercely.
Before the monsters could react, blinding blue beams and thousands of flame shells had already closed in!
Under the dense firepower coverage, countless monsters were killed on the spot!
Compared to the previous days, Han Xing doubled the number of defense towers.
Often, a round of bombardment could easily eliminate tens of thousands of monsters!
Faced with millions of Blood Tides, it would only take two rounds to wipe them out.
And this meant that each Thunderbolt Tower burst could earn him hundreds of thousands of Battle Merit!
After a day’s fighting, Han Xing gained between six to ten million Battle Merit!
Now, Han Xing stood proudly at the top of the Battle Merit Rankings with a staggering total of 54 million.
The second place, Zhou Huang, barely had 800,000 Battle Merit now.
No one expected anyone to surpass Star River anymore.
After a whole day of fighting, everyone felt both exhilarated and exhausted.
Soon.
The time came to the third day.
Today marked the ninth day of the Blood Tide outbreak.
Han Xing, after fighting for another day, gained over nine million Battle Merit.
Now, his Battle Merit had surpassed sixty million!
At this moment, on the Lord’s Mansion wall, Han Xing looked excited.
"Great, as those Defense Towers on the territory are completed batch by batch, dealing with those Blood Tide Monsters becomes easier."
"Now, just the daily Battle Merit earns almost ten million! The day to exchange for that Sun Treasure Chest is near!"
Then, Han Xing looked at his warehouse again.
The number of Blood Curse Antidotes had broken through 120,000 once more.
Han Xing said excitedly, "120,000 bottles of antidote, I can sell another batch, but today, the price needs to be increased a little more!"
After concluding the second batch of Blood Curse Antidote transactions yesterday, Han Xing discovered.
Many survivors who bought the potions didn’t use them on themselves.
Instead, they quickly tossed them into the trading channel, selling them for 50,000 or even 100,000.
For these people, Han Xing couldn’t impose more restrictions.
After all, he stipulated that only those afflicted by the Blood Curse could participate in the buying.
Since they’d rather endure the curse to earn more, Han Xing couldn’t stop them.
So, Han Xing decided to increase the price slightly.
Now it had reached 30,000 Spirit Cores per bottle.
Also, an additional restriction was made.
That is, any single survivor can only buy one bottle within seven days.
This restriction once again cut off most survivors looking to resell the Blood Curse Antidotes.
Because you can’t guarantee to get the next batch of Blood Curse Antidotes.
When 120,000 bottles of Blood Curse Antidotes went on sale, they sold out within thirty seconds.
This meant Han Xing pocketed nearly 3.6 billion in resources again.
Han Xing’s mouth curled into a satisfied smile.
"Good, even at 30,000 per bottle, there’s still no worry of sales."
"However, there’s no need to continue increasing the price afterward."
"At this price, I can accumulate about 2.8 billion in material resources each day."
"I’m getting close to achieving my goal!"
A sharp gleam flickered in Han Xing’s eyes.
After the last Blood Tide outbreak, he decided to triple the number of Defense Towers on the territory and then target the Blood Altar.
And within only three days, the goal was almost halfway completed!
"At this rate, in a few more days, I’ll reach 100 million Battle Merit, exchange for that Sun Treasure Chest, and open the first Divine Artifact in the entire server!"
"Then, the number of Defense Towers will reach my expectations!"
"Next, it’s time to target those Blood Pool Altars and completely eliminate the Blood Tide disaster!"
Han Xing had already made a detailed plan for his future development.
Early the next morning.
Han Xing, as if on adrenaline, roused everyone up.
"Brothers, get up and get to work!"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun looked at the excited Han Xing with a face of confusion.
"What’s up, Brother Xing, did something good happen?"
Han Xing didn’t answer but wore a mysterious smile.
Today, the entire day, Xingyu City was advancing quickly.
All along the way, any monster tides encountered were crushed effortlessly!
Everyone’s levels were steadily increasing.
By sunset, Han Xing’s level had risen to 28.
Shen Yun and others’ levels were between 26 and 27.
In addition to that, those relatives had finally broken through level ten and completed their First Transformation.
Moreover, today Han Xing killed over eight million Blood Tide monsters, gaining nearly ten million Battle Merit!
Now, his accumulated Battle Merit reached 64 million!

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 182: Big-beaked Bird Hatches
paragraphs: Currently, Han Xing’s accumulated battle merit has reached 64 million.
He looked at this number with satisfaction, then glanced at his warehouse.
After a whole day of production.
The number of Blood Curse Antidotes once again surpassed eighty thousand bottles. Trading them all off would be a huge resource.
Just as Han Xing was about to trade off this batch of curse antidotes, he suddenly heard a system prompt.
"Your territory creature, the Big-beaked Bird has hatched successfully."
Han Xing’s eyes lit up instantly, "The first batch of Big-beaked Birds is out?"
He joyfully rushed down to the foot of the mountain and then entered into the huge mine cave.
Before he got close, Han Xing heard a dense, chirping sound from inside.
The sound was continuous, just like thousands of baby birds, calling for their mother.
Indeed, there were actually thousands of baby birds inside.
As Han Xing walked in, he saw pieces of broken eggshells everywhere on the bird’s nest.
Each newborn bird, with only a few strands of down feather, stretched its neck calling out.
This is what the Big-beaked Birds look like when they’re just born.
Their long beak, half as big as their body, is their most distinctive feature.
The moment Han Xing stepped in, these chicks opened their mouths instantly, shouting out loud.
"Chirp! Chirp!"
"Chirp! Chirp chirp!"
The chicks’ calls rose and fell, making a buzzing noise in one’s ears.
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch his mouth.
Then, Han Xing also saw the attributes of these chicks.
[Big-beaked Bird (Newborn Stage)]
[Level]: lv0
[Attributes]: None
[Skills]: To be activated
[State]: Awaiting feeding.
Note: Please feed the Big-beaked Birds as soon as possible for their growth. Each feeding increases the bird’s level by lv1.
"These things need Spirit Cores to upgrade..."
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch his mouth again.
Looking at the thousands of gaping mouths begging for food, Han Xing felt that he might not have the patience to feed them one by one.
So.
He opened the territory residents interface, ready to call for help.
A few minutes later.
Lanlan and a few other girls awoke from their dreams with puzzled expressions.
Hearing Han Xing’s call, they quickly put on their pajamas and came out of their rooms.
They followed the location given by Han Xing and soon arrived at the entrance of the mine cave at the foot of the mountain.
Han Xing was waiting outside the mine.
At this moment, Lanlan asked drowsily, "Lord... my Lord, what’s going on?"
The girls were somewhat anxious, seemingly not knowing why Han Xing had called them out in the middle of the night.
Moreover, it was a mine cave, a place that could easily spark one’s imagination.
Han Xing didn’t explain, instead, he turned and walked into the mine cave, letting Lanlan and the others follow.
As soon as they entered the mine.
Everyone heard the rising and falling, dense bird cries.
The girls exchanged glances, all seeing the astonishment and panic in each other’s eyes.
"Lord... my Lord, what’s inside?"
Beside Lanlan, a well-built female assassin in leather clothing trembled slightly.
As girls, they seemed to have a natural fear of creatures in such cave environments.
"Birds," Han Xing said simply and directly.
"Ah?"
The girls looked puzzled, not seeming to understand what Han Xing meant.
However, their confusion didn’t last long.
Because they had already seen the giant bird’s nest inside the cave.
And on the nest, thousands of Big-beaked Birds flapping their meaty wings and cawing chaotically.
At this point, Han Xing said directly, "I have a task for you, help me feed Spirit Cores to this group of chicks."
Lanlan then realized the purpose of Han Xing’s call for them.
Lanlan quickly agreed, "Alright Lord, leave it to us!"
Her tone carried a touch of excitement, seemingly thrilled by Han Xing’s first task for them.
Han Xing nodded, distributing 500,000 Spirit Cores to each of them.
For the first time, the girls were touching such an enormous number, their faces filled with obvious shock.
Before they could say anything.
They saw Han Xing had already turned around, took out a Spirit Core, and fed it to one of the Big-beaked Birds.
Han Xing noticed that after swallowing the Spirit Core, this Big-beaked Bird underwent rapid growth.
From its initially hatched head size, it quickly grew to the size of a hen.
Additionally, the white down feathers on its body grew denser.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
"Feeding successful, Big-beaked Bird level +1."
Han Xing thought, "Just one Spirit Core from level 0 to level 1, the cost is acceptable."
Then, Han Xing continued feeding.
However, raising from level 1 to level 2 required feeding 10 Spirit Cores.
Lanlan and the other girls followed suit, constantly feeding Spirit Cores to these Big-beaked Birds.
In front of Han Xing, the chick closed its eyes, opening its giant mouth, seemingly anticipating Han Xing’s feeding.
Han Xing tossed down one Spirit Core after another.
The Big-beaked Bird swallowed them like jelly beans.
A total of forty Spirit Cores were fed.
The message of the Big-beaked Bird’s level-up kept coming.
Then, Han Xing found that this Big-beaked Bird had already reached level 5.
Apart from the level increase, the size of this little guy is also rapidly growing.
With a speed visible to the naked eye, it continues to expand.
It’s now as big as an adult goose.
Moreover, its feathers are starting to darken, gradually turning into a dark blue color.
When it stands up on its slender long legs, it’s almost a meter tall.
In front of Han Xing appeared the attributes of this Big-beaked Bird.
[Big-beaked Bird (Growth Stage)]
[Level]: lv5
[Attributes]: Power 15, Agility 17, Spirit 13, Constitution 16.
[Skills]: Giant Beak Bite, Rapid Assault.
[State]: Hungry.
Han Xing murmured, "According to the technology level of the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest, these chicks can grow up to level 28."
"It seems they can continue to grow."
At this time, the Big-beaked Bird approached again, seemingly still expecting Han Xing to feed it.
However, upon realizing it could walk on its own, Han Xing grabbed it by the neck and tossed it in front of a large box.
Inside the box were hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores.
Han Xing pointed at the Big-beaked Bird, then at the Spirit Cores in the box.
The Big-beaked Bird looked at Han Xing blankly.
It seemed to not understand his meaning, flapping its wings, ready to pounce on Han Xing again.
Han Xing grabbed its big beak and threw it to the side of the box, saying.
"Since you can walk, you need to learn to eat by yourself."
"Don’t always think about waiting for others to feed you, understand?"
This time, the Big-beaked Bird understood what Han Xing meant.
It turned its head, pitifully burying its beak into the box.
Han Xing chuckled softly.
"Little rascal."
Then, he placed several large boxes nearby, also filled with hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores, serving as feeding troughs for these Big-beaked Birds.
At this time, Han Xing said to Lanlan and the others: "Just feed these chicks to level 5, they’ll come to eat by themselves."
At this moment, Lanlan and the others were surrounded by hundreds of chicks, already somewhat flustered.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s voice, Lanlan quickly said: "Okay... okay, Lord!"
However, before Lanlan and the others could react, those Big-beaked Birds had already rushed over, snatching the Spirit Cores from their hands.
Lanlan and the other girls exclaimed, "Birdies, don’t snatch, take turns!"
"Ah! Don’t pull my clothes, you naughty bird!"
"Don’t... don’t bite there..."
The Big-beaked Birds, famished, were unwilling to let go, clinging to the corners of the girls’ clothes.
Just then, Han Xing heard a strange sound.
With a ripping sound.
Lanlan’s thin pajamas were directly torn by a Big-beaked Bird, revealing large patches of snow-white skin on her back.
Hearing the sound, Han Xing turned around and saw this scene.
However, Lanlan and the others, busy feeding the Big-beaked Birds, seemed not to notice.
At this moment, Han Xing cleared his throat awkwardly.
"Ahem, ahem..."
The girls seemed to realize something, looking at each other, then simultaneously looking at Lanlan.
Feeling the gazes of everyone, and the gust of wind on her back.
Lanlan understood what had happened.
In an instant, her face turned crimson.
However, Han Xing didn’t say much, only reminding her: "Put on those leveled equipments, the Big-beaked Birds can’t bite through them."
After saying that, he turned and left the mine.
Leaving the girls looking at each other in surprise.
At this moment, Lanlan clasped her arms, her face burning red.
Beside her, the other girls realized and asked.
"Sister Lan, why are you wearing pajamas out here..."
Lanlan quietly replied: "I... I didn’t know this would happen."
"Besides, this is my habit... you guys know it, don’t make fun of me..."
"I’m ignoring you all!"
Saying that, Lanlan buried her head into the grass pile.
At this moment, a female assassin couldn’t help but comment: "You know, Sister Lan’s figure is still so good, I wonder what Lord was thinking just now."
The other girls heard this and had mischievous smiles on their faces.
"You guys still talking!"
Lanlan was ashamed to no end.
At this time, Han Xing was unaware of the girls’ antics.
He still had a few things to do.
That is, selling the Blood Curse Antidotes in his hand, acquiring more resources to build defense towers.
Today, Han Xing still sold them at the price of 30,000 Spirit Cores per bottle.
Similarly, they were sold out within thirty seconds.
Han Xing’s mouth curled into a smile.
"Great, another 2 billion resources in hand."
Then, as usual, Han Xing used these resources to build defense towers, converting them into his combat strength.
After finishing all the work, Han Xing finally slept peacefully.
The next day.
Today marks the tenth day of the Blood Tide outbreak.
Since last night, the chat channel had been buzzing about how the levels of Blood Tide Monsters had generally increased a lot.
The previous Blood Tide, no matter how numerous, consisted mostly of 20-level monsters, except for those lord-level creatures.

Because they had already seen the giant bird’s nest inside the cave.
And on the nest, thousands of Big-beaked Birds flapping their meaty wings and cawing chaotically.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 183: Wuhu! Take Off!
paragraphs: But today, among the Blood Tide Monsters, there are already many Level 21 creatures, which means they are Three-star Level.
Going from Two-star to Three-star is a huge leap.
The intensity of the monster tide is becoming higher and higher.
Fortunately, the strength of the survivors has also been increasing over these days.
More and more survivors have completed advancement tasks and become Second Transformation Professionals.
So far, it’s barely manageable.
Early in the morning, Han Xing was awakened by various chattering sounds coming from the territory.
As he walked out of the Lord’s Mansion, he saw several gigantic figures soaring overhead.
Moreover, thousands of gigantic figures were circling back and forth around the territory.
At this moment, the residents of Xingyu City came out, curiously looking at the sky.
At this moment, Lanlan and a group of young girls, all with a tired demeanor, came over and said.
"L-Lord..."
"All these Big-beaked Birds have been fed, but they are just too mischievous. After being fed, they refuse to settle down and all flew out of the nest.
"Moreover, these Big-beaked Birds don’t listen to us at all; they won’t come back even when called."
After listening to Lanlan’s account, Han Xing roughly understood what had happened.
Once these Big-beaked Birds were full, their abundant energy was vented by circling endlessly around Xingyu City.
All night long, the uproar caused unrest inside and outside the Lord’s Mansion.
Han Xing’s lips twitched at this.
Then, he directly opened the resident interface of the territory to call over one of the Big-beaked Birds.
From the sky, a massive figure quickly descended and stopped right next to Han Xing.
Han Xing saw the Big-beaked Bird lower its head.
With a body length of about four meters, deep blue feathers, long legs, and an enormous beak about one meter long.
It was already a formidable creature.
At this moment, the attributes of this gigantic bird appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Big-beaked Bird (Three-Star Ordinary Creature)]
[Level]: lv28.
[Attributes]: 504, Agility 534, Spirit 498, Constitution 513.
[Skills]: Giant Beak Bite, Rapid Assault
[State]: Good
The Level 28 Big-beaked Bird alone was nearly two meters tall.
With its wings spread, it reached an astounding six meters in length.
At this moment, the Big-beaked Bird eyed Han Xing with a proud look.
However, when it met Han Xing’s gaze, its proud eyes instantly turned docile.
Cheng Jianyong, next to him, exclaimed, "Brother Xing, are these the new troops you’ve recently recruited?"
Han Xing nodded.
"I see, I was wondering why there were suddenly so many flying creatures around our territory."
Cheng Jianyong’s face showed a look of realization,
Shen Yun also sighed beside him, "Speaking of which, the attributes of these Big-beaked Birds are truly strong, comparable to Minotaurs, yet with more comprehensive attributes."
"Plus, being flying creatures, they might even surpass Minotaurs in combat capabilities."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
The 28-level Big-beaked Bird was massive, even Minotaur Vanguards at the Elite Level couldn’t match it.
Though, in the Sky Island Paradise, a larger size doesn’t always mean superior strength over smaller creatures.
However, there are rarely weaklings among the larger creatures.
At this moment, Han Xing had a sudden idea, a strange thought appeared in his mind.
He asked the Big-beaked Bird to lower its body.
Amidst everyone’s surprise, Han Xing leaped onto its broad back.
The next moment, grabbing a tuft of feathers on the Big-beaked Bird’s back, he commanded.
"Fly for me!"
Amid the astonished gazes of the crowd.
The Big-beaked Bird spread its wings.
Whoosh—
Whoosh—
Continuous gusts of wind came rushing.
Then, they saw the Big-beaked Bird with Han Xing soared to the sky with a swift pierce.
"Lord..."
"Brother Han Xing..."
Below, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang watched the figure in the sky in confusion.
This was when Cheng Jianyong said blankly, "It actually... really flew..."
Sitting on the broad back of the Big-beaked Bird, Han Xing had a look of exhilaration in his eyes.
"Hahaha! So fast!"
"This speed of flight can even rival those Three-star Elite Monsters!"
"So, this is the true purpose of the Big-beaked Bird!"
As a flying creature, the Big-beaked Bird could naturally carry others to fly.
The Level 28 Big-beaked Bird had a movement speed exceeding two thousand kilometers per hour.
It was truly at lightning speed!
Han Xing was ecstatic in the air.
The whistling wind filled his ears.
Ahead lay the vast, boundless blue sky.
Then, Han Xing maneuvered the Big-beaked Bird in the sky, circling several times, thrilling those below like Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, several large figures flew near the group.
Standing on the Big-beaked Bird’s back, Han Xing looked at them and said, "How about it, want to experience it together?"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked expectantly, "Ca-can we, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Cut the nonsense and get up here already!"
Seeing this, the two didn’t stand on ceremony.
With an excited expression, each chose a Big-beaked Bird and leaped onto its back.
Then Han Xing looked down at Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, asking, "Want to join us?"
The two women exchanged a glance and saw the eager anticipation in each other’s eyes.
After all, who hasn’t had a dream of soaring through the sky when they were young?
The next moment.
The five of them stood on the backs of the Big-beaked Birds.
In the excited gaze of everyone watching.
Cheng Jianyong shouted.
"Wuhu! Take off!!!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Five figures soared into the sky!
This scene left their relatives on the ground astonished, with a hint of envy.
It wasn’t until the five figures turned into a black dot and disappeared that everyone slowly came back to their senses.
The five controlled their Big-beaked Birds, flying continuously for half an hour.
In the sky, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s cries of excitement kept coming.
"Wuhu!! This is awesome!"
"Xiaoyunzi, cooperate with me for a set of stunts!"
Initially, Shen Yun didn’t want to accommodate Cheng Jianyong’s childish request.
But seeing the eagerness in his eyes, she nodded in agreement.
The next moment, two Big-beaked Birds flew close together.
Then, in a spiral ascent, they tangled with each other and soared rapidly.
"Hahaha! So agile!"
The five Big-beaked Birds roamed freely in the sky, flying for about ten minutes, leaving their relatives below both worried and slightly envious.
Not until they had had their fill of fun did they slowly descend into Xingyu City.
Even when the two women came down, their faces were brimming with excitement.
At this time, Shen Yun patted the Big-beaked Bird beside her and said, "By the way, Brother Xing, since these Big-beaked Birds can also be used as mounts."
"Doesn’t the Wolf Cavalry in your territory urgently need a batch of mounts?"
Han Xing nodded; he had just thought of this too.
And he was now preparing to go and test it out.
Then, Han Xing approached the area near the Wolf Cavalry legion.
Upon seeing Han Xing approach, tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry saluted respectfully at the same time.
Han Xing nodded and then called over all six thousand Big-beaked Birds.
A dense array, directly shocking the tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry.
At this time, Han Xing said, "Wolf Cavalry, you are known as a race on horseback, so I am giving you these Big-beaked Birds as your flying mounts. Do you have the confidence?"
The Wolf Cavalry looked at each other.
Because, in terms of individual combat power, these Big-beaked Birds are actually much stronger than the Wolf Cavalry.
It would take about two Wolf Cavalry of the same level to handle one Big-beaked Bird.
They felt a bit uneasy about controlling such massive creatures.
At this moment, the Wolf Cavalry really wanted to say, I’m a land cavalry, not an aerial cavalry...
But when they saw the look of expectation on Han Xing’s face, they all nodded nonetheless.
Because they also wanted to perform well in front of Han Xing.
"We will live up to the expectations of Lord!" the Wolf Cavalry said respectfully.
Then, over forty thousand Wolf Cavalry, along with six thousand Big-beaked Birds, began training.
Due to Han Xing’s command, the Big-beaked Birds dared not resist the orders of the Wolf Cavalry.
Therefore, the training of the Wolf Cavalry was relatively smooth.
After all, they were inherently rich in riding skill experience.
The mount was just a bit different.
As long as they trained for a period of time, the Wolf Cavalry could adapt to creatures like the Big-beaked Birds.
At that time, it might even yield unexpected results.
Han Xing thought to himself, "The Big-beaked Bird is indeed an excellent troop type."
"I need to rear another batch."
With that in mind, Han Xing went to the Bird’s Nest and added another six thousand giant eggs, waiting for them to hatch.
After doing all this.
Han Xing then began to lead everyone to hunt Blood Tide Monsters everywhere.
A whole day of fighting passed.
Everyone’s level was rapidly increasing.
Han Xing reached Level 29 today.
Apart from a huge amount of experience.
Han Xing, as usual, reaped more than eight million in battle merit.
In the evening, he sold today’s production of Blood Curse Antidotes.
And erected more Defense Towers.
Days of such cycles continued.
Three days later...
The time reached the thirteenth day since the eruption of the Blood Tide.
These days.
The human situation continued to evolve.
First, the Huayi Alliance led by Zhou Huang merged the first team ’Divine Hall’ of the initial three districts.
Then, the ’Kunlun’ team of Boundless also began large-scale recruitment of Survivors.
And together with Kyushu from the fourth district and the Immortal Mansion from the fifth district, they formed a vast alliance.
Other Survivors also found their respective teams.
The overall human mode began to develop towards teamwork.
Of course.
During this period, several super big groups were buried in the Blood Tide.
Such as the previously famous groups like Cybertron, Between the Rainbows, and Galaxy Guard, all perished in the tide of monsters.
Since the full eruption of the Blood Tide, in just five days.
At least over two hundred million people have died in the increasingly terrifying Blood Tide.
Such a high death rate kept the nerves of humans around the world constantly tense.

Then, Han Xing maneuvered the Big-beaked Bird in the sky, circling several times, thrilling those below like Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, several large figures flew near the group.
Standing on the Big-beaked Bird’s back, Han Xing looked at them and said, "How about it, want to experience it together?"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked expectantly, "Ca-can we, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Cut the nonsense and get up here already!"
Seeing this, the two didn’t stand on ceremony.
With an excited expression, each chose a Big-beaked Bird and leaped onto its back.
Then Han Xing looked down at Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, asking, "Want to join us?"
The two women exchanged a glance and saw the eager anticipation in each other’s eyes.
After all, who hasn’t had a dream of soaring through the sky when they were young?
The next moment.
The five of them stood on the backs of the Big-beaked Birds.
In the excited gaze of everyone watching.
Cheng Jianyong shouted.
"Wuhu!
Take off!!!"
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Five figures soared into the sky!
This scene left their relatives on the ground astonished, with a hint of envy.
It wasn’t until the five figures turned into a black dot and disappeared that everyone slowly came back to their senses.
The five controlled their Big-beaked Birds, flying continuously for half an hour.
In the sky, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s cries of excitement kept coming.
"Wuhu!!
This is awesome!"
"Xiaoyunzi, cooperate with me for a set of stunts!"
Initially, Shen Yun didn’t want to accommodate Cheng Jianyong’s childish request.
But seeing the eagerness in his eyes, she nodded in agreement.
The next moment, two Big-beaked Birds flew close together.
Then, in a spiral ascent, they tangled with each other and soared rapidly.
"Hahaha!
So agile!"
The five Big-beaked Birds roamed freely in the sky, flying for about ten minutes, leaving their relatives below both worried and slightly envious.
Not until they had had their fill of fun did they slowly descend into Xingyu City.
Even when the two women came down, their faces were brimming with excitement.
At this time, Shen Yun patted the Big-beaked Bird beside her and said, "By the way, Brother Xing, since these Big-beaked Birds can also be used as mounts."
"Doesn’t the Wolf Cavalry in your territory urgently need a batch of mounts?"
Han Xing nodded; he had just thought of this too.
And he was now preparing to go and test it out.
Then, Han Xing approached the area near the Wolf Cavalry legion.
Upon seeing Han Xing approach, tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry saluted respectfully at the same time.
Han Xing nodded and then called over all six thousand Big-beaked Birds.
A dense array, directly shocking the tens of thousands of Wolf Cavalry.
At this time, Han Xing said, "Wolf Cavalry, you are known as a race on horseback, so I am giving you these Big-beaked Birds as your flying mounts.
Do you have the confidence?"
The Wolf Cavalry looked at each other.
Because, in terms of individual combat power, these Big-beaked Birds are actually much stronger than the Wolf Cavalry.
It would take about two Wolf Cavalry of the same level to handle one Big-beaked Bird.
They felt a bit uneasy about controlling such massive creatures.
At this moment, the Wolf Cavalry really wanted to say, I’m a land cavalry, not an aerial cavalry...
But when they saw the look of expectation on Han Xing’s face, they all nodded nonetheless.
Because they also wanted to perform well in front of Han Xing.
"We will live up to the expectations of Lord!" the Wolf Cavalry said respectfully.
Then, over forty thousand Wolf Cavalry, along with six thousand Big-beaked Birds, began training.
Due to Han Xing’s command, the Big-beaked Birds dared not resist the orders of the Wolf Cavalry.
Therefore, the training of the Wolf Cavalry was relatively smooth.
After all, they were inherently rich in riding skill experience.
The mount was just a bit different.
As long as they trained for a period of time, the Wolf Cavalry could adapt to creatures like the Big-beaked Birds.
At that time, it might even yield unexpected results.
Han Xing thought to himself, "The Big-beaked Bird is indeed an excellent troop type."
"I need to rear another batch."
With that in mind, Han Xing went to the Bird’s Nest and added another six thousand giant eggs, waiting for them to hatch.
After doing all this.
Han Xing then began to lead everyone to hunt Blood Tide Monsters everywhere.
A whole day of fighting passed.
Everyone’s level was rapidly increasing.
Han Xing reached Level 29 today.
Apart from a huge amount of experience.
Han Xing, as usual, reaped more than eight million in battle merit.
In the evening, he sold today’s production of Blood Curse Antidotes.
And erected more Defense Towers.
Days of such cycles continued.
Three days later...
The time reached the thirteenth day since the eruption of the Blood Tide.
These days.
The human situation continued to evolve.
First, the Huayi Alliance led by Zhou Huang merged the first team ’Divine Hall’ of the initial three districts.
Then, the ’Kunlun’ team of Boundless also began large-scale recruitment of Survivors.
And together with Kyushu from the fourth district and the Immortal Mansion from the fifth district, they formed a vast alliance.
Other Survivors also found their respective teams.
The overall human mode began to develop towards teamwork.
Of course.
During this period, several super big groups were buried in the Blood Tide.
Such as the previously famous groups like Cybertron, Between the Rainbows, and Galaxy Guard, all perished in the tide of monsters.
Since the full eruption of the Blood Tide, in just five days.
At least over two hundred million people have died in the increasingly terrifying Blood Tide.
Such a high death rate kept the nerves of humans around the world constantly tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 184: It’s Time for Humanity to Strike Back!
paragraphs: However, during this period, humanity did not remain entirely without progress.
At the very least, with the expansion of the exploration range by the survivors, the locations of one blood altar after another were discovered.
And these were compiled by those with the intention to do so.
Currently, the number of altars discovered worldwide has already exceeded five hundred.
This is an astounding number.
Not counting those altars that have yet to be discovered.
With the current number of altars, the number of monsters arriving in this world through the altars every day is countless.
Moreover, around these altars, the most terrifying numbers of monsters are still lurking.
With five hundred altars, it’s estimated that the total number of Blood Tide Monsters has already reached several tens of billions.
Now, survivors all over the world see these altars as a dire threat.
But, no one has the confidence.
To face the pressure of over a billion Blood Tide Monsters and boldly raid and destroy the altars hidden deep within.
At the same time.
This morning.
Two Sky Islands, each with an area exceeding millions of square meters and resembling large cities, were connected to each other.
On them, there are over a million humans.
The survivors from both sides looked at each other, eyes filled with curiosity or vigilance.
These two Sky Islands.
One belongs to Zhou Huang of the Huayi Alliance, and the other to Boundless of the Kunlun.
At this moment.
The two most powerful men in the current human race had their first direct encounter.
At the edge of Zhou Huang’s territory, there is a small pavilion.
On it, there is a stone table and several stone benches.
The two found a place to sit down.
Boundless, with silver hair, occasionally exuded a bloodthirsty aura more terrifying than the Blood Tide Monsters.
Opposite him, Zhou Huang wore a gentle smile, one that seemed to emit a holy glow.
Two men with entirely different auras sat face-to-face at this moment.
At this time, Zhou Huang cupped his hands and said, "Brother Boundless, I’ve long admired you."
"I’ve long admired you."
Opposite him, Boundless nodded slightly, economical with words.
Zhou Huang was not angry but chuckled, "Brother Boundless, although this is our first meeting, I won’t say any unnecessary words."
"You should know, the purpose of my visit today."
Zhou Huang got straight to the point.
Opposite, Boundless frowned slightly.
After a moment, Boundless spoke slowly, "Zhou Huang, I know what you want to do, but I must say, your decision is bold and crazy."
"You should know, if our operation fails, the two strongest forces of the human race will suffer heavy blows."
"By then, humanity will be in great danger."
Nevertheless, Zhou Huang merely chuckled lightly, "Without taking risks, where will opportunities come from?"
"Now, with the Blood Tide Monsters becoming more rampant, even if we don’t take this step, the situation for humanity won’t improve."
Boundless pondered for a moment but still shook his head and said, "Honestly, I don’t have much confidence."
"And, I don’t trust you either."
"You act so noble and righteous, I don’t believe there is such a pure person in the world."
To this point, Zhou Huang offered no explanation.
He still wore an indifferent smile and said.
"Brother Boundless, if we succeed this time, have you considered how much benefit we could gain in one fell swoop?"
"In the face of enormous benefits, does it really matter what kind of person I am?"
Boundless was moved in his heart.
At this moment, Zhou Huang continued, "Brother Boundless, I noticed your battle merit has recently surpassed mine, did you find some treasure?"
Boundless’s expression remained unchanged, "Why, can’t it be that my strength itself is stronger than yours?"
Zhou Huang, hearing this, smiled and said, "Impossible, I’ve looked into your situation."
"The cursed item on you is indeed very powerful, but it also comes with corresponding side effects."
"If used too often, the backlash could eventually turn you into that creature.
"But recently, I’ve noticed you haven’t shown symptoms of backlash and even appear to be improving."
"It seems you’ve completely resolved the curse on that item, haven’t you?"
Upon hearing this, Boundless’s fingertips trembled slightly.
He found it really frustrating to talk with this man.
Always a feeling of being seen through.
Zhou Huang didn’t waste further words on this subject and continued, "Boundless, you should understand the current situation for humanity."
"If we don’t destroy the blood altars, we can’t possibly solve the Blood Tides."
"And we are already the two strongest forces in the entire human race."
"Only by combining our forces can we mobilize other teams to break through the terrifying Blood Tides and destroy the altars!"
Boundless also knew that what Zhou Huang said was indeed reasonable.
But he just didn’t want to be led by the nose by this man.
At this time, Boundless asked, "Why not call in Star River? With him, wouldn’t our combat difficulty be much less?"
Zhou Huang replied, smiling, "It would be much less, but if he was by our side, do you think we would gain any benefits?"
Boundless was stunned, and after a moment, he shook his head helplessly.
That man, unlike them, entirely a different level of existence.
After considering for a moment, Boundless asked, "Alright, when do we take action?"
Zhou Huang stood up slowly and said, "Now."
Boundless’s expression became stern.
While Zhou Huang and Boundless were discussing taking action against the blood altar.
Han Xing was standing on the city wall of Xingyu City, satisfied as he looked at the territory now spanning millions of square meters.
"Very good, after a few days of development, the strength of my territory has already undergone a qualitative change!"

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 184: Now It’s Time for Us Humans to Fight Back! (2)
paragraphs: First of all.
It’s the vast expanse of green figures below the territory.
This is an army of nearly ninety thousand wolf cavalry.
Beside the wolf cavalry, there is another massive earth-toned army, though smaller in number.
Minotaurs.
An army of more than forty thousand minotaurs, akin to a legion of war machines.
Among them, there are over two thousand elite-level minotaur vanguards.
Plus, more than thirty minotaur leaders, each over five meters tall and exuding an astonishing aura!
Just these two types of troops are enough to slaughter blood tide creatures numbering less than a million!
Moreover, in the air, over twenty thousand massive flying creatures are circling around Xingyu City.
The three types of troops, working together, can unleash unimaginable power.
Of course, this is not the main force of Xingyu City.
Now, the strongest aspect of the entire Xingyu City is.
The densely packed defense towers, numbering over ten thousand!
Among them.
More than 8,000 flamethrower catapults, balancing destructive power and attack range!
Then there’s ice arrow, corrosion, and venom.
The combined number of these three arrow towers has also exceeded two thousand!
And then, the most deadly and far-reaching are the Thunderbolt Towers!
Now they’ve surpassed 500 towers!
Five days ago.
Han Xing said he would expand the number of territory defense towers by two or three times.
Now, he not only achieved this but exceeded the number completely.
At this moment, Han Xing’s heart was filled with excitement.
Five days of intense development.
Finally, he has achieved his goal.
Now, it is finally time to implement the next plan!
Beside Han Xing.
Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, and others looked at Han Xing with excitement on their faces.
Anyone witnessing the scenery of Han Xing’s territory would involuntarily sigh.
"This level of defense strength can practically make sure nothing slips through!"
"Not to mention monsters, not even a mosquito can fly through!"
Han Xing also smiled and said, "Is everyone ready?"
"Now, it’s time to trouble those guys!"
No trace of fear could be seen in everyone’s eyes, instead, they were filled with surging war intent, looking at Han Xing.
They also seemed to be eagerly anticipating facing the blood tide creatures head-on.
Han Xing nodded with a smile.
The next moment.
The massive Xingyu City suddenly accelerated.
Rushing toward a coordinate point at a speed of 3,500 kilometers per hour!
Along the way, the blood tide creatures they encountered were reduced to debris by hundreds of lightning columns before they could react.
Some sky islands being besieged by blood tide monsters were also instantly cleared of monster tides by Han Xing upon his arrival.
Wherever Xingyu City passed, it was invincible.
Many survivors who were rescued by Han Xing, before they could react, saw the battle had already ended.
Tens of thousands of blood tide monsters formed a blood cloud, which was cleaned up by the opponents at once.
As Xingyu City slowly drifted forward.
The survivors looked blankly at the silhouette of the sky island, unable to snap out of their shock for a long time.
An hour later.
The rapidly advancing Xingyu City finally came to a stop.
A sea wave-like red tide appeared before everyone.
This is their destination this time.
Also the location of one of the blood altars.
At this moment, Han Xing said, "We’ve arrived, get ready."
"In thirty seconds, I will directly attack that blood tide swarm!"
Everyone’s expressions turned serious.
Han Xing’s words meant they were about to attack proactively.
This implies a direct confrontation with the impact of billions or even hundreds of millions of monsters.
Then they will shatter the altar and destroy their birthplace.
And just at this moment, those overwhelming blood tide monsters seemed to have also discovered Han Xing’s sky island.
The next moment, at least millions of monsters charged towards them!
Han Xing silently counted down in his heart.
Ten seconds later...
Below.
Twenty thousand wolf cavalry leaped onto the broad backs of big-beaked birds.
The remaining wolf cavalry and minotaurs stared intently at the distant sky, fully prepared.
At the same time, those relatives also all hid inside the Lord’s Mansion.
They knew, in such a large-scale battle, Han Xing and the others couldn’t care about them.
It’s not the time to farm experience right now either.
Twenty seconds later.
The first wave of monster tide was getting closer.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun nodded, indicating they were ready.
With the end of the thirty-second countdown.
The group of blood-colored monsters was less than a kilometer away from Han Xing.
The next moment.
Han Xing directly invested twenty thousand spirit cores, activating the core acceleration device of the territory.
Buzz!
The gigantic Xingyu City, like a meteorite floating in space, began to move forward quickly.
At this moment, the blood tide formed by millions of bloody monsters also seemed confused seeing Han Xing and others rushing.
Before this, those human survivors met them, fearing to avoid them.
But this group of humans, who knows what madness overcame them.
Seeing them, instead of running away, charged even more aggressively!
But the next moment, these monsters understood why.
On that gigantic sky island, suddenly burst forth hundreds of thick and blindingly blue electric beams.
At this time, the distance between the two sides was less than a kilometer.
At such a close range, these beams nearly pierced through the entire blood tide from beginning to end.
In an instant, tens of thousands of monsters perished under this first burst of the Thunderbolt Towers.
However, before this group of monsters could react, they immediately witnessed an even more terrifying scene.
Two thousand flamethrower catapults fired in unison.
Projectiles burning with intense flames crashed down among the monster hordes.
Rumble!
The sky was constantly trembling.
This scene, comparable in its impact to that of a nuclear explosion, was no less shocking.
The originally terrifying-sized blood tide was utterly wiped out by this wave of bombardment.
The sky was cleared to a sunny day!
Even the blood tide army guarding the altar in the distance was stunned.
The combat prowess exhibited by the sky island was far beyond their imagination.
At this moment, a smile appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth as he said, "Blood tide monsters, you’ve been arrogant for so many days."
"Now, it’s time for us humans to strike back!"
At the same time, the human alliance formed by Zhou Huang and Boundless also began its action.
This time, they assembled the Huayi Alliance, Kunlun, Divine Hall, Immortal Mansion, among others...
A total of thirteen super-large teams came together to form a powerful force.
Among them, just the survivors above level 20 exceed a million in number!
Added to that, the catapults, rotating blade launchers, and various other territorial buildings in their territories.
Altogether, there were already over ten thousand!
This is quite a formidable force.
Zhou Huang, Boundless, and the leaders of the thirteen major groups stood at the core area of the sky island, observing the front.
A moment later, a blood tide no less in scale compared to Han Xing’s side appeared before them.
And just like on Han Xing’s side.
Upon seeing these dozen sky islands, the blood tide split out millions, even tens of millions of blood-colored monsters to intercept them.
At this point, Zhou Huang still maintained a smile and said.
"Everyone, as we agreed, this time we have temporarily formed an alliance."
"In encounters, we fight the monster tide together."
"Everyone can command their own brothers, but in necessary moments, I will oversee the battlefield."
"Remember, do not act separately."
Everyone nodded.
The next moment, the massive blood tide army had arrived.
The two large armies clashed.
At this time, after dealing with this wave of blood tide monsters, Han Xing, without pausing, directly maneuvered the sky island to charge at the blood altar.
The group of monsters appeared extremely enraged.
All these days, it has always been the blood tide monsters chasing humans everywhere.
This weak race managing to endure until today had already exhausted their patience.
And today, these humans dared to proactively attack, charging at their birthplace!
This thoroughly ignited their inner fury.

"Now, it’s time for us humans to strike back!"
At the same time, the human alliance formed by Zhou Huang and Boundless also began its action.
This time, they assembled the Huayi Alliance, Kunlun, Divine Hall, Immortal Mansion, among others...
A total of thirteen super-large teams came together to form a powerful force.
Among them, just the survivors above level 20 exceed a million in number!
Added to that, the catapults, rotating blade launchers, and various other territorial buildings in their territories.
Altogether, there were already over ten thousand!
This is quite a formidable force.
Zhou Huang, Boundless, and the leaders of the thirteen major groups stood at the core area of the sky island, observing the front.
A moment later, a blood tide no less in scale compared to Han Xing’s side appeared before them.
And just like on Han Xing’s side.
Upon seeing these dozen sky islands, the blood tide split out millions, even tens of millions of blood-colored monsters to intercept them.
At this point, Zhou Huang still maintained a smile and said.
"Everyone, as we agreed, this time we have temporarily formed an alliance."
"In encounters, we fight the monster tide together."
"Everyone can command their own brothers, but in necessary moments, I will oversee the battlefield."
"Remember, do not act separately."
Everyone nodded.
The next moment, the massive blood tide army had arrived.
The two large armies clashed.
At this time, after dealing with this wave of blood tide monsters, Han Xing, without pausing, directly maneuvered the sky island to charge at the blood altar.
The group of monsters appeared extremely enraged.
All these days, it has always been the blood tide monsters chasing humans everywhere.
This weak race managing to endure until today had already exhausted their patience.
And today, these humans dared to proactively attack, charging at their birthplace!
This thoroughly ignited their inner fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 185: Two Battlefields
paragraphs: The Blood Tide Monsters were extremely furious at Han Xing and the others for their proactive assault!
However, soon, the anger in their eyes turned into terror.
Because, on Han Xing’s territory, one-fifth of the Defense Towers had already erupted with dazzling light.
Lightning beams shot into the Sea of Blood, like searchlights penetrating the deep sea, forcibly clearing out several vacant areas.
Moreover, Ice Arrows, Corrosion, Poison Arrows, Siege Crossbow Arrows.
Four types of territory buildings launched their respective attacks simultaneously.
Coupled with the bombardment of over a thousand catapults.
This wave directly tore open a big gap in the blood-colored curtain covering the sky and earth.
The monster tide shook endlessly, and corpses rained down like droplets.
The firepower intensity of this territory far exceeded their imagination!
Yet at this moment, Han Xing launched a second wave of attacks.
Rumble!
Over one million monsters perished under this focused fire attack, leaving no remains.
Seeing the flood of notifications, Han Xing’s lips also curled into a slight smile.
The two bombardments rewarded him with nearly over two million Battle Merits!
He was just eight million short of the one billion needed to exchange for that Sun Treasure Chest!
Han Xing knew that as long as he wiped out this wave of Blood Tide Monsters, gathering one billion points was more than achievable!
At this point, that group of monsters also seemed bewildered by Han Xing’s wave of attacks.
However, before they could react.
The third wave of bombardment had already arrived.
Over a thousand blood-red shells, and hundreds of Celestial Punishment Death Lights, all erupted!
Rumble!
The sky filled with Blood Tide Monsters was blasted into fragments.
At this moment, that group of Blood Tide Creatures finally realized the horror of this Sky Island.
And they did not come with good intentions!
From the center of the Blood Tide, a familiar low humming sound emanated.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters moved out in full force!
The target was Han Xing’s Sky Island Territory.
Compared to the scene five days ago, where tens of millions of monsters besieged Han Xing.
This scene was equally shocking!
Furthermore, the level of the monsters inside had also increased.
In five days, the monster group evolved rapidly.
However, Han Xing’s development was even faster!
Calling it a rebirth was an understatement.
It was a true qualitative change!
Previously, he relied on over a hundred Thunderbolt Towers and more than two thousand Flamethrower Catapults to withstand the siege of tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters.
Now, the firepower had expanded several times over.
There was no reason he couldn’t handle a monster scale like this.
Rumble!
Thunderbolt Towers and Flamethrower Catapults continuously bombarded, clearing and consuming waves of the monster tide.
Every moment.
Han Xing’s Battle Merits were increasing at a terrifying speed.
In less than a minute, Han Xing’s Battle Merits had already increased by over eight million.
In Han Xing’s excited gaze.
He watched as his Battle Merits officially broke through from eight digits to nine digits.
At the same time, on the Battle Merit leaderboard, the first existence to break one billion Battle Merits appeared!
At this moment, countless Survivors watching the Battle Merit leaderboard uttered incomprehensible exclamations.
"Good news! The Star God has officially surpassed one billion Battle Merits!"
"Formidable, the speed of acquiring such Battle Merits truly makes us look up to him."
"This is the Star God!"
"The man who withstands natural disasters head-on!"
At this time, the monster tide, seeing that Han Xing could not be conquered after prolonged attack, was also truly enraged.
In the next moment, directly led by ten Lord Creatures.
Along with tens of thousands of Leaders and Elites, forming an elite force, began frantically assaulting Han Xing’s territory.
At this moment, the ten Lords were hidden among the monster group, leading their subordinates to charge fearlessly.
Under such fierce assaults.
Han Xing divided the Defense Towers into five waves for rotation attacks, and a round of attacks couldn’t even kill the Elite Monsters and Leader Monsters among them.
Some of the Blood Tide army even slipped into his territory.
This indeed caused Han Xing a bit of pressure.
But it was just a bit.
Han Xing’s face showed no sign of panic.
Before those monsters that had landed on Xingyu City could attack.
The next moment, a golden horn suddenly appeared in the hand of the human on the city wall.
"Toot—"
An elongated and passionate horn sound rang out.
At this moment, the ten thousand plus Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur units below.
Simultaneously charged mightily towards the monster army.
At this moment, the monster army that reached Han Xing’s territory barely numbered twenty thousand.
Even though there were Leaders and Elite Monsters among them.
They were no match for the two army types on Han Xing’s territory.
Even one-on-one, they couldn’t match the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
Having lost their numerical advantage and being crushed in individual strength as well.
These slipped monsters couldn’t stir up any trouble.
All were trampled into mush by the Minotaurs’ iron hooves, dead beyond dead.
Han Xing didn’t even deploy that batch of flying units.
The monster tide was baffled at this moment.
In the sky, ten Lord-level monsters remained, bewildered as they watched below, their sent elites being crushed to dust.
Before they could react.
They saw thousands of attacks all focusing fire towards them from the territory.
At this moment, those Lord Creatures, originally symbols of terror and nightmares.
Were instantly so frightened that their facial features piled up, their whole bodies shaking madly.
Then, these Lord Creatures unanimously chose to flee.
The people on the side were stunned.
"Damn, these Lord Creatures are so gutless? The moment something seemed off, they just ran away," Cheng Jianyong grumbled.
Han Xing was also stunned for a moment; he didn’t expect these Lord Creatures to flee.
But in the next moment, he quickly reacted, driving the Defense Towers to bombard them.
Boom boom boom!
At this moment, the attacks from the four types of Arrow Towers shot out rapidly.
Among them, five or six Lord Monsters reacted a bit slowly.
The dense arrows had already pierced through their bodies.
The Corrosion Towers weakened their defense.
The Poison Arrow Towers corroded their nerves.
The Ice Arrow Towers froze their bodies.
In the next moment, these six Lord Creatures were directly turned into sieves by this wave of concentrated fire.
System notifications kept appearing.
[Killed Three-star Lord Creature: Evil God’s Mouth, gained Battle Merit *5000, gained Sacred Artifact Fragment *1]
[Killed Three-star Lord Creature: Evil God’s Scale, gained Battle Merit *5000, gained Sacred Artifact Fragment *1]
[Killed...]
Six Lord Creatures brought him another 30,000 Battle Merits and 6 Sacred Artifact Fragments.
Han Xing gazed at the swarm of creatures in the sky, a thoughtful look in his eyes.
"Around an altar, there are typically 10 to 20 Lord Monsters."
"According to this number, if I clear them all, I can get at least 20 Sacred Artifact Fragments..."
"Counting the 10 fragments from destroying the altar, that’s about 30 fragments."
"To exchange for that exclusive Holy Artifact, I need 10,000 Sacred Artifact Fragments..."
"In other words, I have to clear at least over 300 altars to gather those 10,000 fragments!"
This number sounds quite absurd.
After all, according to each altar having over a billion monsters nearby.
Three hundred or so altars would mean over 300 billion monsters.
So many monsters, just standing still, would take Han Xing a long time to bombard.
But Han Xing was not discouraged by this.
After all, it’s a Holy Artifact.
An item one tier higher than a Divine Artifact!
Even leaders of races like the Elf King and the Giant King consider them treasures.
This shows how precious a Holy Artifact is.
"Very well, this Holy Artifact, I am determined to obtain it!"
Han Xing also began to pursue victory.
And with even more ferocious momentum.
He directly controlled the Sky Island to charge fiercely into the sea of scarlet monsters.
In the next moment, dazzling electric light and flame burst forth.
A vast area of monsters was cleared.
On the path, almost no living creature could block Han Xing for a moment.
Including Lord-level Monsters, which also dared not clash with his might!
In less than two minutes.
Han Xing was like a God of Slaughter, cutting a path through the depth of the monster tide.
Then, everyone finally arrived in front of the altar.
From a distance, he saw the altar floating in the air, continuously emanating a bloody aura.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun exchanged a glance, both seeing excitement in each other’s eyes.
Because next, as long as they destroy this altar, it would be equivalent to removing the Blood Tide Monsters’ teleportation point in this world.
And this also signifies that humanity officially fired the first shot in the counterattack against the Blood Tide!
Compared to the ease on Han Xing’s side.
Zhou Huang and the others, after dealing with the first wave of Blood Tide Monsters, immediately faced the frenzied assault from those monsters.
Tens of millions, even billions of monsters mobilized fully.
At this moment, Zhou Huang said solemnly.
"Everyone, line up the Sky Islands uniformly, extend the battle line!"
Luo Chan and Wujie nodded after hearing this.
Because it was agreed from the start that this battle would be commanded by Zhou Huang.
After receiving the order.
More than a dozen large Sky Islands lined up in a row.
Over a million Survivors stood on the edge of the territory, ready to confront the monster horde at any moment.
At this time, the sky-full scarlet monsters were less than a kilometer away from them.
More than a dozen regiment leaders simultaneously looked at Zhou Huang.
In the next moment, Zhou Huang directly ordered.
"Fire!"
At the same time, thousands of Rotating Blade Launchers, Crossbow Arrow Launchers, and Catapults.
All roared with their own fury!
Puff! Puff puff!
Rumble rumble!
The dense monster horde was pierced wave after wave.
Hundreds of thousands of monsters perished.
Several regiment leaders simultaneously showed a trace of joy on their faces.
Because, just with that wave of volley.
The Defense Towers on their territory brought them tens of thousands of Battle Merits.
About equivalent to the total Battle Merits of the entire previous day.
And now, as the massive pile of monsters gathered, their Battle Merits began to soar crazily.
At this moment, more monsters rushed towards them.
The Holy Profession holding their shields high stood at the forefront, all feeling a chill in their hearts.
Even seeing the overwhelming scale of the monsters, they couldn’t help but take a step back.
And at this moment, Zhou Huang’s voice came from behind.
"Don’t retreat, trust me!"
Simultaneously, these melee professions stopped their steps.
In the next moment, everyone saw a giant fifty meters tall, clad in silvery-white Chain Armor, descend from the sky.
Rumble rumble!
The force generated by the Lord-level Puppet directly crushed a large swath of Blood Tide Monsters into bloody debris!
At the same time.
All survivors of the ’Huayi Alliance’ felt a peculiar force envelop them.
Defense greatly increased!

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 186: Confronting the Evil God Altar
paragraphs: Moreover, this enhancement is not targeted at a specific group.
It includes all creatures within the entire territory!
"Kill!"
Someone let out a soft shout.
All the shield warriors took a step forward in unison, bravely withstanding the impact of the Blood Tide monsters!
Meanwhile.
On the other fourteen sky islands.
Lord giants, each fifty meters tall, also appeared.
At this moment, those large group leaders also began to contribute their battle merits.
Although compared to the warriors of the Huayi Alliance, these people were somewhat mixed in quality.
However, with the advantage of numbers and the boost from the lord-level puppets.
They still managed to successfully fend off the overwhelming blood tide assaults.
When those monsters were ready to fly into the air for a raid.
The crowd would immediately launch spinning blades, bringing them down from the sky.
At the same time, the catapults and arrow towers on the territory kept unleashing their firepower without pause.
These large group leaders, seeing the ever-increasing battle merits every moment, showed joy in their eyes.
"Awesome! Just in a few minutes, I’ve gained over eighty thousand battle merits!" said a survivor named Long Yuan.
"I gained ninety thousand battle merits!"
"Me too, how impressive!"
Beside him, Chen Da Chui said with a face full of surprise, "So this is how Brother Xing farms monsters? This is incredible!"
"At this rate, we might have a chance to surpass him, right?"
However, just as Chen Da Chui finished saying this, he saw everyone looking at him as if he were an idiot.
Long Yuan said helplessly, "What are you thinking, surpassing Star River? You should take a look at how many battle merits he already has."
Upon hearing this, Chen Da Chui immediately opened the battle merit ranking.
However, when he saw Han Xing’s 110 million battle merits, he was completely stunned.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui wiped his eyes and asked blankly, "If I remember correctly, ten minutes ago, Star River had just reached one hundred million battle merits, right?"
"Ten minutes, ten million battle merits, is this really something a human can do?"
The other several group leaders were equally as shocked as Chen Da Chui.
Even Boundless was a bit at a loss.
Only Zhou Huang was slightly calmer.
He looked at everyone and said softly, "I bet Star River is doing the same thing we are right now."
Everyone was taken aback upon hearing this.
"You mean Star River is targeting the Blood Altar?"
"Impossible, right? No matter how strong he is, he’s still just one person!"
Yet upon hearing this, Zhou Huang smiled faintly and said, "Nothing is impossible."
"Don’t forget, these days, how many bottles of Blood Curse Antidote has Star River sold."
"The resources he possesses far exceed our imagination."
Everyone was shocked beyond words upon hearing this.
At this time, Han Xing, after clearing out the surrounding Blood Tide monsters.
Was ready to bombard that Blood Altar.
Suddenly, he saw a familiar figure appear ahead.
The figure was over a thousand meters tall, seemingly made up of various animal organs, covered in blood bubbles.
Han Xing immediately warned, "Be careful, a Dominator-level creature is about to act."
As the familiar grotesque sound echoed, everyone braced themselves.
In the next moment, within a thousand-meter radius around its body, all Blood Tide creatures suddenly transformed their forms.
They all developed a blood-colored bubble on their bodies.
Identical to the one enveloping Han Xing’s island, just smaller.
And the next moment.
The monsters enveloped by bubbles charged forward like madmen in a torrential rage.
Thousands of them, like a suicide squad, pounced on Han Xing’s territory.
Moreover, these monsters enveloped by blood bubbles were also immune to damage.
The attacks from the defense towers were all neutralized by the blood bubbles on them.
Even the Thunderbolt Towers were no exception.
Han Xing frowned.
Seeing he couldn’t stop this group of Blood Tide monsters, Han Xing decided to stop trying.
Just then.
The monsters encircled by bubbles, upon reaching the skies above Han Xing’s territory.
Dove directly into the Minotaur and Wolf Cavalry armies.
The next moment.
The blood bubbles burst.
And the Blood Tide monsters inside exploded into a blood mist.
The blood mist, containing the Curse of the Evil God, contaminated the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
They were now all inflicted with a Blood Curse, showing various signs of infection rapidly.
And this was just the beginning.
More Blood Tide monsters rushed into Han Xing’s territory, launching self-destructive attacks.
Simultaneously, the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry being bombarded saw their Blood Curse layers skyrocketing wildly.
In the blink of an eye, reaching over five layers!
Seeing this, Han Xing hurriedly said, "Spread out quickly!"
Below, the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry, with strong combat awareness.
Did not require Han Xing’s reminder, and had already begun to disperse their formations.
At the same time.
Han Xing frowned.
Unexpectedly, this Dominator-level creature was so troublesome.
It hadn’t even officially attacked yet, and casualties were already appearing in his territory.
At this moment, the Dominator-level creature, seeing its tactic working, was about to launch a second wave of attacks.
But then it noticed the abnormal actions of the blood-cursed Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
Before the monsters’ eyes.
They took out a bottle of blood-red potion from their belts or under their leather pants.
Then, drank it down.
In the next moment, these Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs regained their combat power and became even more ferocious.
This scene left the Dominator-level creature dumbfounded.
What the hell?
There’s such a move?
Give these summoned creatures medicine?
Han Xing was a bit angry at this moment.
Just this wave.
At least five thousand bottles of Blood Curse Potion were consumed.
Converted into Spirit Cores, that’s nearly a billion in value.
Compared to summoning one Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur, which only requires a few thousand Spirit Cores.
This is clearly not a cost-effective deal.
But after all, Han Xing is a normal person with flesh and blood.
He couldn’t bear to see these summoned creatures dying in front of him.
Some things can’t be measured by value.
Now, Han Xing could only vent his anger on this Dominator-level monster.
"Damn it, you’re throwing shit at me, huh?"
"Just you wait!"
Han Xing waved his big hand.
At the next moment.
Over a thousand golden, ten-meter-high Metal Giants descended from the sky!
Consuming ten million Battle Merit, Han Xing directly exchanged for a thousand Leader-level Golden Armor Puppets!
Puppet creatures not only have extraordinary combat strength, but they also have one crucial characteristic.
They are immune to the Blood Curse!
The next moment.
When more Blood Tide kamikaze troops came charging in.
The thousand Golden Armor Puppets leaped up.
They extended their arms and actively embraced clusters of blood-colored bubbles.
Pop! Pop!
With the sound of bubbles bursting.
The second wave of Blood Tide kamikaze troops’ offensive was directly dismantled.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
"Now it’s my turn!
Han Xing invested twenty thousand Spirit Cores.
The Sky Island’s speed instantly surged.
It shot straight towards the Dominator-level creature.
As soon as it entered the attack range of the Thunderbolt Tower.
Han Xing directly activated one hundred Thunderbolt Towers, unleashing a simultaneous barrage!
Buzz!
The dazzling blue light carried the power to destroy everything.
And it was all directed at one target!
The next moment, the Dominator-level creature was enveloped in plasma.
From a distance, everyone saw the Dominator-level creature twitching all over from the electricity, rolling continuously in the air.
"Goo——Goo——"
The Dominator-level creature emitted strange cries from the electrocution.
Han Xing’s mouth revealed a pleased smile.
"Good, good, damn you for throwing shit at me, I’ll electrocute you to death!"
Han Xing was just about to strike while the iron was hot.
But saw that the Dominator-level creature suddenly had a blood-colored bubble emerge, covering itself.
At that moment, the blood-colored bubble provided complete immunity to all attacks.
Han Xing’s mouth twitched, "Damn it, this bubble really doesn’t play by the rules, directly immune to both physical and magic attacks."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
However, although the Dominator-level creature was immune to damage.
Correspondingly, it also couldn’t attack outside.
At this moment, Han Xing just needed to silently wait for the blood-colored bubble’s duration to end.
Han Xing counted down in his heart.
Once twenty seconds passed.
Dozens of lightning pillars, along with hundreds of Arrow Tower attacks, suddenly slammed towards the Dominator-level creature!
At this time, the Dominator felt a sense of impending doom.
This wave of attacks, if hit through.
Even if it didn’t die, it would likely be seriously injured.
However, it had just used the life-saving skill, and it was still in cooldown.
Before it could react.
The blinding thunder light and the arrows of three colors had already come.
Puff! Puff puff puff!
All attacks hit the massive body of the Dominator-level creature.
Causing it to howl miserably in the air.
Everyone even saw blood bubbles bursting on its body, revealing the fresh red flesh inside.
At this moment, the Dominator-level creature realized.
The Dominator-level creature glared hatefully at Han Xing, then hurled another blood bubble at Han Xing’s Sky Island.
The Sky Island was once again engulfed by a blood-colored bubble.
But it seemed to have given up on attacking Han Xing’s team, choosing instead to retreat.
At the same time, the remaining Blood Tide monsters followed the Dominator-level creature in retreating.
"Damn it, don’t run, let me gather more Battle Merit!"
Han Xing shouted as he stood in place.
However, the swarm of monsters receded like a tide.
Han Xing and the others, trapped in the blood-colored bubble, could only watch helplessly as they departed.
As the countless monster swarm dispersed.
The space before them turned into an empty expanse.
Only leaving behind a square Blood Pool tens of thousands of square meters in size.
On top of it, blood bubbles continued to gurgle up.
Shen Yun looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, is this the altar that the system mentioned?"
Han Xing nodded.
In front of him, the related attributes of this thing appeared.
[Evil God Altar]: Alternate Space Building.
[Defense Value]: 100000

[Attributes]: Can summon 100 Blood Tide monsters from the alternate space per second, with an Elite Monster appearance probability of 0.5%, Leader Monster appearance probability of 0.05%, and Lord-level creature appearance probability of 0.005%.
When the number of monsters summoned by the altar reaches 100 million, it can summon a minion of the Evil God (Dominator-level creature).

It includes all creatures within the entire territory!
"Kill!"
Someone let out a soft shout.
All the shield warriors took a step forward in unison, bravely withstanding the impact of the Blood Tide monsters!
Meanwhile.
On the other fourteen sky islands.
Lord giants, each fifty meters tall, also appeared.
At this moment, those large group leaders also began to contribute their battle merits.
Although compared to the warriors of the Huayi Alliance, these people were somewhat mixed in quality.
However, with the advantage of numbers and the boost from the lord-level puppets.
They still managed to successfully fend off the overwhelming blood tide assaults.
When those monsters were ready to fly into the air for a raid.
The crowd would immediately launch spinning blades, bringing them down from the sky.
At the same time, the catapults and arrow towers on the territory kept unleashing their firepower without pause.
These large group leaders, seeing the ever-increasing battle merits every moment, showed joy in their eyes.

Just in a few minutes, I’ve gained over eighty thousand battle merits!" said a survivor named Long Yuan.
"I gained ninety thousand battle merits!"
"Me too, how impressive!"
Beside him, Chen Da Chui said with a face full of surprise, "So this is how Brother Xing farms monsters?
This is incredible!"
"At this rate, we might have a chance to surpass him, right?"
However, just as Chen Da Chui finished saying this, he saw everyone looking at him as if he were an idiot.
Long Yuan said helplessly, "What are you thinking, surpassing Star River?
You should take a look at how many battle merits he already has."
Upon hearing this, Chen Da Chui immediately opened the battle merit ranking.
However, when he saw Han Xing’s 110 million battle merits, he was completely stunned.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui wiped his eyes and asked blankly, "If I remember correctly, ten minutes ago, Star River had just reached one hundred million battle merits, right?"
"Ten minutes, ten million battle merits, is this really something a human can do?"
The other several group leaders were equally as shocked as Chen Da Chui.
Even Boundless was a bit at a loss.
Only Zhou Huang was slightly calmer.
He looked at everyone and said softly, "I bet Star River is doing the same thing we are right now."
Everyone was taken aback upon hearing this.
"You mean Star River is targeting the Blood Altar?"
"Impossible, right?
No matter how strong he is, he’s still just one person!"

"Don’t forget, these days, how many bottles of Blood Curse Antidote has Star River sold."
"The resources he possesses far exceed our imagination."
Everyone was shocked beyond words upon hearing this.

Was ready to bombard that Blood Altar.
Suddenly, he saw a familiar figure appear ahead.
The figure was over a thousand meters tall, seemingly made up of various animal organs, covered in blood bubbles.
Han Xing immediately warned, "Be careful, a Dominator-level creature is about to act."
