In the next moment, within a thousand-meter radius around its body, all Blood Tide creatures suddenly transformed their forms.
They all developed a blood-colored bubble on their bodies.
Identical to the one enveloping Han Xing’s island, just smaller.
And the next moment.
The monsters enveloped by bubbles charged forward like madmen in a torrential rage.
Thousands of them, like a suicide squad, pounced on Han Xing’s territory.
Moreover, these monsters enveloped by blood bubbles were also immune to damage.
The attacks from the defense towers were all neutralized by the blood bubbles on them.
Even the Thunderbolt Towers were no exception.
Han Xing frowned.
Seeing he couldn’t stop this group of Blood Tide monsters, Han Xing decided to stop trying.
Just then.
The monsters encircled by bubbles, upon reaching the skies above Han Xing’s territory.
Dove directly into the Minotaur and Wolf Cavalry armies.
The next moment.
The blood bubbles burst.
And the Blood Tide monsters inside exploded into a blood mist.
The blood mist, containing the Curse of the Evil God, contaminated the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
They were now all inflicted with a Blood Curse, showing various signs of infection rapidly.
And this was just the beginning.
More Blood Tide monsters rushed into Han Xing’s territory, launching self-destructive attacks.
Simultaneously, the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry being bombarded saw their Blood Curse layers skyrocketing wildly.
In the blink of an eye, reaching over five layers!
Seeing this, Han Xing hurriedly said, "Spread out quickly!"
Below, the Minotaurs and Wolf Cavalry, with strong combat awareness.
Did not require Han Xing’s reminder, and had already begun to disperse their formations.
At the same time.
Han Xing frowned.
Unexpectedly, this Dominator-level creature was so troublesome.
It hadn’t even officially attacked yet, and casualties were already appearing in his territory.
At this moment, the Dominator-level creature, seeing its tactic working, was about to launch a second wave of attacks.
But then it noticed the abnormal actions of the blood-cursed Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
Before the monsters’ eyes.
They took out a bottle of blood-red potion from their belts or under their leather pants.
Then, drank it down.
In the next moment, these Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs regained their combat power and became even more ferocious.
This scene left the Dominator-level creature dumbfounded.
What the hell?
There’s such a move?
Give these summoned creatures medicine?
Han Xing was a bit angry at this moment.
Just this wave.
At least five thousand bottles of Blood Curse Potion were consumed.
Converted into Spirit Cores, that’s nearly a billion in value.
Compared to summoning one Wolf Cavalry and Minotaur, which only requires a few thousand Spirit Cores.
This is clearly not a cost-effective deal.
But after all, Han Xing is a normal person with flesh and blood.
He couldn’t bear to see these summoned creatures dying in front of him.
Some things can’t be measured by value.
Now, Han Xing could only vent his anger on this Dominator-level monster.
"Damn it, you’re throwing shit at me, huh?"
"Just you wait!"
Han Xing waved his big hand.
At the next moment.
Over a thousand golden, ten-meter-high Metal Giants descended from the sky!
Consuming ten million Battle Merit, Han Xing directly exchanged for a thousand Leader-level Golden Armor Puppets!
Puppet creatures not only have extraordinary combat strength, but they also have one crucial characteristic.
They are immune to the Blood Curse!
The next moment.
When more Blood Tide kamikaze troops came charging in.
The thousand Golden Armor Puppets leaped up.
They extended their arms and actively embraced clusters of blood-colored bubbles.
Pop!
Pop!
With the sound of bubbles bursting.
The second wave of Blood Tide kamikaze troops’ offensive was directly dismantled.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy.
"Now it’s my turn!
Han Xing invested twenty thousand Spirit Cores.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 187: Extra Reward: Hellfire Missile Silo
paragraphs: When they saw the attributes of this thing, everyone was stunned for a moment.
Then, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Oh my, the troop spawning speed of this altar is terrifying!"
"A hundred per second, that’s more than eight million a day!"
"No wonder the system says we should destroy the altar as soon as possible..."
"If we let it continue summoning, the consequences would be unimaginable!"
Everyone nodded in deep agreement.
At this moment, for some unknown reason.
This Evil God Altar had already stopped summoning Blood Tide Monsters.
Han Xing didn’t want to delve too deep into it.
Now that the Blood Tide Monsters were gone, there was nothing obstructing them.
This meant that he could attack the altar at any time!
Han Xing wasted no time.
The next moment, he directly activated over a hundred Thunderbolt Towers and a thousand Flamethrower Catapults to bombard it.
Dazzling pillars of light burst out instantly.
Rumble!
The entire Blood Pool was covered by a sea of plasma.
Crack! Crack crack!
Dense cracks appeared on the surface of the altar.
Then, as the catapult projectiles exploded.
A towering mushroom cloud rose up.
"Boom!"
With a crisp burst sound.
Everyone witnessed the Blood Pool that had transported billions of monsters collapsing into pieces.
At this moment, the system notification appeared.
"Successfully destroyed Blood Altar*1, gained Battle Merit*100000, gained Sacred Artifact Fragment*10."
"Since you are the first Survivor to destroy a Blood Pool, you receive an extra reward: Sacred Artifact Fragment*100, Hellfire Missile Silo blueprint*1."
Han Xing was somewhat surprised: "Wow, there’s an extra reward!
"What even is a Hellfire Missile Silo?"
Before Han Xing could check the related attributes.
At that moment.
A system announcement was heard by all humans worldwide.
"Announcement: The first Survivor to destroy a Blood Pool has appeared, due to your excellent performance, all human attributes have increased by 10%."
"Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards counterattacking the Blood Tide."
"Please continue your efforts to destroy more altars and completely eliminate the Blood Curse."
At the same time, when this announcement was heard by billions of Survivors worldwide, they were momentarily stunned.
Then, an uproar ensued!
"Damn! Someone destroyed an altar!"
"Who is it? So fierce!"
Immediately, a Survivor commented: "Do we still need to ask who it is?"
"Currently, among all humanity, who else besides the Star God has this kind of strength?"
"That’s right, if you look at the current Battle Merit leaderboard, the Star God’s cumulative merits are already at 130 million, it has to be him!"
With this reminder.
Billions of Survivors reacted as well.
And then, their eyes showed a look of shock.
Because, just in the morning.
They saw Han Xing’s Battle Merit was only 92 million.
In less than an hour.
His merits had already become 130 million!
In one hour, it increased by nearly 40 million Battle Merits!
What a terrifying number is this?
At this time, Han Xing suddenly received a different kind of prompt.
"Note: Because you destroyed a Blood Altar, you have been marked by an Otherworldly Evil God."
Seeing this prompt, Han Xing was a bit puzzled: "Evil God Mark? What’s this all about."
With a strange expression, Han Xing opened his status screen.
[Status]: Otherworldly Evil God Mark 1 layer.
Note: A being marked will be hated by the Otherworldly Evil God. When the Evil God is in the same world as you, it will sense your location, and the higher the mark layers, the more it will hate you.
After reading the description of the Evil God Mark, Han Xing interestingly said.
"Damn, these Otherworldly Evil Gods sure hold grudges."
"I just blew up one of your altars, and now I’ve been marked, and will come to kill me later?"
If it were an average person, seeing the effects of this mark would really scare them from attacking the altar again.
After all, the notorious name of the Evil Gods is intimidating.
Even powerhouses like the Giant King and Elf King couldn’t do anything about them.
Being targeted by these beings will put tremendous pressure on one.
Having said that, Han Xing didn’t care.
Not to mention, the mark currently doesn’t affect him.
Even if those Otherworldly Evil Gods want to come after him, that’s something for the future.
Besides, they have to figure out how to descend into this world first.
At this stage, this kind of mark is at most just a threat or a warning.
At this moment, Han Xing opened his backpack again, and a strong joy appeared on his face.
Because he saw another item the system had just rewarded, the Hellfire Missile Silo.
[Hellfire Missile Silo]: Abyss Technology.
[Building Effect]: Every 60 seconds, it channels Abyssal Power to summon a Hellfire to bombard a target area.
The Hellfire, once landed, deals 5000 magic damage to all enemies within an area of 500*500 meters, and stuns all enemies for 1 second.
[Maximum launch range of the Silo]: 50000 meters.
Note: The summoned Hellfire can assist in combat, and dissipates automatically after 30 seconds.
[Hellfire]: Four-Star Elite Creature.
[Level]: lv35.
[Attributes]: Power 834, Agility 756, Spirit 773, Constitution 813.
[Skills]
[Floating]: Hellfire comes with floating power, allowing it to fight in the air.
[Hellish Burning Flame]: Hellfire is endowed with an inextinguishable Hellish Burning Flame, causing nearby creatures within a hundred meters to suffer 100 burn damage per second.
[Blazing Burst]: All attacks of Hellfire come with a flame splash effect, dealing 80% of Attack Power as splash damage to enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 187: Extra Reward: Hellfire Missile Silo_2
paragraphs: After reading the attributes on these blueprints, Han Xing exclaimed.
"Whoa, a fifty-kilometer effective range and five thousand magic damage! It’s like some intercontinental cruise missile!"
"And the summoned Hellfire is actually a four-star elite monster."
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
Han Xing shouted a series of exclamations.
It’s really because the effect of this missile silo is too terrifying.
According to the description, if controlled well,
it can almost achieve ultra-long-distance targeted blasts!
As long as Han Xing builds a few more Hellfire missile silos,
in the future, no matter what enemy he faces,
he can directly unleash a storm of Hellfire, bombing your base from tens of kilometers away.
Even if one wave doesn’t kill,
there’ll be several four-star elite Hellfires waiting at your fountain to finish the job, just asking if you’re scared?
Moreover, as the number of missile silos he constructs increases,
the resulting effect will become even more terrifying!
"Great, great, great, this way I have yet another ace and trump card!" Han Xing said excitedly.
Then, Han Xing clapped both his hands and clicked to learn from the blueprint.
At the same time, he eagerly checked the construction materials needed for the Hellfire missile silo.
[Materials needed to build Hellfire missile silo]: Constant Gold Ingot*10000, Mithril*200,000, Refined Iron*2,000,000, Rare Earth*5,000,000, Abyssal Magic Stone*10000.
Han Xing remarked in surprise: "Wow, the materials needed for building a silo are really somewhat exaggerated..."
"Not to mention the later Abyssal Magic Stone, just these upfront materials will cost at least over 5 billion Spirit Cores."
"No wonder the blueprint’s attributes are so overpowered..."
Han Xing’s expression also showed realization.
Because this isn’t something that could be built at this stage at all.
Most survivors, even after spending one or two years, might not gather enough materials...
Even large teams would need at least one or two months to collect the materials needed for one silo.
Of course, except for himself.
For Han Xing,
although 5 billion is a lot, at his current resource gathering speed, it would only take about half a day.
He checked his material reserves.
Among them, the reserves of Constant Gold Ingot and Mithril were ample, enough to build four silos.
However, for the last Abyssal Magic Stone, Han Xing didn’t have any in reserve.
With a mindset to give it a try, Han Xing opened the trade channel.
After searching the keyword, hundreds of trading information popped up instantly.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
In the trade channel, there really were materials like Abyssal Magic Stones, and quite a few of them!
Over seven hundred consignments, totaling more than twenty-three thousand Abyssal Magic Stones.
If he bought them all, he could build two Hellfire missile silos.
Han Xing looked at the attributes of Abyssal Magic Stone.
[Abyssal Magic Stone]: Special material, can be obtained with low probability from Abyssal Monsters.
"Abyssal Monsters?"
Han Xing’s eyes showed confusion.
"Isn’t the Abyss Realm closed? Where did these people encounter Abyssal Monsters?"
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to remember something.
He took out a special item from his backpack.
[Strong Fragment]: Special material.
[Usage]: Gather 100 fragments to synthesize a Stronger’s Mark, the Stronger’s Mark can be used for ’Abyssal Rift’ challenges.
This material had appeared since the first merging region.
Each time a Cloud Secret Realm is cleared, many Strong Fragments are awarded.
It seems possible to synthesize a Stronger’s Mark, allowing transportation to Abyssal Rift.
As a former battlefield between two realms, naturally, there are many Abyssal Monsters inside.
Han Xing pondered: "It seems someone has used the Stronger’s Mark to enter the Abyssal Rift."
"And these Magic Stones should have been brought back from the Abyssal Rift."
Han Xing’s eyes showed understanding.
Now, he holds a large quantity of Strong Fragments, enough to synthesize 100,000 Stronger’s Marks.
But since entering Sky Island Paradise, continuous events have caused Han Xing to forget about this.
At this moment, Han Xing thought.
"After the Blood Tide incident ends, I could take a look at the Abyssal Rift."
After all, even other survivors could exit easily, the difficulty of the Abyssal Rift might not be too high.
Now, Han Xing was preparing to buy all the Abyssal Magic Stones from the trade channel.
However, the market price for such Magic Stones was a bit high, comparable to Constant Gold Ingots, one Sun Core each.
Just 10,000 Abyssal Magic Stones would require consuming 1 billion Spirit Core resources.
Han Xing knew this was because most survivors had not yet entered the Abyssal Rift, so the output of Abyssal Magic Stones was limited.
After this Blood Tide event ends.
More people will likely venture into the Abyssal Rift.
Then, the price for such Magic Stones should decrease.
But at this stage, Han Xing could only buy them at the current price!
Successful trade prompts kept appearing.
Another over 2 billion Spirit Cores were consumed.
Han Xing managed to gather the materials needed for two Hellfire missile silos.
Then, he arrived at a hill near Xingyu City.
Nearby was the place where he had built the Aurora Aggregator.
It was surrounded by a row of Thorny Shield Walls, even during Blood Tide Monster attacks, none of the Aurora Aggregator suffered any damage.
"This location is pretty good.
"After the silo is built, we’ll set up several rows of Thorny Shield Walls around here."
"By then, the safety here will be greatly enhanced."

The system prompt appeared.
[Consume materials to build Hellfire missile silo*1?]
"Yes."
Massive amounts of materials disappeared.
[Building Hellfire missile silo, Lord’s Mansion speed-up feature activated, remaining time 44 hours and 44 minutes...]
"Forty-plus hours, roughly two days." Han Xing felt that was okay.
After all, for such high-level construction, a longer time is normal.
Then, Han Xing consumed the remaining materials and built the second silo.
On the spot, appeared two vast black cavities occupying over a hundred square meters.
They seemed to connect to another world.
But since it was still under construction, the openings were shrouded in smoke, obscuring view of what’s inside.
Han Xing was filled with anticipation, imagining the scene after the silos were completed.
At this moment, after Han Xing finished building the silos.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong excitedly came over
"Brother Xing, the Blood Tide Monster corpses have all been cleared."
"Now, the entire chat channel is discussing your name."
"They’re calling you the War God of this era, truly formidable!"
Han Xing smiled.
At this time, Shen Yun also asked excitedly, "Brother Xing, I have mapped out the locations of nearby Blood Tide altars and created a map."
"Should we continue to destroy the altars now?"
His face showed excitement and anticipation as he looked at Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, of course."
"But before that, there’s something more important to do."
"More important?" The crowd looked puzzled.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, that’s exchanging for the Sun Treasure Chest!"
Upon hearing the words Sun Treasure Chest, everyone’s pupils contracted instantly.
They suddenly remembered, Han Xing had already accumulated 1 billion battle merits and had well exceeded that.
Now, he could redeem the highest reward in the Battle Merit Store!
Thinking about it, everyone was filled with anticipation.
After all, it’s the Sun Treasure Chest, which has a high chance of containing Divine Artifact level equipment.
It might even be the first Divine Artifact in the entire server!
They watched Han Xing expectantly.
Han Xing chuckled lightly and opened the Battle Merit Store.
Then, he directly clicked to exchange.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 188: Divine Artifact: Armor of Calamity!
paragraphs: Han Xing opened the store and clicked directly on exchange!
System prompt appeared: "Do you want to spend 100 million battle merits to exchange for 1 Sun Treasure Chest?"
"Yes."
"Exchange successful, remaining exchangeable chest quantity: 0."
In the next moment, a chest appeared in front of everyone, entirely dark red with various strange patterns carved on it.
Among those patterns, there was a blood-stained dagger, an ancient magic staff, and various suns, moons, and stars intricately engraved.
The grandeur of this treasure chest could be said to be the most magnificent in history.
Though grandeur doesn’t necessarily mean the contents are better.
However, a plain appearance also doesn’t reflect the prestige of the Sun Treasure Chest.
Han Xing admired, "Good, good, good, I just love these flashy things."
Then he clicked to open it directly.
At the moment the dark red chest was opened.
A pillar of red light shot towards the sky, reaching nearly a hundred thousand meters high, without the slightest pause!
Then, even after reaching a height beyond the naked eye, it didn’t stop.
It seemed this pillar of red light was to continuously break through the universe, connecting to another world.
After observing for a while, Han Xing withdrew his gaze, and then looked down again.
In the Sun Treasure Chest, he saw a branch with green sprouts, a large pile of Rhythm Black Iron, and several black stones.
On top of these materials, there was also armor emitting a ghostly green light, seemingly illusory yet real.
Han Xing collected them all.
System prompt appeared.
[Successfully opened Sun Treasure Chest, obtained Rhythm Black Iron*56, obtained Ancient Spirit Wood*1, obtained Philosopher’s Stone*7, obtained Calamity Armor (Red)*1.]
Red equipment, divine artifact!
And it’s armor!
At this moment, Han Xing and everyone else stared intently at the ghostly green armor.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this equipment appeared.
[Calamity Armor (Red) Lv30, Quality - Divine Artifact, Defense 257~273, Power +100, Constitution +100.]
[Attached Effect]:
[Wind of Calamity]: After wearing the armor, causes all enemies within a 500-meter radius around you to have their healing effects reduced by 30%.
[Shield of Calamity]: Every 60 seconds, generates an Energy Shield with a defense value of 50% of the constitution. After the shield breaks, deals splash damage of constitution*100% to the enemy.
[Evil Talisman]: Legendary Effect, reduces all curses received by 80%.

[Overwhelming Calamity]: Epic Effect, spreads the divine power of the God of Spreading Calamity, reduces the constitution of all creatures within 5000 meters by 50%, reduces healing effects by 100%, effect lasts for 60 seconds, cooldown time is 60 minutes.

[Calamity Incarnation]: Divine-level Effect, when activated, you will gain part of the divine power of the God of Calamity, immunizing and clearing all your own curse effects, and making all your attacks infused with Power of Calamity, effect lasts for 120 seconds, cooldown time is 120 minutes.
Upon seeing this equipment, everyone fell into a protracted silence.
This was their first time seeing equipment at the divine artifact level.
Its formidable attributes, even Han Xing, had only seen twice in his life.
The first time was on the weapon of that Great Demon Monarch.
The attributes of the Calamity Armor, although slightly inferior to the Monarch’s Greatsword.
But it is level 60 equipment.
Moreover, compared to orange armor of the same level, the defense of the Calamity Armor is significantly higher.
Those few effects are also increasingly monstrous.
Especially the last divine-level effect, not only can it immunize all curses, but it can also directly clear them.
During the Blood Tide period, it is undoubtedly a divine artifact.
Even without the Blood Curse Antidote, just with this equipment, Han Xing can ignore the Blood Curse.
He even wanted to equip it on the spot.
However, the required level for this equipment is level 30.
Even Han Xing has just reached level 29.
To equip this Calamity Armor, more time is needed.
Han Xing also regretfully returned the equipment to his backpack.
At this moment, Han Xing began to inspect the other two new materials obtained from the Sun Treasure Chest.
Namely, the Philosopher’s Stone and Ancient Spirit Wood.
[Philosopher’s Stone]: A stone containing great power, one of the main materials for creating divine artifact equipment.
[Ancient Spirit Wood]: Spirit wood left from ancient times, containing potent life force, used to repair the Elf Race’s Holy Tree, the ’World Tree.’
"Wow!"
After reading the introduction of the two items, Han Xing exclaimed again.
The Philosopher’s Stone naturally needs no further explanation, just the phrase ’main material for making divine artifacts’ is enough to show its value.
And the Ancient Spirit Wood afterward shocked Han Xing for a long time.
Because, in all mythologies, the World Tree is a widely known divine tree of utmost significance.
In this world, the World Tree also serves as the Holy Tree of the Elf Race.
But for some reason, it seems there are some issues with the World Tree here.
It needs materials like Ancient Spirit Wood for repairs.
Regardless of the circumstances,
it can be seen that Ancient Spirit Wood is even more precious than the Philosopher’s Stone.
Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh at this time.
Should I say, truly worthy of the Sun Treasure Chest?
Everything that comes out is remarkably significant!
After sighing, there’s some regret.
After all, the Sun Treasure Chest is limited to exchange one.
Otherwise, given my current speed of acquiring battle merits,
perhaps I could directly unlock a whole set of divine artifact equipment!
Han Xing also shook his head with some regret.
However, this does not affect his enthusiasm for continuing to destroy the Evil God Altar.
After all, even if the Sun Treasure Chest cannot be exchanged.
The remaining points can still be used to exchange a large number of Golden Treasure Chests.
At that time, he plans to directly exchange the surplus battle merit for tens of thousands of Golden Treasure Chests.
Which translates to at least tens of thousands of pieces of Golden Equipment!
Even if he can’t use all that Golden Armor, he can still sell it on the trade channel.
At that time, not only can he improve the overall strength of the Human Race.
But he can also harvest a massive amount of resources!
It’s a win-win!
Thinking of this, Han Xing becomes even more enthusiastic.
He can’t wait to destroy more Evil God Altars!
Next, Han Xing opened the map drawn by Shen Yun.
He began to rush forward at speed following the coordinates marked on it.
An hour later.
They quickly found the location of the second Blood Altar.
Like the previous one, there are hundreds of millions of Blood Tide creatures here.
The scale of the monster group is incredibly vast, overwhelming.
However, before the Blood Tide Monsters could react.
Han Xing, as excited as a fly at the sight of a cake, suddenly rushed over.
Rumbling!
The Thunderbolt Tower and Flamethrower Catapult unleashed their firepower wantonly.
All the Blood Tide Monsters they encountered along the way were blasted into ash.
The Blood Tide Monsters died in swathes.
This time, in just less than an hour.
Han Xing had already scattered the Blood Tide Monsters, discarded their helmets and armor, and officially reached the vicinity of the altar.
Forcing the hidden Dominator-level creature inside to take action.
The two sides engaged in a frontal confrontation.
In the end, Han Xing’s side still broke the Dominator-level creature’s methods with a crushing advantage.
Unfortunately, after being heavily injured by Han Xing, the Dominator still opted to flee.
Watching the retreating figures of the monster group, Han Xing felt extremely angry.
He was hoping to snag a first-kill reward for a Dominator-level creature!
But these guys are all so cunning; as soon as they sense something is wrong, they immediately flee.
Moreover, they also took away more than half of the nearby Blood Tide Monsters.
This also robbed Han Xing of the joy of easily farming battle merit.
However, the fierce bombardment in just an hour had increased his battle merit by 30 to 40 million.
Initially, because he exchanged for the Sun Treasure Chest, Han Xing only had one to two million battle merits left.
Now he is wealthy again.
At the same time, on the battle merit leaderboard, Han Xing’s accumulated battle merit has reached 150 million.
However, everyone also noticed that the battle merits of other survivors have also started to rise steadily.
Including Zhou Huang, Boundless, Luo Chan, and others.
The battle merits of these big team leaders skyrocketed like rockets; in just half a day, they almost all increased by hundreds of thousands of battle merits!
Among them, the fastest increase is Boundless.
He has now reached one million accumulated battle merits.
If it weren’t for exchanging for a Lord-level Puppet, Boundless’s battle merits would be enough to exchange for a Bright Moon Treasure Chest now.
Meanwhile.
On the battlefield where Zhou Huang, Boundless, and others are located.
Dozens of large-scale Sky Islands steadfastly hold their ground.
Constantly bombarding invading waves of Blood Tide Monsters.
After five hours of high-intensity combat, below, the faces of those million survivors show a bit of fatigue.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui, the Divine Hall Leader, stood on the shoulder of a Lord Puppet, rallying morale.
"Brothers, hold on!"
"We have already taken out over twenty million Blood Tide Monsters near this altar; just hold on a bit longer, and we can completely wipe out the Blood Tide Monsters here."

"Look at your battle merits, think about the upcoming harvest, if it weren’t for this event organized by Director Zhou, it would be hard for us to have such an opportunity to farm battle merits so much!"
After Chen Da Chui finished speaking.
A crowd of survivors below quickly checked their battle merits during the gap.
At this moment, an Elemental Mage exclaimed: "Damn! I’ve increased by over two thousand battle merits!"
A nearby Hunter also marveled: "Wow, I actually have over a thousand battle merits too."
Compared to Han Xing and those team leaders, a few thousand battle merits may not count for much.
But, not everyone can be like Han Xing and them.
Those ordinary survivors fight all day, occasionally encountering one or two waves of Blood Tide Monsters within their capacity.
Then there is a tough battle.
Often, after a battle, dividing it equally, if someone can get a few hundred battle merits, it’s already good.
The bulk of the battle merits is also taken by their team leaders.
Most survivors, the biggest goal in this battle merit store this time is to save ten thousand battle merits to exchange for a Golden Treasure Chest.
If they can exchange a few more Silver Treasure Chests, it’s a gain.
Therefore, just fighting for a few hours and gaining a few thousand battle merits is already a huge gain for them!

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 189: Elite Hunter Medal
paragraphs: The survivors under Zhou Huang’s command soared in battle merit.
However.
According to the mechanism for obtaining battle merit, only the survivors who delivered the fatal blow would receive the corresponding battle merit reward.
This resulted in the shield knights at the front line receiving the least amount of battle merit.
Those in output professions at the rear garnered more battle merit.
However, after the battle, the leaders would compensate these shield knights accordingly.
At this moment, the dominator-level creatures hidden among the Blood Tide monsters seemed to have realized that this alliance army formed by humans was not weak.
If this trend continued, perhaps they could gradually gnaw away at the Blood Tide monsters nearby.
By then, it would be the only dominator left, and it wouldn’t dare claim it could contend against these millions of survivors.
Thinking of this, the dominator-level creatures also began to take Zhou Huang and the others seriously.
The next moment, after a sharp screech was heard.
The entire Blood Tide army began to tremble continuously.
The next moment, nearly thirty million monsters, along with a dozen lords, rushed toward them simultaneously!
Before the direct collision, everyone already felt the incoming storm of blood.
Even those leaders of large groups couldn’t help but grow tense.
They all looked at the two men on the Sky Island.
There, two men stood, each with outstanding auras but distinctly different styles.
They were Zhou Huang and Boundless.
At this moment, Zhou Huang, with a calm smile, said, "Brother Boundless, the dominator-level creatures inside have made their move."
"According to the original plan, each of us will handle one lord, and the rest will be dealt with by their joint efforts. It shouldn’t be a problem, right?"
After hearing this, Boundless’s face showed no fear, instead revealing a sinister smile.
He licked the corner of his mouth and said with battle intent in his eyes, "Lord-level monsters? Really exciting..."
"I also want to see the limits of this mask!"
At this time, Boundless changed his tone with a provocative meaning and said.
"Zhou Huang, don’t just ask if I have confidence."
"Your deliberately mysterious demeanor makes you hard to understand."
"Don’t tell me your strongest skill lies just in your words?"
Zhou Huang didn’t reply but flicked his right hand.
In his hand, a knight’s longsword radiating a holy glow appeared unknowingly.
Upon closer inspection, this turned out to be a weapon of epic quality!
At the same time, the bead on Zhou Huang’s neck began to burst with brilliant light.
As if a deity governing slaughter and destruction was awakening.
At this moment, Boundless’s pupils constricted.
Because he discovered.
At this moment, Zhou Huang’s aura had completely changed; before him stood not a human, but an ancient fierce beast wrapped in human skin!
"You’re really interesting!"
The next moment.
All the leaders of the large groups drew their weapons,
Chen Da Chui, the leader of the Divine Hall, held up an epic-level Skull Shattering Axe and instantly entered a berserker state.
The leader of Kyushu, Longyuan, summoned a magic staff resembling a piece of black wood in his hand, seemingly infused with powerful dark energy.
Other leaders were also well-equipped, holding at least golden weapons and two or three pieces of golden armor each.
Among them, a green-clad figure was the most eye-catching.
At the moment Luo Chan drew her longsword, an aura exuding elemental yet ethereal charm radiated from her body.
At this time, the survivors below marveled.
"No wonder she’s the Cyan Robed Goddess, her aura alone is enough to make people admire her."
"Indeed, I wonder what kind of man could match her."
In terms of combat power.
These leader-level individuals were the pinnacle of human existence.
With their joint efforts now, even if their opponent was a lord that could bring nightmares to survivors, they were not the least bit afraid!
The next moment, the two sides clashed head-on.
At this time, Han Xing was once again controlling over a hundred Thunderbolt Towers and more than a thousand catapults, fiercely bombarding the altar.
The altar itself had a defense value of 100,000 and could withstand massive damage.
If it were an ordinary survivor team, it would take at least an hour to grind away.
But in Han Xing’s hands, the altar’s defense value flowed like water.
In less than two seconds.
The defense value of 100,000 was reduced to zero.
With an explosion, the altar that had transported over a billion Blood Tide monsters collapsed into fragments.
A system prompt appeared.
[Successfully destroyed the Evil God Altar, received ten Human Race exclusive Sacred Artifact Fragments, and got +1 mark layer of Otherworldly Evil God.]
"Great, another ten fragments accounted for."
Han Xing only focused on the acquisition information of the Sacred Artifact Fragments in the front.
As for the Evil God mark at the back, he completely ignored it.
After this battle, the Sacred Artifact Fragments in Han Xing’s backpack had reached 163 pieces.
This collection speed was quite fast.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong suddenly looked at Han Xing and said, "Brother Xing, have you noticed that the medal on your chest seems to have changed a bit?"
With this reminder, Han Xing also looked down.
He saw that the originally purple special material medal on his chest had somehow turned light gold.
Han Xing exclaimed in surprise, "Oh, is this a Hunter’s Medal upgrade?"
He clicked on the item and quickly checked the attributes of the medal.
[Elite Hunter Medal (Gold)]: Special Equipment, increases all attributes by 10% when worn, dealing an additional 10% damage to Lord-level creatures.
The medal can be upgraded by killing lord-level and higher monsters.
[Medal Upgrade Progress]: 15/100.
Note: Only killing lord monsters of a level not lower than oneself can gain upgrade progress. Next stage of medal, King of the Wilderness Medal (Orange).
"Alright! It really upgraded!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fist.
Compared to the previous purple-grade Hunter’s Medal, the golden-grade medal provides an additional 5% attribute increase.
Moreover, according to the upgrade progress marked on the medal.
Only 85 more lord-level creatures need to be killed to upgrade to the orange-grade medal!
Han Xing felt another surge of joy.
Because this upgrade condition is no difficulty for him at all.
During the Blood Tide outbreak, lord-level monsters are simply too easy to find.
Han Xing whispered to himself, "Fortunately, the upgrade requirements for this medal aren’t too restrictive."
"Even lord monsters killed by territory defense towers contribute to the upgrade progress."
"Thus, it becomes much simpler."
Calculating based on 10 to 20 lord monsters near each altar.
To upgrade the Elite Hunter Medal to the next grade, at most, the lord monsters near ten altars need to be destroyed.
Han Xing contemplated, "Upgrading the medal to orange-grade shouldn’t be difficult."
"It’s just that, I don’t know, after upgrading to orange, can the medal continue to upgrade?"
"If it can, wouldn’t that mean I can directly upgrade it to red?"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He doesn’t yet know the upgrade limit of this medal.
If it truly can be achieved.
Then he would essentially possess the second piece of Divine Artifact equipment in the server, an incredibly rare medal!
Thinking of this, Han Xing became even more excited.
He couldn’t wait to clear out more Blood Tide monsters and altars!
In the next moment.
Xingyu City accelerated rapidly towards the marked location on the map.
An hour later, they found the third Evil God Altar again.
Still following the original battle strategy.
Xingyu City steadily progressed, crushing everything in its path.
After slaughtering millions of Blood Tide monsters and more than a dozen lords.
This Blood Tide army was defeated, leaving in disarray.
Among them, that Dominator-level creature also suffered concentrated fire and fled after being severely wounded by Han Xing.
Watching the Blood Tide army retreat.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim, "Damn, Dominator-level creatures are really hard to kill!"
"So far, I’ve severely injured at least three Dominators, but each time, they manage to escape at the crucial moment."
Dominator-level creatures not only possess exceptional intelligence but also terrifying survival skills.
If they want to flee, Han Xing can’t unleash a full-force attack!
Seeing this, Han Xing could only vent his frustration on the altar.
Rumble!
The third Evil God Altar was destroyed.
The three altars took a total of six hours.
This efficiency cannot be said to be slow; on the contrary, it’s outrageously fast!
Because even Zhou Huang and his group, gathering over a million survivors, mostly Human Race elites.
Their advancement on the first Evil God Altar isn’t even halfway.
Han Xing also hurried to continue destroying more Evil God Altars.
Boom! Boom boom!
Cannon fire and thunder unleashed.
One after another, the Evil God Altars shattered under Han Xing’s concentrated attacks.
Eight more hours passed.
By now, it’s already late at night.
Han Xing maintained his rhythm, destroying four Evil God Altars in eight hours.
Throughout the day, a total of seven altars were destroyed!
At this moment, Han Xing’s face carried satisfaction as he counted today’s gains.
Among them, the monsters killed at the seven altars brought him over four billion battle merits!
Additionally, the number of Sacred Artifact Fragments has reached 224!
Both these items alone are already quite the harvest.
But that’s not all.
Bear in mind, Han Xing has a medal that can be upgraded.
The lord monsters hidden within have significantly increased his medal upgrade progress.
The current upgrade progress has reached: 84/100.
"Great, great, great, tomorrow, I can definitely upgrade the medal to orange-grade!"
"By then, the strength will yet again increase substantially!"
Han Xing thought with anticipation.
Next, just put the newly made Blood Curse Antidotes up for sale today to exchange for a substantial amount of resources.
Today’s goal would then be perfectly accomplished!
Then, Han Xing instantly clicked to consign all 80,000 bottles of Curse of the Evil God Antidote from his backpack.
But to his surprise.
Today’s batch of Blood Curse Antidotes was even more sought after than previous days.
From putting them on sale, in less than five seconds, they were sold out instantly.
At this time, those who didn’t get any started voicing their complaints on the chat channel.
Even Han Xing himself was stunned, couldn’t help but exclaim, "Wow, how fast are these people’s hands?"

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 190: Great Rewards Inspire Yong
paragraphs: However, what he didn’t know was.
Zhou Huang had already arranged a group of ordinary people during the day to monitor the trade channel.
Just waiting for Han Xing to start consignment, so they could seize more Blood Curse Antidotes.
They had gone through a whole day of battle, with more and more Survivors under their command afflicted by the Blood Curse.
At this time, they urgently needed a batch of Antidotes to lift the curse.
Just Zhou Huang’s group alone auctioned over forty thousand bottles of Antidotes.
And this eased their immediate crisis.
At this moment, the alliance that Zhou Huang and his team built had been battling for sixteen hours straight.
After a strategic exchange with the Dominator creature, they finally expelled all the nearby Blood Tide Monsters.
Now, in front of the crowd was only an empty Evil God Altar.
At this moment, nearly a million Survivors were so moved they were almost in tears.
It was too difficult!
In this life, they have never experienced such high-intensity combat.
If it hadn’t been for that Dominator level creature being repelled by the joint effort of all the leaders.
They almost thought they couldn’t keep going.
But ultimately, they won the victory.
At this moment, the leaders also bore relieved smiles, exchanging glances.
A moment later, Zhou Huang looked up at that twisted figure in the air, and said:
"Boundless brother, please."
The crowd also stared dazedly at the figure in the sky.
They seemingly couldn’t believe that Boundless, in the state of combat, would be so crazed.
At this moment, Boundless took down the Stone Gargoyle Mask on his face.
The violent aura around him instantly disappeared.
Zhou Huang’s intention was for Boundless to personally shatter the Evil God Altar.
The Sacred Artifact Fragment obtained would naturally belong to Boundless.
However, no one had any objections.
Because they had already discussed it beforehand.
Every team would take turns smashing an Evil God Altar.
Boundless was not courteous either.
Directly controlling the catapults and other Defense Towers on his territory, focusing fire on the altar.
Rumble...
As the altar crumbled into fragments.
The gloom hanging over these Survivors seemed to have dispersed somewhat.
Since the Blood Curse erupted, every person felt a constant anxiety and uncertainty.
Especially these Survivors who experienced the combat throughout, and felt it even more deeply.
At this moment, Han Xing, after completing the recent Antidote trade, obtained a large amount of resources.
He looked at his warehouse and pondered: "This time, I have gathered about 2.5 billion worth of resources."
"Counting my own resource stockpile, it’s possible to erect six Hellfire Missile Silos all at once."
"But the pity is, I’m now missing a crucial material."
And that is the Abyssal Magic Stone.
Ever since last time, Han Xing cleared out the Abyssal Magic Stones from the trade channel.
Not many consignment messages have appeared since.
It’s due to the ongoing Blood Tide that everyone wasn’t considering exploring the Abyssal Rift.
Then, he posted a purchase message on the consignment channel.
[Consignment Item Info]: Blood Curse Antidote.
[Seller’s Required Item]: Abyssal Magic Stone*3.
[Consignment Person]: Star River.
Seller’s Note: Large-scale acquisition of Abyssal Magic Stones, for every three Abyssal Magic Stones, you can exchange with me for one bottle of Blood Curse Antidote, limited to 20,000 bottles.
Seeing this consignment message, the Survivors were stunned for a moment.
If it were an ordinary person, posting such a purchase message might not attract much attention.
But the difference here is.
The one who posted this message is the currently most popular Star River.
And the item he’s using for trade is the now most scarce Blood Curse Antidote.
For a moment, the chat channel erupted into heated discussion.
"Brothers, the Star God is purchasing Abyssal Magic Stones, if anyone has this material, hurry up and exchange!"
"Abyssal Magic Stone? What’s that thing, it seems quite precious."
"Yeah, I just checked, there seem to be few on the trade channel, and each one costs no less than ten thousand Spirit Cores!"
Upon hearing this number, everyone understood the preciousness of this material.
"Damn, so expensive? Then this material’s definitely rare, right?"

At this moment, a Survivor named Brother Yang said: "I remember, obtaining this thing isn’t too difficult, just take a stroll inside the Abyssal Rift, you’ll likely bring out one or two Abyssal Magic Stones."
After saying this, the chat channel fell silent for a moment.
"Abyssal Rift? Are you referring to the Stronger’s Mark?"
The Survivor named Brother Yang replied: "Yes, I ventured in once with friends before the Blood Tide Burst."
"At that time, I was only fifteen or sixteen levels, and only reached about the seventh layer, but still brought out three Abyssal Magic Stones from there."
With this reminder, those Survivors suddenly realized something.
According to Brother Yang’s description, the Abyssal Rift’s difficulty isn’t high, and if lucky, bringing back one or two Abyssal Magic Stones isn’t hard.
Even if it’s just one, that’s still a profit.
Based on Han Xing’s current purchase price, one Abyssal Magic Stone equals almost 10,000 Spirit Cores in value.
And at the cost of 10,000 Spirit Cores, it would normally take them three to four days to collect!
But now, they just need to try their luck inside the Abyssal Rift.
With good luck, within two or three hours, they might obtain resources that would usually take a week to earn!
At this moment, some Survivors, keenly aware of the changing tides, suddenly realized something.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 190: Great Rewards Inspire Yong
paragraphs: Then, they immediately began to take action.
The chat channel was buzzing with voices.
"Damn, what are you all waiting for, brothers?"
"Those available, hurry and explore the Abyssal Rift. Even if you just get one Abyssal Magic Stone, you’ve hit the jackpot!"
"You’re absolutely right. I’ve already started rushing in, hoping to make a big fortune today."
Besides these people, many others were posting team-up notices.
"Level 21 Shield Knight looking for quality teammates, need some high magic damage Elemental Magic!"
"Level 22 Berserker, weapon is a Purple Battleaxe. Is there any team that needs me?"
"Level 20 Priest..."
At this late night hour, countless Survivors began forming teams and then fearlessly entered the Abyssal Rift.
All to take a chance on bringing back a few Abyssal Magic Stones to exchange with Han Xing for the Blood Curse Antidote.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the content of the Survivors’ chat and smiled.
Because that was his intention all along.
Utilizing his current reputation to draw attention.
Then, making those Survivors recognize the potential profits, prompting them to enter the Abyssal Rift, fearing they’d be too late.
Thus, he essentially had a large batch of helpers collecting materials.
And that is the advantage of being a player.
Though, Han Xing also had to pay a corresponding reward.
However, over these past few days, every time Han Xing sold antidotes, he would keep several thousand bottles for his own use.
The current remaining stock of antidotes in his hand is quite sufficient.
Having done this, Han Xing returned to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
The next day...
As he expected.
Early in the morning, Han Xing found himself overwhelmed by various trading messages.
After a whole night.
Millions, even tens of millions of Survivors fought fiercely through the night, continually exploring the Abyssal Rift.
Thanks to their tireless efforts.
In just under seven hours.
The twenty thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote that Han Xing had additionally consigned were completely sold out.
Even Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
"Wow, these people are incredibly efficient, aren’t they?"
"Is this what they mean by ’with great rewards, bravery follows’?"
What Han Xing didn’t know was that the appeal of the Blood Curse Antidote was just too immense.
Even the leaders of large groups.
The moment they received the message, they relayed orders to their team members.
Overtime tonight!
Everyone team up and enter the Abyssal Rift, bringing back as many Abyssal Magic Stones as possible!
A hint of joy also appeared on Han Xing’s face.
In one night, he gained an additional sixty thousand Abyssal Magic Stones.
This means he could build six more Hellfire Missile Silos!
Han Xing wasted no time and went to the hill he visited yesterday and clicked on build.
With the consumption of a large amount of materials.
The resources totaling over two billion that he gained yesterday were also all depleted.
However, it was all worth it.
The actual combat power provided by six silos could be even more terrifying than that of sixty Thunderbolt Towers.
The rest of the day.
Han Xing continued operating Xingyu City, continuously fighting, mainly targeting the Evil God Altars.
According to the marked locations on the map, Han Xing cleared them one by one along the way.
He maintained a pace of flattening an altar every two hours.
Every moment, a large amount of Battle Merit and Sacred Artifact Fragments were being credited to his account.
Additionally, at noon, Han Xing received more good news.
The Elite Hunter Medal had been upgraded.
It had now become an Orange Level!
Han Xing eagerly checked the attributes of this medal.
[King of the Wilderness Medal (Orange)]: Special equipment, increases all attributes by 15% when equipped, and deals an additional 15% damage to Lord-level creatures.

Includes special effect: Breath of the Wild (when this state is activated, evasion rate increases by 99%, movement speed increases by 99%, Attack Power increases by 99%, effect lasts 10 seconds, cooldown time 24 hours.)
[Medal Upgrade Progress]
Lord-level creatures: 104/10000.
Dominator-level creatures: 0/100.
Legendary creatures: 0/1.
Note: Only defeating monsters not lower than your own level will gain upgrade progress. The next stage of the medal is Bloody Slaughter (Red).
After reading the introduction above, Han Xing was utterly stunned.
The Orange Level medal not only boosted attributes by an additional 5% but also included an extraordinarily powerful new effect!
Breath of the Wild!
Once this state is activated.
The evasion rate directly increases by 99%, combined with the agility from his own equipment.
He could almost be immune to all attacks.
Although it’s only ten seconds.
But within those ten seconds, he’s nearly invincible!
In addition, during this state, speed and attacks increase by almost double.
This newly emerged feature was truly explosively powerful!
Moreover, the most important thing is that this medal can continue upgrading!
"Wow, it really can upgrade to Red Level!"
At that moment, Han Xing felt his breathing become rapid.
With the attributes of an Orange Level medal already so terrifying, if it upgrades to Red Level, what would that be like?
Of course, upgrading to Divine Artifact is an enormously challenging task.
The first condition is to kill ten thousand Lords.
This condition alone could stump 99% of the Survivors.
Even for Han Xing, if it wasn’t for the current Blood Tide, it would take a long, long time.
After all, Lords aren’t like cabbages on the side of the road, readily available for the taking.
Below, there are two more terrifying conditions, to kill a hundred Dominators and one Legend.
Based on Han Xing’s interaction experience with these Dominator-level creatures over the past two days.
Any Dominator-level creature has extremely formidable survival capabilities, making them nearly impossible to kill.
Not only has Han Xing not managed it.
Even Zhou Huang and others, after setting numerous traps and using numerical advantages to besiege it yesterday.
Ultimately, the Dominator still left safely.
Not to mention there are Legendary Creatures.
Therefore, upgrading this medal is no simple task.
Next, Han Xing continued tirelessly, to destroy more Evil God Altars.
With the thundering of Thunderbolt Towers and the barrage of Catapults.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters fell under Han Xing’s bombardment.
Altar after altar of the Evil God collapsed one after another.
[Successfully destroyed the Evil God Altar, you earn Battle Merit * 100,000, obtain Sacred Artifact Fragment * 10.]
[Successfully destroyed...]
At the end of the day.
Han Xing had once more wiped out six Evil God Altars within 14 hours.
Adding in the loot from killing those Ordinary Monsters.
By the end of the day, a total of 100 million battle merits and 10 Sacred Artifact Fragments had been obtained.
This speed can be said to be several times ahead of the Humans’ faction who are also targeting the Evil God Altars.
It’s worth noting that throughout two days of battle, Zhou Huang and the others had only just barely managed to destroy their second altar.
However, after digesting the battle merits gained yesterday, the group leaders allocated them as needed, converting all their battle merits into Silver Treasure Chests.
Even though the increase might be slight.
But given the large base of people.
A small improvement goes a long way.
In fact, they felt that it became somewhat easier to deal with the monsters today.
At this moment, Han Xing continued selling today’s stock of the Blood Curse Antidote.
The eight thousand bottles he sold today were exchanged for other materials.
Whereupon, he funneled these materials into building more Hellfire Missile Silos.
In this way, maintaining balance between income and expenditure.
The next day...
Just as Han Xing woke up early, he received two exciting system notifications!
The Hellfire Missile Silos have been successfully constructed!

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 191: Today Is Another Hopeful Day!
paragraphs: The system prompt appeared.
[Your territory building, the Hellfire Missile Silo, has been completed.]
[Your territory building, the Hellfire Missile Silo, has been completed.]
The first two silos constructed were finally announced as completed after 44 hours.
Han Xing sprang up from his bed like a carp.
Then, he hurried to the hillside.
At this moment, there were eleven areas scattered about, billowing with black smoke.
This was the trump card that Han Xing had spent billions of resources over the past three days to build!
Among them, the black smoke above two areas had already dissipated.
This signified that the silos inside had been successfully constructed!
Having reviewed the attributes of the silos in advance, Han Xing was keenly aware of their terrifying power!
Now, he couldn’t wait to experiment with them.
Then, Han Xing called his teammates over and enthusiastically said, "Brothers, get up and get to work!"
"Today is another day full of hope!"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong were utterly perplexed by Han Xing’s call.
However, they didn’t know that.
Today, Han Xing was planning to use these two Hellfire silos to make a big move!
But as to what exactly, Han Xing didn’t say.
Everyone else maintained a heart full of curiosity and anticipation.
Xingyu City began advancing at full speed.
An hour later.
They reached one of the marked locations on the map once again.
An altar teeming with over a hundred million Blood Tide monsters appeared before them.
Compared to before, they found that this batch of Blood Tide monsters had generally leveled up from 20 to 21, slightly boosting their attributes.
But to Han Xing, the attribute enhancement of these Blood Tide monsters was utterly negligible.
Under the terrifying power of the Thunderbolt Tower and Catapult.
As long as they weren’t level 30 or above, they’d basically die on contact.
Then followed a bombardment almost identical to the previous one.
After an hour-long battle of offense and defense.
Han Xing once again forcefully broke through the Blood Tide monsters’ defenses and rushed toward the Blood Altar.
After a confrontation with the hidden Dominator level creature, he severely wounded it.
The Dominator creature threw a bloody bubble, trapping Han Xing and his team, and chose to flee once more.
It also left behind several million monsters to hold up Han Xing.
At this time, Shen Yun and others, enveloped in the bloody bubble, looked disappointedly in the direction the monster swarm had fled.
Then Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but gripe, "This Dominator level creature is really hard to deal with."
"Unless you cut off its retreat from the start, there’s no way to kill it!"
Yet, Han Xing stared straight at the Dominator creature, as if viewing a prey to be slaughtered.
At the moment the bloody bubble covering the Sky Island dissipated.
The remaining cannon fodder swarmed forward.
Three or four minutes later.
With the bombardment ceasing, over a million left-behind cannon fodder were cleared out.
However, the Blood Tide monster swarm had gotten further and further away.
Cheng Jianyong noticed Han Xing’s somewhat strange expression, initially thinking he’d been frustrated by the Dominator level creature too.
So he approached to comfort him, "It’s okay, Brother Xing, let it run if it ran."
"These guys have too many tricks, it’s really hard to deal with."
"At worst, we’ll clean up all the altars first and then specially deal with these guys later."
"Then, let’s see where they can run to!"
Shen Yun agreed, "That’s right, Brother Xing, don’t take it to heart, everyone knows you’ve done an excellent job."
Yet, Han Xing remained silent, wearing a strange smile as he gazed into the distance.
"Who said I have no way?"
Han Xing suddenly chuckled, "Damn it, so many ran away, today I’ve got to take down one Dominator!
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up.
"Brother Xing, you mean..."
They knew Han Xing wasn’t one to boast lightly.
If he dared say so, it meant he already had a method in mind.
Han Xing silently watched in the direction the Dominator creature fled.
The next moment, he calculated the distance in his mind.
According to the monsters’ movement speed, roughly 2000 kilometers per hour, or 55 meters per second.
After being trapped under the bloody bubble and leaving some cannon fodder to delay.
The Dominator merely gained three or four minutes for escape.
Now, nearly 20 kilometers separated them.
At this distance, if Xingyu City advanced at full speed, they could catch up in a short time.
Previously, Han Xing tried pursuing.
But he found that each time he reached the swarm, the Dominator’s skills seemed to have cooled down.
Then, Han Xing would be trapped again.
In this cycle, a lot of time would be wasted with nothing gained.
But today was different.
Today, both of the territory’s silos were successfully built!
According to the introduction, they have a super long range of 50 kilometers!
No matter how far the Dominator level creature had fled, it was still within the silo’s firepower range!
With a smile, Han Xing said, "These Dominators like to throw crap at us, don’t they?"
"Today, I’ll toss them a couple of hot ones!"
In the bewildered gazes of everyone.
They suddenly felt as if the massive Sky Island beneath them trembled slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 191: Today Is Another Hopeful Day! (Part 2)
paragraphs: In the next moment, they only heard two deafening explosions coming from behind.
Boom!
Boom!
Everyone reflexively turned their heads to look.
They saw near Xingyu City behind them, two meteors engulfed in eerie green flames shooting skyward like rockets!
Just looking at the size of these flaming bodies, they seemed no less than fifty meters tall.
They appeared like meteorites from Hell!
The next moment.
Those two Hellfire meteorites, with thick trails of smoke, fiercely smashed towards the distant horde of monsters with a force of destruction.
The target was precisely the Dominator at the center of the monster horde!
At this time, the Dominator level creature had already escaped over twenty kilometers, feeling a fleeting sense of survival relief.
Yet, before it could revel in its fortune for long.
In the next instant, this Dominator suddenly sensed a gust overhead, a strong sense of crisis suddenly swept over!
The remaining tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters also sensed the danger, simultaneously raising their heads.
Then, they saw.
The sky, originally obscured by their blood-red aura.
Was suddenly forcefully pierced by two masses of eerie green fire.
Those masses of flame descended with terrifying momentum.
Targeting precisely their core area, that Dominator level monster!
The speed of Hellfire was extremely terrifying, carrying an unmatched impact and destructive force!
The 20-kilometer distance was crossed almost instantaneously.
At this moment, the Dominator level creature could foresee.
In its current state, should it face this force directly, it would likely die on the spot!
However, already heavily wounded by Han Xing, dodging at this time was impossible.
Boom!
Two meteorites engulfed in Hellfire crashed down heavily.
In the next moment.
Following a muffled roar.
Two mushroom clouds covering tens of thousands of square meters rose into the sky.
Hum!
The entire monster horde felt swept by an eighteenth-level hurricane.
At least a million Blood Tide Monsters vanished into ashes under this wave of explosions!
The other monsters didn’t fare much better.
The whistling hurricane carrying an astonishing heatwave swept freely through the horde.
Over ten million Blood Tide Monsters were heavily injured or even killed by this wave of impact.
And that Dominator level creature, towering at a thousand meters, was completely enveloped by these two mushroom clouds.
Moments later, when the mushroom clouds dispersed.
A massive silhouette suddenly fell from the thick smoke rising to the sky.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters watched vacantly as their leader fell from the sky as if losing its ability to fly.
At this time, the Dominator level creature seemed stunned by the explosion, suddenly awakening amidst the fall.
It joyfully discovered that it was not dead!
However, before it could rejoice for long,
Two strange creatures, nearly fifty meters tall, floating near its body, engulfed in eerie green flames resembling a Hellfire meteorite structure.
These two creatures were the Hellfire launched through silos!
Four-star Elite Monster!
The next moment.
The two Hellfire creatures swung their truck-head-sized fists heavily down!
Bam! Bam!
Sparks flew.
Each punch from the Hellfire carried a powerful splash damage, and the flaming splashes continued to burn the Dominator monster’s body.
The Dominator level creature was already severely wounded.
Now it was directly pummeled relentlessly in mid-air!
Finally, under the chaotic punches from the two Hellfire creatures.
This Dominator level creature was brutally smashed, its blood spilling across the sky!
Meanwhile, Han Xing also received two system notifications.
[Successfully killed Blood Tide Monster*1031412, obtained Battle Merit: 1145140.]
[Successfully killed Dominator level creature: Evil God’s Lung, obtained Battle Merit*50000, obtained Sacred Artifact Fragment*5.]
A trace of delight appeared at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth.
It was not far from his expectations.
One targeted bombardment from two Hellfire missile silos.
Not only took away the life of over a million Blood Tide Monsters but also finished off the Dominator level creature that was already on the brink of death!
Under that terrifying force.
Han Xing believed as long as that Dominator level creature didn’t have a skill like blood bubble immunity, there was no escape!
At this time, another system notification appeared.
"Attention, as you are the first Survivor in the server to kill a Dominator level creature, you have received the First Kill Bonus: Destruction Rune Blueprint (Golden)."
Han Xing thought: "As expected, killing Dominator level creatures also earns a First Kill Bonus!"
However, unlike the rewards for killing Leaders and Lords before.
This time, the reward wasn’t for a Space Backpack blueprint, but instead, a rune blueprint to enhance equipment attributes.
Han Xing felt a slight disappointment.
Because everyone knew that the attribute added by runes wasn’t much.
Even if enchanting the entire set of equipment, the attributes increased would barely equal the enhancement from just one piece of equipment.
Note, this solely pertains to attributes, excluding other enhancements.
In other words, a mosquito-leg increase.
But still, it’s a blueprint for the First Kill Dominator creature, likely stronger than ordinary runes.
At this moment, Han Xing checked the attributes of this rune with a tentative mindset.
[Destruction Rune (Golden)]: Significantly increases Power and Spirit Attribute, increase range: 25~35.
Note: Golden Rune, each equipment can only be enchanted once.
After reading this rune blueprint, Han Xing’s disappointment vanished, instantly replaced by shock!
Moreover, he inwardly exclaimed, "Holy crap.
Calculating by the minimum attribute increase of 25 points per equipment.
Including everything except the medal, there are the top, bottoms, shoes, wrist guards, helmet, rings*2, necklace*1, backpacks*2.
A total of ten pieces of equipment!
Converting, it’s at least over two hundred points of attribute increase!
Bear in mind, even Orange Weapons only raise main attributes by around 100.
This thing, fully enchanted across all equipment, nearly increases the attributes of a standard level 20 Survivor by 60% and more!
And it adds both Power and Spirit together.
Essentially accommodating the output attributes of all Professions.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim, "I really underestimated you."
"This isn’t a mosquito-leg increase; this is downright elephant-leg enhancement!"
Han Xing eagerly checked the crafting requirements of this rune.
[Materials required for crafting Destruction Rune (Golden)]: Rune Crystal*10000, Spirit Core*10000, Ether*50000.
Compared to an ordinary Chaos Rune, the materials needed for crafting a Destruction Rune were a hundred times more.
However, it’s worth it.
Because the cost-effectiveness of this is simply too high.
The cost is just 30,000 Spirit Core, for the entire set, only 300,000 Spirit Core.
Yet the enhancement gained is more powerful than a piece of Golden Equipment!
This thing, not just 30,000, even 300,000 would have a multitude of people eager to buy!
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, suddenly thinking of another continuous financial strategy.
The key lies in this Destruction Rune.
During the Blood Tide, he could also earn huge profits by selling Blood Curse Antidotes.
But once the Blood Tide crisis is resolved.
At that time, the demand for Blood Antidotes from Survivors would plummet.
This means he loses a source of income.
Now, the appearance of this rune opened up new avenues for him.
Although the profit from runes may not be as terrifying as Blood Curse Antidotes.
Yet Han Xing was content.
Thinking about this, he immediately paused the production of Blood Curse Antidotes and began crafting Destruction Runes.
After all, enchanting all these runes on equipment brings a significant attribute enhancement.
"Do you want to consume materials to craft Destruction Rune (Golden)*100?"
"Yes."
"Crafting Destruction Rune (Golden), remaining crafting time: 11 seconds."
This thing, actually requires 30 seconds to make one.
But was reduced by 50% due to High Level Assembly Line Technology, and further reduced by 4 seconds by Hammer of Curse.
Now, the crafting time has been significantly shortened.
Even if it’s 100 pieces, it only takes 18 minutes.
Han Xing continued his journey while patiently waiting.

sentences.text: In the next moment, they only heard two deafening explosions coming from behind.
Boom!
Boom!
Everyone reflexively turned their heads to look.
They saw near Xingyu City behind them, two meteors engulfed in eerie green flames shooting skyward like rockets!
Just looking at the size of these flaming bodies, they seemed no less than fifty meters tall.
They appeared like meteorites from Hell!
The next moment.
Those two Hellfire meteorites, with thick trails of smoke, fiercely smashed towards the distant horde of monsters with a force of destruction.
The target was precisely the Dominator at the center of the monster horde!
At this time, the Dominator level creature had already escaped over twenty kilometers, feeling a fleeting sense of survival relief.
Yet, before it could revel in its fortune for long.
In the next instant, this Dominator suddenly sensed a gust overhead, a strong sense of crisis suddenly swept over!
The remaining tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters also sensed the danger, simultaneously raising their heads.
Then, they saw.
The sky, originally obscured by their blood-red aura.
Was suddenly forcefully pierced by two masses of eerie green fire.
Those masses of flame descended with terrifying momentum.
Targeting precisely their core area, that Dominator level monster!
The speed of Hellfire was extremely terrifying, carrying an unmatched impact and destructive force!
The 20-kilometer distance was crossed almost instantaneously.
At this moment, the Dominator level creature could foresee.
In its current state, should it face this force directly, it would likely die on the spot!
However, already heavily wounded by Han Xing, dodging at this time was impossible.
Boom!
Two meteorites engulfed in Hellfire crashed down heavily.
In the next moment.
Following a muffled roar.
Two mushroom clouds covering tens of thousands of square meters rose into the sky.
Hum!

At least a million Blood Tide Monsters vanished into ashes under this wave of explosions!
The other monsters didn’t fare much better.
The whistling hurricane carrying an astonishing heatwave swept freely through the horde.
Over ten million Blood Tide Monsters were heavily injured or even killed by this wave of impact.
And that Dominator level creature, towering at a thousand meters, was completely enveloped by these two mushroom clouds.
Moments later, when the mushroom clouds dispersed.
A massive silhouette suddenly fell from the thick smoke rising to the sky.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters watched vacantly as their leader fell from the sky as if losing its ability to fly.

Four-star Elite Monster!

The two Hellfire creatures swung their truck-head-sized fists heavily down!
Bam!
Bam!
Sparks flew.
Each punch from the Hellfire carried a powerful splash damage, and the flaming splashes continued to burn the Dominator monster’s body.
The Dominator level creature was already severely wounded.
Now it was directly pummeled relentlessly in mid-air!
Finally, under the chaotic punches from the two Hellfire creatures.
This Dominator level creature was brutally smashed, its blood spilling across the sky!
