chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 192: Destruction Rune (Gold)
paragraphs: Twenty minutes later.
A hundred Destruction Runes were all crafted.
Han Xing casually checked the attributes of two of the runes.
[Destruction Rune (Golden)]: Power +32, Spirit +35
[Destruction Rune (Golden)]: Power +35, Spirit +30
The attributes of these hundred runes crafted exceeded the average values.
Han Xing knew that this was likely due to his Divine-level Artisan Talent.
Calculating this way, ten runes could increase power or spirit by at least over 300 points.
Converted into attack power, it could even rival the boost from an Orange Weapon!
Indeed, it’s terrifying.
Han Xing immediately decided to distribute this batch of Destruction Runes to enhance everyone’s capabilities.
Upon receiving the trade request, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun realized Han Xing might have acquired something good again.
Shen Yun couldn’t wait and asked, "Brother Xing, what treasure did you get this time?"
Beside him, everyone else also looked expectantly.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Accept the trade, and you’ll know."
"Alright!" The two listened, and swiftly clicked accept.
Then, when they saw ten golden runes on the trade screen, they almost exclaimed simultaneously!
"Wow! Golden runes!"
"Such high power and spirit!"
The surprise on everyone’s faces was barely concealable.
After the trade was completed.
At Han Xing’s signal, everyone was excited, then enchanted all of their equipment with Destruction Runes.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "The effect of these runes is truly terrifying!"
"My current power has reached 1027 points, more than double that of a regular Second-Turned Swordsman!"
Cheng Jianyong was right, runes that increase basic attributes show more substantial improvement at lower levels.
Currently, most Second-Turned Warriors have power values between 400 and 500.
And Cheng Jianyong, because of his top-grade equipment’s bonus, already had much higher attributes than other warriors of the same level.
Now after the rune boost, he’s directly surpassed a thousand, a true crushing in essence!
Besides Cheng Jianyong, everyone else also experienced significant improvements.
Ten runes boosted everyone’s attack power by at least 30%, impressively formidable!
Although runes are consumables and cannot be removed once enchanted on equipment.
But for Han Xing, as long as he spends some time and materials, he can produce as many runes as needed!
Next, Xingyu City continued its progress.
Forty minutes later.
They arrived near an altar.
Then Han Xing continued the methodical assault.
First, steady and solid, killed millions of Blood Tide monsters.
When the monster horde felt challenged, the hidden Dominator emerges, initiating direct confrontation.
Then Han Xing unleashed his full power and severely injured the Dominator Creature.
At this point, typical Dominator-level creatures would consider running away immediately.
If it were before, they couldn’t prevent Dominator-level creatures from fleeing.
But today is different.
Just two hours ago, everyone witnessed Han Xing annihilating that Dominator-level creature.
As the entire Sky Island trembled, two roaring sounds erupted.
Bang! Bang!
When the eerie green flames ascended.
Everyone knew someone was in big trouble.
From twenty kilometers away.
They saw from a distance.
Ahead, two massive mushroom clouds rose.
After the horrifying blast.
Over a million Blood Tide monsters perished in this wave of bombardment.
Including the Dominator-level creature, severely injured as well.
Then it was boxed to death by two Hellfires.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed Dominator-level creature: Evil God’s Stomach, gained Battle Merit *50000, obtained Sacred Artifact Fragment *5.]
Han Xing clenched his fist: "Excellent! Another 5 Sacred Artifact Fragments in hand!"
Having the Hellfire Missile Silo equates to having the means to deal with Dominator-level creatures.
Not only does it speed up Han Xing’s collection of Sacred Artifact Fragments, but it also prevents runaway Dominators from threatening other humans.
Han Xing believes that next, he simply needs to wait for more Hellfire Missile Silos to be completed.
Then his speed in cleaning up Evil God Altars will significantly accelerate.
Even as long as the number of Silos is sufficient.
Later, fighting might not even be necessary; a focused attack wave could instantly kill the Dominator within!
Thinking of this, Han Xing was increasingly expectant.
Next, Han Xing demolished four more Evil God Altars in succession.
Harvesting a total of 160 million Battle Merit and over eighty Sacred Artifact Fragments.
Then, by sunset.
The second batch of Hellfire Missile Silos, six in total, were completed simultaneously.
Now, Han Xing’s territory had a total of eight Silos, the firepower intensity dramatically surged!
For dealing with severely injured Dominator-level creatures, Hellfire doesn’t need a second action.
The first wave of bombing can directly take them down.
That day, many survivors witnessed.
The Sky in the Land of the Abandoned Gods could frequently see eerie green flames ascending.
Then, dozens of kilometers away, ignite a tremendous explosion!
Upon seeing the green flames ascent, numerous Blood Tide monsters, without even approaching, shrank in fear!
The third day came to an end.
Han Xing cleared nine Blood Altars in total today.
He accumulated 320 million Battle Merit and 224 Sacred Artifact Fragments.
Thanks to the eight Hellfire Missile Silos on his territory, his clearing speed accelerated significantly!
In Han Xing’s mind, the idea of building more Hellfire Missile Silos has become even stronger!
However, he also knows that the cost of these things is incredibly high.
Even if he uses all the resources obtained from the daily production of over eighty thousand bottles of Blood Curse Antidote to build the silos.
In one day, he could only build four.
This speed is far from meeting Han Xing’s expectations.
He needs more resources to build the silos.
At this time, Han Xing pondered.
"Other than Blood Curse Antidote, is there anything else valuable in my hands?"
The answer is yes.
That is a full 580 million Battle Merit!
These Battle Merits are his biggest harvest in the past few days.
According to a Golden Treasure Chest costing ten thousand Battle Merit, he can now exchange for fifty-eight thousand!
The total value of the items contained within, even if estimated casually, has already surpassed a hundred billion!
These resources are even enough for Han Xing to build hundreds of Hellfire Missile Silos.
The premise is that there are enough Abyssal Magic Stones.
So, Han Xing decides.
To exhaust some of the excess Battle Merit and exchange them all for Golden Treasure Chests.
Then, put all the Golden Equipment opened inside onto the consignment channel to exchange for a large amount of resources.
Thinking of this, Han Xing started immediately!
He spent five billion Points in one go, exchanging for fifty thousand Golden Treasure Chests!
Clang! Clang!
In a flash, the large open space below the Sky Island was filled with dazzling golden light!
It is currently nighttime.
Under the illumination of the Light-Gathering Stone on the territory, it appears incredibly dazzling.
This shocking scene directly stunned all the Survivors on the entire territory.
A full fifty thousand Golden Treasure Chests!
Even if placed side by side, a few thousand square meters of area is needed.
Everyone also gathered around, looking at this dreamy-like scene before them.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong cautiously asked, "Brother...Brother Xing, how come so many Golden Treasure Chests appeared all of a sudden."
"Did you...did you exchange all the excess Battle Merit?"
His tone was somewhat trembling.
Beside him, everyone also nervously looked at Han Xing.
Only to see Han Xing nod with a light laugh and say, "I didn’t exchange everything, just consumed about five billion Battle Merit."
After saying this, Han Xing added a sentence: "I need a lot of resources now."
"Hiss..."
Upon hearing this exaggerated number, everyone collectively took a deep breath.
Even though they have always stayed by Han Xing’s side and seen big scenes.
But nothing like today.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim: "Five billion Battle Merit...that’s fifty thousand Golden Treasure Chests!"
"Even if luck is poor, there are at least forty thousand pieces of Golden Equipment!"
"According to market price, a piece of Level 25 Rare Quality Golden Armor is 2 million, and Legend Quality Golden Armor is over 3 million..."
"Forty thousand pieces of Golden Equipment equals..."
Cheng Jianyong didn’t continue.
Because, after a casual calculation, he came up with an astronomical number!
Exceed one hundred billion!
This number directly left everyone indescribably shocked.
Because even Han Xing, since entering Sky Island Paradise, has never harvested so many resources!
Also worth mentioning, Han Xing has already reached Level 30 today, and can equip that Divine Artifact Level armor.
So, according to the fluctuating equipment level obtained from the chests.
The equipment inside is likely between Level 25~35.
Even so, it surpasses most current Survivors by far.
For this kind of High Level Equipment, it is naturally more welcomed by everyone.
The higher the level, the longer you can wear it, greatly extending the time for equipment upgrade and replacement.
One can imagine, once this batch of equipment appears in the trade channel, how popular it will be!
Speaking of which, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s accumulated Battle Merit are between one to two million.
Barely able to exchange one or two Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
However, they’re still somewhat distant from Sun Treasure Chests.
Because Battle Merit can’t be traded.
Otherwise, Han Xing even wanted to trade one billion Battle Merit to each of them to exchange the Sun Treasure Chests from the shop.
These days, Han Xing has considered other ways to help them quickly farm Battle Merit.
But accordingly, the system has set corresponding restrictions.
For example, Defense Towers can’t be transferred, and building Defense Towers on the territory to help them is not effective.
Leaving Han Xing to give up.
Then, he walked to those thousands of treasure chests and clicked to open them in bulk.
A series of golden lights flashed.
Almost blinding everyone’s eyes!
Han Xing didn’t even look at the things inside, and put them all into the warehouse.
System prompts appeared one after another.
"Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*13, obtained Mithril*54, obtained Armor of Blessing (Gold)*1."
"Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*15, obtained Flame Burst Staff (Gold)*1."
"Obtained Wind Swallow Armor..."
"Obtained Blue Necklace..."
"Obtained..."

"Successfully opened a Golden Treasure Chest, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*15, obtained Flame Burst Staff (Gold)*1."
"Obtained Wind Swallow Armor..."
"Obtained Blue Necklace..."
"Obtained..."

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 193: Golden Equipment Wholesale (Transition)
paragraphs: System prompts kept appearing, among which a large number of golden equipment were embedded.
When the materials from fifty thousand treasure chests vanished.
The smile on Han Xing’s face was almost uncontrollable!
Because he saw in the warehouse, boxes filled to the brim with precious materials!
Hundreds of thousands of permanent gold ingots and millions of mithril!
Apart from golden equipment, the other materials obtained from the treasure chests were not of low value either.
For example, permanent gold ingots are currently priced at 10,000 spirit cores each, and mithril is 1,000 spirit cores a piece.
Out of the fifty thousand treasure chests, a little over 630,000 permanent gold ingots were obtained, equating to materials worth over 63 billion.
In addition, the number of mithril is 3.28 million, carrying a value close to 33 billion.
Just these two main materials alone brought Han Xing over 100 billion in revenue—truly terrifying!
Adding in the other assorted materials, the total value reaches 15 billion!
And this, is just one aspect of this treasure chest haul.
The major highlight remains on those golden equipment.
Han Xing roughly counted them.
Altogether, there were 43,216 pieces of golden equipment.
Among them, the rare quality golden armor counts around 20,000 pieces, while the legendary quality golden armor is over 23,000 pieces.
Just looking at this batch of equipment made Han Xing almost gasp.
At this moment, he couldn’t help but murmur softly.
"This is a real fortune now..."
"If I sell all this equipment, I might just build hundreds of Hellfire missile silos for you!"
"By then, gods and buddhas won’t stand a chance!"
Of course, this is just an ideal scenario.
With limited abyssal magic stones, it’s impossible for Han Xing to build silos without restrictions.
Nonetheless.
A resource worth hundreds of billions.
At least, for the foreseeable future, he won’t be worried about resources!
Han Xing took a deep breath, striving to calm his excited feelings.
Then, he opened the trading channel.
Just like before, there were still many people camped in the trading channel today.
These people have always been waiting for Han Xing’s Blood Curse Antidote to be listed so they could grab it immediately.
When they’re bored, they also joke and chat in the trading channel.
"Guys, did you see the battle merit leaderboard? Director Zhou and Boundless have already caught up, officially surpassing Qing Meng and Clever Little Sheep, taking second and third place."
"Saw it, Director Zhou is invincible!"
"Leader of the Boundaryless is mighty!"
Among them, naturally, there are many survivors from the ’Huayi Alliance’ and ’Kunlun’ teams.
They are all proud of their leaders.
At this point, other survivors said.
"Don’t celebrate too soon, I heard that Qing Meng and Clever Little Sheep are Star God’s friends and so are the other two in the top ten."
"Hmm? Are you talking about Lone Brave and Yun Tianming?"
"Yes."
Everyone paused for a moment.
Many of them knew that Lone Brave and Yun Tianming are Han Xing’s friends.
But Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang weren’t mentioned much.
Now that this person brought it up, they all realized something.
Someone asked: "Do you think Star God will help his friends to dominate the top five on the leaderboard again, like last time?"
However, others shook their heads and said: "Probably not, because this time, apart from the first place, the rewards for the top ten are quite similar.
Hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
Then, as they chatted, the topic turned back to the Blood Curse Antidote.
"By the way, why hasn’t Star God put the Blood Curse Antidote on the market today?"
A survivor named Noah echoed: "Yeah, I’ve been waiting for most of the day, and many brothers in my team urgently need the antidote for treatment."
"Noah, are you sure it’s for your team brothers’ use and not for reselling?"
"Others may not know you, but don’t think we don’t!"
"You’re well-known as a second-hand dealer."
The survivor named Noah, exposed on the spot, chose to keep his mouth shut.
And just then, they suddenly saw that Star River’s name appeared in the consignment channel.
At this moment, the millions of camping survivors all became alert.
When Han Xing posted the consignment information, everyone didn’t clearly see what it was.
Their instinct in their minds drove them to instinctively reach out and click to bid!
Because their experience from the past days told them.
With only tens of thousands of bottles of Blood Curse Antidote available, if they’re just a few seconds late, they’re gone!
However, the next moment, they were dumbfounded.
Because this time, what Han Xing was selling was not the Blood Curse Antidote, but several pieces of golden equipment.
"Eh? What’s going on with Star God today, why not sell antidotes, and instead sell equipment?"
"Yeah, and it’s golden equipment, which seems to have pretty good attributes."
At this time, other survivors also reacted and said.

"Indeed, the attributes are good, and the level is quite high. It seems like Star God opened extra golden equipment from the chests recently; he doesn’t need it, so he’s offering it to us as welfare, right?"
"Welfare?"
The survivors asked in confusion.
"Yeah, didn’t you notice? Star God’s golden equipment doesn’t require you to trade with equipment of the same value; it’s sold at a standard price."
"In other words, if you currently have materials worth two to three million spirit cores, you can directly purchase one."
With this reminder, the survivors realized something.
Indeed!
The golden equipment that appeared in the trading channel before was mostly exchanged for equipment of the same level by the survivors.
Trying to trade those common materials for it is simply a dream!
But today, Han Xing has marked the prices clearly.
Golden equipment of rare quality equals two million spirit cores.
Golden equipment of legendary quality equals three million spirit cores.
And it can be replaced with other materials of the same value.
At this moment, the survivors were also tempted.
They wanted to buy two pieces but found they had already been snatched up.
All ten pieces of golden equipment just put up by Han Xing had been instantly taken.
"Damn! How long have you been single to have such fast hand speed?"
"Seriously, it’s too fast; I haven’t even gathered all the materials!"
The survivors who didn’t get them also shook their heads with some regret.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the ten pieces of transaction information, a smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
Because, this batch of equipment was used by him to test the market reaction.
It seems the response was quite good.
In less than half a minute, ten pieces of golden equipment were gone.
Han Xing received 27 million spirit cores worth of resources.
Thinking about this, Han Xing entered the trading channel and spoke again.
"Good evening, fellow citizens, I am Star River."
Upon seeing this message, the entire chat channel fell silent for a moment.
Because Han Xing, currently the most famous and popular person worldwide, seldom spoke in the announcement channel.
The first time was when he consigned the Blood Curse Antidote.
After that, they hadn’t seen him speak in the trading channel at all.
Now, many survivors’ impressions of Han Xing are cold, taciturn, and powerful.
However, what they didn’t know was that these labels, except for the last one.
The first two don’t apply to Han Xing at all.
He simply finds it troublesome.
Now, seeing Han Xing speak again, the chat channel erupted in a huge wave.
Various messages appeared like a burst.
In just about two seconds, at least over a hundred thousand messages flooded in.
Most were asking when the Blood Potion would be available, while others asked Han Xing if he still had golden equipment.
Han Xing felt somewhat helpless at this time.
Without Zhou Huang’s administrator privileges, he couldn’t silence these survivors.
After waiting for a moment, the chat channel finally quieted down.
Han Xing continued, "Everyone, please don’t get excited, the Blood Curse Antidote will still be sold."
"But before that, I want to sell some other things."
Other survivors asked again.
"Star God, may I ask what things?"
Han Xing replied, "Next, I will list a batch of golden equipment on the trading channel; the quantity is large, and the quality is high."
"As for the price, it’s similar to my previous pricing; you can trade materials of the same value for this batch of golden equipment."
"As for the Blood Curse Antidote you’re all anxious about, it will be back on sale after the golden equipment trade is complete. Please be patient."
After speaking, Han Xing didn’t continue to look at their messages and directly closed the chat box.
However, what he didn’t see was the chat box of the trading channel.
After he finished speaking that paragraph, it began to shake even more crazily again.
Those survivors aren’t fools; they heard a lot of information from Han Xing’s words just now.
"Did I hear wrong? Star God just said he’s going to put up another batch of golden equipment, and the quantity is plentiful?"
"It seems so, and Star God also said, they can be traded with those normal materials!"
"Wow, isn’t this giving us benefits? Is Star God just too rich with golden equipment, burning up inside?"
"What do you mean burning up inside? Did you see Star God’s accumulated battle merits? 730 million, exchanging all for Golden Treasure Chests, the number would scare you!"
This reminder made everyone tense up.
At the same time, they realized the importance of Han Xing’s words.
"Quickly, notify the leader, tell him Star God is about to sell numerous pieces of deluxe golden equipment and they can be exchanged with normal materials!"
"Hurry, get all the brothers up, gather as much resources as possible for me!"
"Old Chen, lend me five million spirit cores!"
At the current stage.
The leaders of large groups have relatively abundant material reserves.
However, golden equipment is very rare.
Not everyone can use their surplus battle merits like Han Xing to exchange for golden equipment.
Even Zhou Huang and others are now making every effort to accumulate millions of battle merits to exchange all the Bright Moon Treasure Chests from the store first.
The upgrade of golden equipment is undoubtedly huge.
Especially those top teams, their demand for this high-level equipment is incredibly strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 194: Massive Resources (Transitional, Skippable)
paragraphs: After hearing that Han Xing was preparing to mass sell golden equipment on the trade channel.
The leaders of the great groups all put down what they were doing and eagerly rushed into the trade channel, fearing they might fall behind!
Within a few minutes.
The entire trade channel once again fell into an unprecedented lively scene.
All kinds of information were frantically filling the screen.
Han Xing observed for a few minutes.
Seeing more and more people, a smile emerged at the corner of his mouth.
He softly said, "Almost there, now is the time to act."
Then, Han Xing activated the consignment function and began listing them one by one!
[Consignment Item Information]: Enchanting Staff (Gold)
[Items Required by Seller]: 3 million Spirit Cores or other materials of equivalent value, Abyssal Magic Stones preferred.
[Consigner]: Star River.
Seller’s note: Level 30 Legendary Quality Magic Staff, first come, first served...
[Consignment Item Information]: Dusk Blood Dagger (Gold)
[Consignment Item Information]: Hammer of Justice Punishment (Gold)
As each piece of golden equipment set its conditions and was listed.
The Survivors were surprised to discover that this batch of golden equipment from Star River was not only of high quality but also of high levels.
None of them were below Level 25.
Among them, they even found quite a few Level 35 equipment!
Although this level was still distant for them, it didn’t stop people from planning ahead, preparing for the future.
After all, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
If they missed this chance, where else could they find so many top-notch golden armors that could be traded with ordinary materials!
For a moment, those leaders of the great groups started taking action one by one, frantically grabbing the equipment they could use.
The entire trade channel once again witnessed a grand scene reminiscent of the first sale of Blood Curse Antidote!
It was bustling with excitement.
Other Survivors, whose resources were not enough, were also reaching out to their friends or relatives, desperately gathering supplies.
Just to be able to bid on a piece of golden armor!
However, they found that these people’s hand speed was astonishingly fast.
Usually, as soon as Han Xing listed an item, in less than a second.
They hadn’t even clearly seen the equipment attributes when it already indicated the item was sold out.
At this stage, the demand for top-notch golden armor among Survivors was simply overwhelming.
"Damn it, how can these people be so fast? Are they bidding with their eyes closed?"
"I also think these guys are just bidding randomly! When they can’t use what they bought, it’ll be a joke if it ends up stuck in their hands."
However, this person’s words did not gain the crowd’s approval.
At that moment, someone shouted.
"Brothers, don’t just focus on the equipment you can use, even if you bid on other items, it’s a guaranteed profit!"
"Once Star River God finishes selling this batch of equipment, we can completely take the equipment we bid on and exchange it for the equivalent equipment we can use."
"Even if there’s nothing for personal use, it can be used to trade for other materials, turning a profit again!"
With this person’s reminder, the chat channel was filled with billions of Survivors, and suddenly their eyes lit up!
Because, what this person said made a lot of sense.
Even if the equipment they bid on wasn’t usable, throwing it back into the trade channel could still guarantee a huge profit!
Only then did they understand why those people were bidding so eagerly.
There was no consideration of making a loss at all!
Meanwhile, those merchants or leaders of great groups who were frantically sweeping goods had a change of expression.
Their plan was exposed, more and more people joined in the bidding.
With this, they couldn’t make a profit by buying up a large amount of golden armor.
The competitive pressure increased significantly.
At the same time, Han Xing’s side was also swarmed with various trade messages.
"Trade successful, you lost Aura Chain (Gold), you gained 1.78 million Spirit Cores, 23 Permanent Gold Ingots, Mithril..."
"Trade successful, you lost Dragon Slayer Ring (Gold), you gained 1.32 million Spirit Cores, 13 Abyssal Magic Stones, Permanent Gold Ingot..."
Due to the fact that equipment items could only be consigned one by one.
Han Xing was also swiftly going through the equipment information, setting different prices according to the level, quality, and part of the equipment.
Generally between 2 million and 4.5 million.
But even so, within a second of Han Xing listing it, it would still be immediately bought.
Every second, millions of resources were being accounted for.
Now, Han Xing’s speed of resource acquisition depended on how quickly he could list items.
Later, Han Xing almost lost the patience to carefully check the attributes of each piece.
He would glance at the quality and level of the equipment and directly set the price and list it.
From listing one piece of golden armor per second initially, he went to listing two or three pieces per second later.
However, despite this.
To sell off the entire batch of equipment in the warehouse would still require a substantial amount of time.
The bustling scene of the trade channel continued from sunset until the early hours of the morning without stopping.
Han Xing’s fingers, tapping to list items, were starting to tremble a little.
A moment later, he shakily listed the last piece of equipment—the ’Robe of Resistance (Gold)’.
When the system notification of a successful transaction appeared.
Han Xing also breathed a sigh of relief, feeling as if a weight had been lifted off his shoulders.
Over forty-three thousand pieces of golden equipment took Han Xing more than five hours to completely trade!
This time, Han Xing looked at the underground warehouse beneath his Lord’s Mansion.
It was almost filled with various materials, and his eyes were filled with strong delight.
He hadn’t tallied the value of all these supplies yet.
But there was no doubt, it was terrifying!
According to Han Xing’s initial budget, over 40,000 pieces of golden equipment are roughly equivalent to seven or eight hundred billion in resources.
Note, it’s billions!
If it weren’t for the need to build hellfire missile silos, requiring abyssal magic stones as a key material.
Han Xing could have built one or two hundred on the spot now!
But obviously, things can’t go as smoothly as Han Xing intended.
From this transaction, he received a total of about 120,000 abyssal magic stones.
Just enough to continue building 12 silos.
Counting those already in his territory, altogether there are 23 silos.
This number, Han Xing feels, is still not enough!
What he wants is the firepower to instantly kill the lord, even the dominator level, in one bombardment!
According to Han Xing’s expectations, to instantly kill a dominator in full state, at least 30 hellfire missile silos need to explode simultaneously.
Now, there’s still a gap to this goal.
The main issue is the lack of abyssal magic stones as a material.
After pondering for a moment.
To motivate these Survivors to explore the abyssal rift, Han Xing immediately decided.
To change half of today’s blood curse antidote to only be traded for abyssal magic stones.
Other blood curse antidotes will be traded normally.
Then, he directly clicked to put them up for sale.
At the same time.
The survivors in the trading channel, seeing the consignment information, were also stunned for a moment.
"Look, Star God has changed the trading terms again, it seems he really needs abyssal magic stones."
"Yeah, when Star God sold that batch of golden equipment earlier, he also emphasized the need for magic stones."
"Brothers, what are you waiting for? Hurry and form a team with me to explore the abyssal rift?
"You know, with our strength, even bringing back one abyssal magic stone would be a huge profit!"
The person is right, given the difficulty of an abyssal rift, a normal five-person team would require about two to three hours to explore completely.
If they’re lucky, they can bring back one or two abyssal magic stones, which amounts to an income of 20,000 spirit cores.
If not for Han Xing’s purchase, they wouldn’t have such a good opportunity to make money.
At the same time.
A large number of survivors began fighting through the night, forming teams to explore the abyssal rift.
And this time, the scale is even larger than before.
Even the main material for entering the abyssal rift, strong fragment, thus rose in price.
Seeing the high spirits of the crowd, Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, he returned to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
The next day.
As soon as Han Xing woke up, he saw the information that the 40,000 bottles of blood curse antidote had been sold out.
This means Han Xing has gained another 120,000 abyssal magic stones!
"Great, this way, the number of abyssal magic stones in my hand has reached 250,000 pieces."
"I can pull up another 25 hellfire missile silos at once!"
Han Xing’s eyes sparkled with excitement.
Because this way, he can achieve his goal.
hellfire missile silos, designated explosion.
Their power is absolutely capable of instantly killing dominator-level creatures!
Then, Han Xing couldn’t wait to come to that hillside, preparing to mass-produce hellfire missile silos.
But when Han Xing just arrived, he was a bit dumbfounded.
This hillside was already filled with silos and aurora aggregators and other constructions.
Having no other choice, he could only choose another piece of vacant land at the foot of the mountain on the other side of Xingyu City as the new hellfire missile silo base.
Then, Han Xing directly clicked to build.
System prompts appeared one after another.
"Do you want to consume materials... build hellfire missile silo *1?"
"Yes."
After 25 consecutive prompts.
In less than a minute, Han Xing spent tens of billions of resources!
However, he didn’t feel distressed at all.
Because last night’s transactions caused his resource reserves to soar!
hellfire missile silos are just about a tenth of his resources.
Looking at the bustling scene in front of him, Han Xing felt a surge of pride.
"Great, wait another two days for this batch of silos to be completed."
"By then, none of those dominators will be able to escape!"
Han Xing thought confidently.
In the following two days, Han Xing continued to maintain the respective rhythm.
Flattening seven to nine altars during the day.
Harvesting one to two hundred million battle merits, plus 100 to 130 sacred artifact fragments.
Selling the blood curse antidotes made during the night.
Time flew, and two days later...
Today is the nineteenth day since the blood tide officially broke out.
It is also the fifth day of humanity’s official counterattack against the blood tide.
Early in the morning, Han Xing received a string of exciting good news!
Those 25 hellfire missile silos have all been declared completed!
Excited, Han Xing swiftly got out of bed and went to the foot of the mountain below Xingyu City.

All kinds of information were frantically filling the screen.
Han Xing observed for a few minutes.
Seeing more and more people, a smile emerged at the corner of his mouth.
He softly said, "Almost there, now is the time to act."
Then, Han Xing activated the consignment function and began listing them one by one!
[Consignment Item Information]: Enchanting Staff (Gold)
[Items Required by Seller]: 3 million Spirit Cores or other materials of equivalent value, Abyssal Magic Stones preferred.
[Consigner]: Star River.
Seller’s note: Level 30 Legendary Quality Magic Staff, first come, first served...
[Consignment Item Information]: Dusk Blood Dagger (Gold)
[Consignment Item Information]: Hammer of Justice Punishment (Gold)
As each piece of golden equipment set its conditions and was listed.
The Survivors were surprised to discover that this batch of golden equipment from Star River was not only of high quality but also of high levels.
None of them were below Level 25.
Among them, they even found quite a few Level 35 equipment!
Although this level was still distant for them, it didn’t stop people from planning ahead, preparing for the future.
After all, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
If they missed this chance, where else could they find so many top-notch golden armors that could be traded with ordinary materials!
For a moment, those leaders of the great groups started taking action one by one, frantically grabbing the equipment they could use.
The entire trade channel once again witnessed a grand scene reminiscent of the first sale of Blood Curse Antidote!
It was bustling with excitement.
Other Survivors, whose resources were not enough, were also reaching out to their friends or relatives, desperately gathering supplies.
Just to be able to bid on a piece of golden armor!
However, they found that these people’s hand speed was astonishingly fast.
Usually, as soon as Han Xing listed an item, in less than a second.
They hadn’t even clearly seen the equipment attributes when it already indicated the item was sold out.
At this stage, the demand for top-notch golden armor among Survivors was simply overwhelming.
"Damn it, how can these people be so fast?
Are they bidding with their eyes closed?"
"I also think these guys are just bidding randomly!
When they can’t use what they bought, it’ll be a joke if it ends up stuck in their hands."
However, this person’s words did not gain the crowd’s approval.
At that moment, someone shouted.
"Brothers, don’t just focus on the equipment you can use, even if you bid on other items, it’s a guaranteed profit!"
"Once Star River God finishes selling this batch of equipment, we can completely take the equipment we bid on and exchange it for the equivalent equipment we can use."
"Even if there’s nothing for personal use, it can be used to trade for other materials, turning a profit again!"
With this person’s reminder, the chat channel was filled with billions of Survivors, and suddenly their eyes lit up!
Because, what this person said made a lot of sense.
Even if the equipment they bid on wasn’t usable, throwing it back into the trade channel could still guarantee a huge profit!
Only then did they understand why those people were bidding so eagerly.
There was no consideration of making a loss at all!
Meanwhile, those merchants or leaders of great groups who were frantically sweeping goods had a change of expression.
Their plan was exposed, more and more people joined in the bidding.
With this, they couldn’t make a profit by buying up a large amount of golden armor.
The competitive pressure increased significantly.
At the same time, Han Xing’s side was also swarmed with various trade messages.
"Trade successful, you lost Aura Chain (Gold), you gained 1.78 million Spirit Cores, 23 Permanent Gold Ingots, Mithril..."
"Trade successful, you lost Dragon Slayer Ring (Gold), you gained 1.32 million Spirit Cores, 13 Abyssal Magic Stones, Permanent Gold Ingot..."
Due to the fact that equipment items could only be consigned one by one.
Han Xing was also swiftly going through the equipment information, setting different prices according to the level, quality, and part of the equipment.
Generally between 2 million and 4.5 million.
But even so, within a second of Han Xing listing it, it would still be immediately bought.
Every second, millions of resources were being accounted for.
Now, Han Xing’s speed of resource acquisition depended on how quickly he could list items.
Later, Han Xing almost lost the patience to carefully check the attributes of each piece.
He would glance at the quality and level of the equipment and directly set the price and list it.
From listing one piece of golden armor per second initially, he went to listing two or three pieces per second later.
However, despite this.
To sell off the entire batch of equipment in the warehouse would still require a substantial amount of time.
The bustling scene of the trade channel continued from sunset until the early hours of the morning without stopping.
Han Xing’s fingers, tapping to list items, were starting to tremble a little.
A moment later, he shakily listed the last piece of equipment—the ’Robe of Resistance (Gold)’.
When the system notification of a successful transaction appeared.
Han Xing also breathed a sigh of relief, feeling as if a weight had been lifted off his shoulders.
Over forty-three thousand pieces of golden equipment took Han Xing more than five hours to completely trade!
This time, Han Xing looked at the underground warehouse beneath his Lord’s Mansion.
It was almost filled with various materials, and his eyes were filled with strong delight.
He hadn’t tallied the value of all these supplies yet.
But there was no doubt, it was terrifying!
According to Han Xing’s initial budget, over 40,000 pieces of golden equipment are roughly equivalent to seven or eight hundred billion in resources.
Note, it’s billions!
If it weren’t for the need to build hellfire missile silos, requiring abyssal magic stones as a key material.
Han Xing could have built one or two hundred on the spot now!
But obviously, things can’t go as smoothly as Han Xing intended.
From this transaction, he received a total of about 120,000 abyssal magic stones.
Just enough to continue building 12 silos.
Counting those already in his territory, altogether there are 23 silos.
This number, Han Xing feels, is still not enough!
What he wants is the firepower to instantly kill the lord, even the dominator level, in one bombardment!
According to Han Xing’s expectations, to instantly kill a dominator in full state, at least 30 hellfire missile silos need to explode simultaneously.
Now, there’s still a gap to this goal.
The main issue is the lack of abyssal magic stones as a material.
After pondering for a moment.
To motivate these Survivors to explore the abyssal rift, Han Xing immediately decided.
To change half of today’s blood curse antidote to only be traded for abyssal magic stones.
Other blood curse antidotes will be traded normally.
Then, he directly clicked to put them up for sale.
At the same time.
The survivors in the trading channel, seeing the consignment information, were also stunned for a moment.
"Look, Star God has changed the trading terms again, it seems he really needs abyssal magic stones."
"Yeah, when Star God sold that batch of golden equipment earlier, he also emphasized the need for magic stones."
"Brothers, what are you waiting for?
Hurry and form a team with me to explore the abyssal rift?
"You know, with our strength, even bringing back one abyssal magic stone would be a huge profit!"
The person is right, given the difficulty of an abyssal rift, a normal five-person team would require about two to three hours to explore completely.
If they’re lucky, they can bring back one or two abyssal magic stones, which amounts to an income of 20,000 spirit cores.
If not for Han Xing’s purchase, they wouldn’t have such a good opportunity to make money.
At the same time.
A large number of survivors began fighting through the night, forming teams to explore the abyssal rift.
And this time, the scale is even larger than before.
Even the main material for entering the abyssal rift, strong fragment, thus rose in price.
Seeing the high spirits of the crowd, Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, he returned to the Lord’s Mansion to rest.
The next day.
As soon as Han Xing woke up, he saw the information that the 40,000 bottles of blood curse antidote had been sold out.
This means Han Xing has gained another 120,000 abyssal magic stones!
"Great, this way, the number of abyssal magic stones in my hand has reached 250,000 pieces."
"I can pull up another 25 hellfire missile silos at once!"
Han Xing’s eyes sparkled with excitement.
Because this way, he can achieve his goal.
hellfire missile silos, designated explosion.
Their power is absolutely capable of instantly killing dominator-level creatures!
Then, Han Xing couldn’t wait to come to that hillside, preparing to mass-produce hellfire missile silos.
But when Han Xing just arrived, he was a bit dumbfounded.
This hillside was already filled with silos and aurora aggregators and other constructions.
Having no other choice, he could only choose another piece of vacant land at the foot of the mountain on the other side of Xingyu City as the new hellfire missile silo base.
Then, Han Xing directly clicked to build.
System prompts appeared one after another.
"Do you want to consume materials... build hellfire missile silo *1?"
"Yes."
After 25 consecutive prompts.
In less than a minute, Han Xing spent tens of billions of resources!
However, he didn’t feel distressed at all.
Because last night’s transactions caused his resource reserves to soar!
hellfire missile silos are just about a tenth of his resources.
Looking at the bustling scene in front of him, Han Xing felt a surge of pride.
"Great, wait another two days for this batch of silos to be completed."
"By then, none of those dominators will be able to escape!"
Han Xing thought confidently.
In the following two days, Han Xing continued to maintain the respective rhythm.
Flattening seven to nine altars during the day.
Harvesting one to two hundred million battle merits, plus 100 to 130 sacred artifact fragments.
Selling the blood curse antidotes made during the night.
Time flew, and two days later...
Today is the nineteenth day since the blood tide officially broke out.
It is also the fifth day of humanity’s official counterattack against the blood tide.
Early in the morning, Han Xing received a string of exciting good news!
Those 25 hellfire missile silos have all been declared completed!
Excited, Han Xing swiftly got out of bed and went to the foot of the mountain below Xingyu City.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 195: Han Xing’s Arrogance! (Transitional, Skippable)
paragraphs: Han Xing had just arrived at the hillside.
Then, he saw at a glance.
That vast area, with as many as 25 wells emitting ghostly green firelight!
Each one containing destructive power!
Now, Han Xing could truly say, the Blood Tide was no longer a concern for him.
At this moment.
He didn’t need to shout, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong and others were already battle-ready.
Because they saw that the 36 Hellfire Missile Silos in the territory had all entered charging state.
Over the past few days, everyone had deeply realized how terrifying its power was.
Any random ball of hellfire falling on one’s head would be devastating damage.
Among everyone present, except for Shen Yun who had the confidence to withstand a wave without dying, the rest would be instantly killed under the hellfire bombardment.
At this moment, Shen Yun proactively reported.
"Brother Xing, the number of altars on the map has been updated in these days, from the original 527 to 614."
"The nearest Blood Altar to us is over nine hundred kilometers away."
"At full speed, it will take about twenty minutes to reach."
Han Xing nodded. He wasn’t surprised about the increasing number of altars.
Because he knew, the number of Blood Altars was definitely far more than 500, just not yet discovered.
As survivors explored over these days, more and more altars were found by people.
As of now.
Han Xing had destroyed a total of 51 Evil God Altars, this number should be considered the highest among humans.
Even the alliance army formed by Zhou Huang and others, only managed to take down 7 altars with difficulty over these five days.
Xingyu City continued to move forward.
An hour later.
A vast and mighty Blood Tide once again appeared in front of everyone.
In two days, the level of Blood Tide Monsters increased slightly, and the number grew larger.
They seemed to know that there are two forces among humans who are targeting their Teleportation Arrays, which are the altars.
For this reason, more and more Blood Tide Monsters gathered near the Blood Altar over these days, strengthening their defensive power.
Which led to the current situation.
Moreover, Han Xing also discovered.
The dozens of Dominator-level creatures that had escaped before were now converging with other monster groups.
In other words.
Originally, near a Blood Altar, there should have been only one Dominator-level boss.
Now, there might be two.
However, for Han Xing now.
One or two Dominator-level creatures was already irrelevant.
Under hellfire’s blast, all beings are equal.
But for Zhou Huang and others, it was more troublesome.
If unlucky, encountering a monster tide with two Dominators.
That would be quite the ordeal.
At this moment.
Shen Yun, Cheng Jianyong, Su Xiaoyang and others stood expectantly in the territory.
They seemed to be looking forward to the next scene as well.
Han Xing was locked onto the Dominator-level creature hidden in the monster tide from several kilometers away.
Through contact over this period.
Han Xing could now judge whether there was a Dominator-level creature inside, as well as its hidden location, through some activity signs of the monster groups.
A few minutes later.
Han Xing finally confirmed that there was only one Dominator-level monster inside.
Hidden in the center of the monster tide, near the Evil God Altar.
At this moment, Han Xing estimated in his mind: "At this distance and with the kill range of hellfire."
"One bombing wave should be enough to cover both the Dominator-level creature and the altar."
"If controlled well, not only can that Dominator be killed instantly, but possibly, even the Evil God Altar can be destroyed together!"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, thinking there’s a chance!
The next moment, he began to correct the direction.
At this moment, everyone was waiting patiently as well.
Ten seconds later.
Han Xing directly clicked launch!
Thirty-six Hellfire Missile Silos emitted dazzling green light simultaneously.
Then, everyone felt a tremor beneath their feet!
This time, the intensity of the shake far exceeded the past!
The entire Sky Island trembled continuously as if struck by a meteorite.
Bang! Bang bang bang bang bang bang!
Explosions resounded in their ears.
The next moment.
balls of Hellfire soared into the sky!
At this moment.
The entire sky was stained with a ghastly green, symbolizing the color of hell.
Fires representing evil and destruction, streaked across the sky trailing smoky tails.
Then with unstoppable might, they slammed toward the crimson sea symbolizing calamity and death!
Rumble!
Meteorite impact!
Heaven and earth shattering!
mushroom clouds rose simultaneously.
Triggering even more terrifying reactions.
The sky seemed torn apart by this violent explosion.
Far away, twenty kilometers watching the battle, everyone suddenly heard a muffled blasting sound.
"Boom!"
Then, a heatwave suddenly swept over them.
Swoosh!
The entire Xingyu City was gently shaken by the hot wind.
Then, they witnessed a scene comparable to an atomic bomb blast.
Horrifying green flames completely obscured the scarlet sky.
A massive mushroom cloud, over ten kilometers in diameter, rose.
As if it were a warning from the demons of the Abyss Realm.
"Scum from the Alternate Space, the Holy Spirit Realm is not a place you can meddle with!"
"Get lost and go back!"
Of course, the Holy Spirit Realm is also not a place for those demons to meddle with either.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun simultaneously ran their hands through their messy hair, mumbling to themselves.
"So... so terrifying!"
"Damn, what level of creature can withstand this level of firepower?"
The next moment, Han Xing heard a few exhilarating system notifications.
[Successfully killed Blood Tide Creatures *10244151, obtained Battle Merit *12412341.]
[Successfully killed Dominator-level Creature: Evil God’s Intestines, obtained Battle Merit *50000, obtained Sacred Artifact Fragment *5.]
[Successfully destroyed Evil God Altar, obtained Battle Merit *100000, obtained Sacred Artifact Fragment *15, Alternate Space Evil God Mark Layers +1.]
The notifications were more astonishing one after another!
This wave of bombardment not only directly wiped out over ten million Blood Tide Creatures,
but also successfully annihilated the Dominator among them, along with destroying the Blood Altar!
One wave achieved all objectives.
Primarily, it’s because the Hellfire Missile Silo’s speed is too fast.
Under pinpoint blasts, the means for the Dominator-level creature to save itself didn’t even have time to be implemented before it faced a direct bombardment.
Although the power of the first wave of bombardment had already dispersed,
for those Blood Tide Creatures, the nightmare was far from over.
When the dust settled,
thirty-six giants, each fifty meters tall and covered in green flames, stood hovering in the air.
Then, these Hellfire Giants plunged into the monster crowd, commencing a grand slaughter!
Hellfire’s attack methods are very direct.
It’s just using punches.
But because they carry a splash effect, every punch delivers area damage.
Their terrifying destructive power is comparable to enhanced Large Fireballs.
Every moment, Han Xing received messages of a huge amount of Battle Merit being credited.
Meanwhile, he also immediately controlled Xingyu City to charge into the monster crowd.
With Hellfire ravaging this group of Blood Tide Creatures,
there’s no way Han Xing wouldn’t lend a hand!
Beating down underdogs is Han Xing’s favorite thing to do.
Before even reaching the scene, Han Xing shouted with a boisterous laugh, "Hahaha, you spawn of the Evil God, I’m coming!"
At this moment, the Dominator-level creature among the Blood Tide Creatures was annihilated, and the altar was also destroyed.
For a moment, the group was leaderless.
Adding to that, with over thirty Hellfire beings slaughtering inside, the monster crowd descended into chaos.
Then, it turned into a one-sided massacre.
A massive number of monsters perished.
Thirty seconds later,
the duration of the Hellfire ended, transforming into clusters of flames, dissipating in mid-air.
However, before these Blood Tide Creatures could fully breathe a sigh of relief,
one minute later,
the cooldown time of the missile silos had ended.
The next moment,
a scene akin to a nuclear explosion reappeared.
Rumbling sounds of explosions echoed.
This time, without Dominator-level creatures absorbing the primary damage,
the death toll among these Blood Tide Creatures skyrocketed to over twenty million.
Among them, even three to four Lord-level creatures were present.
At this point, Han Xing and the others had arrived.
On the Sky Island, hundreds of Thunderbolt Towers wantonly unleashed their power.
These past few days, Han Xing not only constructed Hellfire Missile Silos in large numbers, but other territorial buildings were not neglected either.
Without the constraint of Dominator-level creatures, Han Xing’s Sky Island was like a tiger loose among a wolf pack, starting an unrestrained slaughter!
Each second, hundreds of thousands of monsters were blasted into dust!
The Blood Tide Creatures fled in all directions; as soon as they saw Han Xing’s Sky Island approaching, they didn’t dare resist even for a moment and directly fled!
Even, the others saw fear in the eyes of these monsters.
At this moment, it seemed they were no longer the natural disasters that brought death and terror!
That man... he was the true embodiment of a natural disaster!
For a moment, a vast number of Blood Tide Creatures frantically fled.
However, Han Xing constantly kept an eye on the entire battle situation.
Seeing a large number of monsters leaving their ranks and preparing to flee, he would immediately react.
"Hmm? Trying to run?"
The next moment,
Han Xing directly controlled one of the Hellfire Missile Silos.
And dropped a nuclear bomb right on their heads.
The Blood Tide Creatures were cornered and killed by him.
At this moment, Han Xing was just too arrogant!
He directly abandoned defense, controlling Xingyu City to ram into the densest part of the monster crowd and slaughtered at will!
Xingyu City, unrestrained, rushed madly like a bulldozer.
Everyone watched as one Blood Tide Creature after another was mercilessly rammed into pulp, and then blasted into dust by the firepower from the territory!
Such a bloody and insane scene, yet it made everyone extremely excited.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly said, "Don’t just stand there, quickly cast some Skills to gain experience and Battle Merit!"
After speaking, he was the first to throw a Blast Flame Arrow into the most crowded area of monsters.
Boom!
With one arrow, thousands of Blood Tide Creatures were annihilated, amassing a large amount of Experience Value.
Upon hearing that, the others also immediately reacted.
Various ranged methods were used to greet the monster crowd.
In no time, everyone’s experience soared.
At this moment, Han Xing still felt it was not thrilling enough.
He wore the Armor of Calamity, held the Ice Burial Longbow, wore Phantom Spirit Boots, and bore the King of the Wilderness Medal on his chest.
Four pieces of equipment, the lowest quality among them being Legendary Level, provided him with immense confidence.
Then, he directly approached the edge of the Sky Island and leaped forward!

At this time, Han Xing suddenly said, "Don’t just stand there, quickly cast some Skills to gain experience and Battle Merit!"
After speaking, he was the first to throw a Blast Flame Arrow into the most crowded area of monsters.
Boom!
With one arrow, thousands of Blood Tide Creatures were annihilated, amassing a large amount of Experience Value.
Upon hearing that, the others also immediately reacted.
Various ranged methods were used to greet the monster crowd.
In no time, everyone’s experience soared.
At this moment, Han Xing still felt it was not thrilling enough.
He wore the Armor of Calamity, held the Ice Burial Longbow, wore Phantom Spirit Boots, and bore the King of the Wilderness Medal on his chest.
Four pieces of equipment, the lowest quality among them being Legendary Level, provided him with immense confidence.
Then, he directly approached the edge of the Sky Island and leaped forward!

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 196: Wild Ranger · Master
paragraphs: "Brother Xing? Damn it!!!" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim.
In the incredulous gaze of the crowd, Han Xing jumped off the Sky Island as if courting death.
However, before they could react.
Suddenly, they saw a Big-beaked Bird swiftly sweep past from below.
On its wide back stood a familiar figure, none other than Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with intense War Intent.
Without any pause, he directly controlled the Big-beaked Bird and charged alone into the Blood Tide!
Han Xing’s bold move left everyone on the field stunned.
For a moment, everyone forgot their combat actions.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong murmured, "Brother Xing, this shouldn’t be a problem, right?"
Everyone else also had a lump in their throats, momentarily lost for words.
Though there was a bit of worry in their hearts.
They knew Han Xing was not a reckless person.
If he dared to do this, he must have the confidence to back it up.
However, what they didn’t know.
Was that Han Xing’s Equipment quality had reached an unimaginably strong level.
Coupled with his Level, which completely overwhelmed these Blood Tide Monsters.
With the Lord and Dominator Level monsters slaughtered.
These Ordinary Monsters could no longer pose any threat to him.
At this time, Han Xing transformed into a Sky Knight, standing on its broad back, massacring the Blood Tide monster group.
In less than two minutes, more than ten thousand Blood Tide Monsters fell at his hand.
Meanwhile, the Blood Tide Monsters also noticed this audacious human.
Hundreds of thousands of monsters besieged Han Xing.
However, every time the monster horde pounced, Han Xing would counter with various trump cards.
Extreme Cold Domain, Ice Burial, Breath of the Wild, Overwhelming Calamity, Calamity Incarnation...
A series of terrifying Equipment effects erupted one after another.
In less than three minutes, Han Xing, relying on his own strength, killed over fifty thousand Blood Tide Monsters!
Han Xing, with a delighted smile on his face, said:
"Is this what they call unparalleled mowing? What a thrill!"
"Hahahaha!"
His wild laughter echoed through the entire monster group.
A few minutes later.
In the eyes of the crowd, both excited and worried.
A Big-beaked Bird returned safely from the monster group, upon which stood a blood-soaked human.
It was Han Xing, who had finished the battle.
The reason he returned so quickly was not because he didn’t want to continue killing.
But because Han Xing saw a system prompt.
"Your Experience Value has reached the current Level Limit and can no longer level up, please complete the Profession advancement quest as soon as possible."
Only then did Han Xing realize that he had reached Level 30.
Just like the Second Transformation, he also needed to complete an advancement quest.
The difficulty of this advancement quest was about the same as the Second Transformation, requiring him to solo kill a Leader Monster of the same Level to obtain a Master’s Emblem.
Only then could he complete the Third Transformation.
Currently, the levels of the Blood Tide Monsters weren’t very high, nor was there a Level 30 Leader Monster among them.
Therefore, he decided to finish off this wave of monsters before finding a suitable target.
Then, Xingyu City resumed its bombardment.
The slaughter continued for half an hour.
This time, Han Xing wiped out nearly sixty million Blood Tide Monsters.
What a terrifying number.
Especially since he didn’t let a single Lord Level or above monster escape.
This wave netted him over seventy million Battle Merit, plus 31 Sacred Artifact Fragments.
In Han Xing’s eyes, these monsters were merely Battle Merit, which equated to resources!
The more Blood Tide Monsters killed, the stronger his Xingyu City and personal power would become!
The crowd was also stunned by Han Xing’s terrifying massacre speed.
Then, Han Xing rushed non-stop to the next location.
Continuing with this battle strategy.
Encountering an Evil God Altar.
First a wave of nuclear greetings.
After instantly killing the Dominator Level creatures inside, he rushed in to slaughter at will.
The number of monsters killed increased, and the speed of gaining Battle Merit became terrifying.
Nevertheless, the time it took him to destroy a Blood Altar not only didn’t increase but shortened significantly.
At the end of the day.
Han Xing destroyed a total of 15 Evil God Altars, greatly improving from previous efficiency!
Moreover, most of the time was wasted on traveling.
Otherwise, Han Xing’s efficiency in tearing down Evil God Altars would be even faster!
However, once Han Xing completes the Wild Ranger Third Transformation tonight.
This efficiency will significantly increase.
Because, Han Xing’s Level up means the Sky Island moves faster.
At night, after a day of fighting ended.
Xingyu City was now parked in front of a Sky Island exceeding 100,000 square meters.
This was the target Sky Island Han Xing had chosen.
Inside, there was a group of Cyclops living and thriving.
The leader of this group of Cyclops was a Level 30 Leader Creature.
As soon as Han Xing jumped in, a group of gigantic creatures appeared, looking somewhat similar to humans but with a minimum height of four or five meters.
The most distinctive feature of these creatures was a single eye occupying most of their face!
Seeing Han Xing approach.
This group of Cyclops looked very angry.
"Human, die!"
A few Cyclops shouted, either picking up a tree stump or lifting large boulders, hurling them fiercely at Han Xing!
However, with Han Xing’s current Attributes, these Attacks had no effect whatsoever.
It took five minutes.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 196: Wild Ranger · Master
paragraphs: Han Xing, with the momentum of thunder, cleared the Cyclops in this forest, completing the trial task.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Trial task completed, received task item: Master’s Emblem *1."
"You have met the requirements for career advancement."
"Would you like to advance now as: Wild Ranger (Master)?"
Upon hearing this prompt, Han Xing murmured, "Is the level range from 30 to 40 considered Master?"
"Then what is the range from 40 to 50?"
He knew that the titles above level 50 were Legend and Demigod.
But below level 50, there wasn’t a specific classification.
Thus, Han Xing was curious about these titles.
Then, he directly clicked on advancement.
The next moment.
The entire Sky Island began to tremble slightly.
The breeze blew, and the trees on Sky Island began to sway with the wind.
Han Xing could feel a higher-level power awakening within him!
This power was ancient and vast, like the Power of Heaven and Earth.
Meanwhile, Han Xing noticed.
The attributes section on his personal panel also began to increase rapidly.
Especially the Agility Attribute.
Originally, with equipment bonuses, Han Xing’s Agility Attribute had already reached 714 points.
At this moment, while in an advancement state, it was increasing almost every second!
In just three seconds, it directly broke through a thousand!
And, it only stopped at 1034.
At this point, a system prompt appeared.
"Congratulations, you have successfully advanced to the Third Transformation profession: Wild Ranger (Master)."
"Basic Attributes increased by 100%, learned new Wild Ranger skills: ’Wind Spirit·Fury’, ’Surprise Attack·Break’."
Powerful!
Unprecedented power!
At this moment, Han Xing only felt a familiar yet unfamiliar powerful force surging within him.
He knew that this power was brought by the two newly learned skills, one of them in particular.
[Wind Spirit·Fury]: Passive Skill, all attacks by the Survivor carry the Wind Spirit effect, all damage increased by 30%, upon hit, reduces the enemy’s agility by 30%.
As the first Passive Skill of the Wild Ranger, it was beyond Han Xing’s imagination in strength.
A permanent 30% increase in Attack Power, even comparable to an Orange Weapon’s bonus.
Additionally, hitting an enemy could 100% apply a negative state of agility reduction.
With the Longbow Ice Burial’s special effect, it could achieve unexpected results.
At this time, Han Xing checked the introduction of the other skill.
[Surprise Attack·Break]: Survivor aims at the target, shooting an unavoidable arrow, causing 500% fatal damage to the enemy at a maximum range of: Agility*10 meters.
Cooldown time: 180 seconds.
"So strong!" Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim.
A 500% damage coefficient was already the highest burst skill damage for Han Xing except for ’Broken Moon’.
However, the feature of this skill was not its damage coefficient, but its ultra-long range.
Han Xing’s current Agility Attribute is 1034 points.
With a maximum range of 1034*10 meters, that’s over ten thousand meters of killing distance!
Although it’s still a notch below the Hellfire Missile Silo and Thunderbolt Tower.
But it’s important to know that this skill’s power and range will also increase with Han Xing’s attribute enhancement.
Once completing the Fourth Transformation or even the Fifth Transformation in the future.
Sniping an enemy from a thousand miles away wouldn’t be difficult at all.
Han Xing was very satisfied.
After completing the Third Transformation, not only did his attributes skyrocket.
The two new skills he learned were also very impressive.
Then, Han Xing turned around and merged this Sky Island into his territory.
At this moment, everyone saw Han Xing returning, their eyes brightened.
In Han Xing, they sensed a different change.
A suppression from the depths of the soul emerged.
It was like facing a Lord-level creature.
At this time, Shen Yun smiled and said, "Congratulations, Brother Xing, on the successful advancement."
Han Xing waved his hand and said, "A task that can be completed with ease is nothing to congratulate."
Everyone laughed heartily.
Although Han Xing spoke casually.
They knew that Han Xing’s transformation this time must be terrifying.
Before completing the Second Transformation, Han Xing could already single-handedly challenge Lord Monsters of the same level.
Now after completing the Third Transformation, how powerful could he be?
At this time, Han Xing said, "In the next few days, try to level up as much as possible and advance quickly."
"Best if we can use this Blood Tide to raise our levels to 40."
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Although they knew Han Xing’s words were a bit exaggerated.
After all, everyone on the field now, except for Han Xing, was still between level 28 and 30.
Especially after level 30, each level requires an astronomical amount of Experience Value.
Reaching level 40 is a very distant goal.
However, if everyone could complete the Third Transformation, it would already be a significant enhancement.
At this moment, everyone had a strange feeling.
This Blood Tide outbreak, for all of humanity, was an unimaginable disaster with heavy casualties.
But they found that it did not cause them any losses.
Instead, it brought them a tremendous opportunity.
Not only was the overall strength crazily improving, but Battle Merit was also skyrocketing.
It can be said that among all humanity, no other team benefited more than they did.
Especially Han Xing!
The next day...
As soon as Han Xing woke up, he saw the discussions in the chat channel.
Among the Survivors, someone had spread the news.
Zhou Huang and Boundless were jointly targeting the Evil God Altar.
Moreover, they had succeeded, having already destroyed five altars.
In the process, they gained a large number of resources and Battle Merit, enhancing the strength of the entire team.
On the Battle Merit leaderboard, the skyrocketing Points of Zhou Huang and Boundless were the best evidence.
Now, even the team member with the lowest Battle Merit, Dragon Abyss, had over two million Battle Merit.
Even the regular Survivors in the team gained a lot of benefits from it.
The quality of their equipment was generally a notch higher than other Survivors.
Causing other Survivors to be envious.
The current top ten on the Battle Merit leaderboard.
Besides Han Xing and the four others.
Were Zhou Huang, Boundless, Luo Chan, Chen Da Chui, and Dragon Abyss.
The ten of them exactly occupied the top ten spots.
Everyone was surprised to discover.
These ten were all Survivors from Hua Country!
At this moment, the heads of large groups from other countries were not pleased.
How could you guys, with your thick eyebrows and big eyes, secretly strategize the altar without telling us!
Then, led by ’King’s Game’, ’Angel’s Heartbeat’, and several other prestigious foreign teams.
They jointly formed several colossal forces, each with over a million or even ten million members!
Their target was also the Evil God Altar.
They wanted to gain as much benefit from it as Zhou Huang and the others did.
Of course, these people were not fools and wouldn’t just rush in because of their numbers.
Before doing anything, they needed a detailed plan.
Moreover, before this, Zhou Huang and the others had already summarized a lot of experience.
Thus.
These foreign teams, by spending a lot of resources, bought information from the Survivors under Zhou Huang, about the Blood Tide.
Including how to resist when Lords attack, the skills of Dominator-level creatures, and methods to deal with them.
These materials, in the game, were akin to detailed guides.
Allowing these teams to reduce countless casualties.
While these group leaders were feeling smug about their cleverness.
At this moment, Boundless, standing beside Zhou Huang, said with a strange expression, "Zhou Huang, is fooling idiots fun?"
"Did you spread the news on purpose just to sell this guide for money?"
However, Zhou Huang shook his head and said, "I’m not fooling them. The information I gave is all real and reliable."
"If they follow the steps I provided, step by step, conquering the Evil God Altar won’t be that difficult."
"At that time, the overall strength of humanity increases, which is also a good thing for us."
Boundless, hearing this, said with doubt, "Will you be this kind-hearted?"
Zhou Huang chuckled, "In your eyes, am I such a selfish person?"
Boundless glanced at him but didn’t continue to debate.
