chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 197: Human Race Counteroffensive Operation (Transition)
paragraphs: After the batch of strategies carefully crafted by Zhou Huang flowed into the market.
At this moment.
The leader of the ’King’s Game’, Anderson.
The leader of ’Angel’s Heartbeat’, Megan.
They both looked at the document in their hands, lost in thought.
After a moment, joy appeared on their faces.
Anderson’s figure was burly, his face full of flesh, and he slapped Megan’s petite shoulder.
"Little Megan, inform the Duke of Wild Bull and the Tsar and tell them the intelligence is correct. We can act right now!"
Opposite him, Megan was petite, standing under 120 centimeters tall.
Standing next to Anderson, she seemed like a little girl next to a giant.
She had a look of disgust on her face and flicked her shoulder disdainfully.
"Got it, got it."
"Anderson, next time, if you touch my body without my permission, I will kill you!"
Megan’s tone had no trace of killing intent, but the words coming from her tiny body gave off a chilling feeling.
Opposite, Anderson’s expression froze.
He seemed a bit afraid of this little girl.
Meanwhile.
After Zhou Huang’s strategies spread out.
Large teams formed alliances, actively targeting the Evil God Altars on the map.
Facing the overwhelming monsters, it still made people a bit uneasy.
However, the success stories of Zhou Huang and others showed them hope in defeating the Blood Tide!
Moreover, as everyone’s level and equipment began to steadily improve.
People discovered those overwhelming mutant monsters didn’t seem so terrifying after all.
On this day, tens of billions of human survivors launched a wave of counterattacking the Blood Tide!
Han Xing and others naturally received the relevant information.
At this time, Shen Yun asked in the team channel, "Brother Xing, more and more survivors are discovering the opportunities within the Blood Tide."
"In this way, won’t it also affect your plan?"
Han Xing understood Shen Yun’s meaning.
The current situation seemed that the Blood Tide no longer posed a significant threat to the Human Race.
Removing the Evil God Altar, one by one, and completely resolving the Blood Tide was just a matter of time.
So now, at this moment.
Everyone wanted to extract as much benefit from the Blood Tide as possible.
And the number of altars was limited.
Shen Yun was worried that global survivors would come to deal with the Evil God Altars.
In the end, before Han Xing could gather a million Sacred Artifact Fragments, the Blood Tide would already be over.
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t worry, at their efficiency, if all the world’s survivors together manage to push down more than ten altars a day, that would be fast."
"During this period, we also need to consider not having too many casualties, and the consumption of Curse of the Evil God Antidotes can’t be too great, so this speed will inevitably be slower."
"Before then, we still have plenty of time."
Everyone nodded in realization upon hearing this.
Han Xing indeed had no concerns in this regard.
Because, so far, he had already destroyed more than seventy altars.
In addition, Han Xing always maximized his benefits, never sparing Lord-level and above monsters.
Now, he had 2,132 Sacred Artifact Fragments in his possession.
He was already one-fifth of the way to exchanging for a Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact.
Thus, with Han Xing’s pace, accumulating a million fragments was quite simple.
Next, Han Xing continued maintaining his rhythm, targeting Evil God Altars.
One altar after another was swept through by him.
But this time, Han Xing didn’t deliberately kill those fleeing Ordinary Blood Tide Monsters.
Doing so, while maximizing each altar’s benefits.
Also wasted a lot of time.
This time, the most precious items in the Battle Merit Store had already been exchanged by him.
He now needed to quickly gather a million Sacred Artifact Fragments.
Then exchange for the Human Race exclusive Holy Artifact.
So.
Han Xing adjusted his strategy.
Controlling travel and combat time within an hour.
Now, upon finding an Evil God Altar, he immediately bombarded it with dozens of rounds of Hellfire.
First, eliminating the Dominator inside, then destroying the altar, doing it all in one go.
Then, taking advantage of the monster horde in chaos, finding those Lord-level creatures one by one to annihilate!
After completing these.
The monsters inside were almost wiped out in the tens of millions.
The remaining Blood Tide creatures began to scatter and flee.
At this time, Han Xing would cease pursuit.
Decisively leaving, to find another victim group, repeating the process.
As for those fleeing Blood Tide Monsters, with no Lord-level monster commanding them, they could only run around like headless flies.
During their escape, their ranks kept splitting, turning into small-scale monster tides, wandering the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
And these small-scale monster tides would quickly encounter other survivors.
The two sides engaged in a wave of direct combat.
The survivors were surprised to find this batch of Blood Tide monsters seemed weaker than those previously encountered.
Not only did they fight without any discipline, but they also lacked much attack desire.
Without the command of lord-level creatures, the threat of the monster tide has been reduced to a minimum.
Everyone was astonished.
At this moment, a survivor named Fei Xinliu couldn’t help but sigh: "If all the Blood Tide Monsters were like them, we could earn battle merit just by lying down!"
At this point, several other companions mocked: "What are you thinking, the current Blood Tide Monsters are all concentrated near the Evil God Altar, small-scale monster groups are already scarce."
"If you want to rack up battle merit, you can only join those large alliances."
"Encountering this wave of Blood Tide Monsters, we’re considered to be quite lucky."
However, before their mocking laughter subsided, they saw scattered monster groups everywhere in the distant sky.
At this moment, everyone felt a sudden shortness of breath.
Then, as if seeing treasures, they all rushed towards those Blood Tide Monsters without saying a word.
Meanwhile, on Han Xing’s side.
Because he no longer deliberately kills the surrounding ordinary monsters.
His efficiency in destroying the Evil God Altars has surged.
In one day, he can destroy at least 20 Evil God Altars.
And the survivors near these altars have also gained a large amount of battle merit as a result.
Next, Han Xing maintained this rhythm.

During the day, he frantically slaughtered Blood Tide creatures, and at night he exchanged the gained battle merit for Golden Treasure Chests, then sold various equipment and potions to other survivors.
Every day, he harvested an almost massive amount of resources.
So much so that Han Xing no longer bothers to make a detailed tally.
He only knows that he is now very wealthy, extremely wealthy.
The influx of so much equipment into the market also indirectly enhances the survivors’ power.
The overall strength of the Human Race is constantly rising.
The result is that the efficiency of clearing Evil God Altars has become faster.
Time flew by, and soon ten days passed.
Today marks the twenty-fifth day of the Blood Tide eruption!
After ten days.
The situation for humanity has undergone earth-shattering changes.
First, the vast majority of survivors have completed the Second Transformation.
Including a significant portion of the second batch of survivors who have completed the First Transformation.
Now, even without the protection of those teams, these people already have some self-protective power.
Next is the change in the Blood Tide.
These days.
More and more survivors have spontaneously formed alliances and begun to take action against the Evil God Altars.
With the experience of their predecessors, everyone has been progressing relatively smoothly in dealing with the Evil God Altars.
Every day, dozens of altars are discovered, and a considerable number of altars are destroyed.
Some survivors specifically tally the number of Evil God Altars destroyed each day.
In the end, they came up with a startling figure.
Excluding the altar numbers destroyed by Han Xing, the entire human race combined.
Destroyed 384 Evil God Altars in these ten days!
It has to be said, there is indeed strength in numbers.
This number even exceeds the total amount of altars destroyed by Han Xing.
But keep in mind, they number in the tens of billions.
Even excluding those survivors whose levels are still generally low, the number is at least one to two billion.
It can be said that Han Xing alone accounts for fifty percent of the power of the entire human race.
Of course, during this period, the survivors have not been without losses.
Since the eruption of the Blood Tide.
The total human death toll has already exceeded fifteen billion.
Those who survived the trial of blood and fire are all elites.
Even those survivors who entered this world in the second batch have grown rapidly in just over twenty days.
Today, Han Xing woke up as usual in the Lord’s Mansion.
Compared to ten days ago, his territory, the Sky Island, has once again undergone earth-shattering changes.
First, there is the visible expansion in area.
Now, Han Xing’s Sky Island alone spans nearly twenty square kilometers, with the longest diameter reaching up to six kilometers!
It is truly a mobile war fortress.
On such a massive Sky Island, various new terrains have also appeared.
In the past few days, Han Xing has also taken time to rearrange them.
First, he expanded Xingyu City’s town area by nearly double.
The total number of houses hasn’t increased, simply the streets have been widened by almost double.
He has also reserved a lot of open space in the city center for the construction of new buildings in the future.
Next, he has re-planned and arranged the tens of thousands of Defense Towers on the territory.
He has placed these Defense Towers together according to their type as much as possible.
Now, every so often, you can see rows of colored Arrow Towers.
Ice Arrow Tower Group, Poison Arrow Tower Group, Corrosion Tower Group.
The advantage of doing this is that it can concentrate resources to build more Thorny Shield Walls to protect them.
The disadvantage is that if an attack occurs and the Thorny Shield Wall is destroyed, they could all be taken out at once.
However, Han Xing will not allow such a situation to happen.
Besides these Arrow Towers.
On the hillside, rows of Flamethrower Catapults can be seen from time to time, numbering in the tens of thousands.
Outside the Xingyu City city wall are the most powerful Thunderbolt Towers, numbering about a thousand.

The leader of ’Angel’s Heartbeat’, Megan.
They both looked at the document in their hands, lost in thought.

We can act right now!"
Opposite him, Megan was petite, standing under 120 centimeters tall.
Standing next to Anderson, she seemed like a little girl next to a giant.
She had a look of disgust on her face and flicked her shoulder disdainfully.
"Got it, got it."
"Anderson, next time, if you touch my body without my permission, I will kill you!"
Megan’s tone had no trace of killing intent, but the words coming from her tiny body gave off a chilling feeling.
Opposite, Anderson’s expression froze.
He seemed a bit afraid of this little girl.
Meanwhile.

Large teams formed alliances, actively targeting the Evil God Altars on the map.
Facing the overwhelming monsters, it still made people a bit uneasy.
However, the success stories of Zhou Huang and others showed them hope in defeating the Blood Tide!
Moreover, as everyone’s level and equipment began to steadily improve.
People discovered those overwhelming mutant monsters didn’t seem so terrifying after all.
On this day, tens of billions of human survivors launched a wave of counterattacking the Blood Tide!
Han Xing and others naturally received the relevant information.

The current situation seemed that the Blood Tide no longer posed a significant threat to the Human Race.
Removing the Evil God Altar, one by one, and completely resolving the Blood Tide was just a matter of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 198: [Blood Tide Calamity: Final Phase]
paragraphs: Since the perimeter of the city walls was nearly complete, Han Xing relocated some of the Thunderbolt Towers to within Xingyu City.
Not only could they serve some decorative purpose, but they could also enhance the defense of Xingyu City.
However, Han Xing’s ultimate weapon, the Hellfire Missile Silo, had a different location.
Beside Xingyu City, there was a deep valley.
For the past five days, the valley had been shrouded in a ghastly green flame day and night.
At the bottom of the valley.
There were as many as eighty-five Hellfire Missile Silos emitting a green light.
Ten days ago, with just over thirty Hellfire Missile Silos, Han Xing had made the Blood Tide Monsters suffer a crushing defeat.
Now, with the number more than doubling, in battles, there was little need for him to take any action.
One wave of bombing could easily annihilate tens of millions of monsters.
Apart from these, the number of his territory’s troops also reached a saturation point.
The number of Wolf Cavalry exceeded 300,000.
The Minotaur Army officially broke through 100,000, among which were hidden thousands of Leader and Elite Level Minotaurs.
In the jungle within his territory, 100,000 Big-beaked Birds were also active long-term.
With just these troops alone, Han Xing was confident enough to wipe out Blood Tide Monsters numbering under ten million.
Now, Xingyu City could be truly described as having a strong and powerful military!
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng, Su Xiaoyang, Cheng Jianyong, and Shen Yun were smiling as they looked at him from above the city walls.
Over the past few days, besides the enhancement of the territory.
The overall strength of everyone was also improving.
Now, the entire group had completed the Third Transformation, becoming Master-level Professionals.
They all learned two powerful new skills.
At this moment, Shen Yun approached and reported: "Brother Xing, just as you predicted."
"Now, throughout the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the newly discovered Evil God Altars are becoming increasingly scarce."
"Zhou Huang and Boundless have increased from destroying one altar a day to two altars a day."
"Aside from them, those in the ’King’s Game,’ ’Angel Creed,’ are also not slow."
After hearing Shen Yun’s report, Han Xing nodded.
Now, the Evil God Altars recorded on the map are nearly all gone.
However, he was still some distance from collecting ten thousand Sacred Artifact Fragments.
Han Xing roughly calculated that he had destroyed a total of 311 Evil God Altars, obtaining 9,472 Sacred Artifact Fragments.
According to everyone’s estimation.
The remaining number of Evil God Altars in the Land of the Abandoned Gods does not exceed one hundred.
That means Han Xing still needs to destroy at least 20 altars to accumulate enough Sacred Artifact Fragments.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion: "Why is the exchange condition for this Holy Artifact so stringent, and the fragments are non-tradable."
"Without Brother Xing, I reckon no human could redeem it."
After hearing this, everyone seemed to realize this point and found it somewhat unreasonable.
However, Shen Yun laughed and said: "Isn’t this normal?"
"After all, the Holy Artifact can influence a race’s power."

"If someone as chosen as Brother Xing hadn’t risen powerfully, altering the entire battle situation with unimaginable means, the sacrifices the Human Race would have to endure would increase at least a hundredfold!"
"By then, less than one percent of the Human Race would survive, with severe loss of life force."
"Do you think such a race still deserves to own such a Holy Artifact?"
After hearing this, everyone nodded in sudden realization.
Indeed, Shen Yun’s analysis made sense.
This Blood Tide, without Han Xing, humans might still get through it.
But the number of survivors would probably be less than a hundred million.
Han Xing continued to destroy the Evil God Altars.
However, just as he destroyed today’s third altar.
Everyone heard a different system alert.
Announcement: "All survivors, please note that the number of Evil God Altars has been reduced to below one hundred."
"The arrival plan of the Otherworldly Evil God has been thwarted, and they will send more powerful entities to launch a final assault on the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"The Blood Tide calamity’s final phase has begun!"
"During this phase, all survivors can see the remaining number of altars and the arrival time of the Evil God Commander."
"Please destroy the remaining altars as soon as possible to prevent more Evil God Commanders from descending upon the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
At this moment.
Billions of survivors worldwide shivered in apprehension when they heard the system alert.
Including Han Xing and others, a sense of foreboding arose in their hearts.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, instinctively seeking his decision in moments like these.
At this moment, Han Xing frowned and spoke in a low voice: "So far, Dominator Level monsters have appeared in the Blood Tide."
"And now, the system says even stronger entities will arrive."
"Could it be... Legendary Level?"
Upon hearing the words Legendary Level.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s faces also darkened.
Since entering the Sky Island Paradise, they had only encountered one Legendary Creature.
That was the Shadow Giant Dragon.
However, at that time, the Shadow Giant Dragon was suppressed by the Secret Realm’s rules.
It couldn’t exert even a thousandth of its true power!
And the Legendary Monster descending from the Evil God Altar would have no power restrictions.
It’s important to know that even the most ordinary Legendary is a creature over Level 50.
The appearance of such an entity would be a catastrophe for the entire Human Race!
At this point, Han Xing glanced at his own status bar.
There, over three hundred layers of the Evil God Mark were particularly glaring.
He could imagine how much the Otherworldly Evil God hated him now.
After all, it was he alone who destroyed nearly half of the altars, causing the entire blood tide disaster to suffer a heavy blow!
He also indirectly thwarted the Evil God’s plot.
And if those Legendary Level Evil God Commanders were to descend, the first one they’d come for would probably be him.
At this moment, Han Xing realized that he must destroy all the altars in the shortest time possible.
Otherwise, he would become the first victim!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said solemnly, "Prepare for battle, everyone enters the wartime state now."
"Without my orders, all relatives stay inside Xingyu City and don’t come out!"
"We need to hasten the pace, destroy more Evil God Altars as fast as we can."
"We must not let a single monster from the alternate space descend into this world!"
Everyone could hear the seriousness and a hint of urgency in Han Xing’s words.
The next moment, Xingyu City began accelerating at high speed.
Simultaneously.
In front of all the world’s survivors, two numbers appeared.
[Blood Tide Disaster: Final Phase.]
[Remaining Evil God Altar Count]: 97.
[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 25 hours 32 minutes...
hours!
Evil God Altars!
If they are not cleared within the time limit.
The more remaining Evil God Altars, the more Legendary Level monsters will appear!
At this moment, a strong sense of urgency rose in the hearts of all mankind globally!
Simultaneously, all major alliances, without needing any discussion, immediately launched their actions.
In the face of a major crisis concerning the race, nothing can be put aside as irrelevant.
In the face of disaster, you must do your best!
No, not just do your best, but exhaust everything.
We must destroy all the Evil God Altars in the shortest time!
Otherwise, allowing any Legendary monster to come forth would be catastrophic for all humanity.
The entire human race entered the final battle mode!
At this moment, Han Xing.
Looking at those Defense Towers on his territory, he felt a little uneasy.
After all, Legendary Level creatures are a different tier of life altogether.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, they are already top-level beings!
Therefore, he was not sure if the Defense Towers on his territory could handle the so-called Evil God Commanders.
Next up.
Han Xing entered a frenzied acceleration phase.
He maintained a speed of almost five thousand kilometers per hour, advancing at full speed.
Soon, an Evil God Altar appeared in front of everyone.
At the same time, many monsters also noticed Han Xing and others’ Sky Island, preparing to intercept them.
As everyone drew their weapons, getting ready for battle.
They heard Han Xing shout directly, "Ignore them, go!"
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "What’s going on, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing said, "A real man never looks back at an explosion!"
Cheng Jianyong: "???"
Shen Yun: "???"
Under the shocked gazes of everyone,
volleys of Hellfire suddenly shot out, like a massive meteorite thrown into the sea, kicking up a towering tsunami!
Countless monsters were blasted to ashes by the wave.
Mushroom clouds of a tragic green color rose behind everyone.
Han Xing didn’t look back, directly maneuvering the Sky Island to escape.
In no time, Xingyu City continued racing towards the next target location.
Now, the map that Shen Yun created had all the altars cleared.
They could only confirm the location of nearby altars through the coordinates sent in the chat channel.
At this moment, the chat channel was full of various support information being sent out frantically.
"Coordinates: 41224, 87455, 95221, there’s an Evil God Altar, hurry up!"
The ’Blood Pearl’ team needs support, coordinates..."
"The ’Mountain Cave People’ are arriving soon, hold on!"
At this moment, Han Xing also chose the nearest coordinates based on the information in the chat channel and rushed there madly.
Several minutes later, sure enough, an Evil God Altar appeared in front of everyone.
But now, there was a group of other forces making a move on this Evil God Altar.
A super team formed by dozens of Sky Islands, with more than a million people.
Han Xing could see that the group’s coordination was somewhat disorganized.
Like loosely organized forces that had just come together.
Though they could barely hold back the blood tide monsters, their progress towards the altar was really too slow.
At this moment, from more than thirty kilometers away.
Han Xing watched the Evil God Altar from afar.
Everyone saw the progress of those survivors and couldn’t help but frown.
At their pace, destroying just one altar would take at least a whole day.
With bad luck, they might even fail to destroy it, leading to all efforts being for naught.

"During this phase, all survivors can see the remaining number of altars and the arrival time of the Evil God Commander."
"Please destroy the remaining altars as soon as possible to prevent more Evil God Commanders from descending upon the Land of the Abandoned Gods!"
At this moment.
Billions of survivors worldwide shivered in apprehension when they heard the system alert.
Including Han Xing and others, a sense of foreboding arose in their hearts.
Everyone looked at Han Xing, instinctively seeking his decision in moments like these.
At this moment, Han Xing frowned and spoke in a low voice: "So far, Dominator Level monsters have appeared in the Blood Tide."
"And now, the system says even stronger entities will arrive."
"Could it be...
Legendary Level?"
Upon hearing the words Legendary Level.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s faces also darkened.
Since entering the Sky Island Paradise, they had only encountered one Legendary Creature.
That was the Shadow Giant Dragon.
However, at that time, the Shadow Giant Dragon was suppressed by the Secret Realm’s rules.
It couldn’t exert even a thousandth of its true power!
And the Legendary Monster descending from the Evil God Altar would have no power restrictions.
It’s important to know that even the most ordinary Legendary is a creature over Level 50.
The appearance of such an entity would be a catastrophe for the entire Human Race!
At this point, Han Xing glanced at his own status bar.
There, over three hundred layers of the Evil God Mark were particularly glaring.
He could imagine how much the Otherworldly Evil God hated him now.
After all, it was he alone who destroyed nearly half of the altars, causing the entire blood tide disaster to suffer a heavy blow!
He also indirectly thwarted the Evil God’s plot.
And if those Legendary Level Evil God Commanders were to descend, the first one they’d come for would probably be him.
At this moment, Han Xing realized that he must destroy all the altars in the shortest time possible.
Otherwise, he would become the first victim!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said solemnly, "Prepare for battle, everyone enters the wartime state now."
"Without my orders, all relatives stay inside Xingyu City and don’t come out!"
"We need to hasten the pace, destroy more Evil God Altars as fast as we can."
"We must not let a single monster from the alternate space descend into this world!"
Everyone could hear the seriousness and a hint of urgency in Han Xing’s words.
The next moment, Xingyu City began accelerating at high speed.
Simultaneously.
In front of all the world’s survivors, two numbers appeared.
[Blood Tide Disaster: Final Phase.]
[Remaining Evil God Altar Count]: 97.
[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 25 hours 32 minutes...
hours!
Evil God Altars!
If they are not cleared within the time limit.
The more remaining Evil God Altars, the more Legendary Level monsters will appear!
At this moment, a strong sense of urgency rose in the hearts of all mankind globally!
Simultaneously, all major alliances, without needing any discussion, immediately launched their actions.
In the face of a major crisis concerning the race, nothing can be put aside as irrelevant.
In the face of disaster, you must do your best!
No, not just do your best, but exhaust everything.
We must destroy all the Evil God Altars in the shortest time!
Otherwise, allowing any Legendary monster to come forth would be catastrophic for all humanity.
The entire human race entered the final battle mode!
At this moment, Han Xing.
Looking at those Defense Towers on his territory, he felt a little uneasy.
After all, Legendary Level creatures are a different tier of life altogether.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, they are already top-level beings!
Therefore, he was not sure if the Defense Towers on his territory could handle the so-called Evil God Commanders.
Next up.
Han Xing entered a frenzied acceleration phase.
He maintained a speed of almost five thousand kilometers per hour, advancing at full speed.
Soon, an Evil God Altar appeared in front of everyone.
At the same time, many monsters also noticed Han Xing and others’ Sky Island, preparing to intercept them.
As everyone drew their weapons, getting ready for battle.
They heard Han Xing shout directly, "Ignore them, go!"
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "What’s going on, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing said, "A real man never looks back at an explosion!"
Cheng Jianyong: "???"
Shen Yun: "???"
Under the shocked gazes of everyone,
volleys of Hellfire suddenly shot out, like a massive meteorite thrown into the sea, kicking up a towering tsunami!
Countless monsters were blasted to ashes by the wave.
Mushroom clouds of a tragic green color rose behind everyone.
Han Xing didn’t look back, directly maneuvering the Sky Island to escape.
In no time, Xingyu City continued racing towards the next target location.
Now, the map that Shen Yun created had all the altars cleared.
They could only confirm the location of nearby altars through the coordinates sent in the chat channel.
At this moment, the chat channel was full of various support information being sent out frantically.
"Coordinates: 41224, 87455, 95221, there’s an Evil God Altar, hurry up!"
The ’Blood Pearl’ team needs support, coordinates..."
"The ’Mountain Cave People’ are arriving soon, hold on!"
At this moment, Han Xing also chose the nearest coordinates based on the information in the chat channel and rushed there madly.
Several minutes later, sure enough, an Evil God Altar appeared in front of everyone.
But now, there was a group of other forces making a move on this Evil God Altar.
A super team formed by dozens of Sky Islands, with more than a million people.
Han Xing could see that the group’s coordination was somewhat disorganized.
Like loosely organized forces that had just come together.
Though they could barely hold back the blood tide monsters, their progress towards the altar was really too slow.
At this moment, from more than thirty kilometers away.
Han Xing watched the Evil God Altar from afar.
Everyone saw the progress of those survivors and couldn’t help but frown.
At their pace, destroying just one altar would take at least a whole day.
With bad luck, they might even fail to destroy it, leading to all efforts being for naught.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 199: Clan Extermination Crisis and Race Against Death
paragraphs: The efficiency of these survivors in dealing with the Evil God Altar is too slow.
At this moment, Shen Yun seemed to notice the concern in Han Xing’s heart and said, "Brother Xing, should we negotiate with them to let us have this Evil God Altar?"
Han Xing nodded, "Let me handle it."
Then, he directly opened the regional channel and spoke.
"Greetings, human compatriots in this area, I am Star River."
Since the Blood Tide began, this name has been well-known.
Seeing Han Xing’s message.
For a moment, the combat rhythm of the millions of survivors slowed down a bit.
Now is a special period, Han Xing did not elaborate further and got straight to the point.
"Fellow compatriots, I see you are dealing with this altar, but the progress is slow, wasting too much time may cause unforeseen changes."
"Why don’t you let me have this Evil God Altar?"
Hearing Han Xing’s straightforward words, the crowd was also taken aback.
If it were any ordinary person asking them to give up the battlefield, no one would agree.
After all, it’s like underestimating one’s own power.
But since the person speaking is Star River, there’s no argument.
Currently, the videos about Han Xing circulating on forums are very popular.
Even though almost half a month has passed, the scene of the Thunderbolt Tower in action still leaves a deep impression.
Perhaps in Star River’s eyes, their speed of a million people is indeed quite slow.
At this moment, a bald knight stepped forward and said, "Now is the time of life and death for humanity, destroying an altar reduces risk significantly."
"If the Star God can destroy the altar with thunderous means, it will also be a contribution to all humankind."
"Star God, please proceed!"
He seemed to be the leader of this team.
At this time, other survivors chimed in one after another.
"Star God, go ahead."
"We’ve only seen it in videos before, never witnessed the Star God in action in person!"
"Yes, Star God, show us your power!"
The crowd looked expectantly at Han Xing.
At this time, the bald knight said, "Star God, do you need us to continue dealing with the monsters as cover for you?"
He meant to coordinate with Han Xing to destroy this Evil God Altar together.
At the current stage, most survivors’ understanding of Han Xing’s power was still from half a month ago.
However, what they didn’t know was.
During this period, Han Xing’s power had undergone a tremendous transformation!
Han Xing directly said, "No need, I can resolve the battle quickly."
"Then, I’ll need you to stay and clean up the aftermath."
Hearing Han Xing’s strange statement, the survivors felt puzzled.
After all, even the most powerful forces needed at least half a day to destroy an altar.
No matter how strong Star River is, he has to deal with the outside monsters first to get close to the altar, right?
However, Han Xing didn’t respond.
The next moment.
He directly activated sixty Hellfire Missile Silos from his territory.
Boom! Boom boom boom!
A dull sound of breaking through the air was heard.
Under the puzzled gazes of the crowd, dozens of burning flames shot into the sky!
And then, they witnessed an unforgettable scene.
The Hellfire, shooting upwards from dozens of kilometers away, fell straight into the middle of the horde.
Boom! Rumble rumble!
Massive mushroom clouds rose, stirring strong winds that sent these survivors on Sky Island swaying wildly.
The eerie green flames seemed to occupy every line of sight, making everyone involuntarily close their eyes.
And when they recovered their sight, they all gasped!
"Hiss..."
"This... this is terrifying, isn’t it?
"Am I not dreaming?"
Not only were the Blood Tide Monsters stunned by the explosion, but the millions of survivors were also dumbfounded!
They had never seen such an overwhelming scene in their lives!
The previously dense Blood Tide.
With this wave of bombing, a huge vacuum area appeared right in the middle.
Tens of millions of Blood Tide Monsters, along with the hidden Lords and Dominators, including the Evil God Altar, were all wiped out!
A complete cleanup in one go!
This kind of power, reminiscent of a nuclear explosion, is it really something humans can possess?
All survivors looked towards the Sky Island with incredulous eyes, even with a hint of fear.
At this moment, Han Xing, upon hearing the system prompt, also had a pleased expression.
Then, he said directly on the local network, "The altar has been destroyed, I now need to make haste to the next location."
"Thank you all, until we meet again."
Saying this, Han Xing headed towards the next region without looking back.
At this moment, the survivors finally reacted.
A moment later, the bald knight’s throat moved with difficulty.
"Star God... he’s truly a man who continuously frightens us."
Beside him, a human warrior also agreed, "Yes, it feels like the Star God is on a completely different level from us."
"So overpowering..."
Now, shortly after Han Xing’s departure.
The Blood Tide, having been bombed, scattered and fled.
The group of survivors then saw the monsters.
At this time, everyone’s eyes lit up.
The horde is now leaderless, these monsters are the best to kill.
If they can eliminate them all, it’s battle merit in millions!
If it were any other team, they would not let go of such a great opportunity to kill all the Blood Tide Monsters and convert them into battle merit.
However, Han Xing didn’t even look back, he just turned and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 199: Clan Annihilation Crisis and a Race Against Death! (Part 2)
paragraphs: It’s equivalent to giving them tens of millions of battle merits.
At this moment, everyone couldn’t help but sigh.
The Star God is such a great person!
Tens of millions of battle merits are just given up.
In an instant, all the survivors rushed forward, attacking the chaotic Blood Tide monsters.
At this moment, beside the bald leader, a human warrior said, "Boss, shouldn’t we make a move? That’s tens of millions of battle merits!"
However, the leader next to him slapped the man on the head, angrily scolding, "Damn it, what time is it, and you’re still thinking about battle merits?"
"Don’t you see how many people on the chat channel are asking for support?"
"I don’t care what other teams are doing."
"But here at Xuanya Pavilion, everyone must think of the bigger picture!"
"Now, hurry up and get the brothers to adjust their state and prepare to help our fellow humans who are dealing with the Evil God Altar."
This man, having been slapped, had a somewhat aggrieved look in his eyes.
But he also knew that his leader was right.
So, he rubbed his head and immediately began to execute the order.
Meanwhile, Han Xing continued to sprint wildly, with Xingyu City advancing at full speed!
And while moving, the defense towers on Xingyu City continued to unleash firepower, attacking the Blood Tide monster masses encountered along the way.
Bombarding all the way, countless monsters fell under the artillery fire.
At this moment, Shen Yun constantly monitored the information on the chat channel.
Combining the coordinates released by survivors, then selecting the nearest location to report to Han Xing.
"Brother Xing, there is an Evil God Altar at 41222, 96331, 74455!"
"It’s about 1400 kilometers away from us; at full speed, it will take about ten minutes."
Han Xing nodded and said, "Good!"
With that, the entire Sky Island immediately changed direction, rushing towards the coordinate location at full speed.
Ever since Han Xing completed his third transformation and advancement, the speed of the Territory Core has also skyrocketed.

The permanent movement speed of the Sky Island had already broken through the 1500-kilometer barrier, and with the push of the Territory Core Accelerator, it reached an astonishing speed of over 4500 kilometers per hour!
Moreover, in these ten days, Han Xing had leveled up 3 more times.
Now, his personal level had reached level 33, and Xingyu City’s maximum speed had also surpassed 5000 kilometers.
Ten minutes later.
Han Xing had already arrived at a spot just over forty kilometers from the target area.
From such a distant location, even with Han Xing’s eyesight, he could only vaguely see the altar’s position in the center of the monster masses.
However, this did not hinder the aiming of the Hellfire missile silo.
To prevent any accidents from happening.
Han Xing directly activated all the Hellfire missile silos on the territory, sending a wave of bombardment.
Rumble!
Eighty-five groups of ghastly green flames shot into the sky.
Two seconds later.
Everyone’s vision went white at the same time.
After a dull explosion, they knew the battle was already declared over.
Meanwhile, a system notification appeared.
"Successfully destroyed the Evil God Altar, gained Battle Merit * 100000, gained Sacred Artifact Fragment * 10, Alternate Space Evil God Mark layering +1."
"Successfully killed Dominator-level creature: Evil God’s Intestines, gained Battle Merit * 50000, gained Sacred Artifact Fragment * 5."
There was a long string of other notifications as well.
But Han Xing ignored them all.
As long as these two notifications appeared, the others were simply irrelevant.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
And directly controlled Xingyu City.
Continuing to rush towards the next location.
Just as Han Xing and the others left.
In the distance, over a hundred large-scale Sky Islands joined together, coming over in a mighty fleet.
However, before they even arrived, they saw the scene of the Evil God Altar having already been destroyed.
Millions of survivors looked at each other, seemingly puzzled by which team acted so swiftly.
Meanwhile, survivors around the world entered the final war state.
All at once, war broke out, and the sound of battle was incessant.
At such a critical juncture, all survivors, including the commanders, took out their hidden treasures.
They utilized all the Secret Elixirs and special items accumulated, just to speed up the advancement a little.
Including the precious Curse of the Evil God Antidote, which was being used without hesitation.
Fifteen hours later.
Survivors worldwide looked at those two numbers, worry spreading across their faces.
[Remaining Altar Count]: 41.
[Evil God Commander’s Arrival Time]: 10 hours 12 minutes...
In 15 hours, humans globally had destroyed 56 altars.
This speed really wasn’t slow anymore.
One must know, previously they advanced steadily, and in a full twenty-four hours, at most, they could only destroy more than thirty altars.
Now, efficiency had doubled, almost squeezing out everyone’s potential!
But even so, the figure 41 still exerted heavy pressure on everyone.
Because only the last ten hours remained!
Yet at this moment, a system notice tightened everyone’s hearts even more.
Announcement: "Attention all survivors!"
"The Evil God Commander is a Legendary Level creature. With humanity’s current power, the hope of victory is very slim."
"Please speed up the progress and destroy all Evil God Altars, otherwise, humanity faces the threat of extinction today!"
After hearing the system’s near-solemn warning, everyone felt a heavy pressure envelop their hearts.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui, the commander of the Divine Hall, was commanding the team of survivors, attacking an altar.
Gazing at the countdown in front of him, his eyes fell into contemplation.
Nearby the Divine Hall’s Sky Island, there were a few slightly smaller Sky Island forces, cooperating in attacking the Evil God Altar.
After a moment, Chen Da Chui exhaled slowly, and said on the team channel of the Divine Hall.
"Did everyone hear the system notice?"
"In the last ten hours, if we don’t smash all the Evil God Altars, today humanity is most likely finished."
Throughout the Divine Hall, millions of survivors fighting nodded with difficulty.
Their eyes carried the same despair and pessimism.
However, at this moment, Chen Da Chui cursed: "But, damn it, I don’t believe it, nor do I accept it!"
"Humanity has undergone countless existential crises since its inception."
"Yet, even so, life has relentlessly evolved. Humanity has been reborn after every crisis, even rising to the top of the food chain!"
"Even in this world, the Human Race remains the spirit of all things!"
"Want to destroy the Human Race? First, ask if I agree!"
In the next moment, Chen Da Chui, disregarding everything, controlled the massive Sky Island, plunging fiercely into the monster masses!
The battle situation instantly entered a tense moment, with a vast number of monsters enveloping them in a blink.
"Catapult, we need catapult firepower coverage here!"
"There are too many monsters; we can’t break through the defense line to destroy the altar!"
Once he finished speaking, at least a hundred catapults in the sky poured firepower down here.
The area ahead was cleared completely.
The Divine Hall’s Sky Island seized the opportunity to advance several hundred meters with difficulty once again.
However, more monsters surged forward at this time.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui stood atop the Sky Island, commanding.
"Don’t worry about those ordinary monsters; leave them to other teams!"
"Those with Curse Antidote, don’t hold back or hide; quickly consume it. If you survive, report to me for reimbursement!"
"Our task is to destroy this altar at all costs!"
With that said, the Divine Hall’s Sky Island resolutely plunged into the monster masses.
Seeing this, the other survivors also had a determined look in their eyes.
"Damn it, we’re going too!"
"Charge with the commander! Even if we die, we must tear open the monster mass defense line and win an opportunity for the brothers behind!"
All humans entered the final frenzy stage!
They did not know how terrifying the Legendary Level monsters were.
They only knew that when the time ended.
Every additional altar would birth an unimaginable terrifying existence, causing terrible damage to humans.
And all of humanity would face extinction because of it!
Han Xing, on his side, also unconsciously sped up.
At this moment, everyone on Xingyu City was breathing heavily, each with a tense look watching the five individuals.

"Humanity has undergone countless existential crises since its inception."
"Yet, even so, life has relentlessly evolved.
Humanity has been reborn after every crisis, even rising to the top of the food chain!"
"Even in this world, the Human Race remains the spirit of all things!"
"Want to destroy the Human Race?
First, ask if I agree!"
In the next moment, Chen Da Chui, disregarding everything, controlled the massive Sky Island, plunging fiercely into the monster masses!
The battle situation instantly entered a tense moment, with a vast number of monsters enveloping them in a blink.
"Catapult, we need catapult firepower coverage here!"
"There are too many monsters; we can’t break through the defense line to destroy the altar!"
Once he finished speaking, at least a hundred catapults in the sky poured firepower down here.
The area ahead was cleared completely.
The Divine Hall’s Sky Island seized the opportunity to advance several hundred meters with difficulty once again.
However, more monsters surged forward at this time.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui stood atop the Sky Island, commanding.
"Don’t worry about those ordinary monsters; leave them to other teams!"
"Those with Curse Antidote, don’t hold back or hide; quickly consume it.
If you survive, report to me for reimbursement!"
"Our task is to destroy this altar at all costs!"
With that said, the Divine Hall’s Sky Island resolutely plunged into the monster masses.
Seeing this, the other survivors also had a determined look in their eyes.
"Damn it, we’re going too!"
"Charge with the commander!
Even if we die, we must tear open the monster mass defense line and win an opportunity for the brothers behind!"
All humans entered the final frenzy stage!
They did not know how terrifying the Legendary Level monsters were.
They only knew that when the time ended.
Every additional altar would birth an unimaginable terrifying existence, causing terrible damage to humans.
And all of humanity would face extinction because of it!
Han Xing, on his side, also unconsciously sped up.
At this moment, everyone on Xingyu City was breathing heavily, each with a tense look watching the five individuals.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 200: World’s Number One, Chen Da Chui!
paragraphs: The final ten hours, with forty-one altars remaining.
Time was becoming more and more pressing.
And Han Xing, holding his breath, bombarded relentlessly with Hellfire all the way!
Later, when he saw an Evil God Altar, even if there was already a survivor army nearby launching an attack.
He would not hesitate to strike!
No matter what, destroy the altar first!
In fifteen hours, Han Xing had destroyed 25 altars, almost half of humanity’s total!
Yet despite this, just as Han Xing destroyed the thirty-first Evil God Altar.
Shen Yun reminded at this moment: "Brother Xing, there’s not enough time."
Han Xing frowned upon hearing this.
He looked at the two numbers before him.
[Number of Evil God Altars]: 29.
[Time until Evil God’s Arrival]: 7 hours and 02 minutes...
"7 hours... there’s still a chance!"
"Charge with me!"
Even though hope was slim, everyone still wouldn’t give up.
Han Xing couldn’t help but clench his fist and rush to the next location.
By now, all of humanity had been through at least eighteen hours of high-intensity combat!
Everyone felt their nerves stretched to the limit.
But at this time, no one dared to rest, not even a moment of relaxation!
Everyone gritted their teeth, exerting every last bit of potential from their bodies!
On the side of the Divine Hall.
Under the leadership of their leader, Chen Da Chui.
Over a million survivors, at the cost of six hundred thousand deaths, finally charged near the altar in just three hours!
Now, they were finally clearing the last obstacle before destroying the altar.
And that was the Dominator!
However, because too many survivors in the team had died.
They could no longer execute effective tactics against Dominator Level creatures.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui roared fiercely, splitting a Leader Monster in front of him in half, blood splattering everywhere.
Yet he saw, in the sky, waves of Blood Tide Monsters, seeming to have gone mad, all rushing into the survivor army for self-destruct attacks!
Pop! Pop! Pop pop pop!
Like flowers of ominous fate blooming.
The blood energy, stained with a terrifying curse, contaminated the nearby survivors.
Tens of thousands of survivors watched as the layers of Blood Curse skyrocketed on their status bars!
In no time, it broke through the 10-layer limit.
At this level, even the Purification of the Holy Profession no longer worked.
Moreover, the Blood Curse Antidote in everyone’s hands was almost exhausted.
So many people were cursed, it was impossible to save them all immediately.
At this moment, a young boy was overwhelmed with terror, watching his skin decay, crying in despair.
"Boo hoo hoo... I’m going to die..."
"Dad, I’m so scared, save me!"
Beside him, a middle-aged man was also on his knees, roaring in unwilling anger.
"Damn it! I’m not accepting this! I won’t accept it!!"
"I’d rather die than become that kind of monster!"
Yet, no matter how unwilling or angry they were.
They could only watch as comrades who once fought side by side turned into those terrifying monsters.
In the next moment, those monsters lost their reason, glaring with blood-red eyes, all pouncing at them.
The survivors stepped back one step.
They knew, the other side was no longer their comrades and friends, but Blood Tide Monsters that must be quickly eliminated.
However, looking at those twisted yet somewhat familiar faces.
For a moment, they couldn’t bring themselves to strike.
But those monsters didn’t care, they had lost their reason, charging into the crowd to start a massacre.
In an instant, the sounds of screams and slaughter were continuous.
At this moment, a burly figure descended from the sky.
A giant axe slashed across horizontally, slicing a dozen monsters in half!
Chen Da Chui glared and cursed: "Move it! What the hell are you all dazing for?"
The other survivors were stunned for a moment, not expecting their leader to be so decisive.
After all, these were comrades who fought alongside them!
However, as they exchanged glances, they saw the red, swollen eyes of Chen Da Chui.
The next moment, everyone froze, then suppressed the pain in their hearts, venting their grief and anger on that group of monsters!
Nevertheless, Dominator Level creatures weren’t easy targets.
It understood that it absolutely couldn’t let this group of humans approach the altar now!
Hundreds of thousands of Blood Tide Monsters, as if imbued with a layer of Bloodthirsty Buff, fearlessly charged the Sky Island of the Divine Hall.
No matter how fiercely they resisted, they could only watch helplessly as their team members dwindled continuously.
One after another, vibrant lives perished in the siege of the monster horde.
Even those who had just completed the First Transformation were involved in the fight.
In just half an hour, another 300,000 survivors died under the onslaught of the monster horde.
Such horrific casualty rates, indicating the severity of the battle!
The entire Sky Island seemed to be drenched in a blood rain, littered with mutilated corpses.
Blood constantly flowed down the edges of the Sky Island, literally rivers of blood.
A few dozen minutes.
The number of survivors in the Divine Hall has dwindled to less than 200,000.
The look in everyone’s eyes has shifted from despair to numbness.
The death of too many family and friends has left their hearts ashen.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui also seems to realize that if things continue like this, even if everyone in the Divine Hall is sacrificed here, they won’t achieve their goal.
In the next moment, Chen Da Chui shouted loudly, "Brothers, we have reached the final step."
"We absolutely cannot let the sacrifices of other brothers be in vain!"
"The Dominator level creature, I’ll deal with it, no matter what, you must destroy the Evil God Altar!"
In the shocked eyes of the crowd.
They suddenly saw a potion emanating starlight appear in Chen Da Chui’s hand, seemingly containing some powerful force.

[Blood of the Mad God Secret Elixir]: An ultimate secret elixir containing a drop of divine blood. After consuming, the survivor’s all attributes will soar to the current limit, and they’ll possess a portion of the mad god’s divine power.
Note: Life forms below the Legendary Level are strictly prohibited from consuming this elixir, otherwise they’ll burst and die after the effect ends!
However, at this moment, Chen Da Chui didn’t care about the side effects mentioned!
He only wants to take down this Dominator, at any cost!
In the next moment, in front of everyone, Chen Da Chui drank the potion in one gulp.
Everyone just felt.
A breath from the barbaric wilderness suddenly burst from Chen Da Chui’s body.
At this moment, his body swelled to three meters tall, with his entire being inflated to a muscular monster by the furious power!
Even the Dominator level creature in the distance felt a trace of threatening aura from him.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui instantly leaped, shooting out like a cannonball.
Boom! Boom boom!
Compared to the thousand-meter size of the Dominator, Chen Da Chui’s three-meter-tall body seemed so small.
However, it was this tiny human who, at this moment, was wielding a giant axe, causing the Dominator level creature to howl in pain.
Thud! Thud thud!
Every axe strike could take away a large chunk of the Dominator’s flesh, spraying blood everywhere!
The Dominator level monster was being completely suppressed by the rampaging Chen Da Chui.
At this moment, other team members also saw an opportunity.
"Brothers, the captain has created an opportunity for us, follow me!"
As the words fell, the Divine Hall’s Sky Island once again charged towards the altar with a resolute stance against the blood tide monsters!
Everyone’s eyes were filled with the determination to die; they had just one goal left in their eyes.
Destroy the altar!
The blood tide monsters also went mad, rushing recklessly into the survivors with bared teeth and claws.
The casualty rate soared once more.
Every hundred meters advanced saw thousands of corpses added to the Sky Island.
Some were monsters, some were humans.
The catapults and arrow towers on the territory were also being destroyed one after another.
Finally, the Divine Hall’s Sky Island was now less than a hundred meters from the Evil God Altar!
This distance was already within the attack range of most survivors.
The defense value of the Evil God Altar had been focused on and reduced to less than 50,000.
However, the once million-strong force now had less than fifty thousand remaining.
The surviving survivors had resolute eyes.
They knew that even if they destroyed this altar, they would be overwhelmed by the blood tide monsters, leaving none behind.
At this moment, a team member, with a sobbing tone, shouted.
"Captain, do you see it?"
"We’re about to succeed, we’ve done it!"
At this moment, Chen Da Chui, who was fighting a life-and-death battle in the air with the Dominator, also heard the voices of the team members.
A gratified smile appeared on his lips as he loudly responded,
"I see it!"
"You all are damn brave men!"
"Today, I’ll let everyone see the heroic demeanor of our Divine Hall brothers!"
As the words fell, he activated the live broadcast recording function, directly uploading the video here to the chat channel.
Then, Chen Da Chui, while violently slaughtering the Dominator, arrogantly said in the chat channel.
"Everyone!"
"Watch closely, our Divine Hall brothers took just three hours to reach the vicinity of the Evil God Altar, and we’re about to blow up the altar."
"This is the third altar we’ve destroyed today!"
"What Huayi Alliance, Kunlun, Immortal Mansion, none of them compare to us, hahaha!"
The crowd heard Chen Da Chui’s arrogant laughter and also saw the current tragic state on the Divine Hall’s Sky Island.
Mountains of corpses and seas of blood, one in a hundred surviving.
For a moment, it moved everyone deeply.
At this moment, Chen Da Chui suddenly felt his blood stirring within.
He knew that the potion’s effect was nearing its limit.
And when the time ended, the terrifying side effects would take his life directly.
However, there was no fear of facing death in Chen Da Chui’s eyes, only a strong confidence.
He shouted in the chat channel.
"Zhou Huang, Boundless, watch closely!"
"Today, I’m going to kill the Dominator! And then blow up this third altar!"
"Looking at your dilly-dallying, I’m not even going to talk about those overseas rubbish teams, but I didn’t expect your Huayi Alliance and Kunlun to be so useless!"
"So long, still wandering near the second altar."
"In view of this, I, Chen Da Chui, truly am the number one person in the world!"
"Zhou Huang, Boundless, just a bunch of trash!"
"Star River is not as good as me either, hahahahahaha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 201: I’m So High Right Now!!!
paragraphs: In the midst of his wild laughter, Chen Da Chui, right before self-destructing, mustered all his strength to swing a colossal axe!
Then, everyone saw that the Dominator Level creature was chopped in half by this axe.
Its massive body plummeted from the sky.
After a few seconds.
Under the watchful eyes of humans around the globe.
The number of Evil God Altars decreased by one more.
The Divine Hall succeeded.
But the cost was, the team that once ranked third in Hua Country, became history today.
Over a million survivors were buried in the endless Blood Tide.
The chat channel plunged into silence.
Moments later, Zhou Huang sighed inside.
"Director Chen, a modern-day heroic figure too!"
Everyone was deeply moved.
Zhou Huang was not angry at Chen Da Chui’s final mockery.
However, the directors of ’King’s Game’ and ’Great Britain’ took Chen Da Chui’s final words to heart.
Even though they knew Chen Da Chui said it on purpose to provoke everyone.
But anyone looked down upon like that would feel indignant!
At this moment, Anderson’s face twitched with rage and he shouted, "Damn, it’s just three altars, acting as if they destroyed thirty, so arrogant!"
"As if it’s only you Hua Country survivors who aren’t afraid of death!"
"Damn! We originally wanted to conserve some strength until the disaster ended."
"Now, King’s Game, everyone move!"
"This guy dares to look down on us, today, we must show them!"
"Our Russian Union Zone brothers aren’t afraid of death!"
At this time, survivors from various union zones heard Chen Da Chui’s final mockery.
A simmering anger inside them urgently needed to be unleashed!
Everyone in the chat channel loudly responded.
"Charge!"
"Even if it costs our lives today, we must destroy some altars to show them!"
"Brothers of the Hand of God, let’s take down these monsters!"
"Great Britain, charge!"
At this moment, Boundless was directing his survivor subordinates and other allied forces in an orderly advance.
He seemed to be spurred by Chen Da Chui’s death as well, and in the next moment, a sinister smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
"One by one, we’re not kids in our teens anymore, yet so fired up with passion..."
"You Chen Da Chui, killed a mere Dominator and dared to insult me as useless?"
Next moment, Boundless looked at the million-strong team and solemnly asked.
"Brothers, it seems the Divine Hall looked down on us, what do you say we do now?"
The team members were silent for a moment, then loudly shouted in unison.
"Kill!"
Boundless felt the surging war intent in their hearts, and a smile emerged again at the corner of his mouth.
"Good, then let’s kill!"
In the next moment, under the shocked gaze of other alliance teams.
They saw Kunlun’s vast Sky Island suddenly accelerate and charge unhesitatingly into the endless blood clouds.
At this moment, Boundless put on the Gargoyle Mask again, leading the charge.
The whole person leaped up and rushed into the monster horde.
He knew what was most troublesome here and had to solve it as quickly as possible.
Otherwise, Kunlun would follow in the footsteps of the Divine Hall.
In the endless blood clouds.
A humanoid figure exuding astonishing blood aura shuttled back and forth among the monster horde.
Boundless was repeatedly heavily wounded along the way, but he could instantly recover by absorbing the blood aura contained in the Blood Tide!
For him, the Blood Tide didn’t seem to be a curse but became some kind of nourishment.
Like a dragon entering the water, surging waves!
In the next moment, Boundless finally found the hidden Dominator Level creature amid the endless blood clouds.
A smile appeared at the corner of Boundless’s mouth.
"Chen Da Chui was also a waste, a mere Dominator forced him to self-destruct along with so many at the Divine Hall."
"Today, I’ll kill a Dominator to show you!"
In the next moment, Boundless rushed directly and engaged in close combat with the Dominator Level monster!
Even if each attack from the Dominator Level monster took away large chunks of flesh from him causing serious wounds.
Boundless could recover immediately each time.
And the more he fought, the more intense the madness in Boundless’s eyes became.
He was so excited in the air that he shivered all over.
"Interesting! So interesting!"
"Is this the true power of a Dominator Level monster?"
"I’m really on a high!!!"
In the next moment, Boundless’s figure flashed, and just as the monster opened its enormous mouth, he charged directly into the Dominator Level monster’s body!
Four hours later.
Humans worldwide looked once more at the two numbers before them.
[Remaining Altars]: 14.
[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 2 hours 57 minutes...
Under the relentless efforts of countless survivors, unhesitant, this began to surge!
"Brothers, victory is just ahead!"
"Only 14 altars left, hold on!"
Yet, despite this, the casualties in various places reached a terrifying number.
At this time, a survivor named Fang Zhicheng shouted in the chat channel.
"All human compatriots! I am Fang Zhicheng, the Director of Comet Society!"
"Our alliance is about to be wiped out, the Blood Tide Monsters here have been more than half cleared by us, and the Dominator Level creature is also at its last gasp!"
"Please, all nearby humans, hurry to the coordinates to pick up where we left off; we must not fail at the final step!"
"We will hold on as long as possible until you arrive, even if we fight to the last person, Comet Society will never retreat!"
Fang Zhicheng is sacrificing the lives of the survivors in his team, determined to destroy an altar.
This moves all of humanity.
"Director Fang, please hold on, we are on our way!"
"That’s right, humanity will not squander your sacrifice!"
Billions of people worldwide are once again bursting forth with astounding power.
Survivor Sky Islands, like human bombs, charge fearlessly into the Blood Tide.
Countless teams perish amidst the monster hordes in these few hours of frenzied assaults.
Not everyone can succeed like Chen Da Chui, who exchanges life for victory.
More teams end in failure.
Whether defeated by monster hordes or Dominator-level creatures’ terrifying power.
However, as long as a small fraction succeeds, it is humanity’s victory!
These individuals, through their sacrifice, finally carve a path of hope within the endless Blood Tide!
This is humanity’s anthem, a song of blood and courage!
Boom! Boom boom!
Hellfire is rampaging wildly.
Wave after wave of monsters are obliterated.
The cries of living beings, the roar of flames.
Han Xing has reached a numb state in his killing!
He continuously fires Hellfire.
Mushroom clouds rise, and upon hearing the system prompt, he turns and leaves without hesitation.
In the next two hours...
Countless survivors charge forward, unflinching and fearless.
Altars are pulled down and destroyed one after another.
Finally, after two hours, they see hope!
At this moment, only three altars remain.
Less than half an hour remains.
Everyone simultaneously tenses up, asking in the chat channel.
"Quick! Where are the last three altars? I’m going to blow them up!"
"The Ace Suicide Squad is ready!"
Humankind has fought until red-eyed, no matter the sacrifice, they will not allow a failed effort!
Just then, someone replies in the chat channel: "The locations of the three altars are all exposed, and they’re currently being dealt with."
"Everyone, you can rest assured."
Upon hearing this, everyone sighed in relief.
It’s as if the huge stone blocking their chest has been slightly moved.
But they are still anxious, fearing some last-minute mishap.
So, they all ask in the chat.
"Which team is handling those three altars? Do they need support?"
Again, someone replies in the chat channel.
"Huayi Alliance, King’s Game, Great Britain."
Upon hearing these names, everyone is momentarily stunned.
No need to mention Huayi Alliance, their formidable strength is well-known.
King’s Game and Great Britain, as emerging forces among foreign survivors.
Their ranks contain millions of Second Transformation survivors, and with their alliance teams, they’re quite strong.
Handling an Evil God Altar should not be a problem.
The question is, can they finish the battle in the last half hour?
At this time, Zhou Huang directly uses administrative privileges to say in the chat channel: "Huayi Alliance is about to finish the battle and destroy the altar!"
"How about our comrades at the other two places? Do you need support? Please respond quickly!"
Soon, someone sends a message in the public chat channel.
"King’s Game has no issues, can definitely take down the altar in half an hour!"
"Great Britain also has no issues."
Hearing replies from both sides, everyone relaxed significantly.
At this crucial moment for human survival, these people do not dare to brag for pride.
Otherwise, they would be eternal sinners!
Indeed.
Ten minutes later.
Huayi Alliance sends the good news that their side has finished the battle.
Everyone witnesses the remaining altar count drop from 3 to 2, simultaneously exhaling deeply.
Meanwhile, in the Russian Zone’s King’s Game and European Zone’s Great Britain, they’re unwilling to be outdone.
They also finish the battle within five minutes, one after another.
Under the watch of over forty billion pairs of eyes.
Now, those two strings of numbers turn into.
[Evil God Altar Remaining]: 0
[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 14 minutes 32 seconds...
Worldwide, everyone’s taut nerves relax at the same time.
Then, countless people faint on the spot.
They are exhausted.
At this time, other survivors are expressing emotions in the chat channel.
"It’s finally over... It was too hard!"
"Yeah, it was so difficult..."
"Old Chen, did you see this? Your sacrifice wasn’t in vain, this time, we’ve won..."
Talking about this, countless people shed tears.
During the tense life-or-death countdown, even when faced with the death of loved ones, everyone had to suppress their grief.

sentences.text: In the midst of his wild laughter, Chen Da Chui, right before self-destructing, mustered all his strength to swing a colossal axe!
Then, everyone saw that the Dominator Level creature was chopped in half by this axe.
Its massive body plummeted from the sky.
After a few seconds.
Under the watchful eyes of humans around the globe.
The number of Evil God Altars decreased by one more.
The Divine Hall succeeded.
But the cost was, the team that once ranked third in Hua Country, became history today.
Over a million survivors were buried in the endless Blood Tide.
The chat channel plunged into silence.
Moments later, Zhou Huang sighed inside.
"Director Chen, a modern-day heroic figure too!"
Everyone was deeply moved.
Zhou Huang was not angry at Chen Da Chui’s final mockery.
However, the directors of ’King’s Game’ and ’Great Britain’ took Chen Da Chui’s final words to heart.
Even though they knew Chen Da Chui said it on purpose to provoke everyone.
But anyone looked down upon like that would feel indignant!
At this moment, Anderson’s face twitched with rage and he shouted, "Damn, it’s just three altars, acting as if they destroyed thirty, so arrogant!"
"As if it’s only you Hua Country survivors who aren’t afraid of death!"
"Damn!
We originally wanted to conserve some strength until the disaster ended."
"Now, King’s Game, everyone move!"
"This guy dares to look down on us, today, we must show them!"
"Our Russian Union Zone brothers aren’t afraid of death!"
At this time, survivors from various union zones heard Chen Da Chui’s final mockery.
A simmering anger inside them urgently needed to be unleashed!
Everyone in the chat channel loudly responded.
"Charge!"
"Even if it costs our lives today, we must destroy some altars to show them!"
"Brothers of the Hand of God, let’s take down these monsters!"
"Great Britain, charge!"
At this moment, Boundless was directing his survivor subordinates and other allied forces in an orderly advance.
He seemed to be spurred by Chen Da Chui’s death as well, and in the next moment, a sinister smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
"One by one, we’re not kids in our teens anymore, yet so fired up with passion..."
"You Chen Da Chui, killed a mere Dominator and dared to insult me as useless?"
Next moment, Boundless looked at the million-strong team and solemnly asked.
"Brothers, it seems the Divine Hall looked down on us, what do you say we do now?"
The team members were silent for a moment, then loudly shouted in unison.
"Kill!"
Boundless felt the surging war intent in their hearts, and a smile emerged again at the corner of his mouth.
"Good, then let’s kill!"
In the next moment, under the shocked gaze of other alliance teams.
They saw Kunlun’s vast Sky Island suddenly accelerate and charge unhesitatingly into the endless blood clouds.
At this moment, Boundless put on the Gargoyle Mask again, leading the charge.
The whole person leaped up and rushed into the monster horde.
He knew what was most troublesome here and had to solve it as quickly as possible.
Otherwise, Kunlun would follow in the footsteps of the Divine Hall.
In the endless blood clouds.
A humanoid figure exuding astonishing blood aura shuttled back and forth among the monster horde.
Boundless was repeatedly heavily wounded along the way, but he could instantly recover by absorbing the blood aura contained in the Blood Tide!
For him, the Blood Tide didn’t seem to be a curse but became some kind of nourishment.
Like a dragon entering the water, surging waves!
In the next moment, Boundless finally found the hidden Dominator Level creature amid the endless blood clouds.
A smile appeared at the corner of Boundless’s mouth.
"Chen Da Chui was also a waste, a mere Dominator forced him to self-destruct along with so many at the Divine Hall."
"Today, I’ll kill a Dominator to show you!"
In the next moment, Boundless rushed directly and engaged in close combat with the Dominator Level monster!
Even if each attack from the Dominator Level monster took away large chunks of flesh from him causing serious wounds.
Boundless could recover immediately each time.
And the more he fought, the more intense the madness in Boundless’s eyes became.
He was so excited in the air that he shivered all over.
"Interesting!
So interesting!"
"Is this the true power of a Dominator Level monster?"
"I’m really on a high!!!"
In the next moment, Boundless’s figure flashed, and just as the monster opened its enormous mouth, he charged directly into the Dominator Level monster’s body!
Four hours later.
Humans worldwide looked once more at the two numbers before them.
[Remaining Altars]: 14.
[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 2 hours 57 minutes...
Under the relentless efforts of countless survivors, unhesitant, this began to surge!
"Brothers, victory is just ahead!"
"Only 14 altars left, hold on!"
Yet, despite this, the casualties in various places reached a terrifying number.
At this time, a survivor named Fang Zhicheng shouted in the chat channel.
"All human compatriots!
I am Fang Zhicheng, the Director of Comet Society!"
"Our alliance is about to be wiped out, the Blood Tide Monsters here have been more than half cleared by us, and the Dominator Level creature is also at its last gasp!"
"Please, all nearby humans, hurry to the coordinates to pick up where we left off; we must not fail at the final step!"
"We will hold on as long as possible until you arrive, even if we fight to the last person, Comet Society will never retreat!"
Fang Zhicheng is sacrificing the lives of the survivors in his team, determined to destroy an altar.
This moves all of humanity.
"Director Fang, please hold on, we are on our way!"
"That’s right, humanity will not squander your sacrifice!"
Billions of people worldwide are once again bursting forth with astounding power.
Survivor Sky Islands, like human bombs, charge fearlessly into the Blood Tide.
Countless teams perish amidst the monster hordes in these few hours of frenzied assaults.
Not everyone can succeed like Chen Da Chui, who exchanges life for victory.
More teams end in failure.
Whether defeated by monster hordes or Dominator-level creatures’ terrifying power.
However, as long as a small fraction succeeds, it is humanity’s victory!
These individuals, through their sacrifice, finally carve a path of hope within the endless Blood Tide!
This is humanity’s anthem, a song of blood and courage!
Boom!
Boom boom!
Hellfire is rampaging wildly.
Wave after wave of monsters are obliterated.
The cries of living beings, the roar of flames.
Han Xing has reached a numb state in his killing!
He continuously fires Hellfire.
Mushroom clouds rise, and upon hearing the system prompt, he turns and leaves without hesitation.
In the next two hours...
Countless survivors charge forward, unflinching and fearless.
Altars are pulled down and destroyed one after another.
Finally, after two hours, they see hope!
At this moment, only three altars remain.
Less than half an hour remains.
Everyone simultaneously tenses up, asking in the chat channel.
"Quick!
Where are the last three altars?
I’m going to blow them up!"
"The Ace Suicide Squad is ready!"
Humankind has fought until red-eyed, no matter the sacrifice, they will not allow a failed effort!
Just then, someone replies in the chat channel: "The locations of the three altars are all exposed, and they’re currently being dealt with."
"Everyone, you can rest assured."
Upon hearing this, everyone sighed in relief.
It’s as if the huge stone blocking their chest has been slightly moved.
But they are still anxious, fearing some last-minute mishap.
So, they all ask in the chat.
"Which team is handling those three altars?
Do they need support?"
Again, someone replies in the chat channel.
"Huayi Alliance, King’s Game, Great Britain."
Upon hearing these names, everyone is momentarily stunned.
No need to mention Huayi Alliance, their formidable strength is well-known.
King’s Game and Great Britain, as emerging forces among foreign survivors.
Their ranks contain millions of Second Transformation survivors, and with their alliance teams, they’re quite strong.
Handling an Evil God Altar should not be a problem.
The question is, can they finish the battle in the last half hour?

"How about our comrades at the other two places?
Do you need support?
Please respond quickly!"
Soon, someone sends a message in the public chat channel.
"King’s Game has no issues, can definitely take down the altar in half an hour!"
"Great Britain also has no issues."
Hearing replies from both sides, everyone relaxed significantly.

Otherwise, they would be eternal sinners!
Indeed.
Ten minutes later.
Huayi Alliance sends the good news that their side has finished the battle.
Everyone witnesses the remaining altar count drop from 3 to 2, simultaneously exhaling deeply.
Meanwhile, in the Russian Zone’s King’s Game and European Zone’s Great Britain, they’re unwilling to be outdone.
They also finish the battle within five minutes, one after another.
Under the watch of over forty billion pairs of eyes.

[Evil God Commander Arrival Time]: 14 minutes 32 seconds...
