They are exhausted.
At this time, other survivors are expressing emotions in the chat channel.
"It’s finally over...
It was too hard!"
"Yeah, it was so difficult..."
"Old Chen, did you see this?
Your sacrifice wasn’t in vain, this time, we’ve won..."
Talking about this, countless people shed tears.
During the tense life-or-death countdown, even when faced with the death of loved ones, everyone had to suppress their grief.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 202: Battle Lost, Nightmare Descends...
paragraphs: Now, humans worldwide came to their senses.
They suddenly realized.
That within those twenty-plus hours.
They lost so many of their compatriots.
At least a billion survivors.
In the final clash of life and death, they sacrificed their lives.
It was precisely their sacrifice that allowed more people to survive.
The names of these sacrifices will forever be remembered in the history of the Human Race.
However, what puzzled everyone was that even after the number of altars became 0.
The countdown to the arrival of the Evil God Commander below continued slowly.
"What’s going on? Why is that countdown still going?"
Finally, someone asked this question.
However, other survivors looked at each other, as they also didn’t know the reason.
They could only offer comfort with words.
"I don’t know, the system hasn’t given any prompts."
"I reckon that when the countdown ends, it’ll just disappear?"
There was some logic to what this person said.
After all, up to now, the system hasn’t given any relevant prompts.
Despite this, everyone had a bad premonition in their hearts...
And at this moment.
In some unknown corner of the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
A Dominator Level creature with twisted limbs, full of various hairs and nails.
Followed the guidance in its heart, arriving at a certain area.
It seemed to have already fallen into a serious injury state, with blood continuously flowing from its body.
In front of this Dominator Level creature, a barren Sky Island appeared.
This Sky Island looked like a desert terrain, with nothing on it.
However, the Dominator Level creature’s body trembled, and a terrifying blood energy surged.
The sand on the entire Sky Island was blown away.
A moment later, above the Sky Island, a pool filled with cracks and already dried up appeared.
If other survivors were here, they would definitely recognize it.
This pool, although somewhat worn out, looked exactly like an Evil God Altar.
The Dominator Level creature seemed to have predicted this.
And this was its purpose.
In an unknown corner.
The Dominator Level creature’s body suddenly swelled, instantaneously expanding from its original kilometer length to nearly ten kilometers.
Like an enlarged version of a sausage balloon, it seemed to reach a certain limit and exploded with a roar!
Crash!
The sky started to fall with red blood rain at this moment.
The rain mixed with various flesh tissues and unknown liquids.
All mixed and poured into the Blood Pool.
Simultaneously, in just a few seconds, this Blood Pool underwent an astonishing transformation!
From previously lifeless to revitalized.
The surface of the Blood Pool began to churn continuously.
Burble—
Burble—
Meanwhile, more and more Blood Tide Monsters sprang out like a geyser!
Next moment.
Under the terrified gaze of humans worldwide.
They witnessed firsthand.
The number of Evil God Altars suddenly jumped from 0 to 1!
This bright red number instantly pierced the eyes of everyone.
A sensational storm arose among the billions of humans!
They never expected that the Evil God Altars that had been wiped clean.
For some unknown reason, increased by one.
No one had anticipated this.
Even Han Xing and Zhou Huang didn’t expect it.
Survivors wailed one after another.
"Damn it! Can someone tell me what the hell is going on?"
"It’s over, completely over now!"
"Once the Evil God Commander descends, humanity is done for!"
"Brother, father, you died in vain...
The entire chat channel was shrouded in a pessimistic atmosphere.
But at this moment, one survivor said: "Hell with it, saying it’s over, isn’t there only 1 altar left?"
"No matter how strong that Evil God Commander is, it’s just one, even if we pile up lives, we can kill it!"
However, this person’s words didn’t receive the populace’s agreement.
When an individual’s mighty power reaches a certain height, it’s not solvable by sheer numbers anymore.
No matter how many ants there are, they cannot shake an elephant.
Even taking a step back, assuming it can be shaken.
How much sacrifice would humanity have to make for this?
Tens of millions? Or billions?
These aren’t simple numbers; they represent lives, one after another.
Moreover, previously in order to eliminate those hundred Evil God Altars, a large number of brave warriors already died.
If more die, it would really be a severe blow to the race’s energy, possibly leading to extinction!
Humans worldwide were enveloped by an oppressive aura.
The chat channel fell into rare silence.
Including Zhou Huang, for a moment, couldn’t say any comforting words.
At this moment, a survivor sighed: "Forget it, let’s give up."
"You’ve all done your best, it’s not that we didn’t try hard enough, it’s just that the enemy is too powerful."
"Yeah, we really tried our best."
"If humanity is destined to perish, at least we have fought."
And at this moment, a familiar name appeared and said solemnly.
"Everyone, now move collectively!"
"Try to explore nearby, find the location of the last Evil God Altar!"
"Then report to me immediately!"
"There’s still time now, please everyone do not give up!"
The speaker’s ID was Star River.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, the public chat channel fell silent for a moment,
Then, however, nobody responded.
Because now there’s just not enough time left, even rushing wouldn’t be enough.
Even if the Evil God Altar is found, what difference does it make, the Evil God Commander’s arrival is already a foregone conclusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 202: Battle Lost, Nightmare Descends...
paragraphs: At this moment, a survivor named Wang Beihuan said, "Star God, you’ve done enough. We’ve all seen it; you’ve destroyed dozens of altars along the way."
"Without you, humanity would be in even greater danger this time."
The other survivors also echoed, "Yeah, give up, Star God. Everyone will remember your contribution."
However, Han Xing directly said.
"Stop talking nonsense, act immediately!
"Even if that so-called Evil God Commander descends, I’ll handle it!"
"But I need your help!"
After Han Xing finished speaking, the entire chat channel went silent again for a moment.
Then, a survivor cautiously asked.
"Star God, do you mean you are confident you can deal with the Evil God Commander?"
Everyone looked at the chat channel simultaneously, seemingly also awaiting Han Xing’s answer!
Then Han Xing directly replied, "No."
"But without confidence, should we just sit still and die?"
"Should we just watch the Otherworldly Evil God descend and then let it destroy us one by one?"
"There is still a chance now!"
"As long as you give me a little time, I’m sure I can blow up the Evil God Altar!"
Han Xing’s words rekindled hope among the survivors.
Everyone, without prior agreement, began to take action.
The remaining over four billion survivors and tens of millions of Sky Islands began to dash through the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
The final thirteen minutes of life-and-death speed!
Global humanity started to take action.
Han Xing could only leave it to fate at this moment.
If the altar was close enough to his position, he would have the chance to destroy it before the countdown ended!
If that terrifying existence appeared after the countdown was over.
He wouldn’t avoid it either.
After all, he was undeniably the strongest in the Human Race right now.
If he ran away, it would mean leaving the remaining humans to deal with such a terrible creature.
And when humanity’s core power was exhausted.
Eventually, it would inevitably be Han Xing’s turn.
So, no matter what, Han Xing would confront this Evil God Commander.
It would be better to face it while it just emerged, before it caused significant damage to humanity, and engage in a hard fight!
Meanwhile.
Global survivors were also frantically searching for the last altar’s whereabouts.
Time kept slipping away.
Three minutes later.
The time for the Evil God Commander’s arrival was drawing closer.
Han Xing’s heart was growing heavier as well.
This meant that the opponent’s arrival into this world was already a set fact.
Unless this altar happened to appear near Han Xing and was discovered by him and destroyed by airdrop immediately.
But this was obviously impossible!
Finally, in the last seven minutes.
A survivor finally shouted in the chat channel!
"I see it! There’s a terrifying monster tide ahead, numbering over a million!"
"And new monsters keep appearing, so many!"
After hearing this person’s description, everyone realized that he had likely discovered the location of the last altar.
So they all shouted, "Report the coordinates! Quickly!"
The next moment, the survivor posted a string of numbers in the chat channel.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and others had their expressions tighten.
Because they also saw the location of those coordinates.
It was very far from them, over eight hundred kilometers.
Even at full speed, it would take at least nine minutes.
However, the remaining countdown now only had seven minutes left...
Doing a quick calculation in their hearts, everyone knew it was already too late.
For a moment, panic gripped everyone.
Han Xing glanced around at everyone, a thoughtful look in his eyes, not sure what he was thinking.
But at that moment, Shen Yun seemed to see through Han Xing’s thoughts and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, let’s move."
"Don’t worry about us, and don’t think about moving us away first and facing the threat of the Evil God Commander alone."
"We will not let you go alone!"
Shen Yun said earnestly.
Cheng Jianyong, hearing this, also seemed to realize something, and his face showed shock.
"No way, Brother Xing, are you really planning to do that?"
"I’m telling you, whatever you do, we’ll follow you, but don’t think about ditching us!"
Beside them, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, upon hearing this, also looked at him firmly.
Seeing this, Han Xing knew that everyone’s minds were made up.
He didn’t try to make a sentimental speech.
Because the five of them had experienced life-and-death camaraderie by now.
If Han Xing died for it, they wouldn’t be willing to survive alone.
This was the tacit understanding among them.
A moment later, Han Xing chuckled lightly and said, "Alright, then let’s go together!"
"To hell with the Evil God Commander!"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong exchanged a glance, then laughed and shouted.
"Alright, to hell with the Evil God Commander!"
As for those relatives, at this time, Han Xing had no time to seek each of their opinions.
The next moment, Xingyu City charged with full force.
They nearly plowed through everything in their path.
As the scenery sped past, Han Xing’s eyes showed a trace of apprehension and a trace of excitement.
He couldn’t help but lick the corner of his mouth.
"Damn, never thought, in the end, we’d still have to face a Legendary Level creature..."
"I hope that the war fortress I’ve painstakingly created over the past couple of months can actually damage the Legendary Creatures!"
A few minutes later.
The countdown had reached the last thirty seconds.
Since Han Xing said that sentence, he hadn’t spoken again in the chat channel.
The survivors had no idea what was happening on Han Xing’s end, or even if he had reached there.
At this time, some survivors had already despaired.
"What’s going on over there with Star God, only thirty seconds left, it’s totally too late, right?"
"Yeah, Star God isn’t talking, he might have seen that he can’t make it and ran away, right?"
"Possible, after all, that’s a monster above the Dominator level, anyone who goes would be sent to their death."
However, at this moment, some loyal supporters of Han Xing scolded, "Shut up, didn’t you hear Star God say? Even if the Evil God Commander finally comes out, he’ll take care of it!"
"Yeah, what are you all chattering about here?"
"You bunch of guys, while Star God fights at the front, you’re back here questioning him. In modern times, you’d be outright traitors!"
"I’ve memorized your names. Once humanity survives this crisis, I’ll be sure to give you trouble!"
Hearing the threat, the group who just questioned Han Xing hurriedly defended themselves.
"No, no no! That’s not what I meant, I was saying, perhaps Star God needs help over there..."
"Yes! That’s what I thought too!"
"I truly meant nothing else!"
Nonetheless, Han Xing did not have the leisure to pay attention to the chat channel now, and was advancing at full speed.
A few minutes later.
In the distance, everyone could already see a patch of red light ahead.
That was the location of the Evil God Altar.
Everyone couldn’t help but clench their fists.
Now, the countdown was at the final ten seconds.
At this speed, it was completely too late for them.
Even so.
Han Xing still did not slow down.
Because from the start, he was ready to face the Legendary Creatures head-on.
At this point, there was no way he’d back down!
When the ten-second countdown ended.
The system prompt appeared.
"Time’s up, the action to prevent the Evil God Commander’s descent failed..."
"All survivors, please note, the Evil God Commander is a Legendary Level creature, whose personal Mighty Power far exceeds the Human Race’s bearing limit."
"Don’t think of fighting it, please escape the Land of the Abandoned Gods as soon as possible, and strive to preserve the last ember of the Human Race."
"Humans, this is your last chance..."
The system’s prompt had a despairing tone.
Making everyone, including Han Xing, feel a heaviness settle in their hearts.
Even the system said there was no hope for humanity to win.
This meant that the strength of the Legendary Creatures was far beyond everyone’s imagination!
Previously, they said they would use numbers to pile up against the Evil God Commander, but now, it seemed entirely impossible.
At this moment, people couldn’t help but wonder.
Could Star River really handle that Evil God Commander?

We’ve all seen it; you’ve destroyed dozens of altars along the way."
"Without you, humanity would be in even greater danger this time."
The other survivors also echoed, "Yeah, give up, Star God.
Everyone will remember your contribution."
However, Han Xing directly said.
"Stop talking nonsense, act immediately!
"Even if that so-called Evil God Commander descends, I’ll handle it!"
"But I need your help!"
After Han Xing finished speaking, the entire chat channel went silent again for a moment.
Then, a survivor cautiously asked.
"Star God, do you mean you are confident you can deal with the Evil God Commander?"
Everyone looked at the chat channel simultaneously, seemingly also awaiting Han Xing’s answer!
Then Han Xing directly replied, "No."
"But without confidence, should we just sit still and die?"
"Should we just watch the Otherworldly Evil God descend and then let it destroy us one by one?"
"There is still a chance now!"
"As long as you give me a little time, I’m sure I can blow up the Evil God Altar!"
Han Xing’s words rekindled hope among the survivors.
Everyone, without prior agreement, began to take action.
The remaining over four billion survivors and tens of millions of Sky Islands began to dash through the Land of the Abandoned Gods!
The final thirteen minutes of life-and-death speed!
Global humanity started to take action.
Han Xing could only leave it to fate at this moment.
If the altar was close enough to his position, he would have the chance to destroy it before the countdown ended!
If that terrifying existence appeared after the countdown was over.
He wouldn’t avoid it either.
After all, he was undeniably the strongest in the Human Race right now.
If he ran away, it would mean leaving the remaining humans to deal with such a terrible creature.
And when humanity’s core power was exhausted.
Eventually, it would inevitably be Han Xing’s turn.
So, no matter what, Han Xing would confront this Evil God Commander.
It would be better to face it while it just emerged, before it caused significant damage to humanity, and engage in a hard fight!
Meanwhile.
Global survivors were also frantically searching for the last altar’s whereabouts.
Time kept slipping away.
Three minutes later.
The time for the Evil God Commander’s arrival was drawing closer.
Han Xing’s heart was growing heavier as well.
This meant that the opponent’s arrival into this world was already a set fact.
Unless this altar happened to appear near Han Xing and was discovered by him and destroyed by airdrop immediately.
But this was obviously impossible!
Finally, in the last seven minutes.
A survivor finally shouted in the chat channel!
"I see it!
There’s a terrifying monster tide ahead, numbering over a million!"
"And new monsters keep appearing, so many!"
After hearing this person’s description, everyone realized that he had likely discovered the location of the last altar.
So they all shouted, "Report the coordinates!
Quickly!"
The next moment, the survivor posted a string of numbers in the chat channel.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and others had their expressions tighten.
Because they also saw the location of those coordinates.
It was very far from them, over eight hundred kilometers.
Even at full speed, it would take at least nine minutes.
However, the remaining countdown now only had seven minutes left...
Doing a quick calculation in their hearts, everyone knew it was already too late.
For a moment, panic gripped everyone.
Han Xing glanced around at everyone, a thoughtful look in his eyes, not sure what he was thinking.
But at that moment, Shen Yun seemed to see through Han Xing’s thoughts and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, let’s move."
"Don’t worry about us, and don’t think about moving us away first and facing the threat of the Evil God Commander alone."
"We will not let you go alone!"
Shen Yun said earnestly.
Cheng Jianyong, hearing this, also seemed to realize something, and his face showed shock.
"No way, Brother Xing, are you really planning to do that?"
"I’m telling you, whatever you do, we’ll follow you, but don’t think about ditching us!"
Beside them, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, upon hearing this, also looked at him firmly.
Seeing this, Han Xing knew that everyone’s minds were made up.
He didn’t try to make a sentimental speech.
Because the five of them had experienced life-and-death camaraderie by now.
If Han Xing died for it, they wouldn’t be willing to survive alone.
This was the tacit understanding among them.
A moment later, Han Xing chuckled lightly and said, "Alright, then let’s go together!"
"To hell with the Evil God Commander!"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong exchanged a glance, then laughed and shouted.
"Alright, to hell with the Evil God Commander!"
As for those relatives, at this time, Han Xing had no time to seek each of their opinions.
The next moment, Xingyu City charged with full force.
They nearly plowed through everything in their path.
As the scenery sped past, Han Xing’s eyes showed a trace of apprehension and a trace of excitement.
He couldn’t help but lick the corner of his mouth.
"Damn, never thought, in the end, we’d still have to face a Legendary Level creature..."
"I hope that the war fortress I’ve painstakingly created over the past couple of months can actually damage the Legendary Creatures!"
A few minutes later.
The countdown had reached the last thirty seconds.
Since Han Xing said that sentence, he hadn’t spoken again in the chat channel.
The survivors had no idea what was happening on Han Xing’s end, or even if he had reached there.
At this time, some survivors had already despaired.
"What’s going on over there with Star God, only thirty seconds left, it’s totally too late, right?"
"Yeah, Star God isn’t talking, he might have seen that he can’t make it and ran away, right?"
"Possible, after all, that’s a monster above the Dominator level, anyone who goes would be sent to their death."
However, at this moment, some loyal supporters of Han Xing scolded, "Shut up, didn’t you hear Star God say?
Even if the Evil God Commander finally comes out, he’ll take care of it!"
"Yeah, what are you all chattering about here?"
"You bunch of guys, while Star God fights at the front, you’re back here questioning him.
In modern times, you’d be outright traitors!"
"I’ve memorized your names.
Once humanity survives this crisis, I’ll be sure to give you trouble!"
Hearing the threat, the group who just questioned Han Xing hurriedly defended themselves.
"No, no no!
That’s not what I meant, I was saying, perhaps Star God needs help over there..."
"Yes!
That’s what I thought too!"
"I truly meant nothing else!"
Nonetheless, Han Xing did not have the leisure to pay attention to the chat channel now, and was advancing at full speed.
A few minutes later.
In the distance, everyone could already see a patch of red light ahead.
That was the location of the Evil God Altar.
Everyone couldn’t help but clench their fists.
Now, the countdown was at the final ten seconds.
At this speed, it was completely too late for them.
Even so.
Han Xing still did not slow down.
Because from the start, he was ready to face the Legendary Creatures head-on.
At this point, there was no way he’d back down!
When the ten-second countdown ended.
The system prompt appeared.
"Time’s up, the action to prevent the Evil God Commander’s descent failed..."
"All survivors, please note, the Evil God Commander is a Legendary Level creature, whose personal Mighty Power far exceeds the Human Race’s bearing limit."
"Don’t think of fighting it, please escape the Land of the Abandoned Gods as soon as possible, and strive to preserve the last ember of the Human Race."
"Humans, this is your last chance..."
The system’s prompt had a despairing tone.
Making everyone, including Han Xing, feel a heaviness settle in their hearts.
Even the system said there was no hope for humanity to win.
This meant that the strength of the Legendary Creatures was far beyond everyone’s imagination!
Previously, they said they would use numbers to pile up against the Evil God Commander, but now, it seemed entirely impossible.
At this moment, people couldn’t help but wonder.
Could Star River really handle that Evil God Commander?
